entries.description: This element specifies the settings for line numbering to be displayed before each column of text in this section in the document.

attributes.name: countBy
attributes.title: Line Number Increments to Display
attributes.description: Specifies the line number increments to be displayed in the current document.

attributes.name: distance
attributes.title: Distance Between Text and Line Numbering
attributes.description: Specifies the distance between the text margin and the edge of any line numbers appearing in that section.

attributes.name: restart
attributes.title: Line Numbering Restart Setting
attributes.description: Specifies when the line numbering in this section shall be reset to the line number specified by the start attribute's value.

attributes.name: start
attributes.title: Line Numbering Starting Value
attributes.description: Specifies the starting value used for the first line whenever the line numbering is restarted by use of the restart attribute.

entries.name: paperSrc
entries.title: Paper Source Information
entries.description: This element specifies printer-specific settings for the printer tray(s) that shall be used to print different pages in this section in the document.

attributes.name: first
attributes.title: First Page Printer Tray Code
attributes.description: Specifies a printer-specific code that uniquely identifies a specific printer tray to be used to print the first page of this section in the document.

attributes.name: other
attributes.title: Non-First Page Printer Tray Code
attributes.description: Specifies a printer-specific code that uniquely identifies a specific printer tray to be used to print the each subsequent (non-first) page of this section in the document.

entries.name: pgBorders
entries.title: Page Borders
entries.description: This element specifies the page borders for each page in this section. Each child element of the pgBorders element specifies a specific of border (left, right, bottom, or top).

attributes.name: display
attributes.title: Pages to Display Page Borders
attributes.description: Specifies the pages in this section on which the page border shall be printed.

attributes.name: offsetFrom
attributes.title: Page Border Positioning
attributes.description: Specifies how the relative positioning of the page borders shall be calculated.

attributes.name: zOrder
attributes.title: Z-Ordering of Page Border
attributes.description: Specifies whether the page border is positioned above or below intersecting texts and objects in this document.

entries.name: pgMar
entries.title: Page Margins
entries.description: This element specifies the page margins for all pages in this section.

attributes.name: bottom
attributes.title: Page Bottom Spacing
attributes.description: Specifies the distance (in twentieths of a point) between the bottom of the text margins for the main document and the bottom of the page for all pages in this section.

attributes.name: footer
attributes.title: Spacing to Bottom of Footer
attributes.description: Specifies the distance (in twentieths of a point) from the bottom edge of the page to the bottom edge of the footer.

attributes.name: gutter
attributes.title: Page Gutter Spacing
attributes.description: Specifies the page gutter for each page in the current section.

attributes.name: header
attributes.title: Spacing to Top of Header
attributes.description: Specifies the distance (in twentieths of a point) from the top edge of the page to the top edge of the header.

attributes.name: left
attributes.title: Left Margin Spacing
attributes.description: Specifies the distance (in twentieths of a point) between the left edge of the page and the left edge of the text extents for this document.

attributes.name: right
attributes.title: Right Margin Spacing
attributes.description: Specifies the distance (in twentieths of a point) between the right edge of the page and the right edge of the text extents for this document.

attributes.name: top
attributes.title: Top Margin Spacing
attributes.description: Specifies the distance (in twentieths of a point) between the top of the text margins for the main document and the top of the page for all pages in this section.

entries.name: pgNumType
entries.title: Page Numbering Settings
entries.description: This element specifies the page numbering settings for all page numbers that appear in the contents of the current section.

attributes.name: chapSep
attributes.title: Chapter Separator Character
attributes.description: Specifies the separator character that shall appear between the chapter and page number, if a chapter style has been set for page numbers in this section.

attributes.name: chapStyle
attributes.title: Chapter Heading Style
attributes.description: Specifies the one-based index of the heading style applied to chapter titles in the document which shall be used as chapter headings in all page numbers for this section, by locating the nearest heading of that style and extracting the numbering information.

attributes.name: fmt
attributes.title: Page Number Format
attributes.description: Specifies the number format that shall be used for all page numbering in this section.

attributes.name: start
attributes.title: Starting Page Number
attributes.description: Specifies the page number that appears on the first page of the section.

entries.name: pgSz
entries.title: Page Size
entries.description: This element specifies the properties (size and orientation) for all pages in the current section.

attributes.name: code
attributes.title: Printer Paper Code
attributes.description: Specifies an optional value which can be used to store an identifier for the current paper size.

attributes.name: h
attributes.title: Page Height
attributes.description: Specifies the height (in twentieths of a point) for all pages in the current section.

attributes.name: orient
attributes.title: Page Orientation
attributes.description: Specifies the orientation of all pages in this section.

attributes.name: w
attributes.title: Page Width
attributes.description: This attribute indicates the width (in twentieths of a point) for all pages in the current section.

entries.name: printerSettings
entries.title: Reference to Printer Settings Data
entries.description: This element specifies an explicit relationship to a Printer Settings part containing information about the printer settings used for this section. If this element is omitted, than no additional settings are associated with this section.

entries.name: rtlGutter
entries.title: Gutter on Right Side of Page
entries.description: This element specifies that the page gutter shall be placed on the right side of the page for this section only. The page gutter defines the amount of extra space added to the specified margin, above any existing margin values.

entries.name: sectPr
entries.title: Document Final Section Properties
entries.description: This element defines the section properties for the final section of the document. [Note: For any other section the properties are stored as a child element of the paragraph element corresponding to the last paragraph in the given section. end note]

attributes.description: Specifies a unique identifier used to track the editing session when the section mark for this section was deleted from the document.

entries.name: type
entries.title: Section Type
entries.description: This element specifies the section type of the current section. The section type specifies how the contents of the current section shall be placed relative to the previous section. WordprocessingML supports five distinct types of section breaks:  Next page section breaks (the default if type is not specified), which begin the new section on the following page.  Odd page section breaks, which begin the new section on the next odd-numbered page.  Even page section breaks, which begin the new section on the next even-numbered page.  Continuous section breaks, which begin the new section on the following paragraph.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Section Type Setting
attributes.description: Specifies the section type of the current section.

entries.name: vAlign
entries.title: Vertical Text Alignment on Page
entries.description: This element specifies the vertical alignment for text on pages in the current section, relative to the top and bottom margins in the main document story on each page.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Vertical Alignment Setting
attributes.description: Specifies the vertical alignment for text between the top and bottom margins of the parent container (page or table cell).

entries.name: aliases
entries.title: Alternate Style Names
entries.description: This element specifies the set of alternative names for the parent style definition. These names can be used in an application's user interface as desired. The alternate names shall be stored in this element's val attribute, and each name shall be separated by one or more consecutive comma characters (Unicode character value 002C).

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: String Value
attributes.description: Specifies that its contents contain a string.

entries.name: autoRedefine
entries.title: Automatically Merge User Formatting Into Style Definition
entries.description: This element specifies whether an application shall automatically modify this style when the contents of an entire paragraph in the document with this style applied are modified, ensuring that although only a single instance of text with this style was modified, that change is stored on the style and therefore propagated to all locations where the style is in use. If this element is omitted, then formatting shall not automatically be merged back into the style definition.

entries.name: basedOn
entries.title: Parent Style ID
entries.description: This element specifies the style ID of the parent style from which this style inherits in the style inheritance. The style inheritance refers to a set of styles which inherit from one another to produce the resulting set of properties for a single style. The val attribute of this element specifies the styleId attribute for the parent style in the style inheritance.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: String Value
attributes.description: Specifies that its contents contain a string.

entries.name: hidden
entries.title: Hide Style From User Interface
entries.description: This element specifies whether this style shall be hidden from any and all user interfaces when this document is loaded by an application. If this element is set, then this style can be used to format content (i.e. any content which references this style shall have its properties as normal), but the style shall be hidden from all user interface associated with that application. [Note: This setting is typically used to hide styles which are being used internally by an application which should not be used as formatting in a typical case. end note] If this element is omitted, then the style shall not be required to be hidden from the user interface.

entries.name: latentStyles
entries.title: Latent Style Information
entries.description: This element specifies the properties which shall be applied to a set of latent styles for this document. Latent styles refer to any set of style definitions known to an application which have not been included in the current document. [Example: Latent styles can include additional styles known by a particular hosting application. end example] When a style definition is embedded in a document, it specifies two distinct groups of properties:  Behavior properties  Formatting properties Obviously, embedding all the styles known to a particular application in each document which it produces would

attributes.name: count
attributes.title: Latent Style Count
attributes.description: Specifies the number of known styles which shall be initialized to the current latent style defaults when this document is first processed.

attributes.name: defLockedState
attributes.title: Default Style Locking Setting
attributes.description: Specifies the default setting for the locked element (§17.7.4.7) which shall be applied to any style made available by the hosting application which is not explicitly defined in the current document.

attributes.name: defQFormat
attributes.title: Default Primary Style Setting
attributes.description: Specifies the default setting for the qFormat element (§17.7.4.14) which shall be applied to any style made available by the hosting application which is not explicitly defined in the current document.

attributes.name: defSemiHidden
attributes.title: Default Semi- Hidden Setting
attributes.description: Specifies the default setting for the semiHidden element (§17.7.4.16) which shall be applied to any style made available by the hosting application which is not explicitly defined in the current document.

attributes.name: ed
attributes.title: Default Hidden Until Used Setting
attributes.description: Specifies the default setting for the unhideWhenUsed element (§17.7.4.20) which shall be applied to any style made available by the hosting application which is not explicitly defined in the current document.

entries.name: link
entries.title: Linked Style Reference
entries.description: This element specifies the pairing of styles which comprise a linked style. A linked style is a grouping of a paragraph style and character style which is used in a user interface to allow the same set of formatting properties to be applied:  To the contents of one or more entire paragraphs (i.e. as a paragraph style)  To the contents of one or more runs within a paragraph (i.e. as a character style) Each style continues to exist independently in the file format as there is both a paragraph and character style present within the styles element (§17.7.4.18), however these two styles shall be merged into one and applied

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: String Value
attributes.description: Specifies that its contents contain a string.

entries.name: locked
entries.title: Style Cannot Be Applied
entries.description: This element specifies whether an application shall prevent the use of this style when this document is loaded and/or modified. If this element is set, then this style can be used to format existing content (i.e. any content which references this style shall have its properties as normal), but new instances of the style shall be prevented from being applied via all mechanisms associated with that application. If this element is omitted, then the use of the style shall not be prevented by an application processing this document.

entries.name: lsdException
entries.title: Latent Style Exception
entries.description: This element specifies the properties which shall be applied a single latent style for this document. Latent styles refer to any set of known style definitions which have not been included in the current document.

attributes.name: locked
attributes.title: Latent Style Locking Setting
attributes.description: Specifies the default setting for the locked element (§17.7.4.7) which shall be applied to the latent style with the matching style name value.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Primary Style Name
attributes.description: Specifies the primary name for the style which shall inherit this set of latent style property exceptions.

attributes.name: qFormat
attributes.title: Latent Style Primary Style Setting
attributes.description: Specifies the default setting for the qFormat element (§17.7.4.14) which shall be applied to the latent style with the matching style name value.

attributes.name: semiHidden
attributes.title: Semi hidden text override
attributes.description: Specifies the default setting for the semiHidden element (§17.7.4.16) which shall be applied to the latent style with the matching style name value.

attributes.name: uiPriority
attributes.title: Override default sorting order
attributes.description: Specifies the default setting for the uiPriority element (§17.7.4.19) which shall be applied to the latent style with the matching style name value.

attributes.name: unhideWhenUsed
attributes.title: Unhide when used
attributes.description: Specifies the default setting for the unhideWhenUsed element (§17.7.4.20) which shall be applied to the latent style with the matching style name value.

entries.name: name
entries.title: Primary Style Name
entries.description: This element specifies the primary name for the current style in the document. This name can be used in an application's user interface as desired. The actual primary name for this style is stored in its val attribute.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: String Value
attributes.description: Specifies that its contents contain a string.

entries.name: next
entries.title: Style For Next Paragraph
entries.description: This element specifies the style which shall automatically be applied to a new paragraph created following a paragraph with the parent paragraph style applied. [Note: This setting is typically used when the use of the current style is limited to one paragraph at most, and it would typically be undesirable to apply this style to following paragraphs - for example, a title style might specify that its following paragraphs must return to regular text formatting. end note] If this element is specified on a style of any style type other than a paragraph style, this element shall be ignored. If no style whose styleId matches the val attribute of this element exists or that style is not a paragraph

attributes.name: val

entries.description: This element specifies that the parent style, when in use in the context of an e-mail message, was used by default to format all message text from one or more users. [Note: This setting does not provide any additional semantic about the style, but can be used in the context of e-mail to automatically reformat the contents of the e-mail message while ignoring any content to which styles were deliberately applied (since this style was implicitly applied to message text without user interaction). end note] If this element is specified on a style of any style type other than a character style, this element shall be ignored.

entries.name: personalCompose

entries.description: This element specifies that the parent style, when in use in the context of an e-mail message, can be used by default to format new message text within the e-mail message.
