entries.name: ST_BrClear
entries.title: Line Break Text Wrapping Restart Location
entries.description: This simple type specifies the set of possible restart locations which can be used as to determine the next available line when a break’s type attribute has a value of textWrapping. This property only affects the restart location when the current run is being displayed on a line which does not span the full text extents due to the presence of a floating object (see enumeration values for details).

values.name: all
values.title: Restart On Next Full Line
values.description: Specifies that the text wrapping break shall advance the text to the next line in the WordprocessingML document which spans the full width of the line (i.e. the next line which is not interrupted by any floating objects when those objects are positioned on the page at display time.

values.name: left
values.title: Restart In Next Text Region Unblocked on the Left
values.description: Specifies that the text wrapping break shall behave as follows when this line intersects a floating object: If the parent paragraph is left-to-right:  If this is the leftmost region of text flow currently on this line,  If a floating object occurs to the left of the break, advance the text to the next available line that does not have a floating object on the left.  Otherwise, advance the text

values.name: none
values.title: Restart On Next Line
values.description: Specifies that the text wrapping break shall advance the text to the next line in the WordprocessingML document, regardless of its position left to right or the presence of any floating objects which intersect with the line, This is the setting for a typical line break in a document.

values.name: right
values.title: Restart In Next Text Region Unblocked on the Right
values.description: Specifies that the text wrapping break shall behave as follows when this line intersects a floating object: If the parent paragraph is left-to-right:  If the object occurs to the right of the break, advance the text to the next available line that does not have a floating object on the right.  Otherwise, treat this as a text wrapping break of type none.

entries.name: ST_BrType
entries.title: Break Types
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible kinds of break characters in a WordprocessingML document. The break type determines the next location where text shall be placed after this manual break is applied to the text contents (see enumeration values for details).

values.name: column
values.title: Column Break
values.description: Specifies that the current break shall restart itself on the next column available on the current page.

values.name: page
values.title: Page Break
values.description: Specifies that the current break shall restart itself on the next page of the document.

values.name: textWrapping
values.title: Line Break
values.description: Specifies that the current break shall restart itself on the next line in the document The determination of the next line shall be done subject to the value of the clear attribute on the specified break character.

entries.name: ST_CaptionPos
entries.title: Automatic Caption Positioning Values
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible values can be used for the position of an automatically inserted caption on an object within this document. These values specify the position a given caption shall be take relative to the object it is used to label.

values.name: above
values.title: Position Caption Above Object
values.description: Specifies that an automatically inserted caption shall be positioned above the object that it is used to label.

values.name: below
values.title: Position Caption Below Object
values.description: Specifies that an automatically inserted caption shall be positioned below the object that it is used to label.

values.name: left
values.title: Position Caption Left Of Object
values.description: Specifies that an automatically inserted caption shall be positioned to the left of the object that it is used to label (the position where text typed immediately before the object would appear).

values.name: right
values.title: Position Caption Right Of Object
values.description: Specifies that an automatically inserted caption shall be positioned to the right of the object that it is used to label (the position where text typed immediately after the object would appear).

entries.name: ST_ChapterSep
entries.title: Chapter Separator Types
entries.description: This simple type specifies the character which shall be used to separate the chapter number from the page number for page numbers in a given section, when chapter numbers are being displayed.

values.name: colon
values.title: Colon Chapter Separator
values.description: Specifies that a colon character shall be used to separate the chapter number from the page number when page numbers are displayed.

values.name: emDash
values.title: Em Dash Chapter Separator
values.description: Specifies that an em dash character shall be used to separate the chapter number from the page number when page numbers are displayed.

values.name: enDash
values.title: En Dash Chapter Separator
values.description: Specifies that an en dash character shall be used to separate the chapter number from the page number when page numbers are displayed.

values.name: hyphen
values.title: Hyphen Chapter Separator
values.description: Specifies that a non-breaking hyphen character shall be used to separate the chapter number from the page number when page numbers are displayed.

values.name: period
values.title: Period Chapter Separator
values.description: Specifies that a period character shall be used to separate the chapter number from the page number when page numbers are displayed.

entries.name: ST_CharacterSpacing
entries.title: Character-Level Whitespace Compression Settings
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible ways in which full-width characters in the current WordprocessingML document can be compressed to remove additional whitespace when the contents of this document are displayed, specifically by specifying the set(s) of characters which can be compressed to remove additional whitespace.

values.name: compressPunctuation
values.title: Compress Whitespace From Punctuation Characters
values.description: Specifies that only whitespace characters shall have whitespace compression applied to them.

values.name: compressPunctuationAndJapaneseKana
values.title: Compress Whitespace From Both Japanese Kana And Punctuation Characters
values.description: Specifies that whitespace and Japanese kana characters shall have whitespace compression applied to them.

values.name: doNotCompress
values.title: Do Not Compress Whitespace
values.description: Specifies that characters shall not have whitespace compression applied to them.

entries.name: ST_CombineBrackets
entries.title: Two Lines in One Enclosing Character Type
entries.description: This simple type specifies the kind of bracket character which shall be used to enclose the two lines in one text within the current run when displayed

values.name: angle
values.title: Angle Brackets
values.description: Specifies that angle bracket characters shall be used to enclose the contents of the current run’s two lines in one text.

values.name: curly
values.title: Curly Brackets
values.description: Specifies that curly bracket characters shall be used to enclose the contents of the current run’s two lines in one text.

values.name: none
values.title: No Enclosing Brackets
values.description: Specifies that no characters shall be used to enclose the contents of the current run’s two lines in one text.

values.name: round
values.title: Round Brackets
values.description: Specifies that round bracket characters shall be used to enclose the contents of the current run’s two lines in one text.

values.name: square
values.title: Square Brackets
values.description: Specifies that square bracket characters shall be used to enclose the contents of the current run’s two lines in one text.

entries.name: ST_DateTime
entries.title: Standard Date and Time Storage Format
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain a date in the standard XML Schema xsd:dateTime format, whose contents are interpreted based on the context of the parent XML element.

entries.name: ST_DecimalNumber
entries.title: Decimal Number Value
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain a whole decimal number (positive or negative), whose contents are interpreted based on the context of the parent XML element.

entries.name: ST_DecimalNumberOrPercent
entries.title: Percentage Measurement
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents will contain a percentage-based value. See the union's member types for details. This simple type is a union of the following types:  The ST_Percentage simple type (§22.9.2.9).

entries.name: ST_Direction
entries.title: Bidirectional Direction Types
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible values for bidirectional settings within a WordprocessingML document.

values.name: ltr
values.title: Left toRight
values.description: Specifies a left-to-right direction for the property defined by the parent XML element.

values.name: rtl
values.title: Right to Left
values.description: Specifies a right-to-left direction for the property defined by the parent XML element.

entries.name: ST_DisplacedByCustomXml
entries.title: Location of Custom XML Markup Displacing an Annotation
entries.description: an Annotation) This simple type specifies the possible values for the location of a single custom XML element's start and/or end tag relative to the location of an annotation tag in document order. This enumeration shall be used to specify that the parent annotation's placement shall be directly linked with the location of the physical presentation of a custom XML element in the document.

values.name: next
values.title: Displaced by Next Custom XML Markup Tag
values.description: Specifies that this annotation anchor shall be displaced by the physical representation of the next element of custom XML markup in the document.

values.name: prev
values.title: Displaced by Previous Custom XML Markup Tag
values.description: Specifies that this annotation anchor shall be displaced by the physical representation of the previous element of custom XML markup in the document.

entries.name: ST_DocGrid
entries.title: Document Grid Types
entries.description: Specifies the kind of the current document grid, which defines the grid behavior.

values.name: default
values.title: No Document Grid
values.description: Specifies that no document grid shall be applied to the contents of the current section in the document.

values.name: lines
values.title: Line Grid Only
values.description: Specifies that the parent section shall have additional line pitch added to each line within it (as specified on the docGrid element (§17.6.5)) in order to maintain the specified number of lines per page.

values.name: linesAndChars
values.title: Line and Character Grid
values.description: Specifies that the parent section shall have both the additional line pitch and character pitch added to each line and character within it (as specified on the docGrid element (§17.6.5)) in order to maintain a specific number of lines per page and characters per line.

values.name: snapToChars
values.title: Character Grid Only
values.description: Specifies that the parent section shall have both the additional line pitch and character pitch added to each line and character within it (as specified on the docGrid element (§17.6.5)) in order to maintain a specific number of lines per page and characters per line.

entries.name: ST_DocPartBehavior
entries.title: Insertion Behavior Types
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible sets of behaviors which can be applied to the contents of a single glossary document entry (§17.12.5) when it is added to the main document story of a WordprocessingML document.

values.name: content
values.title: Insert Content At Specified Location
values.description: Specifies that when the glossary document entry is inserted into the main document contents of the document, it shall be inserted normally as defined above.

values.name: p
values.title: Ensure Entry Is In New Paragraph
values.description: Specifies that the glossary document entry shall be added into its own unique paragraph, by failing to remove the last paragraph from the entry's contents when they are added to the document.

values.name: pg
values.title: Ensure Entry Is On New Page
values.description: Specifies that the glossary document entry shall be added into its own new page, by preceding the entry with a blank paragraph whose only content is a page break character.

values.name: toolbar
values.title: AutoText User Interface Entry
values.description: Specifies that the type of the current glossary document entry shall be associated with a special grouping of entries associated with a single piece of user interface.

entries.name: ST_DocProtect
entries.title: Document Protection Types
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible set of editing restrictions which can be enforced on a given WordprocessingML document.

values.name: comments
values.title: Allow Editing of Comments
values.description: Specifies that the edits made to this document shall be restricted to:  The insertion and deletion of comments within the document  The editing of regions delimited by range permissions which match the editing rights of the user account which is performing the editing.

values.name: forms
values.title: Allow Editing of Form Fields
values.description: Specifies that the edits made to this document shall be restricted to:  The editing of form fields in sections where the formProt element (§17.6.6) has a value of true.  No restrictions in sections where the formProt element has a value of false.

values.name: none
values.title: No Editing Restrictions
values.description: Specifies that no editing restrictions have been applied to the document.

values.name: readOnly
values.title: Allow No Editing
values.description: Specifies that the edits made to this document shall be restricted to:  The editing of regions delimited by range permissions which match the editing rights of the user account which is performing the editing.

values.name: trackedChanges
values.title: Allow Editing With Revision Tracking
values.description: Specifies that the edits made to this document shall be tracked as revisions.

entries.name: ST_DocType
entries.title: Document Classification Values
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible classifications that can be used for a WordprocessingML document.

entries.name: ST_DropCap
entries.title: Text Frame Drop Cap Location
entries.description: This simple type specifies the location which shall be used to position a drop cap text frame when the contents of that text frame are displayed in the anchor paragraph at display time.

values.name: drop
values.title: Drop Cap Inside Margin
values.description: Specifies that the drop cap text frame shall be positioned inside the text margin on the anchor paragraph when this text frame is displayed in the document.

values.name: margin
values.title: Drop Cap Outside Margin
values.description: Specifies that the drop cap text frame shall be positioned outside of the text margin on the anchor paragraph when this text frame is displayed in the document.

values.name: none
values.title: Not Drop Cap
values.description: Specifies that this text frame is not a drop cap text frame.

entries.name: ST_EdGrp
entries.title: Range Permision Editing Group
entries.description: This simple type specifies the set of possible aliases (or editing groups) which can be used as aliases to determine if the current user shall be allowed to edit a single range defined by a range permission within a document. This mechanism simply provides a set of predefined editing groups which can be associated with user accounts by applications in any desired manner.

values.name: administrators
values.title: Administrator Group
values.description: Specifies that users associated with the Administrators group shall be allowed to edit range permissions using this editing group when document protection is enabled.

values.name: contributors
values.title: Contributors Group
values.description: Specifies that users associated with the Contributors group shall be allowed to edit range permissions using this editing group when document protection is enabled.

values.name: current
values.title: Current Group
values.description: Specifies that users associated with the Current group shall be allowed to edit range permissions using this editing group when document protection is enabled.

values.name: editors
values.title: Editors Group
values.description: Specifies that users associated with the Editors group shall be allowed to edit range permissions using this editing group when document protection is enabled.

values.name: everyone
values.title: All Users Have Editing Permissions
values.description: Specifies that all users that open the document shall be allowed to edit range permissions using this editing group when document protection is enabled.

values.name: none
values.title: No Users Have Editing Permissions
values.description: Specifies that none of the users that open the document shall be allowed to edit range permissions using this editing group when document protection is enabled.

values.name: owners
values.title: Owners Group
values.description: Specifies that users associated with the Owners group shall be allowed to edit range permissions using this editing group when document protection is enabled.

entries.name: ST_EdnPos
entries.title: Endnote Positioning Location
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible positions of endnotes in a document.

values.name: docEnd
values.title: Endnotes Positioned at End of Document
values.description: Specifies that all endnotes shall be placed at the end of the current document, regardless of which section they are referenced within.

values.name: sectEnd
values.title: Endnotes Positioned at End of Section
values.description: Specifies that endnotes shall be placed at the end of the section in which they are referenced.

entries.name: ST_EighthPointMeasure
entries.title: Measurement in Eighths of a Point
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain a positive whole number, whose contents consist of a measurement in eighths of a point (equivalent to 1/576th of an inch). The contents of this measurement are interpreted based on the context of the parent XML element.

entries.name: ST_Em
entries.title: Emphasis Mark Type
entries.description: This simple type specifies an enumerated list of emphasis marks, any one of which may be selected to be applied to each non-space character in a run. When displayed, the position of the emphasis mark relative to the

values.name: circle
values.title: Circle Emphasis Mark
values.description: Specifies that the emphasis mark is a circle.

values.name: comma
values.title: Comma Emphasis Mark
values.description: Specifies that the emphasis mark is a comma.

values.name: dot
values.title: Dot Emphasis Mark
values.description: Specifies that the emphasis mark is a dot.

values.name: none
values.title: No Emphasis Mark
values.description: Specifies that no emphasis mark shall be applied to Enumeration Value Description any characters in the run.

values.name: underDot
values.title: Dot Emphasis Mark Below Characters
values.description: Specifies that the emphasis mark is a dot that shall be rendered below each character in horizontal writing and on the left in vertical writing.

entries.name: ST_FFHelpTextVal
entries.title: Help Text Value
entries.description: This simple type specifies the format of optional help text which can be associated with the parent form field.

entries.name: ST_FFName
entries.title: Form Field Name Value
entries.description: This simple type specifies the format of the name which can be associated with the parent form field.

entries.name: ST_FFStatusTextVal
entries.title: Status Text Value
entries.description: This simple type specifies the format of optional status text which can be associated with the parent form field.

entries.name: ST_FFTextType
entries.title: Text Box Form Field Type Values
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible types of the contents of a text box form field.

values.name: calculated
values.title: Field Calculation
values.description: Specifies that the contents of this text box form field shall be the result of the field calculation specified by the corresponding default element (§17.16.10).

values.name: currentDate
values.title: Current Date Display
values.description: Specifies that the contents of this text box form field shall be the current date when the field is updated.

values.name: currentTime
values.title: Current Time Display
values.description: Specifies that the contents of this text box form field shall be the current time when the field is updated.

values.name: date
values.title: Date
values.description: Specifies that the contents of this text box form field shall be treated as a date.

values.name: number
values.title: Number
values.description: Specifies that the contents of this text box form field shall be treated as a number value.

values.name: regular
values.title: Text Box
values.description: Specifies that this text form field is a plain text field (no additional content restrictions).

entries.name: ST_FldCharType
entries.title: Complex Field Character Type
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible values for the type of a single complex field character in the document.

values.name: begin
values.title: Start Character
values.description: Specifies that the character is a start character, which defines the start of a complex field.

values.name: end
values.title: End Character
values.description: Specifies that the character is an end character, which defines the end of a complex field.

values.name: separate
values.title: Separator Character
values.description: Specifies that the character is a separator character, which defines the end of the field codes and the start of the field result for a complex field.

entries.name: ST_FontFamily
entries.title: Font Family Value
entries.description: This simple type specifies possible values for the font family of a font.

values.name: auto
values.title: No Font Family
values.description: Specifies that information about a font's font family does not exist.

values.name: decorative
values.title: Novelty Font
values.description: Specifies the Novelty font family.

values.name: modern
values.title: Monospace Font
values.description: Specifies a monospace font with or without serifs (monospace fonts are usually modern).

values.name: roman
values.title: Proportional Font With Serifs
values.description: Specifies a proportional font with serifs.

values.name: script
values.title: Script Font
values.description: Specifies a script font designed to mimic the Enumeration Value Description appearance of handwriting.

values.name: swiss
values.title: Proportional Font Without Serifs
values.description: Specifies a proportional font without serifs.

entries.name: ST_FrameLayout
entries.title: Frameset Layout Order
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible order in which the frames (and nested framesets) in a frameset can be displayed. When a frameset is created, it can only contain frames which are stacked in one direction:  Vertically (one on top of another)  Horizontally (one next to another)

values.name: cols
values.title: Stack Frames Horizontally
values.description: Specifies that the frames in the frameset shall be stacked horizontally next to each other in left to right order.

values.name: none
values.title: Do Not Stack Frames
values.description: Specifies that no frames shall be shown in the frameset.

values.name: rows
values.title: Stack Frames Vertically
values.description: Specifies that the frames in the frameset shall be stacked vertically next to each other in top to bottom order.

entries.name: ST_FrameScrollbar
entries.title: Frame Scrollbar Visibility
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible settings for when a scrollbar shall be visible for the contents of the current frame.

values.name: auto
values.title: Automatically Show Scrollbar As Needed
values.description: Specifies that the scrollbar for a frame shall automatically be hidden and/or displayed as needed based on the length of the contents.

values.name: off
values.title: Never Show Scrollbar
values.description: Specifies that the scrollbar for a frame shall always be hidden.

values.name: on
values.title: Always Show Scrollbar
values.description: Specifies that the scrollbar for a frame shall always be Enumeration Value Description displayed (even when not needed).

entries.name: ST_FtnEdn
entries.title: Footnote or Endnote Type
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible types of footnotes and endnotes which can be specified in a WordprocessingML document.

values.name: continuationNotice
values.title: Continuation Notice Separator
values.description: Specifies that this footnote or endnote is a continuation notice footnote or endnote.

values.name: continuationSeparator
values.title: Continuation Separator
values.description: Specifies that this footnote or endnote is a continuation separator footnote or endnote.

values.name: normal
values.title: Normal Footnote/Endnote
values.description: Specifies that this footnote or endnote is a normal footnote or endnote, and can be referenced by main document content.

values.name: separator
values.title: Separator
values.description: Specifies that this footnote or endnote is a separator footnote or endnote.

entries.name: ST_FtnPos
entries.title: Footnote Positioning Location
entries.description: This simple type specifies the position of footnotes in the document.

values.name: beneathText
values.title: Footnotes Positioned Beneath Text
values.description: Specifies that footnotes shall be displayed immediately after the last line of text on the page on which the note reference mark appears.

values.name: docEnd
values.title: Footnotes Positioned At End of Document
values.description: Specifies that all footnotes shall be placed at the end of the current document, regardless of which section they are referenced within.

values.name: pageBottom
values.title: Footnotes Positioned at Page Bottom
values.description: Specifies that footnotes shall be displayed at the bottom margin of the page on which the note reference mark appears.

values.name: sectEnd
values.title: Footnotes Positioned At End of Section
values.description: Specifies that all footnotes shall be placed at the end of the section in which they are referenced.

entries.name: ST_HAnchor
entries.title: Horizontal Anchor Location
entries.description: This simple type specifies the horizontal position to which the parent object has been anchored in the document. This anchor position shall be used as the base location to determine the final horizontal position of the object in the document.

values.name: margin
values.title: Relative To Margin
values.description: Specifies that the parent object shall be horizontally anchored to the text margins.

values.name: page
values.title: Relative to Page
values.description: Specifies that the parent object shall be horizontally anchored to the page edge.

values.name: text
values.title: Relative to Text Extents
values.description: Specifies that the parent object shall be horizontally anchored to the text extents.

entries.name: ST_HdrFtr
entries.title: Header or Footer Type
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible types of headers and footers which can be specified for a given header or footer reference in a document. This value determines the page(s) on which the current header or footer shall be displayed.

values.name: default
values.title: Default Header or Footer
values.description: Specifies that this header or footer shall appear on every page in this section which is not overridden with a specific even or first page header/footer.

values.name: even
values.title: Even Numbered Pages Only
values.description: Specifies that this header or footer shall appear on all even numbered pages in this section (counting from the first page in the section, not the section numbering).

values.name: first
values.title: First Page Only
values.description: Specifies that this header or footer shall appear on the first page in this section.

entries.name: ST_HeightRule
entries.title: Height Rule
entries.description: This simple type specifies the logic which shall be used to calculate the height of the parent object when it is displayed in the document.

values.name: atLeast
values.title: Minimum Height
values.description: Specifies that the height of the parent object shall be at least the value specified, but can be expanded to fit its content as needed.

values.name: auto
values.title: Determine Height Based On Contents
values.description: Specifies that the height of the parent object shall be automatically determined by the size of its contents, with no predetermined minimum or maximum size.

values.name: exact
values.title: Exact Height
values.description: Specifies that the height of the parent object shall be exactly the value specified, regardless of the size of the contents of the object.

entries.name: ST_HexColor
entries.title: Color Value
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain one of the following:  A color values in RRGGBB format (ST_HexColorRGB)  The enumeration value auto (ST_HexColorAuto) The contents of this measurement are interpreted based on the context of the parent XML element.

entries.name: ST_HexColorAuto
entries.title: ‘Automatic’ Color Value
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain the enumeration value auto. This value shall be used to specify an automatically determined color value, the meaning of which is interpreted based on the context of the parent XML element.

values.name: auto
values.title: Automatically Determined Color
values.description: Specifies that the color value can automatically be defined when this document is processed, based on the display context.

entries.name: ST_HighlightColor
entries.title: Text Highlight Colors
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible values for highlighting colors which can be applied as a background behind the contents of a text run.

values.name: black
values.title: Black Highlighting Color
values.description: Specifies that the text highlighting color for this run shall be black.

values.name: blue
values.title: Blue Highlighting Color
values.description: Specifies that the text highlighting color for this run shall be blue.

values.name: cyan
values.title: Cyan Highlighting Color
values.description: Specifies that the text highlighting color for this run shall be cyan.

values.name: darkBlue
values.title: Dark Blue Highlighting Color
values.description: Specifies that the text highlighting color for this run shall be dark blue.

values.name: darkCyan
values.title: Dark Cyan Highlighting Color
values.description: Specifies that the text highlighting color for this run shall be dark cyan.

values.name: darkGray
values.title: Dark Gray Highlighting Color
values.description: Specifies that the text highlighting color for this run shall be dark gray.

values.name: darkGreen
values.title: Dark Green Highlighting Color
values.description: Specifies that the text highlighting color for this run shall be dark green.

values.name: darkMagenta
values.title: Dark Magenta Highlighting Color
values.description: Specifies that the text highlighting color for this run shall be dark magenta.

values.name: darkRed
values.title: Dark Red Highlighting Color
values.description: Specifies that the text highlighting color for this run shall be dark red.

values.name: darkYellow
values.title: Dark Yellow Highlighting Color
values.description: Specifies that the text highlighting color for this run shall be dark cyan.

values.name: green
values.title: Green Highlighting Color
values.description: Specifies that the text highlighting color for this run shall be green.

values.name: lightGray
values.title: Light Gray Highlighting Color
values.description: Specifies that the text highlighting color for this run shall be light gray.

values.name: magenta
values.title: Magenta Highlighting Color
values.description: Specifies that the text highlighting color for this run shall be magenta.

values.name: none
values.title: No Text Highlighting
values.description: Specifies that this text run shall have no text highlighting applied to its contents.

values.name: red
values.title: Red Highlighting Color
values.description: Specifies that the text highlighting color for this run shall be red.

values.name: white
values.title: White Highlighting Color
values.description: Specifies that the text highlighting color for this run shall be white.

values.name: yellow
values.title: Yellow Highlighting Color
values.description: Specifies that the text highlighting color for this run shall be yellow.

entries.name: ST_Hint
entries.title: Font Type Hint
entries.description: This simple type specifies information used to decide how to format any characters in the current run for which the font type is otherwise ambiguous. Certain characters can be mapped into more than one of the font slot categories described in the parent element. This attribute shall be used to determine how ambiguities in this run shall be handled. [Note: This can be used to handle the formatting on the paragraph mark glyph, and other characters that are not stored as text in the WordprocessingML document.

values.name: cs
values.title: Complex Script Font
values.description: Specifies that the font hint for this text run shall be to use the Complex Script font defined for the run via the style hierarchy.

values.name: default
values.title: no font hint
values.description: Specifies that no hint shall apply to this text run.

values.name: eastAsia
values.title: East Asian Font
values.description: Specifies that the font hint for this text run shall be to use the East Asian font defined for the run via the style hierarchy.

entries.name: ST_HpsMeasure
entries.title: Measurement in Half-Points
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain either:  A positive whole number, whose contents consist of a measurement in half-points (equivalent to 1/144th of an inch), or  A positive decimal number immediately followed by a unit identifier. The contents of this measurement are interpreted based on the context of the parent XML element.

entries.name: ST_InfoTextType
entries.title: Help or Status Text Type
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible values for the type of help or status text which can be associated with a form field.

values.name: autoText
values.title: Glossary Document Entry
values.description: Specifies that the value specified by the parent XML element's val attribute shall be interpreted as the name of a glossary document entry whose contents contain the help or status text.

values.name: text
values.title: Literal Text
values.description: Specifies that the value specified by the parent XML element's val attribute shall be interpreted as the literal text for the help or status text.

entries.name: ST_Jc
entries.title: Horizontal Alignment Type
entries.description: This simple type specifies all types of alignment which are available to be applied to objects in a WordprocessingML document.

values.name: both
values.title: Justified
values.description: Specifies that the text shall be justified between both of the text margins in the document.

values.name: center
values.title: Align Center
values.description: Specifies that the text shall be centered on the line between both of the text margins in the document.

values.name: distribute
values.title: Distribute All Characters Equally
values.description: Specifies that the text shall be justified between both of the text margins in the document.

values.name: end
values.title: Align to Trailing Edge
values.description: Specifies that the text shall be aligned on the trailing text margin in the document (right for left-to-right paragraphs; left for right-to-left paragraphs).

values.name: highKashida
values.title: Widest Kashida Length
values.description: Specifies that the kashida length for text in the current paragraph shall be extended to its widest possible length.

values.name: lowKashida
values.title: Low Kashida Length
values.description: Specifies that the kashida length for text in the current paragraph shall be extended to a slightly longer length.

values.name: mediumKashida
values.title: Medium Kashida Length
values.description: Specifies that the kashida length for text in the current paragraph shall be extended to a medium length determined by the consumer.

values.name: numTab
values.title: Align to List Tab
values.description: Specifies that the text shall be aligned to the list tab, which is the tab stop after the numbering for the current paragraph.

values.name: start
values.title: Align To Leading Edge
values.description: Specifies that the text shall be aligned on the leading text margin in the document (left for left-to-right paragraphs; right for right-to-left paragraphs).

values.name: thaiDistribute
values.title: Thai Language Justification
values.description: Specifies that the text shall be justified with an optimization for Thai.

entries.name: ST_JcTable
entries.title: Table Alignment Type
entries.description: This simple type specifies all types of alignment that are available to be applied to tables in a WordprocessingML document.

values.name: center
values.title: Align Center
values.description: Specifies that the table shall be centered on the line between both of the text margins in the document.

values.name: end
values.title: Align to Trailing Edge
values.description: Specifies that the table shall be aligned to the trailing edge of the text flow – the right text margin (for a left- to-right table); or the left text margin (for a right-to- left table) in the document. (See §17.4.1)

values.name: start
values.title: Align to Starting Edge
values.description: Specifies that the table shall be aligned to the leading edge of the text flow – the left text margin (for a left- to-right table); or the right text margin (for a right-to- left table) in the document. (See §17.4.1)

entries.name: ST_LevelSuffix
entries.title: Content Between Numbering Symbol and Paragraph Text
entries.description: This simple type specifies the types of content which shall be possible between a given numbering level's text and the text of every numbered paragraph which references that numbering level.

values.name: nothing
values.title: Nothing Between Numbering and Text
values.description: Specifies that no character shall be displayed between the numbering level's text and the contents of the paragraph when displaying the numbered paragraph.

values.name: space
values.title: Space Between Numbering and Text
values.description: Specifies that a space character shall be displayed between the numbering level's text and the contents of the paragraph when displaying the numbered paragraph.

values.name: tab
values.title: Tab Between Numbering and Text
values.description: Specifies that a tab character shall be displayed between the numbering level's text and the contents of the paragraph when displaying the numbered paragraph.

entries.name: ST_LineNumberRestart
entries.title: Line Numbering Restart Position
entries.description: This simple type specifies when the line numbering in the parent section shall be reset to its restart value. The line numbering increments for each line (even if the line number itself is not displayed) until it reaches the restart point specified by this element.

values.name: continuous
values.title: Continue Line Numbering From Previous Section
values.description: Specifies that line numbering for the parent section shall continue from the line numbering from the end of the previous section, if any.

values.name: newPage
values.title: Restart Line Numbering on Each Page
values.description: Specifies that line numbering for the parent section shall restart to the starting value whenever a new page is displayed.

values.name: newSection
values.title: Restart Line Numbering for Each Section
values.description: Specifies that line numbering for the parent section shall restart to the starting value whenever the parent begins.

entries.name: ST_LineSpacingRule
entries.title: Line Spacing Rule
entries.description: This simple type specifies the logic which shall be used to calculate the line spacing of the parent object when it is displayed in the document.

values.name: atLeast
values.title: Minimum Line Height
values.description: Specifies that the height of the line shall be at least the value specified, but might be expanded to fit its content as needed.

values.name: auto
values.title: Automatically Determined Line Height
values.description: Specifies that the line spacing of the parent object shall be automatically determined by the size of its contents, with no predetermined minimum or maximum size.

values.name: exact
values.title: Exact Line Height
values.description: Specifies that the height of the line shall be exactly the value specified, regardless of the size of the contents of the contents.

entries.name: ST_Lock
entries.title: Locking Types
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible set of locking behaviors that can be applied to the contents of the nearest ancestor structured document tag when the contents of this document are edited by an application (whether through a user interface or directly).

values.name: contentLocked
values.title: Contents Cannot Be Edited At Runtime
values.description: Specifies that the editing restriction applied to the nearest ancestor structured document tag shall be as follows:  This structured document tag's contents shall not be editable  This structured document tag can be deleted in its entirety (but only entirely, no sub portion of it can be deleted)

values.name: sdtContentLocked
values.title: Contents Cannot Be Edited At Runtime And SDT Cannot Be Deleted
values.description: Specifies that the editing restriction applied to the nearest ancestor structured document tag shall be as follows: Enumeration Value Description  This structured document tag's contents shall not be editable  This structured document tag shall not be deleted in its entirety

values.name: sdtLocked
values.title: SDT Cannot Be Deleted
values.description: Specifies that the editing restriction applied to the nearest ancestor structured document tag shall be as follows:  This structured document tag's contents shall be editable  This structured document tag shall not be deleted in its entirety

values.name: unlocked
values.title: No Locking
values.description: Specifies that no special locking behaviors shall be applied to the nearest ancestor structured document tag.

entries.name: ST_LongHexNumber
entries.title: Eight Digit Hexadecimal Value
entries.description: This simple type specifies a number value specified as a four octet (eight digit) hexadecimal number, whose contents are interpreted based on the context of the parent XML element.

entries.name: ST_MacroName
entries.title: Script Subroutine Name Value
entries.description: This simple type specifies a subroutine in a scripting language which can be executed based on the context of the parent XML element. The language and location of this subroutine can be determined using any method desired by an application.

entries.name: ST_MailMergeDataType
entries.title: Mail Merge Data Source Type Values
entries.description: This simple type specifies the data source access mechanism used to connect to the data source for a mail merge. This setting is purely a suggestion of the data source access mechanism which shall be used, and can be ignored in favor of an alternative mechanism if one is present. Although this any access mechanism value can be specified, the following values are reserved: Value Description native (Office Data Source Object Data Source) Specifies that a given merged WordprocessingML document has been connected to an external data source via the data stored in the Office Data Source Object (ODSO) interface (§17.14.25).

entries.name: ST_MailMergeDest
entries.title: Merged Document Destination Types
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible results which can be generated when a mail merge is carried out on a given WordprocessingML source document. In other words, this element is used to specify what is to be done with the merged documents that result from populating the fields within a given merged WordprocessingML document with data from the specified external data source.

values.name: email
values.title: Send Merged Documents as E-mail Messages
values.description: Specifies that conforming hosting applications shall generate emails using the documents that result from populating the fields within a given merged WordprocessingML document with data from the specified external data source.

values.name: fax
values.title: Send Merged Documents as Faxes
values.description: Specifies that conforming hosting applications shall generate faxes using the documents that result from populating the fields within a given merged WordprocessingML document with data from the specified external data source.

values.name: newDocument
values.title: Send Merged Documents to New Documents
values.description: Specifies that conforming hosting applications shall generate new documents by populating the fields within a given merged WordprocessingML document with data from the specified external data source.

values.name: printer
values.title: Send Merged Documents to Printer
values.description: Specifies that conforming hosting applications shall print the documents that result from populating the fields within a given merged WordprocessingML document with external data from the specified external data source.

entries.name: ST_MailMergeDocType
entries.title: Source Document Types
entries.description: This simple types specifies the possible types for a given WordprocessingML source document.

values.name: catalog
values.title: Catalog Source Document
values.description: Specifies that the mail merge source document is of the catalog type.

values.name: email
values.title: E-Mail Source Document
values.description: Specifies that the mail merge source document is of the e-mail message type.

values.name: envelopes
values.title: Envelope Source Document
values.description: Specifies that the mail merge source document is of the envelope type.

values.name: fax
values.title: Fax Source Document
values.description: Specifies that the mail merge source document is of Enumeration Value Description the fax type.

values.name: formLetters
values.title: Form Letter Source Document
values.description: Specifies that the mail merge source document is of the form letter type.

values.name: mailingLabels
values.title: Mailing Label Source Document

entries.name: ST_MultiLevelType

entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible types of numbering which can be defined by a given abstract numbering type. This information shall only be used by a consumer to determine user interface behaviors for this numbering definition, and shall not be used to limit the behavior of the list (i.e. a list with multiple levels marked as singleLevel shall not be prevented from using levels 2 through 9).

values.name: singleLevel

entries.name: ST_ObjectDrawAspect
entries.title: Embedded Object Representations
entries.description: This simple type specifies the ways in which embedded objects are displayed in the application.

values.name: content
values.title: Snapshot
values.description: The object's presentation is a picture of the contained document (provided by the object's server application).

values.name: icon
values.title: Icon
values.description: The object's presentation is an icon.

entries.name: ST_ObjectUpdateMode
entries.title: Embedded Object Update Modes
entries.description: This simple type specifies how an embedded object is updated.

values.name: always
values.title: Server Application Update
values.description: The object is updated whenever the object's server application indicates there is new data available.

values.name: onCall
values.title: User Update
values.description: The object is updated when the user chooses to update it.

entries.name: ST_PageBorderDisplay
entries.title: Page Border Display Options
entries.description: This simple type specifies the pages in the parent section on which the page border shall be printed.

values.name: allPages
values.title: Display Page Border on All Pages
values.description: Specifies that the page border shall be displayed on all pages in the parent section.

values.name: firstPage
values.title: Display Page Border on First Page
values.description: Specifies that the page border shall be displayed on only the first page in the parent section.

values.name: notFirstPage
values.title: Display Page Border on All Pages Except First
values.description: Specifies that the page border shall be displayed on only the first page in the parent section.

entries.name: ST_PageBorderOffset
entries.title: Page Border Positioning Base
entries.description: This simple type specifies how the relative positioning of the page borders shall be calculated. If the value of this attribute is text, then the space attribute on each page border shall be interpreted as the distance from the text margins that shall be left before the page border.

values.name: page
values.title: Page Border Is Positioned Relative to Page Edges
values.description: Specifies that the space attribute on each page border shall be interpreted as the distance from the edge of the page that shall be left before the page border.

values.name: text
values.title: Page Border Is Positioned Relative to Text Extents
values.description: Specifies that the space attribute on each page border shall be interpreted as the distance from the edge of the text extents (text margins) that shall be left before the page border..

entries.name: ST_PageBorderZOrder
entries.title: Page Border Z-Order
entries.description: This simple type specifies whether the page border is positioned above or below intersecting texts and objects in this document.

values.name: back
values.title: Page Border Behind Text
values.description: Specifies that the page border shall be rendered beneath any text or object which intersects it - effectively placing it at the lowest z-order on the page.

values.name: front
values.title: Page Border Ahead of Text
values.description: Specifies that the page border shall be rendered above any text or object which intersects it - effectively placing it at the highest z-order on the page.

entries.name: ST_PageOrientation
entries.title: Page Orientation
entries.description: This simple type specifies the orientation of all pages in the parent section. This information is used to determine the actual paper size to use when printing the file.

values.name: landscape
values.title: Landscape Mode
values.description: Specifies that pages in this section shall be printed in landscape mode, which prints the page contents with a 90 degree rotation with respect to the normal page orientation.

values.name: portrait
values.title: Portrait Mode
values.description: Specifies that pages in this section shall be printed in portrait mode.

entries.name: ST_Pitch
entries.title: Font Pitch Value
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible values for the font pitch of a font.

values.name: default
values.title: Default
values.description: Specifies that no information is available about the pitch of a font.

values.name: fixed
values.title: Fixed Width
values.description: Specifies that this is a fixed width font.

values.name: variable
values.title: Proportional Width
values.description: Specifies that this is a proportional width font.

entries.name: ST_PixelsMeasure
entries.title: Measurement in Pixels
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain a positive whole number, whose contents consist of a measurement in pixels. The contents of this measurement are interpreted based on the context of the parent XML element.

entries.name: ST_PointMeasure
entries.title: Measurement in Points
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain a positive whole number, whose contents consist of a measurement in points (equivalent to 1/72nd of an inch). The contents of this measurement are interpreted based on the context of the parent XML element.

entries.name: ST_Proof
entries.title: Proofing State Values
entries.description: This simple type specifies the values which can be used to indicate the status of a given hosting application's grammar and spell checking when a given WordprocessingML document was last saved.

values.name: clean
values.title: Check Completed
values.description: Specifies that the given proofing engine completed checking the document when it was last saved.

values.name: dirty
values.title: Check Not Completed
values.description: Specifies that the given proofing engine did not complete checking the document when it was last saved.

entries.name: ST_ProofErr
entries.title: Proofing Error Type
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible values for the types of proofing error markers which can appear in the contents of a WordprocessingML document to indicate the last known state of any spell- and grammar-checking performed on the contents of this document.

values.name: gramEnd
values.title: End of Region Marked as Grammatical Error
values.description: Specifies that this proofing error marker shall indicate the start of a region to be marked as a grammatical error in the document.

values.name: gramStart
values.title: Start of Region Marked as Grammatical Error
values.description: Specifies that this proofing error marker shall indicate the end of a region to be marked as a grammatical error in the document.

values.name: spellEnd
values.title: End of Region Marked as Spelling Error
values.description: Specifies that this proofing error marker shall indicate the end of a region to be marked as a spelling error in the document.

values.name: spellStart
values.title: Start of Region Marked as Spelling Error
values.description: Specifies that this proofing error marker shall indicate the start of a region to be marked as a spelling error in the document.

entries.name: ST_PTabAlignment
entries.title: Absolute Position Tab Alignment
entries.description: This simple type specifies the alignment of an absolutely positioned tab character in a document. This alignment value determines the position on the line to which this absolute tab shall advance, as well as the alignment of the text entered after the alignment tab character position.

values.name: center
values.title: Center
values.description: Specifies that the positional tab should be center aligned on the line relative to the specified base (the text margins with or without indents), and that the text at that location shall be center aligned.

values.name: left
values.title: Left
values.description: Specifies that the positional tab should be left aligned on the line relative to the specified base (the text margins with or without indents), and that the text at that location shall be left aligned.

values.name: right
values.title: Right
values.description: Specifies that the positional tab should be right aligned on the line relative to the specified base (the text margins with or without indents), and that the text at that location shall be right aligned.

entries.name: ST_PTabLeader
entries.title: Absolute Position Tab Leader Character
entries.description: This simple type specifies the characters which can be used to fill in the space created by a positional tab. This character shall be repeated as required to completely fill the tab spacing generated by the positional tab character.

values.name: dot
values.title: Dot Leader Character
values.description: Specifies that the leader character for this positional Enumeration Value Description tab stop shall be a dot.

values.name: hyphen
values.title: Hyphen Leader Character
values.description: Specifies that the leader character for this positional tab stop shall be a hyphen.

values.name: middleDot
values.title: Centered Dot Leader Character
values.description: Specifies that the leader character for this positional tab stop shall be a centered dot.

values.name: none
values.title: No Leader Character
values.description: Specifies that there shall be no leader character for this positional tab.

values.name: underscore
values.title: Underscore Leader Character
values.description: Specifies that the leader character for this positional tab stop shall be an underscore.

entries.name: ST_PTabRelativeTo
entries.title: Absolute Position Tab Positioning Base
entries.description: Specifies the possible extents which can be used to calculate the absolute positioning of this positional tab character.

values.name: indent
values.title: Relative To Indents
values.description: Specifies that the absolute positioning of the tab shall be relative to the indents.

values.name: margin
values.title: Relative To Text Margins
values.description: Specifies that the absolute positioning of the tab shall be relative to the margins.

entries.name: ST_RestartNumber
entries.title: Footnote/Endnote Numbering Restart Locations
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible values for when the automatic numbering of footnotes or endnotes shall be restarted.

values.name: continuous
values.title: Continue Numbering From Previous Section
values.description: Specifies that the numbering of footnotes or endnotes shall continue from the previous section in the document.

values.name: eachPage
values.title: Restart Numbering On Each Page
values.description: Specifies that the numbering of footnotes or endnotes shall be restarted to its starting value for each unique page in the document.

values.name: eachSect
values.title: Restart Numbering For Each Section
values.description: Specifies that the numbering of footnotes or endnotes shall be restarted to its starting value for each unique section in the document.

entries.name: ST_RubyAlign
entries.title: Phonetic Guide Text Alignment
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible alignment settings which can be used to determine the placement of phonetic guide text with respect to the base text when this phonetic guide is displayed.

values.name: center
values.title: Center
values.description: Specifies that the phonetic guide text shall be centered with respect to the base text in this document.

values.name: distributeLetter
values.title: Distribute All Characters
values.description: Specifies that the phonetic guide text shall be distributed with respect to the base text in this document.

values.name: distributeSpace
values.title: Distribute all Characters w/ Additional Space On Either Side
values.description: Specifies that the phonetic guide text shall be distributed with respect to the base text in this document, with additional space added to the guide text to ensure it is indented with respect to the base text.

values.name: left
values.title: Left Aligned
values.description: Specifies that the phonetic guide text shall be left aligned with respect to the base text in this document.

values.name: right
values.title: Right Aligned
values.description: Specifies that the phonetic guide text shall be right aligned with respect to the base text in this document.

values.name: rightVertical
values.title: Vertically Aligned to Right of Base Text
values.description: Specifies that the phonetic guide text shall be right aligned with respect to the base text in this document, and shall always be displayed vertically and to the right of the base text, regardless of the alignment of the base text.

entries.name: ST_SdtDateMappingType
entries.title: Date Storage Format Types
entries.description: This simple type specifies then possible types of translations which can be performed on the displayed date in a date picker structured document tag when the current contents are saved into the associated custom XML data via the dataBinding element (§17.5.2.6).

values.name: date
values.title: XML Schema Date Format
values.description: Specifies that the date specified in the parent date picker structured document tag shall be converted to the xsd:date format when stored in a mapped XML element.

values.name: dateTime
values.title: XML Schema DateTime Format
values.description: Specifies that the date specified in the parent date picker structured document tag shall be converted to the xsd:dateTime format when stored in a mapped XML element.

values.name: text
values.title: Same As Display
values.description: Specifies that no translation shall be performed on the displayed date when stored in a mapped XML element - the mapped contents shall be the same as the displayed contents.

entries.name: ST_SectionMark
entries.title: Section Type
entries.description: Specifies the kind of the current section.

values.name: continuous
values.title: Continuous Section Break
values.description: Specifies a continuous section break, which begin the new section on the following paragraph.

values.name: evenPage
values.title: Even Page Section Break
values.description: Specifies an even page section break, which begins the new section on the next even-numbered page, leaving the next odd page blank if necessary.

values.name: nextColumn
values.title: Column Section Break
values.description: Specifies a column section break, which begins the new section on the following column on the page.

values.name: nextPage
values.title: Next Page Section Break
values.description: Specifies a next page section break, which begins the new section on the following page.

values.name: oddPage
values.title: Odd Page Section Break
values.description: Specifies an odd page section break, which begins the new section on the next odd-numbered page, leaving the next even page blank if necessary.

entries.name: ST_ShortHexNumber
entries.title: Four Digit Hexadecimal Value
entries.description: This simple type specifies a number value specified as a two octet (four digit) hexadecimal number, whose contents are interpreted based on the context of the parent XML element.

entries.name: ST_SignedHpsMeasure
entries.title: Signed Measurement in Half-Points
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain either:  A positive or negative whole number, whose contents consist of a measurement in half-points (equivalent to 1/144th of an inch).  A positive or negative number followed immediately by a unit identifier. The contents of this measurement are interpreted based on the context of the parent XML element.

entries.name: ST_SignedTwipsMeasure
entries.title: Signed Measurement in Twentieths of a Point
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain either:  A positive or negative whole number, whose contents consist of a measurement in twentieths of a point (equivalent to 1/1440th of an inch), or  A positive decimal number immediately following by a unit identifier. The contents of this measurement are interpreted based on the context of the parent XML element.

entries.name: ST_StyleSort
entries.title: Style Sort Settings
entries.description: This simple type specifies the ways in which the list of document styles can be ordered when they are displayed in a user interface.

values.name: basedOn
values.title: Sort by Based On Style
values.description: Specifies that styles which are visible should be sorted by the style on which they are based using the basedOn element (§17.7.4.3).

values.name: default
values.title: Sort by Default Method
values.description: Specifies that styles which are visible should be sorted by the default sorting of the host application.

values.name: font
values.title: Sort by Font
values.description: Specifies that styles which are visible should be sorted by the font which they apply.

values.name: name
values.title: Sort by Style Name
values.description: Specifies that styles which are visible should be sorted by their names.

values.name: priority
values.title: Sort by Style Priority
values.description: Specifies that styles which are visible should be sorted by their UI priority using the uiPriority element (§17.7.4.19).

values.name: type
values.title: Sort by Style Type
values.description: Specifies that styles which are visible should be sorted by their style types (i.e. character, linked, paragraph).

entries.name: ST_StyleType
entries.title: Style Types
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible values for the types of style definitions defined within a WordprocessingML document. WordprocessingML supports six types of style definitions:  Paragraph styles  Character styles  Table styles  Numbering styles  Linked styles (paragraph + character)  Default paragraph + character properties Each of the first four style types corresponds to a different value below, and therefore defines the style type of the current style. [Note: The last two style types are unique in that they are not simply a style type: a linked style is a pairing of a character and paragraph style via the link element (§17.7.4.6); and the document default

values.name: character
values.title: Character Style
values.description: Specifies that the parent style definition is a character style.

values.name: numbering
values.title: Numbering Style
values.description: Specifies that the parent style definition is a numbering style.

values.name: paragraph
values.title: Paragraph Style
values.description: Specifies that the parent style definition is a paragraph style.

values.name: table
values.title: Table Style
values.description: Specifies that the parent style definition is a table style.

entries.name: ST_TabJc
entries.title: Custom Tab Stop Type
entries.description: This simple type specifies the available types of custom tab stop, which determines the behavior of the tab stop and the alignment which shall be applied to text entered at the current custom tab stop.

values.name: bar
values.title: Bar Tab
values.description: Specifies that the current tab is a bar tab.

values.name: center
values.title: Centered Tab
values.description: Specifies that the current tab stop shall result in a location in the document where all following text is centered (i.e. all text runs following this tab stop and preceding the next tab stop shall be centered around the tab stop location).

values.name: clear
values.title: No Tab Stop
values.description: Specifies that the current tab stop is cleared and shall be removed and ignored when processing the contents of this document.

values.name: decimal
values.title: Decimal Tab
values.description: Specifies that the current tab stop shall result in a location in the document where all following text is aligned around the first decimal character in the following text runs.

values.name: end
values.title: Trailing Tab
values.description: Specifies that the current tab stop shall result in a location in the document where all following text is aligned to its trailing edge (i.e. all text runs following this tab stop and preceding the next tab stop shall be aligned against the trailing edge with respect to the tab stop location).

values.name: num
values.title: List Tab
values.description: Specifies that the current tab is a list tab, which is the tab stop between the numbering and the paragraph contents in a numbered paragraph.

values.name: start
values.title: Leading Tab
values.description: Specifies that the current tab stop shall result in a location in the document where all following text is aligned to its leading edge (i.e. all text runs following this tab stop and preceding the next tab stop shall be aligned against the leading edge with respect to the tab stop location).

entries.name: ST_TabTlc
entries.title: Custom Tab Stop Leader Character
entries.description: This simple type specifies the characters which can be used to fill in the space created by a tab which ends at this custom tab stop. The chosen character shall be repeated as required to completely fill the tab spacing generated by the tab character.

values.name: dot
values.title: Dotted leader line
values.description: Specifies that the leader character for this custom tab stop shall be a dot.

values.name: heavy
values.title: Heavy solid leader line
values.description: Specifies that the leader character for this custom tab stop shall be a heavy solid line, or an underscore.

values.name: hyphen
values.title: Dashed tab stop leader line
values.description: Specifies that the leader character for this custom tab stop shall be a hyphen.

values.name: middleDot
values.title: Middle dot leader line
values.description: Specifies that the leader character for this custom tab stop shall be a centered dot.

values.name: none
values.title: No tab stop leader
values.description: Specifies that there shall be no leader character for this custom tab.

values.name: underscore
values.title: Solid leader line
values.description: Specifies that the leader character for this custom tab stop shall be an underscore.
