values.name: 800x600
values.title: Optimize for 800x600
values.description: Specifies that web pages produced from this document should be optimized for a screen size of 800x600.

entries.name: ST_TblLayoutType
entries.title: Table Layout Type
entries.description: This simple type defines the possible types of layout algorithms which can be used to lay out a table within a WordprocessingML document. These algorithms are defined in the following paragraphs (noting, of course, that implementations are free to implement more efficient versions of each). Fixed Width Table Layout - This method of table layout uses the preferred widths on the table items to generate the final sizing of the table, but does not change that size regardless of the contents of each table cell, hence the table is fixed width. [Guidance: Although an application can choose to use a different process, this layout could be performed as

values.name: autofit
values.title: AutoFit Table Layout
values.description: Specifies that this table shall use an AutoFit table layout algorithm.

values.name: fixed
values.title: Fixed Width Table Layout
values.description: Specifies that this table shall use the fixed width table layout algorithm described above.

entries.name: ST_TblOverlap
entries.title: Table Overlap Setting
entries.description: This simple type contains the possible settings for a floating table which shall be used to determine if the table can overlap with other floating tables when displayed in the document.

values.name: never
values.title: Floating Table Cannot Overlap
values.description: Specifies that the parent table, if floating, shall never be displayed in a state where it would be overlapping another floating table in the document.

values.name: overlap
values.title: Floating Table Can Overlap
values.description: Specifies that the parent table, if floating, can be displayed in a state where it would be overlapping another floating table in the document.

entries.name: ST_TblStyleOverrideType
entries.title: Conditional Table Style Formatting Types
entries.description: This simple type specifies possible values for the sections of the table to which the current conditional formatting properties shall be applied when this table style is used.

values.name: band1Horz
values.title: Banded Row Conditional Formatting
values.description: Specifies that the table formatting applies to odd numbered groupings of rows.

values.name: band1Vert
values.title: Banded Column Conditional Formatting
values.description: Specifies that the table formatting applies to odd numbered groupings of columns.

values.name: band2Horz
values.title: Even Row Stripe Conditional Formatting
values.description: Specifies that the table formatting applies to even numbered groupings of rows.

values.name: band2Vert
values.title: Even Column Stripe Conditional Formatting
values.description: Specifies that the table formatting applies to even numbered groupings of columns.

values.name: firstCol
values.title: First Column Conditional Formatting
values.description: Specifies that the table formatting applies to the first column.

values.name: firstRow
values.title: First Row Conditional Formatting
values.description: Specifies that the table formatting applies to the first row.

values.name: lastCol
values.title: Last table column formatting
values.description: Specifies that the table formatting applies to the last column.

values.name: lastRow
values.title: Last table row formatting
values.description: Specifies that the table formatting applies to the last row.

values.name: neCell
values.title: Top right table cell formatting
values.description: Specifies that the table formatting applies to the top right cell.

values.name: nwCell
values.title: Top left table cell formatting
values.description: Specifies that the table formatting applies to the top left cell.

values.name: seCell
values.title: Bottom right table cell formatting
values.description: Specifies that the table formatting applies to the bottom right cell.

values.name: swCell
values.title: Bottom left table cell formatting
values.description: Specifies that the table formatting applies to the bottom left cell.

values.name: wholeTable
values.title: Whole table formatting
values.description: Specifies that the conditional formatting applies to the whole table.

entries.name: ST_TblWidth
entries.title: Table Width Units
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible values for the units of the width property being defined by a specific table width property. These properties are used to define various properties of a table, including: cell spacing, preferred width, and table margins.

values.name: auto
values.title: Automatically Determined Width
values.description: Specifies that the value for the measurement of the current table width property in the parent table shall be automatically determined by the table layout algorithm when the table is displayed (this width can be adjusted as appropriate).

values.name: dxa
values.title: Width in Twentieths of a Point
values.description: Specifies that the value for the measurement of the current table width property in the parent table shall be interpreted as twentieths of a point (1/1440 of an inch).

values.name: nil
values.title: No Width
values.description: Specifies that the current width is zero, regardless of any width value specified on the parent element.

values.name: pct
values.title: Width in Percent of Table Width
values.description: Specifies that the value for the measurement of the current table width property in the parent table shall be interpreted as whole percentage point when a percent sign (U+0025) is present.

entries.name: ST_TextAlignment
entries.title: Vertical Text Alignment Types
entries.description: This simple type specifies the type of vertical alignment which shall be used to align the characters on each line in the parent object.

values.name: auto
values.title: Automatically Determine Alignment
values.description: Specifies that all text in the parent object shall be aligned automatically when displayed.

values.name: baseline
values.title: Align Text at Baseline
values.description: Specifies that all text in the parent object shall be aligned to the baseline of each character when displayed.

values.name: bottom
values.title: Align Text at Bottom
values.description: Specifies that all text in the parent object shall be aligned to the bottom of each character when displayed.

values.name: center
values.title: Align Text at Center
values.description: Specifies that all text in the parent object shall be aligned to the center of each character when displayed.

values.name: top
values.title: Align Text at Top
values.description: Specifies that all text in the parent object shall be aligned to the top of each character when displayed.

entries.name: ST_TextboxTightWrap
entries.title: Lines To Tight Wrap Within Text Box
entries.description: This simple type specifies the lines in the parent paragraph which shall allow the text to be tight wrapped to the paragraph (and not the containing text box) extents when displaying the document.

values.name: allLines
values.title: Tight Wrap All Lines
values.description: Specifies that all lines in the paragraph shall allow surrounding text to be tight wrapped to their extents and not the containing text box’s extents.

values.name: firstAndLastLine
values.title: Tight Wrap First and Last Lines
values.description: Specifies that only the first and last lines in the paragraph shall allow surrounding text to be tight wrapped to their extents and not the containing text box’s extents.

values.name: firstLineOnly
values.title: Tight Wrap First Line
values.description: Specifies that only the first line in the paragraph shall allow surrounding text to be tight wrapped to their extents and not the containing text box’s extents.

values.name: lastLineOnly
values.title: Tight Wrap Last Line
values.description: Specifies that only the last line in the paragraph shall allow surrounding text to be tight wrapped to their extents and not the containing text box’s extents.

values.name: none
values.title: Do Not Tight Wrap
values.description: Specifies that no lines in the paragraph shall allow surrounding text to be tight wrapped to their extents and not the containing text box’s extents.

entries.name: ST_TextDirection
entries.title: Text Flow Direction
entries.description: This simple type specifies the direction of the text flow for the parent object.

values.name: lr
values.title: Lines Flow From Left to Right
values.description: Specifies that text in the parent object shall be oriented vertically, flowing from left to right Enumeration Value Description horizontally on the page.

values.name: lrV
values.title: Lines Flow From Left to Right Rotated
values.description: Specifies that text in the parent object shall be oriented vertically, flowing from left to right horizontally on the page.

values.name: rl
values.title: Lines Flow From Right to Left
values.description: Specifies that text in the parent object shall be oriented vertically, flowing from right to left horizontally on the page, as if the text were rotated 90 degrees.

values.name: rlV
values.title: Lines Flow From Right to Left Rotated
values.description: Specifies that text in the parent object shall be oriented vertically, flowing from right to left horizontally on the page.

values.name: tb
values.title: Lines Flow From Top to Bottom
values.description: Specifies that text in the parent object shall be oriented horizontally, flowing from top to bottom vertically on the page.

values.name: tbV
values.title: Lines Flow From Top to Bottom Rotated
values.description: Specifies that text in the parent object shall be oriented horizontally, flowing from top to bottom vertically on the page.

entries.name: ST_TextEffect
entries.title: Animated Text Effects
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible types of animated text effect which can be applied to a text run when it is displayed..

values.name: antsBlack
values.title: Black Dashed Line Animation
values.description: Specifies that this text shall be surrounded by an animated black dashed line border.

values.name: antsRed
values.title: Marching Red Ants
values.description: Specifies that this text shall be surrounded by an animated red dashed line border.

values.name: blinkBackground
values.title: Blinking Background Animation
values.description: Specifies that this text shall be surrounded by a background color which alternates between black and white.

values.name: lights
values.title: Colored Lights Animation
values.description: Specifies that this text shall be surrounded by a border consisting of a series of colored lights, which constantly change colors in sequence.

values.name: none
values.title: No Animation
values.description: Specifies that this text shall have no animated text effect.

values.name: shimmer
values.title: Shimmer Animation
values.description: Specifies that this text shall be animated by alternating Enumeration Value Description between normal and blurry states.

values.name: sparkle
values.title: Sparkling Lights Animation
values.description: Specifies that this text shall have a background consisting of a random pattern of colored lights, which constantly change colors in sequence.

entries.name: ST_TextScale
entries.title: Text Expansion/Compression Percentage
entries.description: This simple type specifies that the percentage by which the contents of a run shall be expanded or compressed with respect to its normal (100%) character width, with a minimum width of 1% and maximum width of 600%.

entries.name: ST_Theme
entries.title: Theme Font
entries.description: This simple type specifies a theme font type which can be referenced as a theme font within the parent run properties. This theme font is a reference to one of the predefined theme fonts, located in the document's Theme part,which allows for font information to be set centrally in the document.

values.name: majorAscii
values.title: Major ASCII Theme Font
values.description: Specifies that the current font is a reference to the major theme font for the range of characters from U+0000–U+007F.

values.name: majorBidi
values.title: Major Complex Script Theme Font
values.description: Specifies that the current font is a reference to the major theme font for the Complex Script range.

values.name: majorEastAsia
values.title: Major East Asian Theme Font
values.description: Specifies that the current font is a reference to the major theme font for the East Asian range.

values.name: majorHAnsi
values.title: Major High ANSI Theme Font
values.description: Specifies that the current font is a reference to the major theme font for the High ANSI range.

values.name: minorAscii
values.title: Minor ASCII Theme Font
values.description: Specifies that the current font is a reference to the minor theme font for the range of characters from U+0000–U+007F.

values.name: minorBidi
values.title: Minor Complex Script Theme Font
values.description: Specifies that the current font is a reference to the minor theme font for the Complex Script range.

values.name: minorEastAsia
values.title: Minor East Asian Theme Font
values.description: Specifies that the current font is a reference to the minor theme font for the East Asian range.

values.name: minorHAnsi
values.title: Minor High ANSI Theme Font
values.description: Specifies that the current font is a reference to the minor theme font for the High ANSI range.

entries.name: ST_ThemeColor

entries.description: This simple type specifies a theme color to be applied to the current object. The specified theme color is a reference to one of the predefined theme colors, located in the document's Theme part, which allows color information to be set centrally in the document.

values.name: hyperlink

values.name: dashDotHeavy

values.name: dashedHeavy

values.name: dotDotDash
