values.description: Specifies an underline consisting of a series of dash, dot, dot characters beneath all characters in this run.

values.name: dotted
values.title: Dotted Underline
values.description: Specifies an underline consisting of a series of dot characters beneath all characters in this run.

values.name: dottedHeavy
values.title: Thick Dotted Underline
values.description: Specifies an underline consisting of a series of thick dot characters beneath all characters in this run.

values.name: double
values.title: Double Underline
values.description: Specifies an underline consisting of two lines beneath all characters in this run.

values.name: none
values.title: No Underline
values.description: Specifies no underline beneath this run.

values.name: single
values.title: Single Underline
values.description: Specifies an underline consisting of a single line beneath all characters in this run.

values.name: thick
values.title: Thick Underline
values.description: Specifies an underline consisting of a single thick line beneath all characters in this run.

values.name: wave
values.title: Wave Underline
values.description: Specifies an underline consisting of a single wavy line beneath all characters in this run.

values.name: wavyDouble
values.title: Double Wave Underline
values.description: Specifies an underline consisting of a pair of wavy lines Enumeration Value Description beneath all characters in this run.

values.name: wavyHeavy
values.title: Heavy Wave Underline
values.description: Specifies an underline consisting of a single thick wavy line beneath all characters in this run.

values.name: words
values.title: Underline Non-Space Characters Only
values.description: Specifies an underline consisting of a single line beneath all non-space characters in the run.

entries.name: ST_VAnchor
entries.title: Vertical Anchor Location
entries.description: This simple type specifies the vertical position to which the parent object has been anchored in the document. This anchor position shall be used as the base location to determine the final vertical position of the object in the document.

values.name: margin
values.title: Relative To Margin
values.description: Specifies that the parent object shall be vertically anchored to the text margins.

values.name: page
values.title: Relative To Page
values.description: Specifies that the parent object shall be vertically anchored to the page edge.

values.name: text
values.title: Relative To Vertical Text Extents
values.description: Specifies that the parent object shall be vertically anchored to the text extents.

entries.name: ST_VerticalJc
entries.title: Vertical Alignment Type
entries.description: This simple type specifies the vertical alignment for text between the top and bottom margins of the parent container (page or table cell).

values.name: both
values.title: Vertical Justification
values.description: Specifies that the text shall be vertically justified between the top and bottom margins of the parent object, by adding additional line spacing to each paragraph as required.

values.name: page
values.title: returning to the default value of top
values.description: This value is only permitted for page justification settings, and shall be ignored when specified on a table cell (returning to the default value of top).

values.name: bottom
values.title: Align Bottom
values.description: Specifies that the text shall be vertically aligned to the bottom margin of the parent object, by moving all text to the bottom text extent within the parent object as required.

values.name: center
values.title: Align Center
values.description: Specifies that the text shall be vertically aligned to the center of the parent object..

values.name: top
values.title: Align Top
values.description: Specifies that the text shall be vertically aligned to the top margin of the parent object, by moving all text to the top text extent within the parent object as required.

entries.name: ST_View
entries.title: Document View Values
entries.description: This simple type defines the kinds of view available to an application when rendering a WordprocessingML document. Those view kinds are, as follows: default view, draft view, outline view, print layout view, and web page view.

values.name: masterPages
values.title: Master Document View
values.description: Specifies that a given WordprocessingML document should be rendered in a manner that allows a (possibly) long document to be viewed, navigated, or edited in an outline form, possibly based on the headings in that document, showing the relationships among master documents and subdocuments (see §17.17.1).

values.name: none
values.title: Default View
values.description: Specifies that a given WordprocessingML document should be rendered in the default view of the application.

values.name: normal
values.title: Draft View
values.description: Specifies that a given WordprocessingML document should be rendered in a manner that allows a (possibly) long document to be viewed, navigated, or edited.

values.name: outline
values.title: Outline View
values.description: Specifies that a given WordprocessingML document should be rendered in a manner that allows a (possibly) long document to be viewed, navigated, or edited in an outline form, possibly based on the headings in that document.

values.name: print
values.title: Print Layout View
values.description: Specifies that a given WordprocessingML document should be rendered in a view mimicking the way that document would be printed.

values.name: web
values.title: Web Page View
values.description: Specifies that a given WordprocessingML document should be rendered in a view mimicking the way that document would be displayed as a web page.

entries.name: ST_WmlColorSchemeIndex
entries.title: Theme Color Reference
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible set of theme color stored in the document's Theme part which can be referenced by document content. This reference is used to map the use of the theme colors in the ST_ThemeColor enumeration to the theme colors in the theme part.

values.name: accent1
values.title: Accent 1 Theme Color Reference
values.description: Specifies a reference to the accent1 theme color in the document's Theme part.

values.name: accent2
values.title: Accent 2 Theme Color Reference
values.description: Specifies a reference to the accent2 theme color in the document's Theme part.

values.name: accent3
values.title: Accent 3 Theme Color Reference
values.description: Specifies a reference to the accent3 theme color in the document's Theme part.

values.name: accent4
values.title: Accent4 Theme Color Reference
values.description: Specifies a reference to the accent4 theme color in the document's Theme part.

values.name: accent5
values.title: Accent5 Theme Color Reference
values.description: Specifies a reference to the accent5 theme color in the document's Theme part.

values.name: accent6
values.title: Accent 6 Theme Color Reference
values.description: Specifies a reference to the accent6 theme color in the document's Theme part.

values.name: dark1
values.title: Dark 1 Theme Color Reference
values.description: Specifies a reference to the dk1 theme color in the document's Theme part.

values.name: dark2
values.title: Dark 2 Theme Color Reference
values.description: Specifies a reference to the dk2 theme color in the document's Theme part.

values.name: followedHyperlink
values.title: Followed Hyperlink Theme Color Reference
values.description: Specifies a reference to the folHlink theme color in the document's Theme part.

values.name: hyperlink
values.title: Hyperlink Theme Color Reference
values.description: Specifies a reference to the hlink theme color in the document's Theme part.

values.name: light1
values.title: Light 1 Theme Color Reference
values.description: Specifies a reference to the lt1 theme color in the document's Theme part.

values.name: light2
values.title: Light 2 Theme Color Reference
values.description: Specifies a reference to the lt2 theme color in the document's Theme part.

entries.name: ST_Wrap
entries.title: Text Wrapping around Text Frame Type
entries.description: This simple type specifies the type of text wrapping which shall be allowed around a text frame within a document.

values.name: around
values.title: Allow Text Wrapping Around Frame
values.description: Specifies that text shall be allowed to wrap around the remaining space on each line around this text frame in the document.

values.name: auto
values.title: Default Text Wrapping Around Frame
values.description: Specifies that text shall have the default application- defined behavior of the application displaying the WordprocessingML document with regard to the text wrapping displayed around the frame.

values.name: none
values.title: No Text Wrapping Around Frame
values.description: Specifies that text shall not be allowed to wrap around the remaining space on each lines around this text frame.

values.name: notBeside
values.title: No Text Wrapping Beside Frame
values.description: Specifies that text shall not be allowed to wrap around the remaining space on each lines around this text frame.

values.name: through
values.title: Through Text Wrapping Around Frame
values.description: Specifies that text shall be allowed to wrap around the remaining space on each line around this text frame in the document.

values.name: tight
values.title: Tight Text Wrapping Around Frame
values.description: Specifies that text shall be allowed to tightly wrap around the remaining space on each line around this text frame in the document.

entries.name: ST_Zoom
entries.title: Magnification Preset Values
entries.description: This simple type specifies the type of magnification settings which can be applied to a given document on open.

values.name: bestFit
values.title: Display Page Width
values.description: Specifies that the magnification setting shall be adjusted to ensure the width of the current page matches the available window width.

values.name: fullPage
values.title: Display One Full Page
values.description: Specifies that the magnification setting shall be adjusted to ensure that one full page can be seen at a time.

values.name: none
values.title: No Preset Magnification
values.description: Specifies that no preset magnification is present, and the last known cached setting shall be used.

values.name: textFit
values.title: Display Text Width
values.description: Specifies that the magnification setting shall be adjusted to ensure the width of the text extents on the current page matches the available window width.

entries.name: ST_TextScalePercent
entries.title: Text Expansion/Compression Percentage
entries.description: This simple type specifies that the percentage by which the contents of a run shall be expanded or compressed with respect to its normal (100%) character width, with a minimum width of 1% and maximum width of 600%.

entries.name: ST_MeasurementOrPercent
entries.title: Measurement or Percentage Value
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible values for a table measurement, which can be percentage-based or absolute. See the union’s member types for details. This simple type is a union of the following types: The ST_DecimalNumberOrPercent simple type (§17.18.11).

entries.name: bookViews
entries.title: Workbook Views
entries.description: This element specifies the collection of workbook views of the enclosing workbook. Each view can specify a window position, filter options, and other configurations. There is no limit on the number of workbook views that can be defined for a workbook.

entries.name: calcPr
entries.title: Calculation Properties
entries.description: This element defines the collection of properties the application uses to record calculation status and details. Calculation is the process of computing formulas and then displaying the results as values in the cells that contain the formulas.

attributes.name: calcCompleted
attributes.title: Calc Completed
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that determines whether workbook data was recalculated before the workbook was saved.

attributes.name: calcId
attributes.title: Calculation Id
attributes.description: Specifies the version of the calculation engine used to calculate values in the workbook.

attributes.name: calcMode
attributes.title: Calculation Mode
attributes.description: Specifies when the application should calculate formulas in the workbook.

attributes.name: calcOnSave
attributes.title: Calculate On Save
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the application recalculates values when the workbook is saved.

attributes.name: Count
attributes.title: Concurrent Thread Manual Count
attributes.description: Specifies the count of concurrent calculation processes manually set by the user.

attributes.name: forceFullCalc
attributes.title: Force Full Calculation
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the application performs a full recalculation when one was not indicated by other calculation properties.

attributes.name: fullCalcOnLoad
attributes.title: Full Calculation On Load
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the application shall perform a full recalculation when the workbook is opened.

attributes.name: fullPrecision
attributes.title: Full Precision Calculation
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean that indicates the precision the application uses when performing calculations in the workbook.

attributes.name: iterate
attributes.title: Calculation Iteration
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the application should attempt to calculate formulas that contain circular references.

attributes.name: iterateDelta
attributes.title: Iterative Calculation Delta
attributes.description: Specifies a double that contains the maximum change for iterative calculations.

attributes.name: refMode
attributes.title: Reference Mode
attributes.description: Specifies the reference style for this workbook.

entries.name: customWorkbookView
entries.title: Custom Workbook View
entries.description: This element specifies a single custom workbook view. A custom workbook view consists of a set of display and print settings that you can name and apply to a workbook. You can create more than one custom workbook view of the same workbook.

attributes.name: activeSheetId
attributes.title: Active Sheet in Book View
attributes.description: Specifies the sheetId of a sheet in the workbook that identifies to a consuming application the default sheet to display.

attributes.name: autoUpdate
attributes.title: Auto Update
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that is an instruction that if the workbook is loaded by a spreadsheet application, that spreadsheet application should automatically update changes at the interval specified by the mergeInterval attribute.

attributes.name: changesSavedWin
attributes.title: Changes Saved Win
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that instructs a spreadsheet application to overwrite the persisted version of the document with the updated version being persisted.

attributes.name: guid
attributes.title: Custom View GUID
attributes.description: Specifies a globally unique identifier (GUID) for this custom view The possible values for this attribute are defined by the ST_Guid simple type (§22.9.2.4). includeHiddenRow

attributes.name: Col
attributes.title: Include Hidden Rows & Columns
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether to include hidden rows, columns, and filter settings in this custom view.

attributes.name: s
attributes.title: Include Print Settings
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether to include print settings in this custom view.

attributes.name: maximized
attributes.title: Maximized
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the workbook window is maximized.

attributes.name: minimized
attributes.title: Minimized
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the workbook window is minimized.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Custom View Name
attributes.description: Specifies the name of the custom view.

attributes.name: onlySync
attributes.title: Only Synch
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates, during automatic update, the current user's changes are not saved.

attributes.name: personalView
attributes.title: Personal View
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates that this custom view is a personal view for a shared workbook user.

attributes.name: showComments
attributes.title: Show Comments
attributes.description: Specifies how comments are displayed in this custom view The possible values for this attribute are defined by the ST_Comments simple type (§18.18.14).

attributes.name: showFormulaBar
attributes.title: Show Formula Bar
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether to display the formula bar in the application user interface.

attributes.name: oll
attributes.title: Show Horizontal Scroll
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether to display the horizontal scroll bar in the user interface.

attributes.name: showObjects
attributes.title: Show Objects
attributes.description: Specifies how objects are displayed in this custom view.

attributes.name: showSheetTabs
attributes.title: Show Sheet Tabs
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether to display the sheet tabs in the user interface.

attributes.name: showStatusbar
attributes.title: Show Status Bar
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether to display the status bar in the user interface.

attributes.name: showVerticalScroll
attributes.title: Show Vertical Scroll
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether to display the vertical scroll bar.

attributes.name: tabRatio
attributes.title: Sheet Tab Ratio
attributes.description: Specifies the ratio between the workbook tabs bar and the horizontal scroll bar. tabRatio is assumed to be out of 1000 of the horizontal window width.

attributes.name: windowHeight
attributes.title: Window Height
attributes.description: Specifies the height of the workbook window.

attributes.name: windowWidth
attributes.title: Window Width
attributes.description: Specifies the width of the workbook window.

entries.name: customWorkbookViews
entries.title: Custom Workbook Views
entries.description: This element defines the collection of custom workbook views that are defined for this workbook. A customWorkbookView is similar in concept to a workbookView (§18.2.30) in that its attributes contain settings related to the way that the workbook should be displayed on a screen by a spreadsheet application.

entries.name: definedName
entries.title: Defined Name
entries.description: This element defines a defined name within this workbook. A defined name is descriptive text that is used to represents a cell, range of cells, formula, or constant value.

attributes.name: comment
attributes.title: Comment
attributes.description: Specifies the comment the user provided when the name was created.

attributes.name: customMenu
attributes.title: Custom Menu Text
attributes.description: Specifies custom menu text for the defined name.

attributes.name: description
attributes.title: Description
attributes.description: Specifies description text for the defined name.

attributes.name: function
attributes.title: Function
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates that the defined name refers to a user-defined function.

attributes.name: functionGroupId
attributes.title: Function Group Id
attributes.description: Specifies the function group index if the defined name refers to a function.

attributes.name: help
attributes.title: Help
attributes.description: Specifies the help topic to display for this defined name.

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.title: Hidden Name
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the defined name is hidden in the user interface.

attributes.name: localSheetId
attributes.title: Local Name Sheet Id
attributes.description: Specifies the sheet index in this workbook where data from an external reference is displayed.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Defined Name
attributes.description: Specifies the name that appears in the user interface for the defined name.

attributes.name: publishToServer
attributes.title: Publish To Server
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the defined name is included in the version of the workbook that is published to or rendered on a Web or application server.

attributes.name: shortcutKey
attributes.title: Shortcut Key
attributes.description: Specifies the keyboard shortcut for the defined name.

attributes.name: statusBar
attributes.title: Status Bar
attributes.description: Specifies text that is displayed on the application status bar when the user places focus on the defined name.

attributes.name: vbProcedure
attributes.title: Procedure
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the defined name is related to an external function, command, or other executable code.

attributes.name: xlm
attributes.title: External Function
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the defined name is related to an external function, command, or other executable code.

attributes.name: Xml:space
attributes.title: Content Contains Significant Whitespace
attributes.description: Specifies how white space should be handled for the contents of this element using the W3C space preservation rules.

entries.name: definedNames
entries.title: Defined Names
entries.description: This element defines the collection of defined names for this workbook. Defined names are descriptive names to represent cells, ranges of cells, formulas, or constant values. Defined names can be used to represent a range on any worksheet.

entries.name: ext
entries.title: Extension
entries.description: Each extension within an extension list shall be contained within an ext element. Extensions shall be versioned by namespace, using the uri attribute, and shall be allowed to appear in any order within the extension list. Any number of extensions shall be allowed within an extension list.

attributes.name: uri
attributes.title: URI
attributes.description: A token to identify version and application information for this particular extension.

entries.name: externalReference
entries.title: External Reference
entries.description: This element defines an external reference that stores data for workbook elements.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Relationship Id
attributes.description: Specifies a unique identifier that is used to identify a relationship to another part in the file.

entries.name: externalReferences
entries.title: External References
entries.description: This element defines the collection of external references for this workbook.

entries.name: extLst
entries.title: Future Feature Data Storage Area
entries.description: This element provides a convention for extending spreadsheetML in predefined locations. The locations shall be denoted with the extLst element, and are called extension lists. Extension list locations within the markup document are specified in the markup specification and can be used to store extensions to the markup specification, whether those are future version extensions of the markup specification or are private extensions implemented independently from the markup specification.

entries.name: fileRecoveryPr
entries.title: File Recovery Properties
entries.description: This element defines properties that track the state of the workbook file, such as whether the file was saved during a crash, or whether it should be opened in auto-recover mode.

attributes.name: autoRecover
attributes.title: Auto Recover
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the file is mark for auto-recovery.

attributes.name: crashSave
attributes.title: Crash Save
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the application last saved the workbook file after a crash.

attributes.name: dataExtractLoad
attributes.title: Data Extract Load
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the application last opened the workbook for data recovery.

attributes.name: repairLoad
attributes.title: Repair Load
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the application last opened the workbook in safe or repair mode.

entries.name: fileSharing
entries.title: File Sharing
entries.description: This element tracks file sharing settings for the workbook. When a password is to be hashed and stored in this element, it shall be hashed starting from a UTF-16LE encoded string value. If there is a leading BOM character (U+FEFF) in the encoded password it is removed before hash calculation.

attributes.name: algorithmName
attributes.title: Cryptographic Algorithm Name
attributes.description: Specifies the specific cryptographic hashing algorithm which shall be used along with the salt attribute and input password in order to compute the hash value.

attributes.name: hashValue
attributes.title: Password Hash Value
attributes.description: Specifies the hash value for the password required for editing this workbook.

attributes.name: nded
attributes.title: Read Only Recommended
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates on open, whether the application alerts the user that the file be marked as read-only.

attributes.name: saltValue
attributes.title: Salt Value for Password Verifier
attributes.description: Specifies the salt that was prepended to the user-supplied password before it was hashed using the hashing algorithm defined by the preceding attribute values to generate the hashValue attribute, and that shall also be prepended to the user-supplied password before attempting to generate a hash value for comparison.

attributes.name: spinCount
attributes.title: Iterations to Run Hashing Algorithm
attributes.description: Specifies the number of times the hashing function shall be iteratively run (runs using each iteration's result plus a 4 byte value (0-based, little endian) containing the number of the iteration as the input for the next iteration) when attempting to compare a user- supplied password with the value stored in the hashValue attribute.

attributes.name: userName
attributes.title: User Name
attributes.description: Specifies the username of the person with write reservation for this workbook.

entries.name: fileVersion
entries.title: File Version
entries.description: This element defines properties that track which version of the application accessed the data and source code contained in the file.

attributes.name: appName
attributes.title: Application Name
attributes.description: Specifies the application name.

attributes.name: codeName
attributes.title: Code Name
attributes.description: Specifies the GUID that identifies the code project that is associated with the workbook.

attributes.name: lastEdited
attributes.title: Last Edited Version
attributes.description: Specifies the version of the application that last saved the workbook.

attributes.name: lowestEdited
attributes.title: Lowest Edited Version
attributes.description: Specifies the earliest version of the application that saved the workbook.

attributes.name: rupBuild
attributes.title: Build Version
attributes.description: Specifies the incremental public release of the application.

entries.name: functionGroup
entries.title: Function Group
entries.description: This element represents a single function group.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Name
attributes.description: Specifies the name of the function group.

entries.name: functionGroups
entries.title: Function Groups
entries.description: This element defines the collection of function groups for the workbook.

attributes.name: builtInGroupCount
attributes.title: Built-in Function Group Count
attributes.description: Specifies the count of built-in function groups that the application provides in this workbook.

entries.name: oleSize
entries.title: Embedded Object Size
entries.description: This element defines the embedded object server for this workbook.

attributes.name: ref
attributes.title: Reference
attributes.description: Specifies the reference for the embedded object.

entries.name: pivotCache
entries.title: PivotCache
entries.description: This element represents a cache of data for pivot tables and formulas in the workbook.

attributes.name: cacheId
attributes.title: PivotCache Id
attributes.description: Specifies the unique identifier for the pivot cache for this workbook in the pivot cache part.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Relationship Id
attributes.description: Specifies the identifier to a pivot cache definition part where cached data is stored.

entries.name: pivotCaches
entries.title: PivotCaches
entries.description: This element enumerates pivot cache definition parts used by pivot tables and formulas in this workbook.

entries.name: sheet
entries.title: Sheet Information
entries.description: This element defines a sheet in this workbook. Sheet data is stored in a separate part.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Relationship Id
attributes.description: Specifies the identifier of the sheet part where the definition for this sheet is stored.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Sheet Name
attributes.description: Specifies the name of the sheet.

attributes.name: sheetId
attributes.title: Sheet Tab Id
attributes.description: Specifies the internal identifier for the sheet.

attributes.name: state
attributes.title: Visible State
attributes.description: Specifies the visible state of this sheet.

entries.name: sheets
entries.title: Sheets
entries.description: This element represents the collection of sheets in the workbook. There are different types of sheets you can create in SpreadsheetML. The most common sheet type is a worksheet; also called a spreadsheet.

entries.name: smartTagPr
entries.title: Smart Tag Properties
entries.description: This element defines a collection of smart tag properties that determine smart tag behavior in the workbook.

attributes.name: embed
attributes.title: Embed SmartTags
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the application saves smart tags with the workbook.

attributes.name: show
attributes.title: Show Smart Tags
attributes.description: Specifies how the application displays smart tags in the user interface.

entries.name: smartTagType
entries.title: Smart Tag Type
entries.description: This element represents a smart tag in the workbook.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Name
attributes.description: Specifies the element name used for a smart tag that is used by the application.

attributes.name: namespaceUri
attributes.title: SmartTag Namespace URI
attributes.description: Specifies the namespace Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) for a smart tag used by the application.

attributes.name: url
attributes.title: Smart Tag URL
attributes.description: Specifies the URL for a smart tag provided by the smart tag provider in the application.

entries.name: smartTagTypes
entries.title: Smart Tag Types
entries.description: This element defines the collection of smart tag types in the workbook. Smart tags represent data that is recognized and labeled as a particular type.

entries.name: webPublishing
entries.title: Web Publishing Properties
entries.description: This element defines properties that relate to publishing this workbook to the Web.

attributes.name: allowPng
attributes.title: Allow PNG
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the application saves images in the PNG (Portable Network Graphics) graphic format.

attributes.name: characterSet
attributes.title: Character Set
attributes.description: Name of the character set the application uses when a Web page is saved.

attributes.name: css
attributes.title: Use CSS
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the application uses Cascading Style Sheet (CSS) for font formatting on Web pages.

attributes.name: dpi
attributes.title: DPI
attributes.description: Specifies the DPI (defined as the number of pixels per inch) that are used to display images in Web pages.

attributes.name: longFileNames
attributes.title: Enable Long File Names
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the application allows file names longer than 8 octets with a three octet extension for Web pages.

attributes.name: targetScreenSize
attributes.title: Target Screen Size
attributes.description: Specifies the screen size on which Web pages are displayed.

attributes.name: thicket
attributes.title: Thicket
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates that the application stores supporting files such as bullets, background textures, and graphics in a separate folder from the Web page The possible values for this attribute are defined by the W3C XML Schema boolean datatype.

attributes.name: vml
attributes.title: VML in Browsers
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the application uses VML (Vector Markup Language) to display graphics in Web browsers The possible values for this attribute are defined by the W3C XML Schema boolean datatype.

entries.name: webPublishObject
entries.title: Web Publishing Object
entries.description: This element defines a single Web publishing object for the workbook. This element tracks basic information about an object in the workbook, such as a named range, that is published to the Web.

attributes.name: autoRepublish
attributes.title: Auto Republish
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the object specified in sourceObject is automatically published every time the workbook is saved.

attributes.name: destinationFile
attributes.title: Destination File
attributes.description: Specifies the destination file name to which the sourceObject is published.

attributes.name: divId
attributes.title: Div Id
attributes.description: Specifies the destination bookmark (div id) for the published object.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Id
attributes.description: Specifies the number, in "nnnnn" format, used in generated div id, in style id's, token filenames, and other variables.

attributes.name: sourceObject
attributes.title: Source Object
attributes.description: Specifies the named range to be published.

attributes.name: title
attributes.title: Title
attributes.description: Specifies the title of the published item.

entries.name: webPublishObjects
entries.title: Web Publish Objects
entries.description: This element defines the collection of Web publishing objects in the workbook.

attributes.name: count
attributes.title: Count
attributes.description: Specifies the number of items in the collection.

entries.name: workbook
entries.title: Workbook
entries.description: The workbook element is the top level element. It contains elements and attributes that encompass the data content of the workbook. The workbook's child elements each have their own subclause references, and these are shown in the child elements table below.

attributes.name: conformance
attributes.title: Document Conformance Class
attributes.description: Specifies the conformance class (§2.1) to which the SpreadsheetML document conforms.

entries.name: workbookPr
entries.title: Workbook Properties
entries.description: This element defines a collection of workbook properties.

attributes.name: allowRefreshQuery
attributes.title: Allow Refresh Query
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the application will refresh query tables in this workbook.

attributes.name: ures
attributes.title: Auto Compress Pictures
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates the application automatically compressed pictures in the workbook.

attributes.name: backupFile
attributes.title: Create Backup File
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the application creates a backup of the workbook on save.

attributes.name: checkCompatibility
attributes.title: Check Compatibility On Save
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the application checks for compatibility when saving this workbook to older file formats.

attributes.name: codeName
attributes.title: Code Name
attributes.description: Specifies the codename of the application that created this workbook.

attributes.name: date1904
attributes.title: Date 1904
attributes.description: Value that indicates whether to use a 1900 or 1904 date system when converting serial date-times in the workbook to dates.

attributes.name: system.
attributes.title: See §18.17.4.1 for the definition of the date systems.
attributes.description: The default value for this attribute is false.

attributes.name: on
attributes.title: Default Theme Version
attributes.description: Specifies the default version of themes to apply in the workbook.

attributes.name: filterPrivacy
attributes.title: Filter Privacy
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the application has inspected the workbook for personally identifying information (PII).

attributes.name: hidePivotFieldList
attributes.title: Hide Pivot Field List
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether a list of fields is shown for pivot tables in the application user interface.

attributes.name: promptedSolutions
attributes.title: Prompted Solutions
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the user has received an alert to load Smart Document components.

attributes.name: publishItems
attributes.title: Publish Items
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the publish the workbook or workbook items to the application server.

attributes.name: ons
attributes.title: Refresh all Connections on Open
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the workbok shall refresh all the connections to data sources during load.

attributes.name: alues
attributes.title: Save External Link Values
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the application will cache values retrieved from other workbooks via an externally linking formula.

attributes.name: ctedTables
attributes.title: Show Border Unselected Table
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether a border is drawn around unselected tables in the workbook.

attributes.name: n
attributes.title: Show Ink Annotations
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the book shows ink annotations.

attributes.name: showObjects
attributes.title: Show Objects
attributes.description: Specifies how the application shows embedded objects in the workbook.

attributes.name: er
attributes.title: Show Pivot Chart Filter
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether filtering options are shown for pivot charts in the workbook.

attributes.name: updateLinks
attributes.title: Update Links Behavior
attributes.description: Specifies how the application updates external links when the workbook is opened.

entries.name: workbookProtection
entries.title: Workbook Protection
entries.description: This element specifies options for protecting data in the workbook. Applications might use workbook protection to prevent anyone from accidentally changing, moving, or deleting important data. This protection can be ignored by applications which choose not to support this optional protection mechanism.

attributes.name: lockRevision
attributes.title: Lock Revisions
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the workbook is locked for revisions.

attributes.name: lockStructure
attributes.title: Lock Structure
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether structure of workbook is locked.

attributes.name: lockWindows
attributes.title: Lock Windows
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the windows that comprise the workbook are locked.

attributes.name: Name
attributes.title: Cryptographic Algorithm Name
attributes.description: Specifies the specific cryptographic hashing algorithm which shall be used along with the salt attribute and input password in order to compute the hash value for the revisionsHashValue attribute.

attributes.name: e
attributes.title: Password Hash Value
attributes.description: Specifies the hash value for the password stored for unlocking revisions in this workbook.

attributes.name: revisionsSaltValue
attributes.title: Salt Value for Password Verifier
attributes.description: Specifies the salt that was prepended to the user-supplied password before it was hashed using the hashing algorithm defined by the preceding attribute values to generate the revisionsHashValue attribute, and that shall also be prepended to the user-supplied password before attempting to generate a hash value for comparison.

attributes.name: mName
attributes.title: Cryptographic Algorithm Name
attributes.description: Specifies the specific cryptographic hashing algorithm which shall be used along with the salt attribute and input password in order to compute the hash value for the workbookHashValue attribute.

attributes.name: ue
attributes.title: Password Hash Value
attributes.description: Specifies the hash value for the password stored for unlocking this workbook.

attributes.name: e
attributes.title: Salt Value for Password Verifier
attributes.description: Specifies the salt which was prepended to the user-supplied password before it was hashed using the hashing algorithm defined by the preceding attribute values to generate the workbookHashValue attribute, and which shall also be prepended to the user- supplied password before attempting to generate a hash value for comparison.

attributes.name: nt
attributes.title: Iterations to Run Hashing Algorithm
attributes.description: Specifies the number of times the hashing function shall be iteratively run (runs using each iteration's result plus a 4 byte value (0-based, little endian) containing the number of the iteration as the input for the next iteration) when attempting to compare a user- supplied password with the value stored in the workbookHashValue attribute.

entries.name: workbookView
entries.title: Workbook View
entries.description: This element specifies a single Workbook view. Units for window widths and other dimensions are expressed in twips. Twip measurements are portable between different display resolutions.

attributes.name: activeTab
attributes.title: Active Sheet Index
attributes.description: Specifies an unsignedInt that contains the index to the active sheet in this book view.

attributes.name: ping
attributes.title: AutoFilter Date Grouping
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether to group dates when presenting the user with filtering options in the user interface.

attributes.name: firstSheet
attributes.title: First Sheet
attributes.description: Specifies the index to the first sheet in this book view.

attributes.name: minimized
attributes.title: Minimized
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether the workbook window is minimized.

attributes.name: oll
attributes.title: Show Horizontal Scroll
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether to display the horizontal scroll bar in the user interface.

attributes.name: showSheetTabs
attributes.title: Show Sheet Tabs
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether to display the sheet tabs in the user interface.

attributes.name: showVerticalScroll
attributes.title: Show Vertical Scroll
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value that indicates whether to display the vertical scroll bar.

attributes.name: tabRatio
attributes.title: Sheet Tab Ratio
attributes.description: Specifies ratio between the workbook tabs bar and the horizontal scroll bar.

attributes.name: visibility
attributes.title: Visibility
attributes.description: Specifies visible state of the workbook window.

attributes.name: windowHeight
attributes.title: Window Height
attributes.description: Specifies the height of the workbook window.

attributes.name: windowWidth
attributes.title: Window Width
attributes.description: Specifies the width of the workbook window.

entries.name: anchor
entries.title: Object Cell Anchor
entries.description: This element specifies the position of an embedded object or embedded control.

attributes.name: sizeWithCells
attributes.title: Size With Cells
attributes.description: Specifies that the object resizes with its underlying cells.

attributes.name: z-order
attributes.title: Z-Order
attributes.description: Specifies the Z-order index of the object.

entries.name: autoFilter
entries.title: AutoFilter Settings
entries.description: AutoFilter temporarily hides rows based on a filter criteria, which is applied column by column to a table of data in the worksheet. This collection expresses AutoFilter settings.

attributes.name: ref
attributes.title: Cell or Range Reference
attributes.description: Reference to the cell range to which the AutoFilter is applied.

entries.name: brk
entries.title: Break
entries.description: A row or column break to use when paginating a worksheet. [Note: See §18.18.69 for more information on worksheet views. end note]

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Id
attributes.description: Zero-based row or column Id of the page break.

attributes.name: man
attributes.title: Manual Page Break
attributes.description: Manual Break flag. 1 means the break is a manually inserted break.

attributes.name: max
attributes.title: Maximum
attributes.description: Zero-based index of end row or column of the break.

attributes.name: min
attributes.title: Minimum
attributes.description: Zero-based index of start row or column of the break.

attributes.name: pt
attributes.title: Pivot-Created Page Break
attributes.description: Flag indicating that a PivotTable created this break.

entries.name: c
entries.title: Cell
entries.description: This collection represents a cell in the worksheet. Information about the cell's location (reference), value, data type, formatting, and formula is expressed here.

attributes.name: cm
attributes.title: Cell Metadata Index
attributes.description: The zero-based index of the cell metadata record associated with this cell.

attributes.name: ph
attributes.title: Show Phonetic
attributes.description: A Boolean value indicating if the spreadsheet application should show phonetic information.

attributes.name: r
attributes.title: Reference
attributes.description: An A1 style reference to the location of this cell The possible values for this attribute are defined by the ST_CellRef simple type (§18.18.7).

attributes.name: s
attributes.title: Style Index
attributes.description: The index of this cell's style.

attributes.name: t
attributes.title: Cell Data Type
attributes.description: An enumeration representing the cell's data type.

attributes.name: vm
attributes.title: Value Metadata Index
attributes.description: The zero-based index of the value metadata record associated with this cell's value.

entries.name: cellSmartTag
entries.title: Cell Smart Tag
entries.description: Single smart tag associated with a cell. There can be more than one cellSmartTag for a cell.

attributes.name: deleted
attributes.title: Deleted
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating that the application shouldn't display a particular smart tag in the cell.

attributes.name: type
attributes.title: Smart Tag Type Index
attributes.description: Book-level zero-based index of the smart tag type.

attributes.name: xmlBased
attributes.title: XML Based
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating the Smart Tag recognition is triggered because the cell is associated with an XML map (schema-based semantic recognition), as contrasted with the more usual cell-content-based recognition of smart tags.

entries.name: cellSmartTagPr
entries.title: Smart Tag Properties
entries.description: Represents a single property of a smart tag in a cell; contains a key-value pair.

attributes.name: key
attributes.title: Key Name
attributes.description: Key name of a single property of a smart tag in a cell.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: String value of a single property of a smart tag in a cell.

entries.name: cellSmartTags
entries.title: Cell Smart Tags
entries.description: The element is used to label the cell with a smart tag. A cell can be determined to have semantic meaning and the cell containing this data can be labeled with a smart tag. The actions which can be taken depend on the semantic meaning of the data and the actions that the application decides to associate with that type of smart tag.

attributes.name: r
attributes.title: Reference
attributes.description: Reference to the cell that contains this set of smart tags.

entries.name: cellWatch
entries.title: Cell Watch Item
entries.description: The watch window is a single UI location where the application user can keep track of certain cell formulas & values which they have chosen to be in the set of watched cells. This element expresses the cell address of a cell being watched. It is always a reference to a single cell.

attributes.name: r
attributes.title: Reference
attributes.description: Cell reference of the cell being watched.

entries.name: cellWatches
entries.title: Cell Watch Items
entries.description: Collection of cells on this worksheet being watched in the 'watch window'.

entries.name: cfRule
entries.title: Conditional Formatting Rule
entries.description: This collection represents a description of a conditional formatting rule.

attributes.name: aboveAverage
attributes.title: Above Or Below Average
attributes.description: Indicates whether the rule is an "above average" rule. 1 indicates 'above average'.

attributes.name: bottom
attributes.title: Bottom N
attributes.description: Indicates whether a "top/bottom n" rule is a "bottom n" rule. 1 indicates 'bottom'.

attributes.name: dxfId
attributes.title: Differential Formatting Id
attributes.description: This is an index to a dxf element in the Styles Part indicating which cell formatting to apply when the conditional formatting rule criteria is met.

attributes.name: equalAverage
attributes.title: Equal Average
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the 'aboveAverage' and 'belowAverage' criteria is inclusive of the average itself, or exclusive of that value. 1 indicates to include the average value in the criteria.

attributes.name: operator
attributes.title: Operator
attributes.description: The operator in a "cell value is" conditional formatting rule.

attributes.name: percent
attributes.title: Top 10 Percent
attributes.description: Indicates whether a "top/bottom n" rule is a "top/bottom n percent" rule.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.title: Priority
attributes.description: The priority of this conditional formatting rule.

attributes.name: rank
attributes.title: Rank
attributes.description: The value of "n" in a "top/bottom n" conditional formatting rule.

attributes.name: stdDev
attributes.title: StdDev
attributes.description: The number of standard deviations to include above or below the average in the conditional formatting rule.

attributes.name: stopIfTrue
attributes.title: Stop If True
attributes.description: If this flag is 1, no rules with lower priority shall be applied over this rule, when this rule evaluates to true.

attributes.name: text
attributes.title: Text
attributes.description: The text value in a "text contains" conditional formatting rule.

attributes.name: timePeriod
attributes.title: Time Period
attributes.description: The applicable time period in a "date occurring…" conditional formatting rule.

attributes.name: type
attributes.title: Type
attributes.description: Type of conditional formatting rule.

entries.name: cfvo
entries.title: Conditional Format Value Object
entries.description: Describes the values of the interpolation points in a gradient scale.

attributes.name: gte
attributes.title: Greater Than Or Equal
attributes.description: For icon sets, determines whether this threshold value uses the greater than or equal to operator. 0 indicates 'greater than' is used instead of 'greater than or equal to'.

attributes.name: type
attributes.title: Type
attributes.description: The type of this conditional formatting value object.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: The value of this conditional formatting value object.

entries.name: chartsheet
entries.title: Chart Sheet
entries.description: This is the root element of Chartsheet Parts in a SpreadsheetML document.

entries.name: col
entries.title: Column Width & Formatting
entries.description: Defines column width and column formatting for one or more columns of the worksheet.

attributes.name: bestFit
attributes.title: Best Fit Column Width
attributes.description: Flag indicating if the specified column(s) is set to 'best fit'. 'Best fit' is set to true under these conditions:  The column width has never been manually set by the user, AND  The column width is not the default width   'Best fit' means that when numbers are typed into a cell contained in a 'best fit' column, the column width should automatically resize to display the number.

attributes.name: collapsed
attributes.title: Collapsed
attributes.description: Flag indicating if the outlining of the affected column(s) is in the collapsed state.

attributes.name: customWidth
attributes.title: Custom Width
attributes.description: Flag indicating that the column width for the affected column(s) is different from the default or has been manually set.

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.title: Hidden Columns
attributes.description: Flag indicating if the affected column(s) are hidden on this worksheet.

attributes.name: max
attributes.title: Maximum Column
attributes.description: Last column affected by this 'column info' record.

attributes.name: min
attributes.title: Minimum Column
attributes.description: First column affected by this 'column info' record.

attributes.name: outlineLevel
attributes.title: Outline Level
attributes.description: Outline level of affected column(s).

attributes.name: phonetic
attributes.title: Show Phonetic Information
attributes.description: Flag indicating if the phonetic information should be displayed by default for the affected column(s) of the worksheet.

attributes.name: style
attributes.title: Style
attributes.description: Default style for the affected column(s).

attributes.name: width
attributes.title: Column Width
attributes.description: Column width measured as the number of characters of the maximum digit width of the numbers 0, 1, 2, …, 9 as rendered in the normal style's font.

entries.name: colBreaks
entries.title: Vertical Page Breaks
entries.description: A collection of column breaks (§18.3.1.3).

attributes.name: count
attributes.title: Page Break Count
attributes.description: Number of breaks in the collection.

attributes.name: manualBreakCount
attributes.title: Manual Break Count
attributes.description: Number of manual breaks in the collection.

entries.name: color
entries.title: Data Bar Color
entries.description: One of the colors associated with the data bar or color scale. The auto attribute shall not be used in the context of data bars.

attributes.name: auto
attributes.title: Automatic
attributes.description: A boolean value indicating the color is automatic and system color dependent.

attributes.name: indexed
attributes.title: Index
attributes.description: Indexed color value.

attributes.name: rgb
attributes.title: Alpha Red Green Blue Color Value
attributes.description: Standard Alpha Red Green Blue color value (ARGB).

attributes.name: theme
attributes.title: Theme Color
attributes.description: A zero-based index into the <clrScheme> collection (§20.1.6.2), referencing a particular <sysClr> or <srgbClr> value expressed in the Theme part.

attributes.name: tint
attributes.title: Tint
attributes.description: Specifies the tint value applied to the color.

attributes.name: If
attributes.title: tint < 0
attributes.description: Lum’ = Lum * (1.0 + tint) For example: Lum = 200; tint = -0.5; Darken 50% Lum‘ = 200 * (0.5) => 100 For example: Lum = 200; tint = -1.0; Darken 100% (make black) Lum‘ = 200 * (1.0-1.0) => 0

attributes.name: If
attributes.title: tint > 0
attributes.description: Lum‘ = Lum * (1.0-tint) + (HLSMAX – HLSMAX * (1.0-tint)) For example: Lum = 100; tint = 0.75; Lighten 75% Lum‘ = 100 * (1-.75) + (HLSMAX – HLSMAX*(1-.75)) = 100 * .25 + (255 – 255 * .25) = 25 + (255 – 63) = 25 + 192 = 217 For example: Lum = 100; tint = 1.0; Lighten 100% (make white) Lum‘ = 100 * (1-1) + (HLSMAX – HLSMAX*(1-1)) = 100 * 0 + (255 – 255 * 0) = 0 + (255 – 0) = 255 end example] The poss

entries.name: colorScale
entries.title: Color Scale
entries.description: Describes a gradated color scale in this conditional formatting rule.

entries.name: cols
entries.title: Column Information
entries.description: Information about whole columns of the worksheet.

entries.name: conditionalFormatting
entries.title: Conditional Formatting
entries.description: A Conditional Format is a format, such as cell shading or font color, that a spreadsheet application can automatically apply to cells if a specified condition is true. This collection expresses conditional formatting rules applied to a particular cell or range.

attributes.name: sqref
attributes.title: Sequence of Refernces
attributes.description: Range over which these conditional formatting rules apply.

entries.name: control
entries.title: Embedded Control
entries.description: A single embedded control.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Relationship Id
attributes.description: This relationship ID references an Embedded Control Data part which contains control- specific properties and state information about this particular embedded control.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Control Name
attributes.description: The code name of the control.

attributes.name: shapeId
attributes.title: Shape Id
attributes.description: ID of the drawing shape in the DrawingML part with which this control is associated.

entries.name: controlPr
entries.title: Embedded Control Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the visual, positional and cell linkage properties of an embedded control.

attributes.name: altText
attributes.title: Alternative Text
attributes.description: Specifies alternative text for the object, for use by assistive technologies or applications.

attributes.name: autoFill
attributes.title: Automatic Fill Flag
attributes.description: Specifies whether the object’s fill formatting is provided automatically by the application.

attributes.name: autoLine
attributes.title: Automatic Line Flag
attributes.description: Specifies whether the object’s line formatting is provided automatically by the application.

attributes.name: cf
attributes.title: Image Format
attributes.description: Specifies the image format used to render the object.

attributes.name: defaultSize
attributes.title: Default Size Flag
attributes.description: Specifies whether the object is at its default size.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.title: Disabled Flag
attributes.description: Specifies whether the object is allowed to run an attached macro.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Relationship ID for Embedded Control Properties
attributes.description: Specifies the relationship ID for the relationship which contains the properties for this embedded control.

attributes.name: linkedCell
attributes.title: Linked Formula
attributes.description: Specifies the cell the control is linked to, using standard cell A1-style reference syntax as described in §18.17.2.3.1.

attributes.name: listFillRange
attributes.title: List Items Source Range
attributes.description: Specifies the range of source data cells used to populate the list box, using standard A1- style cell reference syntax as described in §18.17.2.3.1.

attributes.name: locked
attributes.title: Locked Flag
attributes.description: Specifies that the object is locked when the sheet is protected.

attributes.name: macro
attributes.title: Custom Function
attributes.description: Specifies the custom function associated with the object.

attributes.name: print
attributes.title: Print Flag
attributes.description: Specifies whether the object is printed when the document is printed.

attributes.name: recalcAlways
attributes.title: Recalculation Flag
attributes.description: Specifies whether the object is always included in recalculation.

attributes.name: uiObject
attributes.title: UI Object Flag
attributes.description: Specifies whether the object is a UI-only object.

entries.name: controls
entries.title: Embedded Controls
entries.description: Worksheets can have embedded controls embedded in them. This collection is a listing of embedded controls in this worksheet. This collection is used to reference individual Embedded Control Data part definitions, enumerate the code name of each control, and reference drawing information used to draw the control.

entries.name: customPr
entries.title: Custom Property
entries.description: The custom property element provides a mechanism to store name/value pairs of arbitrary user-defined data. The name is stored in the attribute name, the arbitrary data is stored in the binary part referenced by the relationshipId.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Relationship Id
attributes.description: This relationship references the binary part containing the specified custom properties.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Custom Property Name
attributes.description: Name of the custom property The possible values for this attribute are defined by the ST_Xstring simple type (§22.9.2.19).

entries.name: customProperties
entries.title: Custom Properties
entries.description: This collection is used to reference binary parts containing arbitrary user-defined data.

entries.name: customSheetView
entries.title: Custom Chart Sheet View
entries.description: This element defines custom view properties for chart sheets. [Note: See customSheetView (§18.3.1.25) for an example. end note]

attributes.name: guid
attributes.title: GUID
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this custom view The possible values for this attribute are defined by the ST_Guid simple type (§22.9.2.4).

attributes.name: scale
attributes.title: Print Scale
attributes.description: Print scaling, representing percent values.

attributes.name: state
attributes.title: Visible State
attributes.description: Visibility state of the sheet.

attributes.name: zoomToFit
attributes.title: Zoom To Fit
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether chart sheet is zoom to fit window.

entries.name: customSheetView
entries.title: Custom Sheet View
entries.description: This collection stores information pertaining to one custom sheet view definition. A custom view is a collection of settings defining a particular view of the sheet. These views can be selected by the user for quick access to predefined views of the sheet.

attributes.name: colorId
attributes.title: Color Id
attributes.description: Index to the color value for the text in row/column headings and gridlines for this custom view.

attributes.name: filter
attributes.title: Filtered List
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the view contains a filtered range.

attributes.name: filterUnique
attributes.title: Filter
attributes.description: Indicates whether an advanced filter has been applied, and the option to filter out duplicate records from the data list has been selected, in this custom view.

attributes.name: fitToPage
attributes.title: Fit To Page
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this view should be fit to page when printing this custom view.

attributes.name: guid
attributes.title: GUID
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this custom view.

attributes.name: hiddenColumns
attributes.title: Hidden Columns
attributes.description: Flag indicating that there is one or more hidden column(s) in this custom view.

attributes.name: hiddenRows
attributes.title: Hidden Rows
attributes.description: Flag indicating that there is one or more hidden row(s) in this custom view.

attributes.name: outlineSymbols
attributes.title: Show Outline Symbols
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether outline symbols are displayed in this custom view.

attributes.name: printArea
attributes.title: Print Area Defined
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a print area is defined as part of this custom view.

attributes.name: scale
attributes.title: Print Scale
attributes.description: Print scaling for this custom view.

attributes.name: showAutoFilter
attributes.title: Show AutoFilter Drop Down Controls
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the autofilter dropdown buttons are visible in this custom view.

attributes.name: showFormulas
attributes.title: Show Formulas
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether formulas are shown in this custom view.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.title: Show Grid Lines
attributes.description: The possible values for this attribute are defined by the W3C XML Schema boolean datatype.

attributes.name: showPageBreaks
attributes.title: Show Page Breaks
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether page breaks are shown in this custom view.

attributes.name: showRowCol
attributes.title: Show Headers
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether row and column headers are shown in this custom view.

attributes.name: showRuler
attributes.title: Show Ruler
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether to show the ruler in this custom view.

attributes.name: state
attributes.title: Visible State
attributes.description: Visibility state for this custom view.

attributes.name: topLeftCell
attributes.title: Top Left Visible Cell
attributes.description: Location of the top left visible cell in the bottom right pane in this custom view (when in Left-to-Right mode).

attributes.name: view
attributes.title: View Type
attributes.description: Indicates the view type for this Custom View The possible values for this attribute are defined by the ST_SheetViewType simple type (§18.18.69).

attributes.name: zeroValues
attributes.title: Show Zero Values
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the window should display 0 (zero) values in this custom view.

entries.name: customSheetViews
entries.title: Custom Chart Sheet Views
entries.description: Collection of custom Chart Sheet View information.

entries.name: customSheetViews
entries.title: Custom Sheet Views
entries.description: This is a collection of custom sheet views.

entries.name: dataBar
entries.title: Data Bar
entries.description: Describes a data bar conditional formatting rule.

attributes.name: maxLength
attributes.title: Maximum Length
attributes.description: The maximum length of the data bar, as a percentage of the cell width.

attributes.name: minLength
attributes.title: Minimum Length
attributes.description: The minimum length of the data bar, as a percentage of the cell width.

attributes.name: showValue
attributes.title: Show Values
attributes.description: Indicates whether to show the values of the cells on which this data bar is applied.

entries.name: dataConsolidate
entries.title: Data Consolidate
entries.description: Data consolidation settings. The dataRefs are the set of source ranges containing data to consolidate. The function indicates the function that shall be used to consolidate the data.

attributes.name: function
attributes.title: Function Index
attributes.description: Indicates which function to use when consolidating the ranges.

attributes.name: link
attributes.title: Link
attributes.description: Create links to source data.

attributes.name: startLabels
attributes.title: Use Starting Column Labels
attributes.description: Use labels in first column.

attributes.name: topLabels
attributes.title: Labels In Top Row
attributes.description: Use labels in top row.

attributes.name: xml:space
attributes.title: Content Contains Significant Whitespace
attributes.description: Specifies how white space should be handled for the contents of this element using the W3C space preservation rules.

entries.name: dataRef
entries.title: Data Consolidation Reference
entries.description: A single data consolidate reference. One dataRef shall use either name or sheet & ref, but not both on the same dataRef.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: relationship Id
attributes.description: Used only when the source range is external to this workbook.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Named Range
attributes.description: Named range, either in this workbook or the external workbook referenced by r:Id.

attributes.name: ref
attributes.title: Reference
attributes.description: Cell range.

attributes.name: sheet
attributes.title: Sheet Name
attributes.description: Sheet name.

attributes.description: The whole range of data to sort (not just the sort-by column).

attributes.name: sortMethod
attributes.title: Sort Method
attributes.description: Strokes or PinYin sort method.

entries.name: tabColor
entries.title: Sheet Tab Color
entries.description: Background color of the sheet tab.

attributes.name: auto
attributes.title: Automatic
attributes.description: A boolean value indicating the color is automatic and system color dependent.

attributes.name: indexed
attributes.title: Index
attributes.description: Indexed color value.

attributes.name: rgb
attributes.title: Alpha Red Green Blue Color Value
attributes.description: Standard Alpha Red Green Blue color value (ARGB).

attributes.name: theme
attributes.title: Theme Color
attributes.description: A zero-based index into the <clrScheme> collection (§20.1.6.2), referencing a particular <sysClr> or <srgbClr> value expressed in the Theme part.

attributes.name: tint
attributes.title: Tint
attributes.description: Specifies the tint value applied to the color.

attributes.name: If
attributes.title: tint < 0
attributes.description: Lum’ = Lum * (1.0 + tint) For example: Lum = 200; tint = -0.5; Darken 50% Lum‘ = 200 * (0.5) => 100 For example: Lum = 200; tint = -1.0; Darken 100% (make black) Lum‘ = 200 * (1.0-1.0) => 0

attributes.name: If
attributes.title: tint > 0
