entries.name: tablePart
entries.title: Table Part
entries.description: A single Table Part reference.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Relationship Id
attributes.description: This relationship Id is used to locate a particular table definition part.

entries.name: tableParts
entries.title: Table Parts
entries.description: This collection expresses a relationship Id pointing to every table on this sheet.

attributes.name: count
attributes.title: Count
attributes.description: A count of table elements in the collection.

entries.name: v
entries.title: Cell Value
entries.description: This element expresses the value contained in a cell. If the cell contains a string, then this value is an index into the shared string table, pointing to the actual string value. Otherwise, the value of the cell is expressed directly in this element.

attributes.name: xml:space
attributes.title: Content Contains Significant Whitespace
attributes.description: Specifies how white space should be handled for the contents of this element using the W3C space preservation rules.

entries.name: webPublishItem
entries.title: Web Publishing Item
entries.description: This element represents information for a single item or object which can be published to HTML.

attributes.name: autoRepublish
attributes.title: Automatically Publish
attributes.description: Automatically publish this item every time the workbook is saved.

attributes.name: destinationFile
attributes.title: Destination File Name
attributes.description: Destination file name.

attributes.name: divId
attributes.title: Destination Bookmark
attributes.description: Destination bookmark.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Id
attributes.description: This is a unique number "nnnnn" of the webPublishItem.

attributes.name: sourceObject
attributes.title: Source Object Name
attributes.description: Source object name (required for sourceType = pivotTable, query, or label).

attributes.name: sourceRef
attributes.title: Source Id
attributes.description: Source range (required for sourceType = 'range').

attributes.name: sourceType
attributes.title: Web Source Type
attributes.description: Type of web source (or objects to publish).

attributes.name: title
attributes.title: Title
attributes.description: HTML title of published item.

entries.name: webPublishItems
entries.title: Web Publishing Items
entries.description: This represents a listing of individual objects in this workbook that have been published (to HTML). When one of these objects is selected to be published, just the object is published to HTML, not the entire workbook contents.

attributes.name: count
attributes.title: Web Publishing Items Count
attributes.description: Number of items.

entries.name: worksheet
entries.title: Worksheet
entries.description: This is the root element of Worksheet parts within a SpreadsheetML document.

entries.name: colorFilter
entries.title: Color Filter Criteria
entries.description: This element specifies the color to filter by and whether to use the cell's fill or font color in the filter criteria. If the cell's font or fill color does not match the color specified in the criteria, the rows corresponding to those cells are hidden from view.

attributes.name: cellColor
attributes.title: Filter By Cell Color
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether or not to filter by the cell's fill color. 1 indicates to filter by cell fill. 0 indicates to filter by the cell's font color.

attributes.name: dxfId
attributes.title: Differential Format Record Id
attributes.description: Id of differential format record (dxf) in the Styles Part which expresses the color value to filter by.

entries.name: customFilter
entries.title: Custom Filter Criteria
entries.description: A custom AutoFilter specifies an operator and a value. There can be at most two customFilters specified, and in that case the parent element specifies whether the two conditions are joined by 'and' or 'or'. For any cells whose values do not meet the specified criteria, the corresponding rows shall be hidden from view when the filter is applied.

attributes.name: operator
attributes.title: Filter Comparison Operator
attributes.description: Operator used by the filter comparison.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Top or Bottom Value
attributes.description: Top or bottom value used in the filter criteria.

entries.name: customFilters
entries.title: Custom Filters
entries.description: When there is more than one custom filter criteria to apply (an 'and' or 'or' joining two criteria), then this element groups the customFilter elements together.

attributes.name: and
attributes.title: And
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the two criteria have an "and" relationship. 1 indicates "and", 0 indicates "or".

entries.name: dateGroupItem
entries.title: Date Grouping
entries.description: This collection is used to express a group of dates or times which are used in an AutoFilter criteria. [Note: See parent element for an example. end note] Values are always written in the calendar type of the first date encountered in the filter range, so that all subsequent dates, even when formatted or represented by other calendar types, can be correctly compared for the purposes of filtering.

attributes.name: dateTimeGrouping
attributes.title: Date Time Grouping
attributes.description: Grouping level.

attributes.name: day
attributes.title: Day
attributes.description: Day (1-31) The possible values for this attribute are defined by the W3C XML Schema unsignedShort datatype.

attributes.name: hour
attributes.title: Hour
attributes.description: Hour (0-23) The possible values for this attribute are defined by the W3C XML Schema unsignedShort datatype.

attributes.name: minute
attributes.title: Minute
attributes.description: Minute (0-59) The possible values for this attribute are defined by the W3C XML Schema unsignedShort datatype.

attributes.name: month
attributes.title: Month
attributes.description: Month (1-12) Attributes Description The possible values for this attribute are defined by the W3C XML Schema unsignedShort datatype.

attributes.name: second
attributes.title: Second
attributes.description: Second (0-59) The possible values for this attribute are defined by the W3C XML Schema unsignedShort datatype.

attributes.name: year
attributes.title: Year
attributes.description: Year (4 digits) The possible values for this attribute are defined by the W3C XML Schema unsignedShort datatype.

entries.name: dynamicFilter
entries.title: Dynamic Filter
entries.description: This collection specifies dynamic filter criteria. These criteria are considered dynamic because they can change, either with the data itself (e.g., "above average") or with the current system date (e.g., show values for "today"). For any cells whose values do not meet the specified criteria, the corresponding rows shall be hidden from view when the filter is applied.

attributes.name: maxValIso
attributes.title: Max ISO Value
attributes.description: A maximum value for dynamic filter. maxValIso shall be required for today, yesterday, tomorrow, nextWeek, thisWeek, lastWeek, nextMonth, thisMonth, lastMonth, nextQuarter, thisQuarter, lastQuarter, nextYear, thisYear, lastYear, and yearToDate.

attributes.name: type
attributes.title: Dynamic filter type
attributes.description: Dynamic filter type, e.g., “today” or “nextWeek”.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: A minimum numeric value for dynamic

attributes.name: filter.
attributes.title: See description of valIso to understand when val is required.
attributes.description: The possible values for this attribute are defined by the W3C XML Schema double datatype.

attributes.name: valIso
attributes.title: ISO Value
attributes.description: A minimum value for dynamic

attributes.name: filter.
attributes.title: See description of maxValIso to understand when val/valIso is required.
attributes.description: Only these types of dynamic filters use numeric data, and therefore shall use val and shall not use valIso:  aboveAverage and belowAverage The possible values for this attribute are defined by the W3C XML Schema dateTime datatype.

entries.name: filter
entries.title: Filter
entries.description: This element expresses a filter criteria value.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Filter Value
attributes.description: Filter value used in the criteria.

entries.name: filterColumn
entries.title: AutoFilter Column
entries.description: The filterColumn collection identifies a particular column in the AutoFilter range and specifies filter information that has been applied to this column. If a column in the AutoFilter range has no criteria specified, then there is no corresponding filterColumn collection expressed for that column.

attributes.name: colId
attributes.title: Filter Column Data
attributes.description: Zero-based index indicating the AutoFilter column to which this filter information applies.

attributes.name: hiddenButton
attributes.title: Hidden AutoFilter Button
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the AutoFilter button for this column is hidden.

attributes.name: showButton
attributes.title: Show Filter Button
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether an application intended for editing Office Open XML documents should show filtering interface elements on this cell.

entries.name: filters
entries.title: Filter Criteria
entries.description: When multiple values are chosen to filter by, or when a group of date values are chosen to filter by, this element groups those criteria together.

attributes.name: blank
attributes.title: Filter by Blank
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether to filter by blank.

attributes.name: calendarType
attributes.title: Calendar Type
attributes.description: Calendar type for date grouped items.

entries.name: iconFilter
entries.title: Icon Filter
entries.description: This element specifies the icon set and particular icon within that set to filter by. For any cells whose icon does not match the specified criteria, the corresponding rows shall be hidden from view when the filter is applied.

attributes.name: iconId
attributes.title: Icon Id
attributes.description: Zero-based index of an icon in an icon set.

attributes.name: iconSet
attributes.title: Icon Set
attributes.description: Specifies which icon set is used in the filter criteria.

entries.name: top10
entries.title: Top 10
entries.description: This element specifies the top N (percent or number of items) to filter by.

attributes.name: filterVal
attributes.title: Filter Value
attributes.description: The actual cell value in the range which is used to perform the comparison for this filter.

attributes.name: percent
attributes.title: Filter by Percent
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether or not to filter by percent value of the column.

attributes.name: top
attributes.title: Top
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether or not to filter by top order.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Top or Bottom Value
attributes.description: Top or bottom value to use as the filter criteria.

entries.name: charset
entries.title: Character Set
entries.description: This element defines the font character set of this font. This field is used in font creation and selection if a font of the given facename is not available on the system. Although it is not required to have around when resolving font facename, the information can be stored for when needed to help resolve which font face to use of all available fonts on a system.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: The value of an integer, where each value corresponds to a different character set.

entries.name: outline
entries.title: Outline
entries.description: This element displays only the inner and outer borders of each character. This is very similar to Bold in behavior.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: A boolean value for the property specified by the parent XML element.

entries.name: phoneticPr
entries.title: Phonetic Properties
entries.description: This element represents a collection of phonetic properties that affect the display of phonetic text for this String Item (si). Phonetic text is used to give hints as to the pronunciation of an East Asian language, and the hints are displayed as text within the spreadsheet cells across the top portion of the cell. Since the phonetic hints are text, every phonetic hint is expressed as a phonetic run (rPh), and these properties specify how to display that phonetic run.

attributes.name: alignment
attributes.title: Alignment
attributes.description: Specifies how the text for the phonetic run is aligned across the top of the cells, with respect to the main text in the body of the cell.

attributes.name: fontId
attributes.title: Font Id
attributes.description: An integer that is a zero-based index into the font record in the style sheet.

attributes.name: type
attributes.title: Character Type
attributes.description: An enumeration which specifies which East Asian character set should be used to display the phonetic run The possible values for this attribute are defined by the ST_PhoneticType simple type (§18.18.57).

entries.name: r
entries.title: Rich Text Run
entries.description: This element represents a run of rich text. A rich text run is a region of text that share a common set of properties, such as formatting properties. The properties are defined in the rPr element, and the text displayed to the user is defined in the Text (t) element.

entries.name: rFont
entries.title: Font
entries.description: This element is a string representing the name of the font assigned to display this run.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: String Value
attributes.description: A string representing the name of the font.

entries.name: rPh
entries.title: Phonetic Run
entries.description: This element represents a run of text which displays a phonetic hint for this String Item (si). Phonetic hints are used to give information about the pronunciation of an East Asian language. The hints are displayed as text within the spreadsheet cells across the top portion of the cell.

attributes.name: eb
attributes.title: Base Text End Index
attributes.description: An integer used as a zero-based index representing the ending offset into the base text for this phonetic run.

attributes.name: sb
attributes.title: Base Text Start Index
attributes.description: An integer used as a zero-based index representing the starting offset into the base text for this phonetic run.

entries.name: rPr
entries.title: Run Properties
entries.description: This element represents a set of properties to apply to the contents of this rich text run.

entries.name: si
entries.title: String Item
entries.description: This element is the representation of an individual string in the Shared String table. If the string is just a simple string with formatting applied at the cell level, then the String Item (si) should contain a single text element used to express the string. However, if the string in the cell is more complex - i.e., has formatting applied at the character level - then the string item shall consist of multiple rich text runs which collectively are used to express the string.

entries.name: sst
entries.title: Shared String Table
entries.description: This element is the root of the Shared String Table, which serves as a collection of individual String Items (si).

attributes.name: count
attributes.title: String Count
attributes.description: An integer representing the total count of strings in the workbook.

attributes.name: uniqueCount
attributes.title: Unique String Count
attributes.description: An integer representing the total count of unique strings in the Shared String Table.

entries.name: strike
entries.title: Strike Through
entries.description: This element draws a strikethrough line through the horizontal middle of the text.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: A boolean value for the property specified by the parent XML element.

entries.name: sz
entries.title: Font Size
entries.description: This element represents the point size (1/72 of an inch) of the Latin and East Asian text.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: A double representing the value of a positive measurement in points (1/72 of an inch).

entries.name: t
entries.title: Text
entries.description: This element represents the text content shown as part of a string. The possible values for this element are defined by the ST_Xstring simple type (§22.9.2.19).

attributes.name: xml:space
attributes.title: Content Contains Significant Whitespace
attributes.description: Specifies how white space should be handled for the contents of this element using the W3C space preservation rules.

entries.name: u
entries.title: Underline
entries.description: This element represents the underline formatting style.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Underline Value
attributes.description: An enumeration representing the style of underlining that is used.

entries.name: vertAlign
entries.title: Vertical Alignment
entries.description: This element adjusts the vertical position of the text relative to the text's default appearance for this run. It is used to get 'superscript' or 'subscript' texts, and shall reduce the font size (if a smaller size is available) accordingly.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: An enumeration representing the vertical-alignment setting.

entries.name: calculatedColumnFormula
entries.title: Calculated Column Formula
entries.description: Columns in a table can have cells that are calculated, usually based on values in other cells in the table. This element stores the formula that is used to perform the calculation for each cell in this column. It shall be understood that formulas which reference columns of this table, shall be calculated using the cells in those columns on the same row of the table as the cell that the formula resides in.

attributes.name: array
attributes.title: Array
attributes.description: A Boolean value that indicates whether this formula is an array style formula.

attributes.name: xml:space
attributes.title: Content Contains Significant Whitespace
attributes.description: Specifies how white space should be handled for the contents of this element using the W3C space preservation rules.

entries.name: table
entries.title: Table
entries.description: This element is the root element for a table that is not a single cell XML table.

attributes.name: comment
attributes.title: Table Comment
attributes.description: A string representing a textual comment about the table.

attributes.name: connectionId
attributes.title: Connection ID
attributes.description: An integer representing an ID to indicate which connection from the connections collection is used by this table.

attributes.name: dataCellStyle
attributes.title: Data Style Name
attributes.description: A string representing the name of the cell style that is applied to the data area cells of the table.

attributes.name: dataDxfId
attributes.title: Data Area Format Id
attributes.description: A zero based integer index into the differential formatting records <dxfs> in the styleSheet indicating which format to apply to the data area of this table.

attributes.name: displayName
attributes.title: Table Name
attributes.description: A string representing the name of the table.

attributes.name: DxfId
attributes.title: Header Row Border Format Id
attributes.description: A zero based integer index into the differential formatting records <dxfs> in the styleSheet indicating what border formatting to apply to the header row of this table.

attributes.name: e
attributes.title: Header Row Style
attributes.description: A string representing the name of the cell style that is applied to the header row cells of the table.

attributes.name: headerRowCount
attributes.title: Header Row Count
attributes.description: An integer representing the number of header rows showing at the top of the table. 0 means that the header row is not shown.

attributes.name: headerRowDxfId
attributes.title: Header Row Format Id
attributes.description: A zero based integer index into the differential formatting records <dxfs>in the styleSheet indicating which format to apply to the header row of this table.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Table Id
attributes.description: A non zero integer representing the unique identifier for this table.

attributes.name: insertRow
attributes.title: Insert Row Showing
attributes.description: A Boolean value indicating whether the insert row should be shown.

attributes.name: insertRowShift
attributes.title: Insert Row Shift
attributes.description: A Boolean that indicates whether cells in the sheet had to be inserted when the insert row was shown for this table (see insertRow for details).

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Name
attributes.description: A string representing the name of the table that is used to reference the table programmatically through the spreadsheet applications object model.

attributes.name: published
attributes.title: Published
attributes.description: A Boolean representing whether this table is marked as published for viewing by a server based spreadsheet application.

attributes.name: ref
attributes.title: Reference
attributes.description: The range on the relevant sheet that the table occupies expressed using A1 style referencing.

attributes.name: tableBorderDxfId
attributes.title: Table Border Format Id
attributes.description: A zero based integer index into the differential formatting records <dxfs> in the styleSheet indicating what border formatting to apply to the borders of this table.

attributes.name: tableType
attributes.title: Table Type
attributes.description: An optional enumeration specifying the type or source of the table.

attributes.name: xfId
attributes.title: Totals Row Border Format Id
attributes.description: A zero based integer index into the differential formatting records <dxfs> in the styleSheet indicating what border formatting to apply to the totals row of this table.

attributes.name: totalsRowCellStyle
attributes.title: Totals Row Style
attributes.description: A string representing the name of the cell style that is applied to the totals row cells of the table.

attributes.name: totalsRowCount
attributes.title: Totals Row Count
attributes.description: An integer representing the number of totals rows that shall be shown at the bottom of the table. 0 means that the totals row is not shown.

attributes.name: totalsRowDxfId
attributes.title: Totals Row Format Id
attributes.description: A zero based integer index into the differential formatting records <dxfs> in the styleSheet indicating which format to apply to the totals row of this table.

attributes.name: totalsRowShown
attributes.title: Totals Row Shown
attributes.description: A Boolean indicating whether the totals row has ever been shown in the past for this table.

entries.name: tableColumn
entries.title: Table Column
entries.description: An element representing a single column for this table.

attributes.name: dataCellStyle
attributes.title: Data Area Style Name
attributes.description: A string representing the name of the cell style that is applied to the cells in the data area of this table column.

attributes.name: dataDxfId
attributes.title: Data & Insert Row Format Id
attributes.description: A zero based integer index into the differential formatting records <dxfs> in the styleSheet indicating which format to apply to the data area of this column.

attributes.name: e
attributes.title: Header Row Cell Style
attributes.description: A string representing the name of the cell style that is applied to the header row cell of this column.

attributes.name: headerRowDxfId
attributes.title: Header Row Cell Format Id
attributes.description: A zero based integer index into the differential formatting records <dxfs> in the styleSheet indicating which format to apply to the header cell of this column.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Table Field Id
attributes.description: An integer representing the unique identifier of this column.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Column name
attributes.description: A string representing the unique caption of the table column.

attributes.name: queryTableFieldId
attributes.title: Query Table Field Id
attributes.description: An integer representing the query table field ID corresponding to this table column.

attributes.name: totalsRowCellStyle
attributes.title: Totals Row Style Name
attributes.description: A string representing the name of the cell style that is applied to the Totals Row cell of this column.

attributes.name: totalsRowDxfId
attributes.title: Totals Row Format Id
attributes.description: A zero based integer index into the differential formatting records <dxfs> in the styleSheet indicating which format to apply to the totals row cell of this column.

attributes.name: totalsRowFunction
attributes.title: Totals Row Function
attributes.description: An enumeration indicating which type of aggregation to show in the totals row cell for this column.

attributes.name: totalsRowLabel
attributes.title: Totals Row Label
attributes.description: A String to show in the totals row cell for this column.

attributes.name: uniqueName
attributes.title: Unique Name
attributes.description: An optional string representing the unique name of the table column.

entries.name: tableColumns
entries.title: Table Columns
entries.description: An element representing the collection of all table columns for this table.

attributes.name: count
attributes.title: Column Count
attributes.description: An integer representing the total count of how many columns there are in this Table.

entries.name: tableStyleInfo
entries.title: Table Style
entries.description: This element describes which style is used to display this table, and specifies which portions of the table have the style applied. Styles define a set of formatting properties that can be easily referenced by cells or other objects in the spreadsheet application. A style can be applied to a table, but tables can define specific parts of the table that should not have the style applied independently of other table parts.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Style Name
attributes.description: A string representing the name of the table style to use with this table.

attributes.name: s
attributes.title: Show Column Stripes
attributes.description: A Boolean indicating whether column stripe formatting is applied.

attributes.name: showFirstColumn
attributes.title: Show First Column
attributes.description: A Boolean indicating whether the first column in the table should have the style applied.

attributes.name: showLastColumn
attributes.title: Show Last Column
attributes.description: A Boolean indicating whether the last column in the table should have the style applied.

attributes.name: showRowStripes
attributes.title: Show Row Stripes
attributes.description: A Boolean indicating whether row stripe formatting is applied.

entries.name: totalsRowFormula
entries.title: Totals Row Formula
entries.description: This element contains a custom formula for aggregating values from the column. Each tableColumn has a totalsRowFunction that can be used for simple aggregations such as average, standard deviation, min, max, count, and others. If a more custom calculation is desired, then this element should be used, and the totalsRowFunction shall be set to "custom".

attributes.name: array
attributes.title: Array
attributes.description: A Boolean value that indicates whether this formula is an array style formula.

entries.name: xmlColumnPr
entries.title: XML Column Properties
entries.description: An element defining the XML column properties for a column. This is only used for tables created from XML mappings.

attributes.name: denormalized
attributes.title: Denormalized
attributes.description: A Boolean that indicates whether the contents of the column have been filled down due to flattening.

attributes.name: mapId
attributes.title: XML Map Id
attributes.description: An integer representing the ID of the XML map this table field is associated with.

attributes.name: xmlDataType
attributes.title: XML Data Type
attributes.description: An enumeration indicating which XML data type is used by this column.

attributes.name: xpath
attributes.title: XPath
attributes.description: A string representing the XML path to the element this column is associated with.

entries.name: singleXmlCell
entries.title: Table Properties
entries.description: This element represents the table properties for a single cell XML table.

attributes.name: connectionId
attributes.title: Connection ID
attributes.description: An integer representing an ID to indicate which connection from the connections collection is used by this table.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Table Id
attributes.description: An integer representing the unique identifier of the table.

attributes.name: r
attributes.title: Reference
attributes.description: An A1 cell style reference to the cell that the single cell xml table occupies.

entries.name: singleXmlCells
entries.title: Single Cells
entries.description: This element is a container for a collection of singleXmlCell tables.

entries.name: xmlCellPr
entries.title: Cell Properties
entries.description: This element stores the XML properties for the cell of a single cell xml table.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Table Field Id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the XML properties for the cell.

attributes.name: uniqueName
attributes.title: Unique Table Name
attributes.description: An optional string representing the unique name of the table column.

entries.name: xmlPr
entries.title: Column XML Properties
entries.description: This element represents the column properties for single cell XML tables.

attributes.name: mapId
attributes.title: XML Map Id
attributes.description: An integer representing the ID of the XML map this table field is associated with.

attributes.name: xmlDataType
attributes.title: XML Data Type
attributes.description: An enumeration indicating which XML data type is used by this column.

attributes.name: xpath
attributes.title: XPath
attributes.description: A string representing the XML path to the element this column is associated with.

entries.name: c
entries.title: Cell
entries.description: This element represents a single cell, which shall contain a formula, in the calc chain. Cells are calculated in the same order as the c elements appear in the Calculation Chain part.

attributes.name: a
attributes.title: Array
attributes.description: A Boolean flag indicating whether the cell's formula is an array formula.

attributes.name: i
attributes.title: Sheet Id
attributes.description: A sheet Id of a sheet the cell belongs to.

attributes.name: l
attributes.title: New Dependency Level
attributes.description: A Boolean flag indicating that the cell's formula starts a new dependency level.

attributes.name: r
attributes.title: Cell Reference
attributes.description: An A-1 style reference to a cell.

attributes.name: s
attributes.title: Child Chain
attributes.description: A Boolean flag indicating whether the cell's formula is on a child chain.

attributes.name: t
attributes.title: New Thread
attributes.description: A Boolean flag indicating whether the cell's formula starts a new thread.

entries.name: calcChain
entries.title: Calculation Chain Info
entries.description: This element represents the root of the calculation chain.

entries.name: author
entries.title: Author
entries.description: This element holds a string representing the name of a single author of comments. Every comment shall have an author. The maximum length of the author string is an implementation detail, but a good guideline is 255 chars.

attributes.name: xml:space
attributes.title: Content Contains Significant Whitespace
attributes.description: Specifies how white space should be handled for the contents of this element using the W3C space preservation rules.

entries.name: authors
entries.title: Authors
entries.description: This element is a container that holds a list of comment author names. There can be many comment authors per sheet, but each author name shall be unique per sheet. The information for each author is stored only once for that sheet, and comments refer to the author by zero based index.

entries.name: comment
entries.title: Comment
entries.description: This element represents a single user entered comment. Each comment shall have an author and can optionally contain richly formatted text.

attributes.name: authorId
attributes.title: Author Id
attributes.description: Required.

attributes.name: guid
attributes.title: Unique Identifier for Comment
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this comment.

attributes.name: ref
attributes.title: Cell Reference
attributes.description: Required.

attributes.name: shapeId
attributes.title: Shape ID
attributes.description: Specifies the ID of the DrawingML shape that provides the visual representation of the comment.

entries.name: commentList
entries.title: List of Comments
entries.description: This element is a container that holds a list of comments for the sheet.

entries.name: commentPr
entries.title: Comment Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the visual and positional properties of a comment.

attributes.name: altText
attributes.title: Alternative Text
attributes.description: Specifies alternative text for the object, for use by assistive technologies or applications.

attributes.name: autoFill
attributes.title: Automatic Fill Flag
attributes.description: Specifies whether the object's fill formatting is provided automatically by the application.

attributes.name: autoLine
attributes.title: Automatic Line Flag
attributes.description: Specifies whether the object's line formatting is provided automatically by the application.

attributes.name: autoScale
attributes.title: Automatic Text Scaling Flag
attributes.description: Specifies whether the object's font is automatically scaled by the application when the object is resized.

attributes.name: colHidden
attributes.title: Hidden Column Flag
attributes.description: Specifies that the column of the cell to which this comment points is hidden.

attributes.name: defaultSize
attributes.title: Default Size Flag
attributes.description: Specifies whether the object is at its default size.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.title: Disabled Flag
attributes.description: Specifies whether the object is allowed to run an attached macro.

attributes.name: justLastX
attributes.title: Far East Alignment Flag
attributes.description: Specifies that Far East alignment is set for the last line in the comment's text.

attributes.name: locked
attributes.title: Locked Flag
attributes.description: Specifies that the object is locked when the sheet is protected.

attributes.name: lockText
attributes.title: Text Lock Flag
attributes.description: Specifies that the object's text is locked.

attributes.name: print
attributes.title: Print Flag
attributes.description: Specifies whether the object is printed when the document is printed.

attributes.name: rowHidden
attributes.title: Hidden Row Flag
attributes.description: Specifies that the row of the cell to which this comment points is hidden.

attributes.name: textHAlign
attributes.title: Text Horizontal Alignment
attributes.description: Specifies the horizontal alignment of the comment's text field.

attributes.name: textVAlign
attributes.title: Text Vertical Alignment
attributes.description: Specifies the vertical alignment of the comment's text field.

attributes.name: uiObject
attributes.title: UI Object Flag
attributes.description: Specifies whether the object is a UI Object.

entries.name: comments
entries.title: Comments
entries.description: This element is the root container of a set of comments and comment authors for a particular sheet. Each set of comments for a sheet is stored in a separate xml part. The relationship part for a sheet defines a link to the correct comment part for that sheet.

entries.name: text
entries.title: Comment Text
entries.description: This element contains rich text which represents the text of a comment. The maximum length for this text is a spreadsheet application implementation detail. A recommended guideline is 32767 chars.

entries.name: alignment
entries.title: Alignment
entries.description: Formatting information pertaining to text alignment in cells. There are a variety of choices for how text is aligned both horizontally and vertically, as well as indentation settings, and so on.

attributes.name: horizontal
attributes.title: Horizontal Alignment
attributes.description: Specifies the type of horizontal alignment in cells.

attributes.name: indent
attributes.title: Indent
attributes.description: An integer value, where an increment of 1 represents 3 spaces.

attributes.name: justifyLastLine
attributes.title: Justify Last Line
attributes.description: A boolean value indicating if the cells justified or distributed alignment should be used on the last line of

attributes.name: text.
attributes.title: This is typical for East Asian alignments but not typical in other contexts.
attributes.description: The possible values for this attribute are defined by the W3C XML Schema boolean datatype.

attributes.name: readingOrder
attributes.title: Reading Order
attributes.description: An integer value indicating whether the reading order (bidirectionality) of the cell is left- to-right, right-to-left, or context dependent. 0 - Context Dependent - reading order is determined by scanning the text for the first non-whitespace character: if it is a strong right-to-left character, the reading order is right-to-left; otherwise, the reading order left-to-right. 1 - Left-to-Right- read

attributes.name: relativeIndent
attributes.title: Relative Indent
attributes.description: An integer value (used only in a dxf element) to indicate the additional number of spaces of indentation to adjust for text in a cell.

attributes.name: textRotation
attributes.title: Text Rotation
attributes.description: Text rotation in cells.

attributes.name: vertical
attributes.title: Vertical Alignment
attributes.description: Vertical alignment in cells.

attributes.name: wrapText
attributes.title: Wrap Text
attributes.description: A boolean value indicating if the text in a cell should be line-wrapped within the cell.

entries.name: b
entries.title: Bold
entries.description: Displays characters in bold face font style.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: A boolean value for the property specified by the parent XML element.

entries.name: bgColor
entries.title: Background Color
entries.description: Background color of the cell fill pattern. Cell fill patterns operate with two colors: a background color and a foreground color. These combine together to make a patterned cell fill.

attributes.name: auto
attributes.title: Automatic
attributes.description: A boolean value indicating the color is automatic and system color dependent.

attributes.name: indexed
attributes.title: Index
attributes.description: Indexed color value.

attributes.name: rgb
attributes.title: Alpha Red Green Blue Color Value
attributes.description: Standard Alpha Red Green Blue color value (ARGB).

attributes.name: theme
attributes.title: Theme Color
attributes.description: A zero-based index into the <clrScheme> collection (§20.1.6.2), referencing a particular <sysClr> or <srgbClr> value expressed in the Theme part.

attributes.name: tint
attributes.title: Tint
attributes.description: Specifies the tint value applied to the color.

attributes.title: tint < 0
attributes.description: Lum’ = Lum * (1.0 + tint) For example: Lum = 200; tint = -0.5; Darken 50% Lum‘ = 200 * (0.5) => 100 For example: Lum = 200; tint = -1.0; Darken 100% (make black) Lum‘ = 200 * (1.0-1.0) => 0

attributes.name: If

entries.name: border
entries.title: Border
entries.description: Expresses a single set of cell border formats (left, right, top, bottom, diagonal). Color is optional. When missing, 'automatic' is implied.

attributes.name: diagonalDown
attributes.title: Diagonal Down
attributes.description: A boolean value indicating if the cell's diagonal border includes a diagonal line, starting at the top left corner of the cell and moving down to the bottom right corner of the cell.

attributes.name: diagonalUp
attributes.title: Diagonal Up
attributes.description: A boolean value indicating if the cell's diagonal border includes a diagonal line, starting at the bottom left corner of the cell and moving up to the top right corner of the cell.

attributes.name: outline
attributes.title: Outline
attributes.description: A boolean value indicating if left, right, top, and bottom borders should be applied only to outside borders of a cell range.

entries.name: borders
entries.title: Borders
entries.description: This element contains borders formatting information, specifying all border definitions for all cells in the workbook.

attributes.name: count
attributes.title: Border Count
attributes.description: Count of border elements.

entries.name: bottom
entries.title: Bottom Border
entries.description: This element specifies the color and line style for the bottom border of a cell.

attributes.name: style
attributes.title: Line Style
attributes.description: The line style for this border.

entries.name: cellStyle
entries.title: Cell Style
entries.description: This element represents the name and related formatting records for a named cell style in this workbook. Annex G contains a listing of cellStyles whose corresponding formatting records are implied rather than explicitly saved in the file. In this case, a builtinId attribute is written on the cellStyle record, but no corresponding formatting records are written.

attributes.name: builtinId
attributes.title: Built-In Style Id
attributes.description: The index of a built-in cell style.

attributes.name: customBuiltin
attributes.title: Custom Built In
attributes.description: True indicates that this built-in cell style has been customized.

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.title: Hidden Style
attributes.description: If 'true' do not show this style in the application UI.

attributes.name: iLevel
attributes.title: Outline Style
attributes.description: Indicates that this formatting is for an outline style .

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: User Defined Cell Style
attributes.description: The name of the cell style.

attributes.name: xfId
attributes.title: Format Id
attributes.description: Zero-based index referencing an xf record in the cellStyleXfs collection.

entries.name: cellStyles
entries.title: Cell Styles
entries.description: This element contains the named cell styles, consisting of a sequence of named style records. A named cell style is a collection of direct or themed formatting (e.g., cell border, cell fill, and font type/size/style) grouped together into a single named style, and can be applied to a cell.

attributes.name: count
attributes.title: Style Count
attributes.description: Count of style elements.

entries.name: cellStyleXfs
entries.title: Formatting Records
entries.description: This element contains the master formatting records (xf's) which define the formatting for all named cell styles in this workbook. Master formatting records reference individual elements of formatting (e.g., number format, font definitions, cell fills, etc) by specifying a zero-based index into those collections. Master formatting records also specify whether to apply or ignore particular aspects of formatting. [Example: Whether to apply a border or not. end example] A cell can have both direct formatting (e.g., bold) and a cell style (e.g., Explanatory) applied to it.

attributes.name: count
attributes.title: Style Count
attributes.description: Count of cell style (xf) elements.

entries.name: cellXfs
entries.title: Cell Formats
entries.description: This element contains the master formatting records (xf) which define the formatting applied to cells in this workbook. These records are the starting point for determining the formatting for a cell. Cells in the Sheet Part reference the xf records by zero-based index.

attributes.name: count
attributes.title: Format Count
attributes.description: Count of xf elements.

entries.name: colors
entries.title: Colors
entries.description: Color information associated with this stylesheet. This collection is written whenever the legacy color palette has been modified (backwards compatibility settings) or a custom color has been selected while using this workbook. When the color palette is modified, the indexedColors collection is written.

entries.name: condense
entries.title: Condense
entries.description: Macintosh compatibility setting. Represents special word/character rendering on Macintosh, when this flag is set. The effect is to condense the text (squeeze it together).

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: A boolean value for the property specified by the parent XML element.

entries.name: diagonal
entries.title: Diagonal
entries.description: This element specifies the color and line style for the diagonal border(s) of a cell, possibly including diagonally up and diagonally down. The line style for diagonal up and diagonal down lines shall be the same.

attributes.name: style
attributes.title: Line Style
attributes.description: The line style for this border.

entries.name: dxf
entries.title: Formatting
entries.description: A single dxf record, expressing incremental formatting to be applied.

entries.name: dxfs
entries.title: Formats
entries.description: This element contains the master differential formatting records (dxf's) which define formatting for all non-cell formatting in this workbook. Whereas xf records fully specify a particular aspect of formatting (e.g., cell borders) by referencing those formatting definitions elsewhere in the Styles part, dxf records specify incremental (or differential) aspects of formatting directly inline within the dxf element. The dxf formatting is to be applied on top of or in addition to any formatting already present on the object using the dxf record.

attributes.name: count
attributes.title: Format Count
attributes.description: Count of dxf elements.

entries.name: end
entries.title: Trailing Edge Border
entries.description: This element specifies the color and line style for the trailing edge border of a cell (i.e., the right border for left- to-right cells and the left border for right-to-left cells)..

attributes.name: style
attributes.title: Line Style
attributes.description: The line style for this border.

entries.name: extend
entries.title: Extend
entries.description: This element specifies a compatibility setting used for previous spreadsheet applications, resulting in special word/character rendering on those legacy applications, when this flag is set. The effect extends or stretches out the text. SpreadsheetML applications are not required to render according to this flag.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: A boolean value for the property specified by the parent XML element.

entries.name: family
entries.title: Font Family
entries.description: The font family this font belongs to. The font name overrides when there are conflicting values.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: The font family this font belongs to.

entries.name: fgColor
entries.title: Foreground Color
entries.description: Foreground color of the cell fill pattern. Cell fill patterns operate with two colors: a background color and a foreground color. These combine together to make a patterned cell fill.

attributes.name: auto
attributes.title: Automatic
attributes.description: A boolean value indicating the color is automatic and system color dependent.

attributes.name: indexed
attributes.title: Index
attributes.description: Indexed color value.

attributes.name: rgb
attributes.title: Alpha Red Green Blue Color Value
attributes.description: Standard Alpha Red Green Blue color value (ARGB).

attributes.name: theme
attributes.title: Theme Color
attributes.description: A zero-based index into the <clrScheme> collection (§20.1.6.2), referencing a particular <sysClr> or <srgbClr> value expressed in the Theme part.

attributes.name: tint
attributes.title: Tint
attributes.description: Specifies the tint value applied to the color.

attributes.name: If
attributes.title: tint < 0
attributes.description: Lum’ = Lum * (1.0 + tint) For example: Lum = 200; tint = -0.5; Darken 50% Lum‘ = 200 * (0.5) => 100 For example: Lum = 200; tint = -1.0; Darken 100% (make black) Lum‘ = 200 * (1.0-1.0) => 0

attributes.name: If
attributes.title: tint > 0
attributes.description: Lum‘ = Lum * (1.0-tint) + (HLSMAX – HLSMAX * (1.0-tint)) For example: Lum = 100; tint = 0.75; Lighten 75% Lum‘ = 100 * (1-.75) + (HLSMAX – HLSMAX*(1-.75)) Attributes Description = 100 * .25 + (255 – 255 * .25) = 25 + (255 – 63) = 25 + 192 = 217 For example: Lum = 100; tint = 1.0; Lighten 100% (make white) Lum‘ = 100 * (1-1) + (HLSMAX – HLSMAX*(1-1)) = 100 * 0 + (255 – 255 * 0) = 0 + (255 – 0) = 25

entries.name: fill
entries.title: Fill
entries.description: This element specifies fill formatting.

entries.name: fills
entries.title: Fills
entries.description: This element defines the cell fills portion of the Styles part, consisting of a sequence of fill records. A cell fill consists of a background color, foreground color, and pattern to be applied across the cell.

attributes.name: count
attributes.title: Fill Count
attributes.description: Count of fill elements.

entries.name: font
entries.title: Font
entries.description: This element defines the properties for one of the fonts used in this workbook.

entries.name: fonts
entries.title: Fonts
entries.description: This element contains all font definitions for this workbook.

attributes.name: count
attributes.title: Font Count
attributes.description: Count of font elements.

entries.name: gradientFill
entries.title: Gradient
entries.description: This element defines a gradient-style cell fill. Gradient cell fills can use one or two colors as the end points of color interpolation.

attributes.name: bottom
attributes.title: Bottom Convergence
attributes.description: This attribute is restricted to values ranging from 0 to 1.

attributes.name: degree
attributes.title: Linear Gradient Degree
attributes.description: Angle of the linear gradient - vertical, horizontal, diagonal.

attributes.name: bottom
attributes.title: color 1 to color 2
attributes.description: Attributes Description 315 = Diagonal Down & bottom to top (color 1 to color 2) end example] The possible values for this attribute are defined by the W3C XML Schema double datatype.

attributes.name: left
attributes.title: Left Convergence
attributes.description: This attribute is restricted to values ranging from 0 to 1.

attributes.name: right
attributes.title: Right Convergence
attributes.description: This attribute is restricted to values ranging from 0 to 1.

attributes.name: top
attributes.title: Top Gradient Convergence
attributes.description: This attribute is restricted to values ranging from 0 to 1.

attributes.name: type
attributes.title: Gradient Fill Type
attributes.description: Type of this gradient fill.

entries.name: horizontal
entries.title: Horizontal Inner Borders
entries.description: This element specifies the color and line style for the horizontal inner border(s) of a range of cells. Used in the context of dxf elements only. [Example: see the borders definitions for TableStyleMedium28. end example]

attributes.name: style
attributes.title: Line Style
attributes.description: The line style for this border.

entries.name: i
entries.title: Italic
entries.description: Displays characters in italic font style. The italic style is defined by the font at a system level and is not specified by ECMA-376.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: A boolean value for the property specified by the parent XML element.

entries.name: indexedColors
entries.title: Color Indexes
entries.description: A legacy indexing scheme for colors that is still required for some records, and for backwards compatibility with legacy formats. This element contains a sequence of RGB color values that correspond to color indexes (zero-based). When using the default indexed color palette, the values are not written out, but instead are implied.

entries.name: mruColors
entries.title: MRU Colors
entries.description: This element contains sequence of RGB values that correspond to custom colors selected by the user for this workbook.

entries.name: name
entries.title: Font Name
entries.description: This element specifies the face name of this font.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: String Value
attributes.description: A string representing the name of the font.

entries.name: numFmt
entries.title: Number Format
entries.description: This element specifies number format properties which indicate how to format and render the numeric value of a cell. Following is a listing of number formats whose formatCode value is implied rather than explicitly saved in the file. In this case, a numFmtId value is written on the xf record, but no corresponding numFmt element is written.

attributes.name: formatCode
attributes.title: Number Format Code
attributes.description: The number format code for this number format.

attributes.name: numFmtId
attributes.title: Number Format Id
attributes.description: Id used by the master style records (xf's) to reference this number format.

entries.name: numFmts
entries.title: Number Formats
entries.description: This element defines the number formats in this workbook, consisting of a sequence of numFmt records, where each numFmt record defines a particular number format, indicating how to format and render the numeric value of a cell.

attributes.name: count
attributes.title: Number Format Count
attributes.description: Count of number format elements.

entries.name: patternFill
entries.title: Pattern
entries.description: This element is used to specify cell fill information for pattern and solid color cell fills. For solid cell fills (no pattern), fgColor is used. For cell fills with patterns specified, then the cell fill color is specified by the bgColor element.

attributes.name: patternType
attributes.title: Pattern Type
attributes.description: Specifies the fill pattern

attributes.name: type
attributes.title: including solid and none
attributes.description: Default is none, when missing.

entries.name: protection
entries.title: Protection Properties
entries.description: Contains protection properties associated with the cell. Each cell has protection properties that can be set. The cell protection properties do not take effect unless the sheet has been protected.

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.title: Hidden Cell
attributes.description: A boolean value indicating if the cell is hidden.

attributes.name: locked
attributes.title: Cell Locked
attributes.description: A boolean value indicating if the cell is locked.

entries.name: rgbColor
entries.title: RGB Color
entries.description: A single ARGB entry for the corresponding color index.

attributes.name: rgb
attributes.title: Alpha Red Green Blue
attributes.description: Color value expressed in Alpha Red Green Blue format (ARGB).

entries.name: scheme
entries.title: Scheme
entries.description: Defines the font scheme, if any, to which this font belongs. When a font definition is part of a theme definition, then the font is categorized as either a major or minor font scheme component. When a new theme is chosen, every font that is part of a theme definition is updated to use the new major or minor font definition for that theme.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Font Scheme
attributes.description: Sets font scheme property.

entries.name: shadow
entries.title: Shadow
entries.description: Macintosh compatibility setting. Represents special word/character rendering on Macintosh, when this flag is set. The effect is to render a shadow behind, beneath and to the right of the text.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: A boolean value for the property specified by the parent XML element.

entries.name: start
entries.title: Leading Edge Border
entries.description: This element specifies the color and line style for the leading edge border of a cell (i.e., the left border for left- to-right cells and the right border for right-to-left cells).

attributes.name: style
attributes.title: Line Style
attributes.description: The line style for this border.

entries.name: stop
entries.title: Gradient Stop
entries.description: One of a sequence of two or more gradient stops, constituting this gradient fill.

attributes.name: position
attributes.title: Gradient Stop Position
attributes.description: Position information for this gradient stop.

entries.name: styleSheet
entries.title: Style Sheet
entries.description: This is the root element of the Styles part.

entries.name: tableStyle
entries.title: Table Style
entries.description: This element represents a single table style definition that indicates how a spreadsheet application should format and display a table. Each of the tableStyle elements contains a collection of tableStyleElement elements that define formatting for a particular region of the table. Annex G contains a listing of table styles whose tableStyleElement elements are implied rather than explicitly saved in the file.

attributes.name: count
attributes.title: Table Style Count
attributes.description: Count of table style elements defined for this table style.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Table Style Name
attributes.description: Name of this table style.

attributes.name: table
attributes.title: Table
attributes.description: True if this table style should be shown as an available table style.

entries.name: tableStyleElement
entries.title: Table Style
entries.description: This element specifies formatting for one area of a table or PivotTable. Together the sequence of these elements makes up one entire Table style or PivotTable style definition. The order in which table style element formatting is applied is as follows: Table Style Element Order  Whole Table  First Column Stripe  Second Column Stripe  First Row Stripe  Second Row Stripe  Last Column  First Column  Header Row  Total Row  First Header Cell  Last Header Cell  First Total Cell  Last Total Cell For instance, row stripe formatting 'wins' over column stripe formatting, and both 'win' over whole table

attributes.name: dxfId
attributes.title: Formatting Id
attributes.description: Zero-based index to a dxf record in the dxfs collection, specifying differential formatting to use with this Table or PivotTable style element.

attributes.name: size
attributes.title: Band Size
attributes.description: Number of rows or columns in a single band of striping.

attributes.name: type
attributes.title: Table Style Type
attributes.description: Identifies this table style element's type.

entries.name: tableStyles
entries.title: Table Styles
entries.description: This element represents a collection of Table style definitions for Table styles and PivotTable styles used in this workbook. It consists of a sequence of tableStyle records, each defining a single Table style. A Table style is a collection of formatting that applies to structured regions of a Table or PivotTable [Example: make the header row & totals bold face, and apply light gray fill to alternating rows in the data portion of the table to achieve striped or banded rows. end example] See the enumeration values in ST_TableStyleType for a listing of structured Table regions to which formatting

attributes.name: count
attributes.title: Table Style Count
attributes.description: Count of table styles defined in this collection.

attributes.name: defaultPivotStyle
attributes.title: Default Pivot Style
attributes.description: Name of the default table style to apply to new PivotTables.

attributes.name: defaultTableStyle
attributes.title: Default Table Style
attributes.description: Name of default table style to apply to new Tables.

entries.name: top
entries.title: Top Border
entries.description: This element specifies the color and line style for the top border of a cell.

attributes.name: style
attributes.title: Line Style
attributes.description: The line style for this border.

entries.name: vertical
entries.title: Vertical Inner Border
entries.description: This element specifies the color and line style for the vertical inner border(s) of a range of cells. Used in the context of dxf elements only. [Example: see the borders definitions for TableStyleMedium28. end example]

attributes.name: style
attributes.title: Line Style
attributes.description: The line style for this border.

entries.name: xf
entries.title: Format
entries.description: A single xf element describes all of the formatting for a cell.

attributes.name: applyAlignment
attributes.title: Apply Alignment
attributes.description: A boolean value indicating whether the alignment formatting specified for this xf should be applied.

attributes.name: applyBorder
attributes.title: Apply Border
attributes.description: A boolean value indicating whether the border formatting specified for this xf should be applied.

attributes.name: applyFill
attributes.title: Apply Fill
attributes.description: A boolean value indicating whether the fill formatting specified for this xf should be applied.

attributes.name: applyFont
attributes.title: Apply Font
attributes.description: A boolean value indicating whether the font formatting specified for this xf should be applied.

attributes.name: at
attributes.title: Apply Number Format
attributes.description: A boolean value indicating whether the number formatting specified for this xf should be applied.

attributes.name: applyProtection
attributes.title: Apply Protection
attributes.description: A boolean value indicating whether the protection formatting specified for this xf should be applied.

attributes.name: borderId
attributes.title: Border Id
attributes.description: Zero-based index of the border record used by this cell format.

attributes.name: fillId
attributes.title: Fill Id
attributes.description: Zero-based index of the fill record used by this cell format.

attributes.name: fontId
attributes.title: Font Id
attributes.description: Zero-based index of the font record used by this cell format.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.title: Number Format Id
attributes.description: The possible values for this attribute are defined by the ST_NumFmtId simple type (§18.18.47).

attributes.name: pivotButton
attributes.title: Pivot Button
attributes.description: A boolean value indicating whether the cell should include pivot table sorting and filtering interface elements, in applications intended for editing Office Open XML documents.

attributes.name: quotePrefix
attributes.title: Quote Prefix
attributes.description: A boolean value indicating whether the text string in a cell should be prefixed by a single quote mark (e.g., 'text).

attributes.name: xfId
attributes.title: Format Id
attributes.description: For xf records contained in cellXfs this is the zero-based index of an xf record contained in cellStyleXfs corresponding to the cell style applied to the cell.

entries.name: bk
entries.title: Metadata Block
entries.description: This element represents a block of metadata records.

entries.name: bk
entries.title: Future Metadata Block
entries.description: This element represents a block of future metadata information. This is a location for storing feature extension information.

entries.name: cellMetadata
entries.title: Cell Metadata
entries.description: This element represents cell metadata information. Cell metadata is information metadata about a specific cell, and it stays tied to that cell position.

attributes.name: count
attributes.title: Metadata Block Count
attributes.description: Number of blocks of metadata records.

entries.name: futureMetadata
entries.title: Future Metadata
entries.description: This element represents future metadata information. Future data storage areas are xml storage areas that a later version of the spreadsheet application can store data into. So a V2 spreadsheet application can store data for new features that don't exist in the V1 version in a future storage area when saving to a format that the V1 version can open.

attributes.name: count
attributes.title: Future Metadata Block Count
attributes.description: Number of future metadata blocks.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Metadata Metadata type name. Attributes Description Type Name

entries.name: header
entries.title: Header

If tracking changes, or sharing workbooks, are enabled, then changes are persisted on the Save event, or at a specified time interval.

attributes.name: dateTime
attributes.title: Date Time
attributes.description: The date and time when this set of revisions was saved.

attributes.name: guid
attributes.title: GUID
attributes.description: A globally unique identifier for this set of revisions.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Relationship ID
attributes.description: This is the ID that is used to find the corresponding log record of the changes made for this header.

attributes.name: maxRId
attributes.title: Max Revision Id
attributes.description: The highest revision Id that belongs to this header.

attributes.name: maxSheetId
attributes.title: Last Sheet Id

attributes.name: minRId

attributes.name: y

attributes.name: lastGuid

attributes.name: preserveHistory
