entries.name: users
entries.title: User List
entries.description: This element represents a list of users who currently have this shared workbook open. This list does not include any users who have the workbook open in Read-Only mode.

attributes.name: count
attributes.title: Active User Count
attributes.description: Number of users who currently have this shared workbook open.

entries.name: deletedField
entries.title: Deleted Field
entries.description: This element specifies a field that has been deleted from the query table.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Deleted Fields Name
attributes.description: Specifies the name of the deleted field.

entries.name: queryTable
entries.title: Query Table
entries.description: This element specifies all the relevant properties for a query table, one query table element is stored for each query table object in the spreadsheetML document.

attributes.name: h
attributes.title: Adjust Column Width On Refresh
attributes.description: Specifies whether to automatically adjust column widths on refresh to fit the data retrieved. true if column widths should be adjusted.

attributes.name: mats
attributes.title: Apply Alignment Formats
attributes.description: The possible values for this attribute are defined by the W3C XML Schema boolean datatype. applyBorderForma

attributes.name: ts
attributes.title: Apply Border Formats
attributes.description: If true apply legacy table autoformat border properties.

attributes.name: applyFontFormats
attributes.title: Apply Font Formats
attributes.description: If true apply legacy table autoformat font properties.

attributes.name: ats
attributes.title: Apply Number Formats
attributes.description: If true apply legacy table autoformat number format properties.

attributes.name: ats
attributes.title: Apply Pattern Formats
attributes.description: If true apply legacy table autoformat pattern properties.

attributes.name: Formats
attributes.title: Apply Width / Height Formats
attributes.description: If true apply legacy table autoformat width/height properties.

attributes.name: autoFormatId
attributes.title: Auto Format Id
attributes.description: Identifies which legacy table autoformat to apply.

attributes.name: h
attributes.title: Background Refresh
attributes.description: Specifies whether or not the query table shall try to refresh data in the background.

attributes.name: connectionId
attributes.title: Connection Id
attributes.description: Specifies the ID number of the external data connection to use to refresh data in the query table.

attributes.name: disableRefresh
attributes.title: Disable Refresh
attributes.description: Specifies whether the query table shall be refreshable.

attributes.name: fillFormulas
attributes.title: Fill Adjacent Formulas
attributes.description: Specifies whether or not formulas in columns adjacent to the query table should be filled down whenever the query table is refreshed.

attributes.name: fresh
attributes.title: First Background Refresh
attributes.description: Specifies whether or not data has ever been refreshed for this query table.

attributes.name: growShrinkType
attributes.title: Grow Shrink Type
attributes.description: Specifies the type of behavior expected for dealing with a variable number of rows of data in the query table between refresh operations.

attributes.name: headers
attributes.title: First Row Column Titles
attributes.description: Specifies whether or not the query table has first row with column titles.

attributes.name: intermediate
attributes.title: Intermediate
attributes.description: Specifies whether this query table is in an intermediate state, having been defined but not fully formed and populated with data.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: QueryTable Name
attributes.description: Specifies the name of the query table.

attributes.name: g
attributes.title: Preserve Formatting On Refresh
attributes.description: Specifies whether the application should try to preserve formatting in the query table and copy this formatting to any new rows of data.

attributes.name: refreshOnLoad
attributes.title: Refresh On Load
attributes.description: Specifies whether the query table shall refresh its data automatically when the spreadsheetML document is loaded or opened.

attributes.name: e
attributes.title: Remove Data On Save
attributes.description: Specifies whether the query table shall remove all data from the worksheet before the spreadsheetML document is saved.

attributes.name: rowNumbers
attributes.title: Row Numbers
attributes.description: Specifies whether the query table shall include a first column of row numbers.

entries.name: queryTableDeletedFields
entries.title: Deleted Fields
entries.description: This element is the collection for deletedField (§18.12.1) elements, each of which represents a column or field that has been deleted from the query table.

attributes.name: count
attributes.title: Deleted Fields Count
attributes.description: Specifies how many deleted fields there are.

entries.name: queryTableField
entries.title: QueryTable Field
entries.description: This element holds the properties related to a specific field or column in a query table.

attributes.name: clipped
attributes.title: Clipped Column
attributes.description: Specifies whether this field/column is currently clipped and thus not visible in the worksheet.

attributes.name: dataBound
attributes.title: Data Bound Column
attributes.description: Specifies whether this column is a user-defined column or comes from the external data query.

attributes.name: fillFormulas
attributes.title: Fill This Formula On Refresh
attributes.description: Specifies whether the formula in this field/column should be filled down on data refresh.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Field Id
attributes.description: Specifies the unique identifier of the query table field.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Name
attributes.description: Specifies the unique name of the query table field.

attributes.name: tableColumnId
attributes.title: Table Column Id
attributes.description: Specifies the unique identifier for the table column if the query table is attached to a table object rather than just a range in the sheet.

entries.name: queryTableFields
entries.title: Query table fields
entries.description: This element is the collection for queryTableField elements.

attributes.name: count
attributes.title: Column Count
attributes.description: Specifies the number of columns there are in this query table.

entries.name: queryTableRefresh
entries.title: QueryTable Refresh Information
entries.description: This element contains information related to refreshing the query table.

attributes.name: fieldIdWrapped
attributes.title: Next Field Id Wrapped
attributes.description: Whether or not the idFieldNext value wrapped around.

attributes.name: esh
attributes.title: Headers In Last Refresh
attributes.description: Whether or not the Query Table had titles last refresh.

attributes.name: minimumVersion
attributes.title: Minimum Refresh Version
attributes.description: For backward compatibility with legacy versions of spreadsheet applications, this attribute specifies the minimum version of the application that is expected to correctly refresh the data in the query table without any problems.

attributes.name: nextId
attributes.title: Next field id
attributes.description: Specifies the next unique queryTableField (§18.12.4) id number available for assignment.

attributes.name: Layout
attributes.title: Preserve Sort & Filter Layout
attributes.description: Specifies whether sorting, autofilter, layout, and table block formatting should be preserved for this query table across data refresh operations.

attributes.name: eft
attributes.title: Columns Left
attributes.description: Specifies the number of extra columns included at the left end of the field array that aren't bound to external data.

attributes.name: ight
attributes.title: Columns Right
attributes.description: Specifies the number of extra columns included at the right end of the Table that aren't bound to external data.

entries.name: connection
entries.title: Connection
entries.description: This element contains both the definition of how to get at an external data source as well as information describing how the connection is used within the workbook. Specific constructs in a worksheet, such as OLAP formulas, QueryTables, or PivotTables make use of information in the connection to retrieve or refresh data based on default events or the user's explicit request.

attributes.name: background
attributes.title: Background Refresh
attributes.description: Indicates whether the connection can be refreshed in the background (asynchronously). true if preferred usage of the connection is to refresh asynchronously in the background; false if preferred usage of the connection is to refresh synchronously in the foreground.

attributes.name: credentials
attributes.title: Reconnection Method
attributes.description: Specifies the authentication method to be used when establishing (or re-establishing) the connection.

attributes.name: deleted
attributes.title: Deleted Connection
attributes.description: Indicates whether the associated workbook connection has been deleted. true if the connection has been deleted; otherwise, false.

attributes.name: description
attributes.title: Connection Specifies the user description for this connection. Attributes Description Description
attributes.description: The possible values for this attribute are defined by the ST_Xstring simple type (§22.9.2.19).

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Connection Id
attributes.description: Specifies The unique identifier of this connection.

attributes.name: interval
attributes.title: Automatic Refresh Interval
attributes.description: Specifies the number of minutes between automatic refreshes of the connection.

attributes.name: sion
attributes.title: Minimum Version Required for Refresh
attributes.description: For compatibility with legacy spreadsheet applications.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Connection Name
attributes.description: Specifies the name of the connection.

attributes.name: odcFile
attributes.title: Connection File
attributes.description: Specifies the full path to external connection file from which this connection was created.

attributes.name: File
attributes.title: Only Use Connection File
attributes.description: Indicates whether the spreadsheet application should always and only use the connection information in the external connection file indicated by the odcFile attribute when the connection is refreshed.

attributes.name: od
attributes.title: Reconnection Method
attributes.description: Specifies what the spreadsheet application should do when a connection fails.

attributes.name: refreshedVersion
attributes.title: Last Refresh Version
attributes.description: For backward compatibility purposes, this attribute indicates the version of the spreadsheet application that last refreshed the connection.

attributes.name: singleSignOnId
attributes.title: SSO Id
attributes.description: Identifier for Single Sign On (SSO) used for authentication between an intermediate spreadsheetML server and the external data source.

attributes.name: sourceFile
attributes.title: Source Database File
attributes.description: Used when the external data source is file-based.

attributes.name: type
attributes.title: Database Source Type
attributes.description: Specifies the data source type.

entries.name: connections
entries.title: Connections
entries.description: This element exists when there are one or more connections in the workbook. It is a container for the individual connection objects.

entries.name: dbPr
entries.title: Database Properties
entries.description: This element stores all properties associated with an ODBC or OLE DB external data connection.

attributes.name: command
attributes.title: Command Text
attributes.description: The string containing the database command to pass to the data provider that will interact with the external source in order to retrieve data.

attributes.name: commandType
attributes.title: custom data source Command Type
attributes.description: Specifies the custom data source command type.

attributes.name: connection
attributes.title: Connection String
attributes.description: The string used to initiate a session with a data source.

attributes.name: serverCommand
attributes.title: Command Text
attributes.description: Specifies a second command text string that is persisted when PivotTable server-based page fields are in use.

entries.name: m
entries.title: No Value
entries.description: This element is present when tables in a web query are missing.

entries.name: olapPr
entries.title: OLAP Properties
entries.description: This element contains all the properties needed for an OLAP data connection. OLAP connections contain both the dbPr and olapPr child elements.

attributes.name: local
attributes.title: Local Cube
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether we should get data from the local cube on refresh versus the Attributes Description original data source. true if a local cube has been created for OLAP data, and it should be used instead of the server.

attributes.name: localConnection
attributes.title: Local Cube Connection
attributes.description: Specifies a connection string to use when a local cube is available.

attributes.name: localRefresh
attributes.title: Local Refresh
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether we should refresh the local cube from the original data source.

attributes.name: rowDrillCount
attributes.title: Drill Through Count
attributes.description: Maximum number of drill-through rows to return when the user drills through an aggregate value in a PivotTable.

attributes.name: sendLocale
attributes.title: Send Locale to OLAP
attributes.description: When true, the spreadsheetML app should send the user interface locale ID to the OLAP provider to retrieve localized member names and properties, etc.

attributes.name: serverFill
attributes.title: OLAP Fill Formatting
attributes.description: When true a PivotTable based on an OLAP source should format the data and aggregate cells in the PivotTable view using the background color from the OLAP source if this information is available.

attributes.name: serverFontColor
attributes.title: OLAP Font Formatting
attributes.description: When true a PivotTable based on OLAP source should format the data and aggregate cells in the PivotTable view using the font color from the OLAP source.

attributes.name: mat
attributes.title: OLAP Number Format
attributes.description: When true, a PivotTable based on OLAP source should format the data and aggregate cells in the PivotTable view using the number format from the OLAP source.

entries.name: parameter
entries.title: Parameter Properties
entries.description: This element stores properties about any parameters used with external data connections. Parameters are used to change the query executed externally and cause different data to be retrieved into the workbook. The type of parameter used – see ST_parameterType (§18.18.54) – determines whether the user is prompted for a value before data is refreshed, or the value is pulled from a cell in the workbook, or whether the same value should be used until explicitly changed in the data connection.

attributes.name: boolean
attributes.title: Boolean
attributes.description: Boolean value to use as the query parameter.

attributes.name: cell
attributes.title: Cell Reference
attributes.description: Cell reference indicating which cell's value to use for the query parameter.

attributes.name: double
attributes.title: Double
attributes.description: Non-integer numeric value to use as the query parameter.

attributes.name: integer
attributes.title: Integer
attributes.description: Integer value to use as the query parameter.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Parameter Name
attributes.description: The name of the parameter.

attributes.name: parameterType
attributes.title: Parameter Type
attributes.description: Type of parameter used.

attributes.name: prompt
attributes.title: Parameter Prompt String
attributes.description: Prompt string for the parameter.

attributes.name: refreshOnChange
attributes.title: Refresh on Change
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the query should automatically refresh when the contents of a cell that provides the parameter value changes.

attributes.name: sqlType
attributes.title: SQL Data Type
attributes.description: SQL data type of the parameter.

attributes.name: string
attributes.title: String
attributes.description: String value to use as the query parameter.

entries.name: parameters
entries.title: Query Parameters
entries.description: This element serves as a collection of parameters for an ODBC or web query.

attributes.name: count
attributes.title: Parameter Count
attributes.description: The number of parameters used.

entries.name: s
entries.title: Character Value
entries.description: This element is used to specify an HTML table to import by name. If the tables are not named, they shall be specified with the <x v="[index]"> syntax instead.

attributes.name: v
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: The name of the table to retrieve when the web query is refreshed.

entries.name: tables
entries.title: Tables
entries.description: This element serves as the collection of tables to be returned via a web query data connection. Tables are then most commonly referenced by <x> via their indices (in order of the <Table> tags in the HTML page).

attributes.name: count
attributes.title: Count of Tables
attributes.description: Number of tables to pull data from when refreshing from a web query.

entries.name: textField
entries.title: Text Import Field Settings
entries.description: This element specifies field settings for text import.

attributes.name: position
attributes.title: Position
attributes.description: The character position the field starts at for fixed-length fields.

attributes.name: type
attributes.title: Field Type
attributes.description: Specifies the field Type.

entries.name: textFields
entries.title: Fields
entries.description: This element that denotes a set of fields to retrieve from a text file. Contains 1 or more textField elements.

attributes.name: count
attributes.title: Count of Fields
attributes.description: Number of distinct fields to retrieve.

entries.name: textPr
entries.title: Text Import Settings
entries.description: This element contains all of the text import settings.

attributes.name: characterSet
attributes.title: Character Set
attributes.description: Name of the character set associated with the text file.

attributes.name: comma
attributes.title: Comma is Delimiter
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether to treat comma characters as field delimiters.

attributes.name: consecutive
attributes.title: Consecutive Delimiters
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether consecutive delimiters should be treated as just one delimiter.

attributes.name: decimal
attributes.title: Decimal Separator
attributes.description: The decimal separator character.

attributes.name: value
attributes.title: data type
attributes.description: Period Comma Comma Period 123.123,45 123,123.45 (numeric) Period Comma Comma Comma 123.123,45 123.123,45 (text) Comma Period Comma Period 123,123.45 123,123.45 (numeric) Period Comma Period Comma 123 123.45 123

attributes.title: text
attributes.description: Period Comma Period Space 123 123.45 123,123.45 (numeric) Strings values of this attribute are expected to be one character in length.

attributes.name: delimiter
attributes.title: Custom Delimiter
attributes.description: User-specified character to be treated as a field delimiter.

attributes.name: fileType
attributes.title: File Type
attributes.description: Ignorable attribute with enum value that defined by ST_FileType.

attributes.name: firstRow
attributes.title: First Row
attributes.description: Indicates at what row of the file to start the data import.

attributes.name: prompt
attributes.title: Prompt for File Name
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the user wants to be prompted for the file name on refresh.

attributes.name: qualifier
attributes.title: Qualifier
attributes.description: Character used as the text string qualifier.

attributes.name: semicolon
attributes.title: Semicolon is Delimiter
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether to treat semicolon characters as field delimiters.

attributes.name: sourceFile
attributes.title: Source File Name
attributes.description: Path to the text file to use to import external data.

attributes.name: space
attributes.title: Space is Delimiter
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether to treat space characters as field delimiters.

attributes.name: tab
attributes.title: Tab as Delimiter
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether to treat tab characters as field delimiters.

attributes.name: thousands
attributes.title: Thousands Separator
attributes.description: The thousands separator character.

entries.name: webPr
entries.title: Web Query Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the properties for a web query source. A web query will retrieve data from HTML tables, and can also supply HTTP "Get" parameters to be processed by the web server in generating the HTML by including the parameters and parameter elements. Here's an example of a web query connection:

attributes.name: consecutive
attributes.title: Consecutive Delimiters
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether consecutive delimiters should be treated as just one delimiter.

attributes.name: editPage
attributes.title: Edit Query URL
attributes.description: The URL of the user-facing web page showing the web query data.

attributes.name: firstRow
attributes.title: Use First Row
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether to parse all tables inside a PRE block with the same width settings as the first row.

attributes.name: htmlFormat
attributes.title: HTML Formatting Handling
attributes.description: How to handle formatting from the HTML source when bringing web query data into the worksheet.

attributes.name: htmlTables
attributes.title: HTML Tables Only
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether web queries should only work on HTML tables.

attributes.name: parsePre
attributes.title: Parse PRE
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether data contained within HTML <PRE> tags in the web page is parsed into columns when you import the page into a query table.

attributes.name: post
attributes.title: Web Post
attributes.description: Returns or sets the string used with the post method of inputting data into a web server to return data from a web query.

attributes.name: sourceData
attributes.title: Import XML Source Data
attributes.description: Flag indicating that XML source data should be imported instead of the HTML table itself.

attributes.name: textDates
attributes.title: Dates as Text
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether dates should be imported into cells in the worksheet as text rather than dates.

attributes.name: url
attributes.title: URL
attributes.description: URL to use to refresh external data.

attributes.name: xl2000
attributes.title: Refreshed in Excel 2000
attributes.description: This flag exists for backward compatibility with older existing spreadsheet files, and is set to true if this web query was refreshed in a spreadsheet application newer than or equal to Microsoft Excel 2000.

attributes.name: xl97
attributes.title: Created in Excel 97
attributes.description: This flag exists for backward compatibility with older existing spreadhseet files, and is set to true if this web query was created in Microsoft Excel 97.

entries.name: cell
entries.title: External Cell Data
entries.description: This element is used to store cached values from external sources such as other workbooks. Formulas from external cells are not stored in the consuming workbook. Also, for this context, the attribute t cannot have a value of inlineStr.

attributes.name: r
attributes.title: Reference
attributes.description: Describes the cell location in the external book.

attributes.name: t
attributes.title: Type
attributes.description: Indicates the data type of the cell value.

attributes.name: vm
attributes.title: Value Metadata
attributes.description: The index of the cell's value metadata, if any exists.

entries.name: ddeItem
entries.title: DDE Item definition
entries.description: This element represents a DDE item.

attributes.name: advise
attributes.title: Advise
attributes.description: Specifies whether the DDE server should notify the application when the external data changes.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: DDE Name
attributes.description: Specifies the DDE item name.

attributes.name: ole
attributes.title: Object Linking TechnologyE
attributes.description: Set to true if this is item uses an object linking technology.

attributes.name: preferPic
attributes.title: Data is an Image
attributes.description: Set to true if data from this DDE item is an image format.

entries.name: ddeItems
entries.title: DDE Items Collection
entries.description: This element serves as a collection for ddeItem elements.

entries.name: ddeLink
entries.title: DDE Connection
entries.description: This element represents a connection to an external Dynamic Data Exchange (DDE) server. DDE is a method of sending data between applications using Windows messages according to a documented protocol that has been stable since about 1990. The hierarchy of names defined by a DDE server is Application, Topics, and Items.

attributes.name: ddeService
attributes.title: Service name
attributes.description: Service name (i.e., application name) for the DDE connection.

attributes.name: ddeTopic
attributes.title: Topic for DDE server
attributes.description: Describes something for the DDE application to which the channel pertains— usually a document of that application.

entries.name: definedName
entries.title: Defined Name
entries.description: This element contains information about a named range in an external workbook.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Defined Name
attributes.description: The defined name.

attributes.name: refersTo
attributes.title: Refers To
attributes.description: Name range definition string.

attributes.name: sheetId
attributes.title: Sheet Id
attributes.description: The index of the worksheet that the named range applies to for named ranges that are scoped to a particular worksheet rather than the full workbook.

entries.name: definedNames
entries.title: Named Links
entries.description: This element is a collection of the defined names associated with the supporting workbook.

entries.name: externalBook
entries.title: External Workbook
entries.description: This element represents an external workbook which is supplying data to the current workbook.

entries.name: externalLink
entries.title: External Reference
entries.description: This element is a container for specific types of external links.

entries.name: oleItem
entries.title: Object Link Item
entries.description: This element represents a single link within the object referenced by the parent element.

attributes.name: advise
attributes.title: Advise
attributes.description: Set to true if the linked object should notify the application when the external data changes.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.title: Icon
attributes.description: Set to true if the linked object is represented by an icon.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Object Name
attributes.description: The linked object's name.

attributes.name: preferPic
attributes.title: Object is an Image
attributes.description: Set to true if the linked object is represented by an image.

entries.name: oleItems
entries.title: Object Link Items
entries.description: This element is a collection of items within the link specified by the parent element.

entries.name: oleLink
entries.title: Generic Object Link Connection
entries.description: This element represents an external link to an embedded object, specified by a progID/object pair. The type of object link is determined by reading the target of the id attribute.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Object Link Relationship
attributes.description: Relationship ID that references a link in the relationships collection.

attributes.name: progId
attributes.title: Object Link Identifier
attributes.description: The ID for the object link connection.

entries.name: row
entries.title: Row
entries.description: This element contains data for an external worksheet row.

attributes.name: r
attributes.title: Row
attributes.description: Row number of the row in the external book containing the cell data referenced.

entries.name: sheetData
entries.title: External Sheet Data Set
entries.description: This element contains the cached worksheet data associated with a supporting workbook.

attributes.name: refreshError
attributes.title: Last Refresh Resulted in Error
attributes.description: Specifies that the last external data refresh for this sheet did not succeed.

attributes.name: sheetId
attributes.title: Sheet Id
attributes.description: Index of sheet in the external workbook that is referenced and partially cached in this data set.

entries.name: sheetDataSet
entries.title: Cached Worksheet Data
entries.description: This element serves as the collection for 1 or more sheetData elements.

entries.name: sheetName
entries.title: Sheet Name
entries.description: Name of a worksheet in the supporting workbook

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Sheet Name Value
attributes.description: Name of the sheet.

entries.name: sheetNames
entries.title: Supporting Workbook Sheet Names
entries.description: This element is the container for all of the worksheet names in a supporting workbook.

entries.name: val
entries.title: DDE Link Value
entries.description: This element specifies a value associated with a particular DDE item.

entries.name: value
entries.title: Value
entries.description: This element contains a value associated with a particular DDE item. This serves as a container for the val element.

attributes.name: t
attributes.title: DDE Value Type
attributes.description: Indicates the DDE value type.

entries.name: values
entries.title: DDE Name Values
entries.description: This element defines a collection of values associated with DDE item.

attributes.name: cols
attributes.title: Columns
attributes.description: The number of columns of data that is returned by the DDE server for this DDE item.

attributes.name: rows
attributes.title: Rows
attributes.description: The number of rows of data that is returned by the DDE server for this DDE item.

entries.name: main
entries.title: Main
entries.description: Represents dependency information for all topics within a volatile dependency type that share the same first string or function argument.

attributes.name: first
attributes.title: First String
attributes.description: Specifies the first string of all topics within this main.

entries.name: stp
entries.title: Strings in Subtopic
entries.description: Represents all strings in the topic except for the first. An stp is allocated for each additional argument. [Example: For the topic {"progid","","foo"}, there would be two STPs: "" and "foo". end example] For Cube functions, value of "1" indicates that all of the related cells with calling cube functions have been refreshed. The possible values for this element are defined by the ST_Xstring simple type (§22.9.2.19).

entries.name: tp
entries.title: Topic
entries.description: Represents dependency information for all topics within a volatile dependency type that share the same first string or argument. For the RTD function, this collection will contain the remaining parameters of the function, and indicate the last known value and data type of that value.

attributes.name: t
attributes.title: Type
attributes.description: Specifies the type of the cell value.

entries.name: tr
entries.title: References
entries.description: Represents the reference to a cell that depends on this topic. Each topic can have one or more cells dependencies. For CUBE functions, each <tr> element contains a cell whose cube function call dependent on the connection in main@first.

attributes.name: r
attributes.title: Reference
attributes.description: Specifies a reference to the cell location.

attributes.name: s
attributes.title: Sheet Id
attributes.description: Specifies the sheet index.

entries.name: volType
entries.title: Volatile Dependency Type
entries.description: Represents dependency information for a specific type of external data server. There is no limit on the number of external dependencies that can exist for a workbook in SpreadsheetML.

attributes.name: type
attributes.title: Type
attributes.description: Specifies the type of the external dependency.

entries.name: volTypes
entries.title: Volatile Dependency Types
entries.description: Represents the collection of external dependencies for a workbook. This element defines the structure of the volatilateDependencies part. There can only be one volatileDependencies part for each workbook.

entries.name: DataBinding
entries.title: XML Mapping
entries.description: This element contains properties which specify how the XML mapping should work.

attributes.name: ConnectionID
attributes.title: Reference to Connection ID
attributes.description: Specifies the Connection ID to the external connection in the External Data Connections part.

attributes.name: ode
attributes.title: XML Data Loading Behavior
attributes.description: Specifies the mode for loading XML data related to this DataBinding.

attributes.name: DataBindingName
attributes.title: Unique Identifer
attributes.description: Specifies the data binding name.

attributes.name: FileBinding
attributes.title: Binding to External File
attributes.description: Specifies whether the data should be retrieved directly from an XML file.

attributes.name: FileBindingName
attributes.title: File Binding Name
attributes.description: Specifies the file binding name.

entries.name: Map
entries.title: XML Mapping Properties
entries.description: This element contains all of the properties related to the XML map, and the behaviors expected during data refresh operations.

attributes.name: Append
attributes.title: Append Data to Table
attributes.description: Specifies whether XML data should overwrite or be appended to the end of the table or range of mapped cells when data is refreshed.

attributes.name: AutoFit
attributes.title: AutoFit Table on Refresh

entries.description: This simple type specifies a font family. A font family is a set of fonts having common stroke width and serif characteristics. This is system-level font information.

entries.description: This element specifies a bold embedded font that is linked to a parent typeface. Once specified, this bold version of the given typeface name is available for use within the presentation. The actual font data is referenced using a relationships file that contains links to all fonts available.

attributes.name: id

entries.name: boldItalic

entries.description: This element specifies a bold italic embedded font that is linked to a parent typeface. Once specified, this bold italic version of the given typeface name is available for use within the presentation. The actual font data is referenced using a relationships file that contains links to all fonts available.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Relationship Identifier
attributes.description: Specifies the relationship identifier that is used in conjunction with a corresponding relationship file to resolve the location of this embedded font that is referenced in a presentation.

attributes.name: showScrollbar
