attributes.description: Specifies whether to show the scroll bar in the viewing window.

entries.name: clrMru
entries.title: Color MRU
entries.description: This specifies the most recently used user-selected colors within the presentation. This list contains custom user-selected colors outside the presentation's theme colors, enabling the application to expose these additional color choices for easy reuse. The first item in the list is the most recently used color.

entries.name: custShow
entries.title: Custom Show
entries.description: This element specifies a custom show which is an ordered list of a group of slides that are contained within the presentation. The custom show element allows for the specification of a presentation order that is different from the order in which the slides themselves are stored.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Custom Show Identifier
attributes.description: This attribute specifies the custom show identification number.

entries.name: custShow
entries.title: Custom Show
entries.description: This element specifies a custom show that defines a specific slide sequence that the slides are displayed in. This allows for many variants of the same set of slides to be presented.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Custom Show ID
attributes.description: Specifies the identification number for this custom show.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Custom Show Name
attributes.description: Specifies a name for the custom show.

entries.name: custShowLst
entries.title: List of Custom Shows
entries.description: This element specifies a list of all custom shows that are available within the corresponding presentation. A custom show is a defined slide sequence that allows for the displaying of the slides with the presentation in any arbitrary order.

entries.name: defaultTextStyle
entries.title: Presentation Default Text Style
entries.description: This element specifies the default text styles that are to be used within the presentation. The text style defined here can be referenced when inserting a new slide if that slide is not associated with a master slide or if no styling information has been otherwise specified for the text within the presentation slide.

entries.name: embeddedFont
entries.title: Embedded Font
entries.description: This element specifies an embedded font. Once specified, this font is available for use within the presentation. Within a font specification there can be regular, bold, italic and boldItalic versions of the font specified.

entries.name: embeddedFontLst
entries.title: Embedded Font List
entries.description: This element specifies a list of fonts that are embedded within the corresponding presentation. The font data for these fonts is stored alongside the other document parts within the document container. The actual font data is referenced within the embeddedFont element.

entries.name: ext
entries.title: Extension
entries.description: This element specifies an extension that is used for future extensions to the current version of DrawingML. This allows for the specifying of currently unknown elements for later versions of generating applications.

attributes.name: uri
attributes.title: Uniform Resource Identifier
attributes.description: This attribute specifies the URI, or uniform resource identifier that represents the data stored under this tag.

entries.name: extLst
entries.title: Extension List
entries.description: This element specifies the extension list within which all future extensions of element type ext are defined. The extension list along with corresponding future extensions is used to extend the storage capabilities of the PresentationML framework. This allows for various new kinds of data to be stored natively within the framework.

entries.name: font
entries.title: Embedded Font Name
entries.description: This element specifies specific properties describing an embedded font. Once specified, this font is available for use within the presentation. Within a font specification there can be regular, bold, italic and boldItalic versions of the font specified.

attributes.name: charset
attributes.title: Similar Character Set
attributes.description: Specifies the character set that is supported by the parent font.

attributes.name: set.
attributes.title: IANA name KS C-5601-1992
attributes.description: Attributes Description 0x86 Specifies the GB-2312 character set. (IANA name GBK) 0x88 Specifies the Chinese Big Five character set. (IANA name Big5) 0xA1 Specifies a Greek character set. (IANA name windows-1253) 0xA2 Specifies a Turkish character set. (IANA name iso-8859-9) 0xA3 Specifies a Vietnamese character set. (IANA name windows-1258) 0xB1 Specifies a Hebrew character set. (IANA name windows

attributes.name: panose
attributes.title: Panose Setting
attributes.description: Specifies the Panose-1 classification number for the current font using the mechanism defined in §4.2.7.17 of ISO/IEC 14496-22:2007.

attributes.name: pitchFamily
attributes.title: Similar Font Family
attributes.description: Specifies the font pitch as well as the font family for the corresponding font.

attributes.name: typeface
attributes.title: Text Typeface
attributes.description: Specifies the typeface, or name of the font that is to be used.

entries.name: handoutMasterId
entries.title: Handout Master ID
entries.description: This element specifies a handout master that is available within the corresponding presentation. A handout master is a slide that is specifically designed for printing as a handout.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Relationship Identifier
attributes.description: Specifies the relationship identifier that is used in conjunction with a corresponding relationship file to resolve the location within a presentation of the handoutMaster element defining this handout master.

entries.name: handoutMasterIdLst
entries.title: List of Handout Master IDs
entries.description: This element specifies a list of identification information for the handout master slides that are available within the corresponding presentation. A handout master is a slide that is specifically designed for printing as a handout.

entries.name: italic
entries.title: Italic Embedded Font
entries.description: This element specifies an italic embedded font that is linked to a parent typeface. Once specified, this italic version of the given typeface name is available for use within the presentation. The actual font data is referenced using a relationships file that contains links to all fonts available.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Relationship Identifier
attributes.description: Specifies the relationship identifier that is used in conjunction with a corresponding relationship file to resolve the location of this embedded font that is referenced in a Attributes Description  The possible values for this attribute are defined by the ST_RelationshipId simple type (§22.8.2.1).

entries.name: kinsoku
entries.title: Kinsoku Settings
entries.description: This element specifies the presentation-wide kinsoku settings that define the line breaking behaviour of East Asian text within the corresponding presentation.

attributes.name: invalEndChars
attributes.title: Invalid Kinsoku End Characters
attributes.description: Specifies the characters that cannot end a line of text.

attributes.name: invalStChars
attributes.title: Invalid Kinsoku Start Characters
attributes.description: Specifies the characters that cannot start a line of text.

attributes.name: lang
attributes.title: Language
attributes.description: Specifies the corresponding East Asian language that these settings apply to.

entries.name: kiosk
entries.title: Kiosk Slide Show Mode
entries.description: This element specifies that the presentation slide show should be viewed in a full-screen kiosk mode. A presentation viewed in kiosk mode should have user input disabled and restarts after a specified interval.

attributes.name: restart
attributes.title: Restart Show
attributes.description: Specifies the time length that the presentation should run until it is to be restarted.

entries.name: modifyVerifier
entries.title: Modification Verifier
entries.description: This element specifies the write protection settings which have been applied to a PresentationML document. Write protection refers to a mode in which the document's contents should not be modified, and the document should not be resaved using the same file name. When present, the application shall require a password to enable modifications to the document.

attributes.name: algorithmName
attributes.title: Cryptographic Algorithm Name
attributes.description: Specifies the specific cryptographic hashing algorithm which shall be used along with the salt attribute and input password in order to compute the hash value.

attributes.name: hashValue
attributes.title: Password Hash Value
attributes.description: Specifies the hash value for the password required to edit this chartsheet.

attributes.name: saltValue
attributes.title: Salt Value for Password Verifier
attributes.description: Specifies the salt which was prepended to the user-supplied password before it was hashed using the hashing algorithm defined by the preceding attribute values to generate the hashValue attribute, and which shall also be prepended to the user-supplied password before attempting to generate a hash value for comparison.

attributes.name: spinValue
attributes.title: Iterations to Run Hashing Algorithm
attributes.description: Specifies the number of times the hashing function shall be iteratively run (runs using each iteration's result plus a 4 byte value (0-based, little endian) containing the number of the iteration as the input for the next iteration) when attempting to compare a user- supplied password with the value stored in the hashValue attribute.

entries.name: notesMasterId
entries.title: Notes Master ID
entries.description: This element specifies a notes master that is available within the corresponding presentation. A notes master is a slide that is specifically designed for the printing of the slide along with any attached notes.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Relationship Identifier
attributes.description: Specifies the relationship identifier that is used in conjunction with a corresponding relationship file to resolve the location within a presentation of the notesMaster element defining this notes master.

entries.name: notesMasterIdLst
entries.title: List of Notes Master IDs
entries.description: This element specifies a list of identification information for the notes master slides that are available within the corresponding presentation. A notes master is a slide that is specifically designed for the printing of the slide along with any attached notes.

entries.name: notesSz
entries.title: Notes Slide Size
entries.description: This element specifies the size of slide surface used for notes slides and handout slides. Objects within a notes slide can be specified outside these extents, but the notes slide has a background surface of the specified size when presented or printed. This element is intended to specify the region to which content is fitted in any special format of printout the application might choose to generate, such as an outline handout.

attributes.name: cx
attributes.title: Extent Length
attributes.description: Specifies the length of the extents rectangle in EMUs.

attributes.name: cy
attributes.title: Extent Width
attributes.description: Specifies the width of the extents rectangle in EMUs.

entries.name: penClr
entries.title: Pen Color for Slide Show
entries.description: This element specifies the pen color that should be used to make markings on the slides while in a presentation.

entries.name: photoAlbum
entries.title: Photo Album Information
entries.description: This element specifies that the corresponding presentation contains a photo album. A photo album specifies a list of images within the presentation that spread across one or more slides, all of which share a consistent layout. Each image in the album is formatted with a consistent style.

attributes.name: bw
attributes.title: Black and White
attributes.description: Specifies whether all pictures in the photo album are to be displayed as black and white.

attributes.name: frame
attributes.title: Frame Type
attributes.description: Specifies the frame type that is to be used on all the pictures in the photo album.

attributes.name: layout
attributes.title: Photo Album Layout
attributes.description: Specifies the layout that is to be used to arrange the pictures in the photo album on individual slides.

attributes.name: showCaptions
attributes.title: Show/Hide Captions
attributes.description: Specifies whether to show captions for pictures in the photo album.

entries.name: present
entries.title: Presenter Slide Show Mode
entries.description: This element specifies that the presentation slide show should be viewed in a full-screen presenter mode. In this mode, the presentation is displayed on one monitor while a different monitor displays notes and provides navigation controls intended to be viewed only by the presenter.

entries.name: presentation
entries.title: Presentation
entries.description: This element specifies within it fundamental presentation-wide properties.

attributes.name: ures
attributes.title: Automatically Compress Pictures
attributes.description: Specifies whether the generating application should automatically compress all pictures for this presentation.

attributes.name: bookmarkIdSeed
attributes.title: Bookmark ID Seed
attributes.description: Specifies a seed for generating bookmark IDs to ensure IDs remain unique across the document.

attributes.name: compatMode
attributes.title: Compatibility Mode
attributes.description: Specifies whether the generating application is to be in a compatibility mode which serves to inform the user of any loss of content or functionality when working with older formats.

attributes.name: conformance
attributes.title: Document Conformance Class
attributes.description: Specifies the conformance class (§2.1) to which the PresentationML document conforms.

attributes.name: nts
attributes.title: Embed True Type Fonts
attributes.description: Specifies whether the generating application should automatically embed true type fonts or not.

attributes.name: firstSlideNum
attributes.title: First Slide Number
attributes.description: Specifies the first slide number in the presentation.

attributes.name: rtl
attributes.title: Right-To-Left Views
attributes.description: Specifies if the current view of the user interface is oriented right-to-left or left-to-right.

attributes.name: saveSubsetFonts
attributes.title: Save Subset Fonts
attributes.description: Specifies to save only the subset of characters used in the presentation when a font is embedded.

attributes.name: serverZoom
attributes.title: Server Zoom
attributes.description: Specifies the scaling to be used when the presentation is embedded in another document.

attributes.name: TitleSld
attributes.title: Show Header and Footer Placeholders on Titles
attributes.description: Specifies whether to show the header and footer placeholders on the title slides.

attributes.name: hars
attributes.title: Strict First and Last Characters
attributes.description: Specifies whether to use strict characters for starting and ending lines of Japanese text.

entries.name: presentationPr
entries.title: Presentation-wide Properties
entries.description: This element functions as a parent element within which additional presentation-wide document properties are contained. All properties and their corresponding settings are defined within the child elements.

entries.name: prnPr
entries.title: Printing Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the default printing properties associated with this presentation document.

attributes.name: clrMode
attributes.title: Print Color Mode
attributes.description: Specifies the color mode to be used when printing.

attributes.name: frameSlides
attributes.title: Frame slides when printing
attributes.description: Specifies whether slides should be framed when printing.

attributes.name: hiddenSlides
attributes.title: Print Hidden Slides
attributes.description: Specifies whether hidden slides should be printed.

attributes.name: prnWhat
attributes.title: Print Output
attributes.description: Specifies what the default print output is in terms of content layout.

attributes.name: scaleToFitPaper
attributes.title: Scale to Fit Paper when printing
attributes.description: Specifies whether the print output should be scaled to fit the paper being used.

entries.name: regular
entries.title: Regular Embedded Font
entries.description: This element specifies a regular embedded font that is linked to a parent typeface. Once specified, this regular version of the given typeface name is available for use within the presentation. The actual font data is referenced using a relationships file that contains links to all fonts available.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Relationship Identifier
attributes.description: Specifies the relationship identifier that is used in conjunction with a corresponding relationship file to resolve the location of this embedded font that is referenced in a presentation.

entries.name: showPr
entries.title: Presentation-wide Show Properties
entries.description: This element functions as a parent element within which all presentation-wide show properties are contained. All properties and their corresponding settings are defined within the child elements.

attributes.name: loop
attributes.title: Loop Slide Show
attributes.description: Specifies whether the slide show should be set to loop at the end.

attributes.name: showAnimation
attributes.title: Show Animation in Slide Show
attributes.description: Specifies whether slide show animation should be shown when presenting.

attributes.name: showNarration
attributes.title: Show Narration in Slide Show
attributes.description: Specifies whether slide show narration should be played when presenting.

attributes.name: useTimings
attributes.title: Use Timings in Slide Show
attributes.description: Specifies whether slide transition timings should be used to advance slides when presenting.

entries.name: sld
entries.title: Presentation Slide
entries.description: This element specifies a slide within a slide list. The slide list is used to specify an ordering of slides.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Relationship ID
attributes.description: This attribute specifies the relationship id that is used to reference to the actual slide XML file that contains all the information to the slide listed within the slide list.

entries.name: sldAll
entries.title: All Slides
entries.description: This attribute specifies all slides instead of a given range of slides for use within the html publishing properties as well as the show properties.

entries.name: sldId
entries.title: Slide ID
entries.description: This element specifies a presentation slide that is available within the corresponding presentation. A slide contains the information that is specific to a single slide such as slide-specific shape and text information.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Relationship Identifier
attributes.description: Specifies the relationship identifier that is used in conjunction with a corresponding relationship file to resolve the location within a presentation of the sld element defining this slide.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Slide Identifier
attributes.description: Specifies the slide identifier that is to contain a value that is unique throughout the presentation.

entries.name: sldIdLst
entries.title: List of Slide IDs
entries.description: This element specifies a list of identification information for the slides that are available within the corresponding presentation. A slide contains the information that is specific to a single slide such as slide- specific shape and text information.

entries.name: sldLst
entries.title: List of Presentation Slides
entries.description: This element specifies a list of presentation slides. A presentation slide contains the information that is specific to a single slide such as slide-specific shape and text information.

entries.name: sldMasterId
entries.title: Slide Master ID
entries.description: This element specifies a slide master that is available within the corresponding presentation. A slide master is a slide that is specifically designed to be a template for all related child layout slides.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Relationship Identifier
attributes.description: Specifies the relationship identifier that is used in conjunction with a corresponding relationship file to resolve the location within a presentation of the sldMaster element defining this slide master.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Slide Master Identifier
attributes.description: Specifies the slide master identifier that is to contain a value that is unique throughout the presentation.

entries.name: sldMasterIdLst
entries.title: List of Slide Master IDs
entries.description: This element specifies a list of identification information for the slide master slides that are available within the corresponding presentation. A slide master is a slide that is specifically designed to be a template for all related child layout slides.

entries.name: sldRg
entries.title: Slide Range
entries.description: This element specifies a slide range for use within the html publishing properties as well as the show properties.

attributes.name: end
attributes.title: End
attributes.description: This attribute defines the end of the index range.

attributes.name: st
attributes.title: Start
attributes.description: This attribute defines the start of the index range.

entries.name: sldSz
entries.title: Presentation Slide Size
entries.description: This element specifies the size of the presentation slide surface. Objects within a presentation slide can be specified outside these extents, but this is the size of background surface that is shown when the slide is presented or printed..

attributes.name: cx
attributes.title: Extent Length
attributes.description: Specifies the length of the extents rectangle in EMUs.

attributes.name: cy
attributes.title: Extent Width
attributes.description: Specifies the width of the extents rectangle in EMUs.

attributes.name: type
attributes.title: Type of Size
attributes.description: Specifies the kind of slide size that should be used.

entries.name: smartTags
entries.title: Smart Tags
entries.description: This element specifies that references to smart tags exist within this document. [Note: For a complete definition of smart tags, which are semantically identical throughout Office Open XML, see §17.5.1. end note] To denote the location of smart tags on individual runs of text, there smart tag identifier attributes are specified for each run to which a smart tag applies. These are further specified in the run property attributes within DrawingML.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Relationship Identifier
attributes.description: Specifies the relationship identifier that is used in conjunction with a corresponding relationship file to resolve the location of this smart tag.

entries.name: cSldViewPr
entries.title: Common Slide View Properties
entries.description: This element functions as a container for slide view properties that are common across multiple view property elements. The specific properties and associated values for these view properties reside within the child elements and attributes.

attributes.name: showGuides
attributes.title: Show Guides in View
attributes.description: Specifies whether to show guides when editing the presentation.

attributes.name: snapToGrid
attributes.title: Snap Objects to Grid
attributes.description: Specifies whether objects should snap to underlying presentation grid when editing.

attributes.name: snapToObjects
attributes.title: Snap Objects to Objects
attributes.description: Specifies whether objects should snap to other objects when editing the presentation.

entries.name: cViewPr
entries.title: Common View Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the view properties that are common across multiple view property elements.

attributes.name: varScale
attributes.title: Variable Scale
attributes.description: Specifies that the view content should automatically scale to best fit the current window size.

entries.name: gridSpacing
entries.title: Grid Spacing
entries.description: This element specifies the grid spacing that should be used for the grid underlying the presentation document. The grid can be used to align objects on the slide and to display visual positioning cues.

attributes.name: cx
attributes.title: Extent Length
attributes.description: Specifies the length of the extents rectangle in EMUs.

attributes.name: cy
attributes.title: Extent Width
attributes.description: Specifies the width of the extents rectangle in EMUs.

entries.name: guide
entries.title: A Guide
entries.description: This element specifies a guide within the presentation. Guides are lines used for arranging layouts and content and never appear except as an aid in editing slides.

attributes.name: orient
attributes.title: Guide Orientation
attributes.description: Specifies the orientation for a guide.

attributes.name: pos
attributes.title: Guide Position
attributes.description: Specifies the position information for a guide.

entries.name: guideLst
entries.title: List of Guides
entries.description: This element specifies a list of guides for a particular view of the presentation.

entries.name: normalViewPr
entries.title: Normal View Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the view properties associated with the normal slide view (§19.7.55) mode. The normal slide view consists of three content regions: the slide itself, a side content region, and a bottom content region. The content of the side content region and bottom content region is determined by the generating application.

attributes.name: horzBarState
attributes.title: State of the Horizontal Splitter Bar
attributes.description: Specifies the state that the horizontal splitter bar should be in when in normal slide view mode (§19.7.55).

attributes.name: preferSingleView
attributes.title: Prefer Single View
attributes.description: Specifies whether the user prefers to see a full-window single-content region over the normal slide view(§19.7.55) with three content regions.

attributes.name: showOutlineIcons
attributes.title: Show Outline Icons in Normal View
attributes.description: Specifies whether the application should show icons if displaying outline content in any of the content regions of normal slide view mode (§19.7.55).

attributes.name: snapVertSplitter
attributes.title: Snap Vertical Splitter
attributes.description: Specifies whether the vertical splitter should snap to a minimized state when the side region is sufficiently small.

attributes.name: vertBarState
attributes.title: State of the Vertical Splitter Bar
attributes.description: Specifies the state that the vertical splitter bar should be in when in normal slide view mode (§19.7.55).

entries.name: notesTextViewPr
entries.title: Notes Text View Properties
entries.description: This element functions as a parent element within which all properties associated with the notes text view are contained. All properties are defined within the child elements.

entries.name: notesViewPr
entries.title: Notes View Properties
entries.description: This element functions as a parent element within which all view properties associated with notes are contained. All properties are defined within the child elements.

entries.name: origin
entries.title: View Origin
entries.description: This element specifies the origin of the slide when it is being viewed with various scaling factors using the scale element.

attributes.name: x
attributes.title: X-Axis Coordinate
attributes.description: Specifies a coordinate on the x-axis.

attributes.name: y
attributes.title: Y-Axis Coordinate
attributes.description: Specifies a coordinate on the x-axis.

entries.name: outlineViewPr
entries.title: Outline View Properties
entries.description: This element functions as a parent element within which all view properties associated with the outline view (§19.7.55) mode are contained. All properties are defined within the child elements. Outline view displays only the textual content of a presentation.

entries.name: restoredLeft
entries.title: Normal View Restored Left Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the sizing of the side content region of the normal slide view (§19.7.55), when the region is of a variable restored size (neither minimized nor maximized).

attributes.name: autoAdjust
attributes.title: Auto Adjust Normal View
attributes.description: Specifies whether the size of the side content region should compensate for the new size when resizing the window containing the view within the application.

attributes.name: sz
attributes.title: Normal View Dimension Size
attributes.description: Specifies the size of the slide region (width when a child of restoredTop, height when a child of restoredLeft).

entries.name: restoredTop
entries.title: Normal View Restored Top Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the sizing of the top slide region of the normal slide view (§19.7.55), when the region is of a variable restored size (neither minimized nor maximized).

attributes.name: sz
attributes.title: Normal View Dimension Size
attributes.description: Specifies the size of the slide region (width when a child of restoredTop, height when a child of restoredLeft).

entries.name: scale
entries.title: View Scale
entries.description: This element specifies the view scaling factors that the presentation was last viewed with.

entries.name: sld
entries.title: Presentation Slide
entries.description: This element specifies a presentation slide and properties specific to the slide's appearance in outline view (§19.7.55).

attributes.name: collapse
attributes.title: Collapsed
attributes.description: Specifies whether this presentation slide is to be shown as collapsed within outline view.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Relationship Identifier
attributes.description: Specifies the relationship identifier that is used in conjunction with a corresponding relationship file to resolve the location of this presentation slide within a presentation.

entries.name: sldLst
entries.title: List of Presentation Slides
entries.description: This element specifies a list of presentation slides. A presentation slide contains the information that is specific to a single slide such as slide-specific shape and text information.

entries.name: slideViewPr
entries.title: Slide View Properties
entries.description: This element functions as a parent element within which all view properties associated with the slide view mode are contained. All properties are defined within the child elements.

entries.name: sorterViewPr
entries.title: Slide Sorter View Properties
entries.description: This element functions as a parent element within which all view properties associated with the slide sorter view (§19.7.55) mode are contained. All properties are defined within the child elements. The slide sorter view displays thumbnails of multiple slides at once; the number of slides and size of thumbnails depends on the scaling factor of the view.

attributes.name: showFormatting
attributes.title: Show Formatting
attributes.description: Specifies whether to show associated slide formatting when in slide sorter view mode.

entries.name: viewPr
entries.title: Presentation-wide View Properties
entries.description: This element functions as a parent element within which all presentation-wide view properties are contained. All properties and their corresponding settings are defined within the child elements.

attributes.name: lastView
attributes.title: Last View
attributes.description: Specifies the view mode that was used when the presentation document was last saved.

attributes.name: showComments
attributes.title: Show Comments
attributes.description: Specifies whether the slide comments should be shown.

entries.name: bg
entries.title: Slide Background
entries.description: This element specifies the background appearance information for a slide. The slide background covers the entire slide and is visible where no objects exist and as the background for transparent objects.

attributes.name: bwMode
attributes.title: Black and White Mode
attributes.description: Specifies that the background should be rendered using only black and white coloring.

entries.name: bgPr
entries.title: Background Properties
entries.description: This element specifies visual effects used to render the slide background. This includes any fill, image, or effects that are to make up the background of the slide.

attributes.name: shadeToTitle
attributes.title: Shade to Title
attributes.description: Specifies whether the background of the slide is of a shade to title background type.

entries.name: bgRef
entries.title: Background Style Reference
entries.description: This element specifies the slide background is to use a fill style defined in the style matrix. The idx attribute refers to the index of a background fill style or fill style within the presentation's style matrix, defined by the fmtScheme element. A value of 0 or 1000 indicates no background, values 1-999 refer to the index of a fill style within the fillStyleLst element, and values 1001 and above refer to the index of a background fill style within

attributes.name: idx
attributes.title: Style Matrix Index
attributes.description: Specifies the style matrix index of the style referred to.

entries.name: blipFill
entries.title: Picture Fill
entries.description: This element specifies the kind of picture fill that the picture object has. Because a picture has a picture fill already by default, it is possible to have two fills specified for a picture object. An example of this is shown below.

attributes.name: dpi
attributes.title: DPI Setting
attributes.description: Specifies the DPI (dots per inch) used to calculate the size of the blip.

attributes.name: rotWithShape
attributes.title: Rotate With Shape
attributes.description: Specifies that the fill should rotate with the shape.

entries.name: bodyStyle
entries.title: Slide Master Body Text Style
entries.description: This element specifies the text formatting style for all body text within a master slide. This formatting is used on all body text within presentation slides related to this master. The text formatting is specified by utilizing the DrawingML framework just as within a regular presentation slide.

entries.name: clrMap
entries.title: Color Scheme Map
entries.description: This element specifies the mapping layer that transforms one color scheme definition to another. Each attribute represents a color name that can be referenced in this master, and the value is the corresponding color in the theme.

attributes.name: accent1
attributes.title: Accent 1
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the accent 1 color.

attributes.name: accent2
attributes.title: Accent 2
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the accent 2 color.

attributes.name: accent3
attributes.title: Accent 3
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the accent 3 color.

attributes.name: accent4
attributes.title: Accent 4
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the accent 4 color.

attributes.name: accent5
attributes.title: Accent 5
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the accent 5 color.

attributes.name: accent6
attributes.title: Accent 6
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the accent 6 color.

attributes.name: bg1
attributes.title: Background 1
attributes.description: A color defined which is associated as the first background color.

attributes.name: bg2
attributes.title: Background 2
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the second background color.

attributes.name: folHlink
attributes.title: Followed Hyperlink
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the color for a followed hyperlink.

attributes.name: hlink
attributes.title: Hyperlink
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the color for a hyperlink.

attributes.name: tx1
attributes.title: Text 1
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the first text color.

attributes.name: tx2
attributes.title: Text 2
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the second text color.

entries.name: clrMapOvr
entries.title: Color Scheme Map Override
entries.description: This element provides a mechanism with which to override the color schemes listed within the ClrMap element. If the masterClrMapping element is present, the color scheme defined by the master is used. If the overrideClrMapping element is present, it defines a new color scheme specific to the parent notes slide, presentation slide, or slide layout.

entries.name: cNvCxnSpPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Connector Shape Drawing Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the non-visual drawing properties specific to a connector shape. This includes information specifying the shapes to which the connector shape is connected.

entries.name: cNvGraphicFramePr
entries.title: Non-Visual Graphic Frame Drawing Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the non-visual drawing properties for a graphic frame. These non-visual properties are properties that the generating application would utilize when rendering the slide surface.

entries.name: cNvGrpSpPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Group Shape Drawing Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the non-visual drawing properties for a group shape. These non-visual properties are properties that the generating application would utilize when rendering the slide surface.

entries.name: cNvPicPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Picture Drawing Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the non-visual properties for the picture canvas. These properties are to be used by the generating application to determine how certain properties are to be changed for the picture object in question.

attributes.name: ze
attributes.title: Relative Resize Preferred
attributes.description: Specifies if the user interface should show the resizing of the picture based on the picture's current size or its original size.

entries.name: cNvPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Drawing Properties
entries.description: This element specifies non-visual canvas properties. This allows for additional information that does not affect the appearance of the picture to be stored.

attributes.name: descr
attributes.title: Alternative Text for Object
attributes.description: Specifies alternative text for the current DrawingML object, for use by assistive technologies or applications which do not display the current object.

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.title: Hidden
attributes.description: Specifies whether this DrawingML object is displayed.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Unique Identifier
attributes.description: Specifies a unique identifier for the current DrawingML object within the current document.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Name
attributes.description: Specifies the name of the object.

attributes.name: title
attributes.title: Title
attributes.description: Specifies the title (caption) of the current DrawingML object.

entries.name: cNvSpPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Drawing Properties for a Shape
entries.description: This element specifies the non-visual drawing properties for a shape. These properties are to be used by the generating application to determine how the shape should be dealt with

attributes.name: txBox
attributes.title: Text Box
attributes.description: Specifies that the corresponding shape is a text box and thus should be treated as such by the generating application.

entries.name: contentPart
entries.title: Content Part
entries.description: This element specifies a reference to XML content in a format not defined by ECMA-376. [Note: This part allows the native use of other commonly used interchange formats, such as:  MathML (http://www.w3.org/TR/MathML2/)  SMIL (http://www.w3.org/TR/REC-smil/)  SVG (http://www.w3.org/TR/SVG11/) end note] The relationship type of the explicit relationship specified by this element shall be http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/customXml and have a TargetMode attribute value of Internal. If an application cannot process content of the content type specified by the targeted part, then it

entries.name: controls
entries.title: List of controls
entries.description: This element specifies a list of embedded controls for the corresponding slide. Custom embedded controls can be embedded on slides.

entries.name: cSld
entries.title: Common Slide Data
entries.description: This element specifies a container for slide information that is relevant to all of the slide types. All slides share a common set of properties that is independent of the slide type; the description of these properties for any particular slide is stored within the slide's cSld container. Slide data specific to the slide type indicated by the parent element is stored elsewhere.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Name
attributes.description: Specifies the slide name property that is used to further identify this unique configuration of common slide data.

entries.name: custData
entries.title: Customer Data
entries.description: This element specifies customer data which allows for the specifying and persistence of customer specific data within the presentation.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Relationship ID
attributes.description: This attribute specifies the relationship id for referencing other resources outside the scope of the current PresentationML file.

entries.name: custDataLst
entries.title: Customer Data List
entries.description: This element allows for the specifying of customer defined data within the PresentationML framework. References to custom data or tags can be defined within this list.

entries.name: cxnSp
entries.title: Connection Shape
entries.description: This element specifies a connection shape that is used to connect two sp elements. Once a connection is specified using a cxnSp, it is left to the generating application to determine the exact path the connector takes. That is the connector routing algorithm is left up to the generating application as the desired path might be different depending on the specific needs of the application.

entries.name: extLst
entries.title: Extension List with Modification Flag
entries.description: This element specifies the extension list with modification ability within which all future extensions of element type ext are defined. The extension list along with corresponding future extensions is used to extend the storage capabilities of the PresentationML framework. This allows for various new kinds of data to be stored natively within the framework.

attributes.name: mod
attributes.title: Modify
attributes.description: This attribute specifies whether the data contained within this element has been modified and should thus be processed again by the generating application.

entries.name: graphicFrame
entries.title: Graphic Frame
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of a graphics frame. This frame contains a graphic that was generated by an external source and needs a container in which to be displayed on the slide surface.

attributes.name: bwMode
attributes.title: Black and White Mode
attributes.description: Namespace: .../drawingml/2006/main Specifies how the graphical object should be rendered, using color, black or white, or grayscale.

entries.name: grpSp
entries.title: Group Shape
entries.description: This element specifies a group shape that represents many shapes grouped together. This shape is to be treated just as if it were a regular shape but instead of being described by a single geometry it is made up of all the shape geometries encompassed within it. Within a group shape each of the shapes that make up the group are specified just as they normally would.

entries.name: grpSpPr
entries.title: Group Shape Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the properties that are to be common across all of the shapes within the corresponding group. If there are any conflicting properties within the group shape properties and the individual shape properties then the individual shape properties should take precedence.

attributes.name: bwMode
attributes.title: Black and White Mode
attributes.description: Specifies that the group shape should be rendered using only black and white coloring.

entries.name: handoutMaster
entries.title: Handout Master
entries.description: This element specifies an instance of a handout master slide. Within a handout master slide are contained all elements that describe the objects and their corresponding formatting for within a handout slide. Within a handout master slide the cSld element specifies the common slide elements such as shapes and their attached text bodies.

entries.name: hf
entries.title: Header/Footer information for a slide master
entries.description: This element specifies the header and footer information for a slide. Headers and footers consist of placeholders for text that should be consistent across all slides and slide types, such as a date and time, slide numbering, and custom header and footer text.

attributes.name: dt
attributes.title: Date/Time Placeholder
attributes.description: Specifies whether the Date/Time placeholder is enabled for this master.

attributes.name: ftr
attributes.title: Footer Placeholder
attributes.description: Specifies whether the Footer placeholder is enabled for this master.

attributes.name: hdr
attributes.title: Header Placeholder
attributes.description: Specifies whether the Header placeholder is enabled for this master.

attributes.name: sldNum
attributes.title: Slide Number Placeholder
attributes.description: Specifies whether the slide number placeholder is enabled.

entries.name: notes
entries.title: Notes Slide
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of a notes slide along with its corresponding data. Contained within a notes slide are all the common slide elements along with addition properties that are specific to the notes element.

attributes.name: m
attributes.title: Show Master Placeholder Animations
attributes.description: Specifies whether or not to display animations on placeholders from the master slide.

attributes.name: showMasterSp
attributes.title: Show Master Shapes
attributes.description: Specifies if shapes on the master slide should be shown on slides or not.

entries.name: notesMaster
entries.title: Notes Master
entries.description: This element specifies an instance of a notes master slide. Within a notes master slide are contained all elements that describe the objects and their corresponding formatting for within a notes slide. Within a notes master slide the cSld element specifies the common slide elements such as shapes and their attached text bodies.

entries.name: notesStyle
entries.title: Notes Text Style
entries.description: This element specifies the text formatting style for the all other text within a notes slide. This formatting is used on all text within the corresponding notes slides. The text formatting is specified by utilizing the DrawingML framework just as within a regular presentation slide.

entries.name: nvCxnSpPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Properties for a Connection Shape
entries.description: This element specifies all non-visual properties for a connection shape. This element is a container for the non- visual identification properties, shape properties and application properties that are to be associated with a connection shape. This allows for additional information that does not affect the appearance of the connection shape to be stored.

entries.name: nvGraphicFramePr
entries.title: Non-Visual Properties for a Graphic Frame
entries.description: This element specifies all non-visual properties for a graphic frame. This element is a container for the non-visual identification properties, shape properties and application properties that are to be associated with a graphic frame. This allows for additional information that does not affect the appearance of the graphic frame to be stored.

entries.name: nvGrpSpPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Properties for a Group Shape
entries.description: This element specifies all non-visual properties for a group shape. This element is a container for the non-visual identification properties, shape properties and application properties that are to be associated with a group shape. This allows for additional information that does not affect the appearance of the group shape to be stored.

entries.name: nvPicPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Properties for a Picture
entries.description: This element specifies all non-visual properties for a picture. This element is a container for the non-visual identification properties, shape properties and application properties that are to be associated with a picture. This allows for additional information that does not affect the appearance of the picture to be stored.

entries.name: nvPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Properties
entries.description: This element specifies non-visual properties for objects. These properties include multimedia content associated with an object and properties indicating how the object is to be used or displayed in different contexts.

attributes.name: isPhoto
attributes.title: Is a Photo Album
attributes.description: Specifies whether the picture belongs to a photo album and should thus be included when editing a photo album within the generating application.

attributes.name: userDrawn
attributes.title: Is User Drawn
attributes.description: Specifies if the corresponding object has been drawn by the user and should thus not be deleted.

entries.name: nvSpPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Properties for a Shape
entries.description: This element specifies all non-visual properties for a shape. This element is a container for the non-visual identification properties, shape properties and application properties that are to be associated with a shape. This allows for additional information that does not affect the appearance of the shape to be stored.

entries.name: otherStyle
entries.title: Slide Master Other Text Style
entries.description: This element specifies the text formatting style for the all other text within a master slide. This formatting is used on all text not covered by the titleStyle or bodyStyle elements within related presentation slides. The text formatting is specified by utilizing the DrawingML framework just as within a regular presentation slide.

entries.name: ph
entries.title: Placeholder Shape
entries.description: This element specifies that the corresponding shape should be represented by the generating application as a placeholder. When a shape is considered a placeholder by the generating application it can have special properties to alert the user that they can enter content into the shape. Different placeholder types are allowed and can be specified by using the placeholder type attribute for this element.

attributes.name: hasCustomPrompt
attributes.title: Placeholder has custom prompt
attributes.description: Specifies whether the corresponding placeholder should have a custom prompt or not.

attributes.name: idx
attributes.title: Placeholder Index
attributes.description: Specifies the placeholder index.

attributes.name: orient
attributes.title: Placeholder Orientation
attributes.description: Specifies the orientation of a placeholder.

attributes.name: sz
attributes.title: Placeholder Size
attributes.description: Specifies the size of a placeholder.

attributes.name: type
attributes.title: Placeholder Type
attributes.description: Specifies what content type a placeholder is intended to contain.

entries.name: pic
entries.title: Picture
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of a picture object within the document.

entries.name: sld
entries.title: Presentation Slide
entries.description: This element is the root element of a Slide part (§13.3.8) and specifies an instance of a slide. Within a slide are contained all elements that describe the objects and their corresponding formatting within a presentation slide. Child elements describe the common slide elements such as shapes and their attached text bodies, transition and timing specific to this slide and color information specific to this slide.

entries.name: sldLayout
entries.title: Slide Layout
entries.description: This element specifies an instance of a slide layout. The slide layout contains in essence a template slide design that can be applied to any existing slide. When applied to an existing slide all corresponding content should be mapped to the new slide layout.

attributes.name: matchingName
attributes.title: Matching Name
attributes.description: Specifies a name to be used in place of the name attribute within the cSld element.

attributes.name: preserve
attributes.title: Preserve Slide Layout
attributes.description: Specifies whether the corresponding slide layout is deleted when all the slides that follow that layout are deleted.

attributes.name: m
attributes.title: Show Master Placeholder Animations
attributes.description: Specifies whether or not to display animations on placeholders from the master slide.

attributes.name: showMasterSp
attributes.title: Show Master Shapes
attributes.description: Specifies if shapes on the master slide should be shown on slides or not.

attributes.name: type
attributes.title: Slide Layout Type
attributes.description: Specifies the slide layout type that is used by this slide.

attributes.name: userDrawn
attributes.title: Is User Drawn
attributes.description: Specifies if the corresponding object has been drawn by the user and should thus not be deleted.

entries.name: sldLayoutId
entries.title: Slide Layout Id
entries.description: This element specifies the relationship information for each slide layout that is used within the slide master. The slide master has relationship identifiers that it uses internally for determining the slide layouts that should be used. Then, to resolve what these slide layouts should be the sldLayoutId elements in the sldLayoutIdLst are utilized.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: ID Tag
attributes.description: Specifies the relationship id value that the generating application can use to resolve which slide layout is used in the creation of the slide.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: ID Tag
attributes.description: Specifies the identification number that uniquely identifies this slide layout within the presentation file.

entries.name: sldLayoutIdLst
entries.title: List of Slide Layouts
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of the slide layout identification list. This list is contained within the slide master and is used to determine which layouts are being used within the slide master file. Each layout within the list of slide layouts has its own identification number and relationship identifier that uniquely identifies it within both the presentation document and the particular master slide within which it is used.

entries.name: sldMaster
entries.title: Slide Master
entries.description: This element specifies an instance of a slide master slide. Within a slide master slide are contained all elements that describe the objects and their corresponding formatting for within a presentation slide. Within a slide master slide are two main elements.

attributes.name: preserve
attributes.title: Preserve Slide Master
attributes.description: Specifies whether the corresponding slide layout is deleted when all the slides that follow that layout are deleted.

entries.name: sp
entries.title: Shape
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of a single shape. A shape can either be a preset or a custom geometry, defined using the DrawingML framework. In addition to a geometry each shape can have both visual and non- visual properties attached.

attributes.name: useBgFill
attributes.title: Use Background Fill
attributes.description: Specifies that the shape fill should be set to that of the slide background surface.

entries.name: spPr
entries.title: Shape Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the visual shape properties that can be applied to a shape. These properties include the shape fill, outline, geometry, effects, and 3D orientation.

attributes.name: bwMode
attributes.title: Black and White Mode
attributes.description: Specifies that the picture should be rendered using only black and white coloring.

entries.name: spTree
entries.title: Shape Tree
entries.description: This element specifies all shape-based objects, either grouped or not, that can be referenced on a given slide. As most objects within a slide are shapes, this represents the majority of content within a slide. Text and effects are attached to shapes that are contained within the spTree element.

entries.name: style
entries.title: Shape Style
entries.description: This element specifies the style information for a shape. This is used to define a shape's appearance in terms of the preset styles defined by the style matrix for the theme.

entries.name: tags
entries.title: Customer Data Tags
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of customer data in the form of tags. This allows for the storage of customer data within the PresentationML framework. While this is similar to the ext tag in that it can be used store information, this tag mainly focuses on referencing to other parts of the presentation document.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Relationship ID
attributes.description: This attribute specifies the relationship identifier for the customer data tag.

entries.name: timing
entries.title: Slide Timing Information for a Slide Layout
entries.description: This element specifies the timing information for handling all animations and timed events within the corresponding slide. This information is tracked via time nodes within the timing element. More information on

entries.name: titleStyle
entries.title: Slide Master Title Text Style
entries.description: This element specifies the text formatting style for the title text within a master slide. This formatting is used on all title text within related presentation slides. The text formatting is specified by utilizing the DrawingML framework just as within a regular presentation slide.

entries.name: transition
entries.title: Slide Transition for a Slide Layout
entries.description: This element specifies the kind of slide transition that should be used to transition to the current slide from the previous slide. That is, the transition information is stored on the slide that appears after the transition is complete.

attributes.name: advClick
attributes.title: Advance on Click
attributes.description: Specifies whether a mouse click advances the slide or not.

attributes.name: advTm
attributes.title: Advance after time
attributes.description: Specifies the time, in milliseconds, after which the transition should start.

attributes.name: spd
attributes.title: Transition Speed
attributes.description: Specifies the transition speed that is to be used when transitioning from the current slide to the next.

entries.name: txBody
entries.title: Shape Text Body
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of text to be contained within the corresponding shape. All visible text and visible text related properties are contained within this element. There can be multiple paragraphs and within paragraphs multiple runs of text.

entries.name: txStyles
entries.title: Slide Master Text Styles
entries.description: This element specifies the text styles within a slide master. Within this element is the styling information for title text, the body text and other slide text as well. This element is only for use within the Slide Master and thus sets the text styles for the corresponding presentation slides.

entries.name: xfrm
entries.title: 2D Transform for Graphic Frame
entries.description: This element specifies the transform to be applied to the corresponding graphic frame. This transformation is applied to the graphic frame just as it would be for a shape or group shape.

attributes.name: flipH
attributes.title: Horizontal Flip
attributes.description: Specifies a horizontal flip.

attributes.name: flipV
attributes.title: Vertical Flip
attributes.description: Specifies a vertical flip.

attributes.name: rot
attributes.title: Rotation
attributes.description: Specifies the rotation of the Graphic Frame.

entries.name: control
entries.title: Embedded Control
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of an embedded control in the slide.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Relationship ID
attributes.description: Specifies the relationship id that is used to identify this Embedded object from within a slide.

attributes.name: imgH
attributes.title: Image Height
attributes.description: Specifies the height of the embedded control.

attributes.name: imgW
attributes.title: Image Width
attributes.description: Specifies the width of the embedded control.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Embedded Object Name
attributes.description: Specifies the identifying name class used by scripting languages.

attributes.name: showAsIcon
attributes.title: Show Embedded Object As Icon
attributes.description: Specifies whether the Embedded object shows as an icon or using its native representation.

entries.name: embed
entries.title: Embedded Object or Control
entries.description: This element specifies an Embedded object or Control that is embedded within the presentation.

attributes.name: followColorScheme
attributes.title: Color Scheme Properties for Embedded object
attributes.description: Specifies the Color Scheme Properties for the corresponding Embedded object being specified.

entries.name: link
entries.title: Linked Object or Control
entries.description: This element specifies a link to an external Embedded object or Control.

attributes.name: updateAutomatic
attributes.title: Update Linked Embedded Objects Automatically
attributes.description: This attribute determines if linked embedded objects are automatically updated when the presentation is opened or printed.

entries.name: oleObj
entries.title: Global Element for Embedded objects and Controls
entries.description: This element specifies a global element to be used for an Embedded object and Control. When the oleObject element contains a pic child element, the identifier specified by the pic/nvPicPr/cNvPr@id attribute shall be ignored and the identifier specified by the graphicFrame/nvGraphicFramePr/cNvPr@id attribute shall be used when deciding which identifier to use for the OLE object.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Relationship ID
attributes.description: Specifies the relationship id that is used to identify this Embedded object from within a slide.

attributes.name: imgH
attributes.title: Image Height
attributes.description: Specifies the height of the embedded control.

attributes.name: imgW
attributes.title: Image Width
attributes.description: Specifies the width of the embedded control.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Embedded Object Name
attributes.description: Specifies the identifying name class used by scripting languages.

attributes.name: progId
attributes.title: Embedded Object ProgID
attributes.description: Specifies the progid for an Embedded object.

attributes.name: showAsIcon
attributes.title: Show Embedded Object As Icon
attributes.description: Specifies whether the Embedded object shows as an icon or using its native representation.

entries.name: tag
entries.title: Programmable Extensibility Tag
entries.description: This element specifies a programmable extensibility tag to be used for storage of legacy variables.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Name
attributes.description: Specifies the name associated with this specific programmable tag.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the value associated with this specific programmable tag.

entries.name: tagLst
entries.title: Programmable Tab List
entries.description: This element specifies the list of programmable extensibility tags that are used to store variables from legacy file formats.

entries.name: cm
entries.title: Comment
entries.description: This element specifies a single comment attached to a slide. It contains the text of the comment, its position on the slide, and attributes referring to its author and date.

attributes.name: authorId
attributes.title: Comment Author ID
attributes.description: This attribute specifies the author of the comment.

attributes.name: dt
attributes.title: Comment Date/Time
attributes.description: This attribute specifies the date and time this comment was last modified.

attributes.name: idx
attributes.title: Comment Index
attributes.description: This attribute specifies an identifier for this comment that is unique within a list of all comments by this author in this document.

entries.name: cmAuthor
entries.title: Comment Author
entries.description: This element specifies a single author with comments in the document. It contains a unique author ID, the author's name and initials, the index of the author's last comment, and the index of a color associated with the author.

attributes.name: clrIdx
attributes.title: Comment Author Color Index
attributes.description: This attribute specifies an index into the generating application's comments color table to allow for visual (color) differentiation of different author's comments.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Comment Author ID
attributes.description: This attribute specifies a unique (within the document) zero-based identifier that refers to a single comment author.

attributes.name: initials
attributes.title: Comment Author Initials
attributes.description: This attribute specifies a string that represents the initials of this particular author.

attributes.name: lastIdx
attributes.title: Index of Comment Author's last comment
attributes.description: Index of the last comment added to this document by this author.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Comment Author Name
attributes.description: This attribute specifies the full name of this particular author.

entries.name: cmAuthorLst
entries.title: List of Comment Authors
entries.description: This element specifies a list of authors with comments in the current document. Each comment in a document shall refer to an author in this list. No cmAuthor element in a cmAuthorLst shall have both the same name attribute value and the same initials attribute value as any other cmAuthor element in the same cmAuthorLst.

entries.name: cmLst
entries.title: Comment List
entries.description: This element specifies a list of comments for a particular slide.

entries.name: pos
entries.title: Comment Position
entries.description: This element specifies the positioning information for the placement of a comment on a slide surface. In LTR versions of the generating application, this position information should refer to the upper left point of the comment shape. In RTL versions of the generating application, this position information should refer to the upper right point of the comment shape.

attributes.name: x
attributes.title: X-Axis Coordinate
attributes.description: Specifies a coordinate on the x-axis.

attributes.name: y
attributes.title: Y-Axis Coordinate
attributes.description: Specifies a coordinate on the y-axis.

entries.name: text
entries.title: Comment's Text Content
entries.description: This element specifies the content of a comment. This is the text with which the author has annotated the slide.

entries.name: anim
entries.title: Animate
entries.description: This element is a generic animation element that requires little or no semantic understanding of the attribute being animated. It can animate text within a shape or even the shape itself.

attributes.name: by
attributes.title: By
attributes.description: This attribute specifies a relative offset value for the animation with respect to its position before the start of the animation.

attributes.name: calcmode
attributes.title: Calculation Mode
attributes.description: This attribute specifies the interpolation mode for the animation.

attributes.name: from
attributes.title: From
attributes.description: This attribute specifies the starting value of the animation.

attributes.name: to
attributes.title: To
attributes.description: This attribute specifies the ending value for the animation as a percentage.

attributes.name: valueType
attributes.title: Value Type
attributes.description: This attribute specifies the type of property value.

entries.name: animClr
entries.title: Animate Color Behavior
entries.description: This animation element is responsible for animating the color of an object.

attributes.name: clrSpc
attributes.title: Color Space
attributes.description: This attribute specifies the color space in which to interpolate the animation.

attributes.name: dir
attributes.title: Direction
attributes.description: This attribute specifies which direction to cycle the hue around the color wheel.

entries.name: animEffect
entries.title: Animate Effect
entries.description: This animation behavior provides the ability to do image transform/filter effects on elements. Some visual effects are dynamic in nature and have a progress that animates from 0 to 1 over a period of time to do visual transitions between hidden and visible states. Other filters are static and apply a effects like a blur or drop- shadow which aren't inherently time-based.

attributes.name: filter
attributes.title: Filter
attributes.description: This attribute specifies the animation types and subtypes to be used for the effect.

attributes.name: prLst
attributes.title: Property List
attributes.description: This attribute specifies a list of properties that coincide with the effect specified.

attributes.name: transition
attributes.title: Transition
attributes.description: This attribute specifies whether to transition the element in or out or treat it as a static filter.

entries.name: animMotion
entries.title: Animate Motion
entries.description: Animate motion provides an abstracted way to move positioned elements. It provides the ability to specify from/to/by motion as well as to use more detailed path descriptions for motion over polylines or bezier curves.

attributes.name: origin
attributes.title: Origin
attributes.description: Specifies what the origin of the motion path is relative to such as the layout of the slide, or the parent.

attributes.name: path
attributes.title: Path
attributes.description: Specifies the path primitive followed by coordinates for the animation motion.

attributes.name: pathEditMode
attributes.title: Path Edit Mode
attributes.description: This attribute specifies how the motion path moves when the target element is moved.

attributes.name: ptsTypes
attributes.title: Points Types
attributes.description: This attribute describes the point type of the points in the path attribute.

attributes.name: rAng
attributes.title: Relative Angle
attributes.description: The attribute describes the relative angle of the motion path.

entries.name: animRot
entries.title: Animate Rotation
entries.description: This animation element is responsible for animating the rotation of an object. Rotation values set in the "by" , "to, and "from" attributes are specified in degrees measured to a 60,000th, i.e 1 degree is 60,000. Rotation values can be larger than 360°.

attributes.name: by
attributes.title: By
attributes.description: This attribute describes the relative offset value for the animation.

attributes.name: from
attributes.title: From
attributes.description: This attribute describes the starting value for the animation.

attributes.name: to
attributes.title: To
attributes.description: This attribute describes the ending value for the animation.

entries.name: animScale
entries.title: Animate Scale
entries.description: This animation element is responsible for animating the scale of an object. When animating the scale, the element shall scale around the reference point of the element and the positioning system used should be consistent with the one used for motion paths. When animating the width and height of an element, all of the width/height animation values are calculated first then the scale animations are applied on top of that.

attributes.name: zoomContents
attributes.title: Zoom Content
attributes.description: This attribute specifies whether to zoom the contents of an object when doing a scaling animation.

entries.name: attrName
entries.title: Attribute Name
entries.description: This element is used to contain an attribute value for an Attribute Name List. This value defines the specific attribute that an animation should be applied to, such as fill, style, and shadow, etc. A specific property is defined by using a "property.sub-property" format which is often extended to multiple sub properties as seen in the allowed values below.

entries.name: attrNameLst
entries.title: Attribute Name List
entries.description: This element is used to describe a list of attributes in which to apply an animation to.

entries.name: audio
entries.title: Audio
entries.description: This element is used to include audio during an animation. This element specifies that this node within the animation tree triggers the playback of an audio file; the actual audio file used is specified by the sndTgt element (§19.5.70).

attributes.name: isNarration
attributes.title: Is Narration
attributes.description: This attribute indicates whether the audio is a narration for the slide.

entries.name: bg
entries.title: Background
entries.description: This element is used to specify animating the background of an object.

entries.name: bldAsOne
entries.title: Build As One
entries.description: This element specifies in the build list to build the entire graphical object as one entity.

entries.name: bldDgm
entries.title: Build Diagram
entries.description: This element specifies how to build the animation for a diagram.

attributes.name: bld
attributes.title: Diagram Build Types
attributes.description: This attribute describes how the diagram is built.

attributes.name: grpId
attributes.title: Group ID
attributes.description: This attribute ties effects persisted in the animation to the build information.

attributes.name: spid
attributes.title: Shape ID
attributes.description: This attribute specifies the shape to which the build applies.

attributes.name: uiExpand
attributes.title: Expand UI
attributes.description: This attribute describes the view option indicating if the build should be displayed expanded.

entries.name: bldGraphic
entries.title: Build Graphics
entries.description: This element specifies how to build a graphical element.

attributes.name: grpId
attributes.title: Group ID
attributes.description: This attribute ties effects persisted in the animation to the build information.

attributes.name: spid
attributes.title: Shape ID
attributes.description: This attribute specifies the shape to which the build applies.

attributes.name: uiExpand
attributes.title: Expand UI
attributes.description: This attribute describes the view option indicating if the build should be displayed expanded.

entries.name: bldLst
entries.title: Build List
entries.description: This element specifies the list of graphic elements to build. This refers to how the different sub-shapes or sub- components of a object are displayed. The different objects that can have build properties are text, diagrams, and charts.

entries.name: bldOleChart
entries.title: Build Embedded Chart
entries.description: This element describes animation an a embedded Chart.

attributes.name: animBg

values.title: Normal Slide View
values.description: Specifies that a given PresentationML document should be rendered in a view that allows slides to be viewed or edited.

entries.name: bldChart
entries.title: Build Chart
entries.description: This element specifies how to build the animation for a diagram.

attributes.name: animBg
attributes.title: Animate Background
attributes.description: Specifies whether or not the chart background elements should be animated as well.

attributes.name: bld
attributes.title: Build
attributes.description: Specifies how the chart is built.

entries.name: bldDgm
entries.title: Build Diagram
entries.description: This element specifies how to build the animation for a diagram.

attributes.name: bld
attributes.title: Build
attributes.description: Specifies how the chart is built.

attributes.name: rev
attributes.title: Reverse Animation
attributes.description: Specifies whether the animation of the objects in this diagram should be reversed or not.

entries.name: chart
entries.title: Chart to Animate
entries.description: This element specifies a reference to a chart that should be animated within a sequence of slide animations. In addition to simply acting as a reference to a chart there is also animation build steps defined.

attributes.name: bldStep
attributes.title: Animation Build Step
attributes.description: Specifies which step this part of the chart should be built using.

attributes.name: categoryIdx
attributes.title: Category Index
attributes.description: Specifies the index of the category within the corresponding chart that should be animated.

attributes.name: seriesIdx
attributes.title: Series Index
attributes.description: Specifies the index of the series within the corresponding chart that should be animated.

entries.name: cNvCxnSpPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Connector Shape Drawing Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the non-visual drawing properties for a connector shape. These non-visual properties are properties that the generating application would utilize when rendering the slide surface.

entries.name: cNvGraphicFramePr
entries.title: Non-Visual Graphic Frame Drawing Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the non-visual drawing properties for a graphic frame. These non-visual properties are properties that the generating application would utilize when rendering the slide surface.

entries.name: cNvGrpSpPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Group Shape Drawing Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the non-visual drawing properties for a group shape. These non-visual properties are properties that the generating application would utilize when rendering the slide surface.

entries.name: cNvPicPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Picture Drawing Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the non-visual properties for the picture canvas. These properties are to be used by the generating application to determine how certain properties are to be changed for the picture object in question.

attributes.name: ze
attributes.title: Relative Resize Preferred
attributes.description: Specifies if the user interface should show the resizing of the picture based on the picture's current size or its original size.

entries.name: cNvPr
