entries.title: Non-Visual Drawing Properties
entries.description: This element specifies non-visual canvas properties. This allows for additional information that does not affect the appearance of the picture to be stored.

attributes.name: descr
attributes.title: Alternative Text for Object
attributes.description: Specifies alternative text for the current DrawingML object, for use by assistive technologies or applications which do not display the current object.

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.title: Hidden
attributes.description: Specifies whether this DrawingML object is displayed.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Unique Identifier
attributes.description: Specifies a unique identifier for the current DrawingML object within the current document.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Name
attributes.description: Specifies the name of the object.

attributes.name: title
attributes.title: Title
attributes.description: Specifies the title (caption) of the current DrawingML object.

entries.name: cNvSpPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Shape Drawing Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the non-visual drawing properties for a shape. These properties are to be used by the generating application to determine how the shape should be dealt with

attributes.name: txBox
attributes.title: Text Box
attributes.description: Specifies that the corresponding shape is a text box and thus should be treated as such by the generating application.

entries.name: cxnSp
entries.title: Connection Shape
entries.description: This element specifies a connection shape that is used to connect two sp elements. Once a connection is specified using a cxnSp, it is left to the generating application to determine the exact path the connector takes. That is the connector routing algorithm is left up to the generating application as the desired path might be different depending on the specific needs of the application.

entries.name: cxnSpLocks
entries.title: Connection Shape Locks
entries.description: This element specifies all locking properties for a connection shape. These properties inform the generating application about specific properties that have been previously locked and thus should not be changed.

attributes.name: noAdjustHandles
attributes.title: Disallow Showing Adjust Handles
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not show adjust handles for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: ads
attributes.title: Disallow Arrowhead Changes
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow arrowhead changes for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: noChangeAspect
attributes.title: Disallow Aspect Ratio Change
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow aspect ratio changes for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: pe
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Type Change
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow shape type changes for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: noEditPoints
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Point Editing
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow shape point changes for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: noGrp
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Grouping
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow shape grouping for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: noMove
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Movement
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow position changes for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: noResize
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Resize
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow size changes for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: noRot
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Rotation
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow shape rotation changes for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: noSelect
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Selection
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow selecting of the corresponding connection shape.

entries.name: dgm
entries.title: Diagram to Animate
entries.description: This element specifies a reference to a diagram that should be animated within a sequence of slide animations. In addition to simply acting as a reference to a diagram there is also animation build steps defined.

attributes.name: bldStep
attributes.title: Animation Build Step
attributes.description: Specifies which step this part of the diagram should be built using.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Identifier
attributes.description: Specifies the GUID of the shape for this build step in the animation.

entries.name: endCxn
entries.title: Connection End
entries.description: This element specifies the ending connection that should be made by the corresponding connector shape. This connects the end tail of the connector to the final destination shape.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Identifier
attributes.description: Specifies the id of the shape to make the final connection to.

attributes.name: idx
attributes.title: Index
attributes.description: Specifies the index into the connection site table of the final connection shape.

entries.name: ext
entries.title: Extension
entries.description: This element specifies an extension that is used for future extensions to the current version of DrawingML. This allows for the specifying of currently unknown elements in the future that is used for later versions of generating applications.

attributes.name: uri
attributes.title: Uniform Resource Identifier
attributes.description: Specifies the URI, or uniform resource identifier that represents the data stored under this tag.

entries.name: extLst
entries.title: Extension List
entries.description: This element specifies the extension list within which all future extensions of element type ext is defined. The extension list along with corresponding future extensions is used to extend the storage capabilities of the DrawingML framework. This allows for various new types of data to be stored natively within the framework.

entries.name: graphic
entries.title: Graphic Object
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of a single graphic object. Document authors should refer to this element when they wish to persist a graphical object of some kind. The specification for this graphical object is provided entirely by the document author and referenced within the graphicData child element.

entries.name: graphicData
entries.title: Graphic Object Data
entries.description: This element specifies the reference to a graphic object within the document. This graphic object is provided entirely by the document authors who choose to persist this data within the document.

attributes.name: uri
attributes.title: Uniform Resource Identifier
attributes.description: Specifies the URI, or uniform resource identifier that represents the data stored under this tag.

entries.name: graphicFrame
entries.title: Graphic Frame
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of a graphics frame. This frame contains a graphic that was generated by an external source and needs a container in which to be displayed on the slide surface.

entries.name: graphicFrameLocks
entries.title: Graphic Frame Locks
entries.description: This element specifies all locking properties for a graphic frame. These properties inform the generating application about specific properties that have been previously locked and thus should not be changed.

attributes.name: noChangeAspect
attributes.title: Disallow Aspect Ratio Change
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow aspect ratio changes for the corresponding graphic frame.

attributes.name: noDrilldown
attributes.title: Disallow Selection of Child Shapes
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow selecting of objects within the corresponding graphic frame but allow selecting of the graphic frame itself.

attributes.name: noGrp
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Grouping
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow shape grouping for the corresponding graphic frame.

attributes.name: noMove
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Movement
attributes.description: Specifies that the corresponding graphic frame cannot be moved.

attributes.name: noResize
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Resize
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow size changes for the corresponding graphic frame.

attributes.name: noSelect
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Selection
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow selecting of the corresponding picture.

entries.name: grpSp
entries.title: Group shape
entries.description: This element specifies a group shape that represents many shapes grouped together. This shape is to be treated just as if it were a regular shape but instead of being described by a single geometry it is made up of all the shape geometries encompassed within it. Within a group shape each of the shapes that make up the group are specified just as they normally would.

entries.name: grpSpLocks
entries.title: Group Shape Locks
entries.description: This element specifies all locking properties for a connection shape. These properties inform the generating application about specific properties that have been previously locked and thus should not be changed.

attributes.name: noChangeAspect
attributes.title: Disallow Aspect Ratio Change
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow aspect ratio changes for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: noGrp
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Grouping
attributes.description: Specifies that the corresponding group shape cannot be grouped.

attributes.name: noResize
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Resizing
attributes.description: Specifies that the corresponding group shape cannot be resized.

attributes.name: noRot
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Rotation
attributes.description: Specifies that the corresponding group shape cannot be rotated Objects that reside within the group can still be rotated unless they also have been locked.

attributes.name: noSelect
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Selection
attributes.description: Specifies that the corresponding group shape cannot have any part of it be selected.

attributes.name: noUngrp
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Ungrouping
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not show adjust handles for the corresponding connection shape.

entries.name: grpSpPr
entries.title: Visual Group Shape Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the properties that are to be common across all of the shapes within the corresponding group. If there are any conflicting properties within the group shape properties and the individual shape properties then the individual shape properties should take precedence.

entries.name: hlinkHover
entries.title: Hyperlink for Hover
entries.description: This element specifies the hyperlink information to be activated when the user's mouse is hovered over the corresponding object. The operation of the hyperlink is to have the specified action be activated when the mouse of the user hovers over the object. When this action is activated then additional attributes can be used to specify other tasks that should be performed along with the action.

attributes.name: action
attributes.title: Action Setting
attributes.description: Specifies an action that is to be taken when this hyperlink is activated.

attributes.name: endSnd
attributes.title: End Sounds
attributes.description: Specifies if the URL in question should stop all sounds that are playing when it is clicked.

attributes.name: highlightClick
attributes.title: Highlight Click
attributes.description: Specifies if this attribute has already been used within this document.

attributes.name: history
attributes.title: Add Hyperlink to Page History
attributes.description: Specifies whether to add this URI to the history when navigating to it.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Drawing Object Hyperlink Target
attributes.description: Specifies the relationship id that when looked up in this slides relationship file contains the target of this hyperlink.

attributes.name: invalidUrl
attributes.title: Invalid URL
attributes.description: Specifies the URL when it has been determined by the generating application that the URL is invalid.

attributes.name: tgtFrame
attributes.title: Target Frame
attributes.description: Specifies the target frame that is to be used when opening this hyperlink.

attributes.name: tooltip
attributes.title: Hyperlink Tooltip
attributes.description: Specifies the tooltip that should be displayed when the hyperlink text is hovered over with the mouse.

entries.name: ln
entries.title: Outline
entries.description: This element specifies an outline style that can be applied to a number of different objects such as shapes and text. The line allows for the specifying of many different types of outlines including even line dashes and bevels.

attributes.name: algn
attributes.title: Stroke Alignment
attributes.description: Specifies the alignment to be used for the underline stroke.

attributes.name: cap
attributes.title: Line Ending Cap Type
attributes.description: Specifies the ending caps that should be used for this line.

attributes.name: cmpd
attributes.title: Compound Line Type
attributes.description: Specifies the compound line type to be used for the underline stroke.

attributes.name: w
attributes.title: Line Width
attributes.description: Specifies the width to be used for the underline stroke.

entries.name: nvCxnSpPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Properties for a Connection Shape
entries.description: This element specifies all non-visual properties for a connection shape. This element is a container for the non- visual identification properties, shape properties and application properties that are to be associated with a connection shape. This allows for additional information that does not affect the appearance of the connection shape to be stored.

entries.name: nvGraphicFramePr
entries.title: Non-Visual Properties for a Graphic Frame
entries.description: This element specifies all non-visual properties for a graphic frame. This element is a container for the non-visual identification properties, shape properties and application properties that are to be associated with a graphic frame. This allows for additional information that does not affect the appearance of the graphic frame to be stored.

entries.name: nvGrpSpPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Properties for a Group Shape
entries.description: This element specifies all non-visual properties for a group shape. This element is a container for the non-visual identification properties, shape properties and application properties that are to be associated with a group

entries.name: nvPicPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Properties for a Picture
entries.description: This element specifies all non-visual properties for a picture. This element is a container for the non-visual identification properties, shape properties and application properties that are to be associated with a picture. This allows for additional information that does not affect the appearance of the picture to be stored.

entries.name: nvSpPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Properties for a Shape
entries.description: This element specifies all non-visual properties for a shape. This element is a container for the non-visual identification properties, shape properties and application properties that are to be associated with a shape. This allows for additional information that does not affect the appearance of the shape to be stored.

entries.name: pic
entries.title: Picture
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of a picture object within the document.

entries.name: picLocks
entries.title: Picture Locks
entries.description: This element specifies all locking properties for a graphic frame. These properties inform the generating application about specific properties that have been previously locked and thus should not be changed.

attributes.name: noAdjustHandles
attributes.title: Disallow Showing Adjust Handles
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not show adjust handles for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: ads
attributes.title: Disallow Arrowhead Changes
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow arrowhead changes for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: noChangeAspect
attributes.title: Disallow Aspect Ratio Change
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow aspect ratio changes for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: pe
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Type Change
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow shape type changes for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: noCrop
attributes.title: Disallow Crop Changes
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow cropping for the corresponding picture.

attributes.name: noEditPoints
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Point Editing
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow shape point changes for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: noGrp
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Grouping
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow shape grouping for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: noMove
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Movement
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow position changes for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: noResize
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Resize
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow size changes for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: noRot
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Rotation
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow shape rotation changes for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: noSelect
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Selection
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow selecting of the corresponding connection shape.

entries.name: snd
entries.title: Hyperlink Sound
entries.description: This element specifies a sound to be played when a hyperlink within the document is activated. This sound is specified from within the parent hyperlink element.

attributes.name: embed
attributes.title: Embedded Audio File Relationship ID
attributes.description: Specifies the identification information for an embedded audio file.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Sound Name
attributes.description: Specifies the original name or given short name for the corresponding sound.

entries.name: sp
entries.title: Shape
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of a single shape. A shape can either be a preset or a custom geometry, defined using the DrawingML framework. In addition to a geometry each shape can have both visual and non- visual properties attached.

entries.name: spLocks
entries.title: Shape Locks
entries.description: This element specifies all locking properties for a shape. These properties inform the generating application about specific properties that have been previously locked and thus should not be changed.

attributes.name: noAdjustHandles
attributes.title: Disallow Showing Adjust Handles
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not show adjust handles for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: ads
attributes.title: Disallow Arrowhead Changes
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow arrowhead changes for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: noChangeAspect
attributes.title: Disallow Aspect Ratio Change
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow aspect ratio changes for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: pe
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Type Change
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow shape type changes for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: noEditPoints
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Point Editing
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow shape point changes for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: noGrp
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Grouping
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow shape grouping for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: noMove
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Movement
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow position changes for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: noResize
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Resize
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow size changes for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: noRot
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Rotation
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow shape rotation changes for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: noSelect
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Selection
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow selecting of the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: noTextEdit
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Text Editing
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow editing of the shape text for the corresponding shape.

entries.name: spPr
entries.title: Shape Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the visual shape properties that can be applied to a shape.

attributes.name: bwMode
attributes.title: Black and White Mode
attributes.description: Specifies that the picture should be rendered using only black and white coloring.

entries.name: stCxn
entries.title: Connection Start
entries.description: This element specifies the starting connection that should be made by the corresponding connector shape. This connects the head of the connector to the first shape.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Identifier
attributes.description: Specifies the id of the shape to make the final connection to.

attributes.name: idx
attributes.title: Index
attributes.description: Specifies the index into the connection site table of the final connection shape.

entries.name: style
entries.title: Shape Style
entries.description: This element specifies the style information for a shape.

entries.name: sx
entries.title: Horizontal Ratio
entries.description: This element specifies the horizontal ratio for use within a scaling calculation.

attributes.name: d
attributes.title: Denominator
attributes.description: Specifies the denominator to be used within the equation.

attributes.name: n
attributes.title: Numerator
attributes.description: Specifies the numerator to be used within the equation.

entries.name: sy
entries.title: Vertical Ratio
entries.description: This element specifies the vertical ratio for use within a scaling calculation.

attributes.name: d
attributes.title: Denominator
attributes.description: Specifies the denominator to be used within the equation.

attributes.name: n
attributes.title: Numerator
attributes.description: Specifies the numerator to be used within the equation.

entries.name: txBody
entries.title: Shape Text Body
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of text to be contained within the corresponding shape. All visible text and visible text related properties are contained within this element. There can be multiple paragraphs and within paragraphs multiple runs of text.

entries.name: txSp
entries.title: Text Shape
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of a text shape within a parent shape. This text shape is specifically used for displaying text as it has only text related child elements.

entries.name: useSpRect
entries.title: Use Shape Text Rectangle
entries.description: This element specifies that the text rectangle from the parent shape should be used for this text shape. If this attribute is specified then the text rectangle, or text bounding box as it is also called should have the same dimensions as the text bounding box of the parent shape within which this text shape resides.

entries.name: cpLocks
entries.title: Content Part Locks
entries.description: This element specifies all locking properties for a content part. These properties inform the generating application about specific properties that have been previously locked and thus should not be changed.

attributes.name: noAdjustHandles
attributes.title: Disallow Showing Adjust Handles
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not show adjust handles for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: ads
attributes.title: Disallow Arrowhead Changes
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow arrowhead changes for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: noChangeAspect
attributes.title: Disallow Aspect Ratio Change
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow aspect ratio changes for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: pe
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Type Change
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow shape type changes for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: noEditPoints
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Point Editing
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow shape point changes for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: noMove
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Movement
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow position changes for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: noResize
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Resize
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow size changes for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: noRot
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Rotation
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow shape rotation changes for the corresponding connection shape.

attributes.name: noSelect
attributes.title: Disallow Shape Selection
attributes.description: Specifies that the generating application should not allow selecting of the corresponding connection shape.

entries.name: alpha
entries.title: Alpha
entries.description: This element specifies its input color with the specific opacity, but with its color unchanged.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the opacity as expressed by a percentage value.

entries.name: alphaMod
entries.title: Alpha Modulation
entries.description: This element specifies a more or less opaque version of its input color. An alpha modulate never increases the alpha beyond 100%. A 200% alpha modulate makes an input color twice as opaque as before.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the opacity as expressed by a percentage relative to the input color.

entries.name: alphaOff
entries.title: Alpha Offset
entries.description: This element specifies a more or less opaque version of its input color. Increases or decreases the input alpha percentage by the specified percentage offset. A 10% alpha offset increases a 50% opacity to 60%.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the opacity as expressed by a percentage offset increase or decrease to the input color.

entries.name: blue
entries.title: Blue
entries.description: This element specifies the input color with the specific blue component, but with the red and green color components unchanged.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the value of the blue component.

entries.name: blueMod
entries.title: Blue Modulation
entries.description: This element specifies the input color with its blue component modulated by the given percentage. A 50% blue modulate reduces the blue component by half. A 200% blue modulate doubles the blue component.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the blue component as expressed by a percentage relative to the input color component.

entries.name: blueOff
entries.title: Blue Offset
entries.description: This element specifies the input color with its blue component shifted, but with its red and green color components unchanged.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the blue component as expressed by a percentage offset increase or decrease to the input color component.

entries.name: comp
entries.title: Complement
entries.description: This element specifies that the color rendered should be the complement of its input color with the complement being defined as such. Two colors are called complementary if, when mixed they produce a shade of grey. For instance, the complement of red which is RGB (255, 0, 0) is cyan which is RGB (0, 255, 255).

entries.name: gamma
entries.title: Gamma
entries.description: This element specifies that the output color rendered by the generating application should be the sRGB gamma shift of the input color.

entries.name: gray
entries.title: Gray
entries.description: This element specifies a grayscale of its input color, taking into relative intensities of the red, green, and blue primaries.

entries.name: green
entries.title: Green
entries.description: This elements specifies the input color with the specified green component, but with its red and blue color components unchanged.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the value of the green component.

entries.name: greenMod
entries.title: Green Modulation
entries.description: This element specifies the input color with its green component modulated by the given percentage. A 50% green modulate reduces the green component by half. A 200% green modulate doubles the green component.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the green component as expressed by a percentage relative to the input color component.

entries.name: greenOff
entries.title: Green Offset
entries.description: This element specifies the input color with its green component shifted, but with its red and blue color components unchanged.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the green component as expressed by a percentage offset increase or decrease to the input color component.

entries.name: hslClr
entries.title: Hue, Saturation, Luminance Color Model
entries.description: This element specifies a color using the HSL color model. A perceptual gamma of 2.2 is assumed. Hue refers to the dominant wavelength of color, saturation refers to the purity of its hue, and luminance refers to its lightness or darkness.

attributes.name: hue
attributes.title: Hue
attributes.description: Specifies the angular value describing the wavelength.

attributes.name: lum
attributes.title: Luminance
attributes.description: Specifies the luminance referring to the lightness or darkness of the color.

attributes.name: sat
attributes.title: Saturation
attributes.description: Specifies the saturation referring to the purity of the hue.

entries.name: hue
entries.title: Hue
entries.description: This element specifies the input color with the specified hue, but with its saturation and luminance unchanged.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the actual angle value to be used with the input color's hue component.

entries.name: hueMod
entries.title: Hue Modulate
entries.description: This element specifies the input color with its hue modulated by the given percentage. A 50% hue modulate decreases the angular hue value by half. A 200% hue modulate doubles the angular hue value.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the hue as expressed by a percentage relative to the input color.

entries.name: hueOff
entries.title: Hue Offset
entries.description: This element specifies the input color with its hue shifted, but with its saturation and luminance unchanged.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the actual angular value of the shift.

entries.name: inv
entries.title: Inverse
entries.description: This element specifies the inverse of its input color.

entries.name: invGamma
entries.title: Inverse Gamma
entries.description: This element specifies that the output color rendered by the generating application should be the inverse sRGB gamma shift of the input color.

entries.name: lum
entries.title: Luminance
entries.description: This element specifies the input color with the specified luminance, but with its hue and saturation unchanged. Typically luminance values fall in the range [0%, 100%].

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the value of the luminance.

entries.name: lumMod
entries.title: Luminance Modulation
entries.description: This element specifies the input color with its luminance modulated by the given percentage. A 50% luminance modulate reduces the luminance by half. A 200% luminance modulate doubles the luminance.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the luminance as expressed by a percentage relative to the input color.

entries.name: lumOff
entries.title: Luminance Offset
entries.description: This element specifies the input color with its luminance shifted, but with its hue and saturation unchanged.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the luminance as expressed by a percentage offset increase or decrease to the input color.

entries.name: prstClr
entries.title: Preset Color
entries.description: This element specifies a color which is bound to one of a predefined collection of colors.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the actual preset color value.

entries.name: red
entries.title: Red
entries.description: This element specifies the input color with the specified red component, but with its green and blue color components unchanged.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the value of the red component.

entries.name: redMod
entries.title: Red Modulation
entries.description: This element specifies the input color with its red component modulated by the given percentage. A 50% red modulate reduces the red component by half. A 200% red modulate doubles the red component.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the red component as expressed by a percentage relative to the input color component.

entries.name: redOff
entries.title: Red Offset
entries.description: This element specifies the input color with its red component shifted, but with its green and blue color components unchanged.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the red component as expressed by a percentage offset increase or decrease to the input color component.

entries.name: sat
entries.title: Saturation
entries.description: This element specifies the input color with the specified saturation, but with its hue and luminance unchanged. Typically saturation values fall in the range [0%, 100%].

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the value of the saturation.

entries.name: satMod
entries.title: Saturation Modulation
entries.description: This element specifies the input color with its saturation modulated by the given percentage. A 50% saturation modulate reduces the saturation by half. A 200% saturation modulate doubles the saturation.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the saturation as expressed by a percentage relative to the input color.

entries.name: satOff
entries.title: Saturation Offset
entries.description: This element specifies the input color with its saturation shifted, but with its hue and luminance unchanged. A 10% offset to 20% saturation yields 30% saturation.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the saturation as expressed by a percentage offset increase or decrease to the input color.

entries.name: schemeClr
entries.title: Scheme Color
entries.description: This element specifies a color bound to a user's theme. As with all elements which define a color, it is possible to apply a list of color transforms to the base color defined.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the desired scheme.

entries.name: scrgbClr
entries.title: RGB Color Model - Percentage Variant
entries.description: This element specifies a color using the red, green, blue RGB color model. Each component, red, green, and blue is expressed as a percentage from 0% to 100%. A linear gamma of 1.0 is assumed.

attributes.name: b
attributes.title: Blue
attributes.description: Specifies the percentage of blue.

attributes.name: g
attributes.title: Green
attributes.description: Specifies the percentage of green.

attributes.name: r
attributes.title: Red
attributes.description: Specifies the percentage of red.

entries.name: shade
entries.title: Shade
entries.description: This element specifies a darker version of its input color. A 10% shade is 10% of the input color combined with 90% black.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the shade as expressed by a percentage value.

entries.name: srgbClr
entries.title: RGB Color Model - Hex Variant
entries.description: This element specifies a color using the red, green, blue RGB color model. Red, green, and blue is expressed as sequence of hex digits, RRGGBB. A perceptual gamma of 2.2 is used.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: The actual color value.

entries.name: sysClr
entries.title: System Color
entries.description: This element specifies a color bound to predefined operating system elements.

attributes.name: lastClr
attributes.title: Last Color
attributes.description: Specifies the color value that was last computed by the generating application.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the system color value.

entries.name: tint
entries.title: Tint
entries.description: This element specifies a lighter version of its input color. A 10% tint is 10% of the input color combined with 90% white.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the tint as expressed by a percentage value.

entries.name: audioCd
entries.title: Audio from CD
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of Audio from a CD. This element is specified within the non-visual properties of an object. The audio shall be attached to an object as this is how it is represented within the document.

entries.name: audioFile
entries.title: Audio from File
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of an audio file. This element is specified within the non-visual properties of an object. The audio shall be attached to an object as this is how it is represented within the document.

attributes.name: contentType
attributes.title: Content Type of Linked Audio File
attributes.description: Specifies the content type for the external file that is referenced by this element.

attributes.name: link
attributes.title: Linked Relationship ID
attributes.description: Specifies the identification information for a linked object.

entries.name: end
entries.title: Audio End Time
entries.description: This element specifies the end point for a CD Audio sound element. Encompassed within this element are the time and track at which the sound should halt its playback. This element is used in conjunction with an Audio Start Time element to specify the time span for an entire audioCD sound element.

attributes.name: time
attributes.title: Time
attributes.description: Specifies the time in seconds that the CD Audio should be stopped at.

attributes.name: track
attributes.title: Track
attributes.description: Specifies which track of the CD this Audio stops playing at.

entries.name: quickTimeFile
entries.title: QuickTime from File
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of a QuickTime file, as defined in the 2007-09-04 version of the QuickTime File Format Specification: http://developer.apple.com/documentation/QuickTime/QTFF/qtff.pdf. [Note: For more information on the QuickTime format: http://developer.apple.com/reference/QuickTime/. end note]. This element is specified within the non-visual properties of an object. The QuickTime file shall be attached to an object as this is how it is represented within the document.

attributes.name: link
attributes.title: Linked Relationship ID
attributes.description: Specifies the identification information for a linked object.

entries.name: st
entries.title: Audio Start Time
entries.description: This element specifies the start point for a CD Audio sound element. Encompassed within this element are the time and track at which the sound should begin its playback. This element is used in conjunction with an Audio End Time element to specify the time span for an entire audioCD sound element.

attributes.name: time
attributes.title: Time
attributes.description: Specifies the time in seconds that the CD Audio should be started at.

attributes.name: track
attributes.title: Track
attributes.description: Specifies which track of the CD this Audio begins playing on.

entries.name: videoFile
entries.title: Video from File
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of a video file. This element is specified within the non-visual properties of an object. The video shall be attached to an object as this is how it is represented within the document.

attributes.name: contentType
attributes.title: Content Type of Linked Video File
attributes.description: Specifies the content type for the external file that is referenced by this element.

entries.name: wavAudioFile
entries.title: Audio from WAV File
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of an audio WAV file. This element is specified within the non-visual properties of an object. The audio shall be attached to an object as this is how it is represented within the document.

attributes.name: embed
attributes.title: Embedded Audio File Relationship ID
attributes.description: Specifies the identification information for an embedded audio file.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Sound Name
attributes.description: Specifies the original name or given short name for the corresponding sound.

entries.name: accent1
entries.title: Accent 1
entries.description: This element defines a color that happens to be the accent 1 color. The set of twelve colors come together to form the color scheme for a theme.

entries.name: accent2
entries.title: Accent 2
entries.description: This element defines a color that happens to be the accent 2 color. The set of twelve colors come together to form the color scheme for a theme.

entries.name: accent3
entries.title: Accent 3
entries.description: This element defines a color that happens to be the accent 3 color. The set of twelve colors come together to form the color scheme for a theme.

entries.name: accent4
entries.title: Accent 4
entries.description: This element defines a color that happens to be the accent 4 color. The set of twelve colors come together to form the color scheme for a theme.

entries.name: accent5
entries.title: Accent 5
entries.description: This element defines a color that happens to be the accent 5 color. The set of twelve colors come together to form the color scheme for a theme.

entries.name: accent6
entries.title: Accent 6
entries.description: This element defines a color that happens to be the accent 1 color. The set of twelve colors come together to form the color scheme for a theme.

entries.name: bgFillStyleLst
entries.title: Background Fill Style List
entries.description: This element defines a list of background fills that are used within a theme. The background fills consist of three fills, arranged in order from subtle to moderate to intense.

entries.name: custClr
entries.title: Custom color
entries.description: This element defines a custom color. The custom colors are used within a custom color list to define custom colors that are extra colors that can be appended to a theme. This is useful within corporate scenarios where there is a set corporate color palette from which to work.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Name
attributes.description: The name of the color shown in the color picker.

entries.name: dk1
entries.title: Dark 1
entries.description: This element defines a color that happens to be the dark 1 color. The set of twelve colors come together to form the color scheme for a theme.

entries.name: dk2
entries.title: Dark 2
entries.description: This element defines a color that happens to be the dark 2 color. The set of twelve colors come together to form the color scheme for a theme.

entries.name: effectStyle
entries.title: Effect Style
entries.description: This element defines a set of effects and 3D properties that can be applied to an object.

entries.name: effectStyleLst
entries.title: Effect Style List
entries.description: This element defines a set of three effect styles that create the effect style list for a theme. The effect styles are arranged in order of subtle to moderate to intense.

entries.name: fillStyleLst
entries.title: Fill Style List
entries.description: This element defines a set of three fill styles that are used within a theme. The three fill styles are arranged in order from subtle to moderate to intense.

entries.name: fmtScheme
entries.title: Format Scheme
entries.description: This element contains the background fill styles, effect styles, fill styles, and line styles which define the style matrix for a theme. The style matrix consists of subtle, moderate, and intense fills, lines, and effects. The background fills are not generally thought of to directly be associated with the matrix, but do play a role in the style of the overall document.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Name
attributes.description: Defines the name for the format scheme.

entries.name: folHlink
entries.title: Followed Hyperlink
entries.description: This element defines a color that happens to be the followed hyperlink color. The set of twelve colors come together to form the color scheme for a theme.

entries.name: font
entries.title: Font
entries.description: This element defines a font within the styles area of DrawingML. A font is defined by a script along with a typeface.

attributes.name: script
attributes.title: Script
attributes.description: Specifies the script, or language, in which the typeface is supposed to be used.

attributes.name: typeface
attributes.title: Typeface
attributes.description: Specifies the font face to use.

entries.name: fontRef
entries.title: Font Reference
entries.description: This element represents a reference to a themed font. When used it specifies which themed font to use along with a choice of color.

attributes.name: idx
attributes.title: Identifier
attributes.description: Specifies the identifier of the font to reference.

entries.name: fontScheme
entries.title: Font Scheme
entries.description: This element defines the font scheme within the theme. The font scheme consists of a pair of major and minor fonts for which to use in a document. The major font corresponds well with the heading areas of a document, and the minor font corresponds well with the normal text or paragraph areas.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Name
attributes.description: The name of the font scheme shown in the user interface.

entries.name: hlink
entries.title: Hyperlink
entries.description: This element defines a color that happens to be the hyperlink color. The set of twelve colors come together to form the color scheme for a theme.

entries.name: lnDef
entries.title: Line Default
entries.description: This element defines a default line that is used within a document.

entries.name: lnStyleLst
entries.title: Line Style List
entries.description: This element defines a list of three line styles for use within a theme. The three line styles are arranged in order from subtle to moderate to intense versions of lines. This list makes up part of the style matrix.

entries.name: lt1
entries.title: Light 1
entries.description: This element defines a color that happens to be the accent 1 color. The set of twelve colors come together to form the color scheme for a theme.

entries.name: lt2
entries.title: Light 2
entries.description: This element defines a color that happens to be the accent 1 color. The set of twelve colors come together to form the color scheme for a theme.

entries.name: majorFont
entries.title: Major Font
entries.description: This element defines the set of major fonts which are to be used under different languages or locals.

entries.name: minorFont
entries.title: Minor fonts
entries.description: This element defines the set of minor fonts that are to be used under different languages or locals.

entries.name: scene3d
entries.title: 3D Scene Properties
entries.description: This element defines optional scene-level 3D properties to apply to an object.

entries.name: spDef
entries.title: Shape Default
entries.description: This element defines the formatting that is associated with the default shape. The default formatting can be applied to a shape when it is initially inserted into a document.

entries.name: txDef
entries.title: Text Default
entries.description: This element defines the default formatting which is applied to text in a document by default. The default formatting can and should be applied to the shape when it is initially inserted into a document.

entries.name: band1H
entries.title: Band 1 Horizontal
entries.description: This element describes the formatting for the first row in horizontal banding. Two different row formatting are applied to the table alternating in order to create a banding effect on the table.

entries.name: band1V
entries.title: Band 1 Vertical
entries.description: This element describes the formatting for the first row in vertical banding. Two different column formattings are applied to the table alternating in order to create a banding effect on the table.

entries.name: band2H
entries.title: Band 2 Horizontal
entries.description: This element describes the formatting for the second row in horizontal banding. Two different row formatting are applied to the table alternating in order to create a banding effect on the table.

entries.name: band2V
entries.title: Band 2 Vertical
entries.description: This element describes the formatting for the second row in vertical banding. Two different row formatting are applied to the table alternating in order to create a banding effect on the table.

entries.name: bevel
entries.title: Bevel
entries.description: This element defines the properties of the bevel associated with the 3D effect applied to a cell in a table.

attributes.name: h
attributes.title: Height
attributes.description: Specifies the height of the bevel, or how far above the shape it is applied.

attributes.name: prst
attributes.title: Preset Bevel
attributes.description: Specifies the preset bevel type which defines the look of the bevel.

attributes.name: w
attributes.title: Width
attributes.description: Specifies the width of the bevel, or how far into the shape it is applied.

entries.name: bottom
entries.title: Bottom Border
entries.description: This element defines the line properties associated with the bottom border in a table cell.

entries.name: effect
entries.title: Effect
entries.description: This element defines the effect that can be applied to a table as a whole through a table style.

entries.name: effectRef
entries.title: Effect Reference
entries.description: This element defines a reference to an effect style within the style matrix. The idx attribute refers the index of an effect style within the effectStyleLst element.

attributes.name: idx
attributes.title: Style Matrix Index
attributes.description: Specifies the style matrix index of the style referred to.

entries.name: fill
entries.title: Fill
entries.description: This element defines the fill that is applied to the table as a whole. The background of the table can contain a single fill that is the entire size of the table. This can allow for gradient fills, or image fills, which span the entire size of the table.

entries.name: fillRef
entries.title: Fill Reference
entries.description: This element defines a reference to a fill style within the style matrix. The idx attribute refers to the index of a fill style or background fill style within the presentation's style matrix, defined by the fmtScheme element. A value of 0 or 1000 indicates no background, values 1-999 refer to the index of a fill style within the fillStyleLst element, and values 1001 and above refer to the index of a background fill style within the bgFillStyleLst element.

attributes.name: idx
attributes.title: Style Matrix Index
attributes.description: Specifies the style matrix index of the style referred to.

entries.name: firstCol
entries.title: First Column
entries.description: This element defines the cell formatting which can be applied to the first column of the table.

entries.name: firstRow
entries.title: First Row
entries.description: This element defines the cell formatting which can be applied to the first row of the table.

entries.name: font
entries.title: Font
entries.description: This element defines the font to be used within a given table cell text style. This element allows for exact definition of the font within the table style instead of referencing a themed font.

entries.name: insideH
entries.title: Inside Horizontal Border
entries.description: This element defines the line properties associated with the inner horizontal borders in a table.

entries.name: insideV
entries.title: Inside Vertical Border
entries.description: This element defines the line properties associated with the inner vertical borders in a table.

entries.name: lastCol
entries.title: Last Column
entries.description: This element defines the cell formatting which can be applied to the last column of the table.

entries.name: lastRow
entries.title: Last Row
entries.description: This element defines the cell formatting which can be applied to the last row of the table.

entries.name: left
entries.title: Left Border
entries.description: This element defines the line properties associated with the left border in a table cell.

entries.name: lnRef
entries.title: Line Reference
entries.description: This element defines a reference to a line style within the style matrix. The idx attribute refers the index of a line style within the fillStyleLst element.

attributes.name: idx
attributes.title: Style Matrix Index
attributes.description: Specifies the style matrix index of the style referred to.

entries.name: neCell
entries.title: Northeast Cell
entries.description: This element defies the formatting for the cell in the northeast corner of a table when both the first row formatting and last column formatting are enabled. This formatting is only applied to the single cell which overlaps between the two formatting options.

entries.name: nwCell
entries.title: Northwest Cell
entries.description: This element defies the formatting for the cell in the northwest corner of a table when both the first row formatting and first column formatting are enabled. This formatting is only applied to the single cell which overlaps between the two formatting options.

entries.name: right
entries.title: Right Border
entries.description: This element defines the line properties associated with the right border in a table cell.

entries.name: seCell
entries.title: Southeast Cell
entries.description: This element defies the formatting for the cell in the southeast corner of a table when both the last row formatting and last column formatting are enabled. This formatting is only applied to the single cell which overlaps between the two formatting options.

entries.name: swCell
entries.title: Southwest Cell
entries.description: This element defies the formatting for the cell in the southwest corner of a table when both the last row formatting and first column formatting are enabled. This formatting is only applied to the single cell which overlaps between the two formatting options.

entries.name: tblBg
entries.title: Table Background
entries.description: This element defines the formatting options which can be applied to the table background shape. The background shape is the same size as the entire table and can hold a fill or an effect which spans the entire table.

entries.name: tblStyle
entries.title: Table Style
entries.description: This is the root element for a table style. Within the table style are different formatting options available in order to apply a table.

attributes.name: styleId
attributes.title: Style ID
attributes.description: Specifies a GUID identifying the table style in a unique manner.

attributes.name: styleName
attributes.title: Name
attributes.description: Specifies the name of the table style which can show up in the user interface identifying the style to a user.

entries.name: tblStyleLst
entries.title: Table Style List
entries.description: This element is simply a list of table styles which are used within a document.

attributes.name: def
attributes.title: Default
attributes.description: The GUID corresponding to the default table style in the list of table styles.

entries.name: tcBdr
entries.title: Table Cell Borders
entries.description: This element defines the borders for the cells within a table.

entries.name: tcStyle
entries.title: Table Cell Style
entries.description: This element defines the style for a give cell in a table.

entries.name: tcTxStyle
entries.title: Table Cell Text Style
entries.description: This element defines the text properties associated with the text contained within a table cell.

attributes.name: b
attributes.title: Bold
attributes.description: Specifies if the text is to be bolded.

attributes.name: i
attributes.title: Italic
attributes.description: Specifies if the text is to be italicized.

entries.name: tl2br
entries.title: Top Left to Bottom Right Border
entries.description: This element defines the line properties associated with the border which goes from the top-left to the bottom- right corner in a table cell.

entries.name: top
entries.title: Top Border
entries.description: This element defines the line properties associated with the top border in a table cell.

entries.name: tr2bl
entries.title: Top Right to Bottom Left Border
entries.description: This element defines the line properties associated with the border which goes from the top-right to the bottom-left corner in a table cell.

entries.name: wholeTbl
entries.title: Whole Table
entries.description: This element contains formatting options which are applied to the table as a whole when it is in its default state with no formatting options (first row, last row, etc) enabled.

entries.name: anchor
entries.title: Anchor Point
entries.description: This element specifies a point in 3D space. This point is the point in space that anchors the backdrop plane. Please see the example in the backdrop (§20.1.5.2) definition for an in depth explanation of this element.

attributes.name: x
attributes.title: X-Coordinate in X-Coordinate in 3D space. Attributes Description 3D
attributes.description: The possible values for this attribute are defined by the ST_Coordinate simple type (§20.1.10.16).

attributes.name: y
attributes.title: Y-Coordinate in 3D
attributes.description: Y-Coordinate in 3D space.

attributes.name: z
attributes.title: Z-Coordinate in 3D
attributes.description: Z-Coordinate in 3D space.

entries.name: backdrop
entries.title: Backdrop Plane
entries.description: This element defines a plane in which effects, such as glow and shadow, are applied in relation to the shape they are being applied to. The points and vectors contained within the backdrop define a plane in 3D space.

entries.name: bevelB
entries.title: Bottom Bevel
entries.description: This element holds the properties associated with defining a bevel on the bottom or back face of a shape.

attributes.name: h
attributes.title: Height
attributes.description: Specifies the height of the bevel, or how far above the shape it is applied.

attributes.name: prst
attributes.title: Preset Bevel
attributes.description: Specifies the preset bevel type which defines the look of the bevel.

attributes.name: w
attributes.title: Width
attributes.description: Specifies the width of the bevel, or how far into the shape it is applied.

entries.name: bevelT
entries.title: Top Bevel
entries.description: This element holds the properties associated with defining a bevel on the top or front face of a shape.

attributes.name: h
attributes.title: Height
attributes.description: Specifies the height of the bevel, or how far above the shape it is applied.

attributes.name: prst
attributes.title: Preset Bevel
attributes.description: Specifies the preset bevel type which defines the look of the bevel.

attributes.name: w
attributes.title: Width
attributes.description: Specifies the width of the bevel, or how far into the shape it is applied.

entries.name: camera
entries.title: Camera
entries.description: This element defines the placement and properties of the camera in the 3D scene. The camera position and properties modify the view of the scene.

attributes.name: fov
attributes.title: Field of View
attributes.description: Provides an override for the default field of view for the camera.

attributes.name: prst
attributes.title: Preset Camera Type
attributes.description: Defines the preset camera that is being used by the camera element.

attributes.name: zoom
attributes.title: Zoom
attributes.description: Defines the zoom factor of a given camera element.

entries.name: contourClr
entries.title: Contour Color
entries.description: This element defines the color for the contour on a shape. The contour of a shape is a solid filled line which surrounds the outer edges of the shape.

entries.name: extrusionClr
entries.title: Extrusion Color
entries.description: This element defines the color of the extrusion applied to a shape. The extrusion on a shape is an artificial height applied to the geometry.

entries.name: flatTx
entries.title: No text in 3D scene
entries.description: Keep text out of 3D scene entirely.

attributes.name: z
attributes.title: Z Coordinate
attributes.description: Specifies the Z coordinate to be used in positioning the flat text within the 3D scene.

entries.name: lightRig
entries.title: Light Rig
entries.description: This element defines the light rig associated with the table. The light rig comes into play when there is a 3D bevel applied to a cell. When 3D is used, the light rig defines the lighting properties associated with the scene.

attributes.name: dir
attributes.title: Direction
attributes.description: Defines the direction from which the light rig is oriented in relation to the scene.

attributes.name: rig
attributes.title: Rig Preset
attributes.description: Defines the preset type of light rig which is to be applied to the scene.

entries.name: norm
entries.title: Normal
entries.description: This element defines a normal vector. To be more precise, this attribute defines a vector normal to the face of the backdrop plane.

attributes.name: dx
attributes.title: Distance along X-axis in 3D
attributes.description: Distance along X-axis in 3D The possible values for this attribute are defined by the ST_Coordinate simple type (§20.1.10.16).

attributes.name: dy
attributes.title: Distance along Y-axis in 3D
attributes.description: Distance along Y-axis in 3D The possible values for this attribute are defined by the ST_Coordinate simple type (§20.1.10.16).

attributes.name: dz
attributes.title: Distance along Z-axis in 3D
attributes.description: Distance along Z-axis in 3D The possible values for this attribute are defined by the ST_Coordinate simple type (§20.1.10.16).

entries.name: rot
entries.title: Rotation
entries.description: This element defines a rotation in 3D space. A rotation in DrawingML is defined through the use of a latitude coordinate, a longitude coordinate, and a revolution about the axis as the latitude and longitude coordinates.

attributes.name: lat
attributes.title: Latitude
attributes.description: Defines the latitude value of the rotation.

attributes.name: lon
attributes.title: Longitude
attributes.description: Defines the longitude value of the rotation.

attributes.name: rev
attributes.title: Revolution
attributes.description: This attributes defines the revolution around the central axis in the rotation.

entries.name: sp3d
entries.title: Apply 3D shape properties
entries.description: This element defines the 3D properties associated with a particular shape in DrawingML. The 3D properties which can be applied to a shape are top and bottom bevels, a contour and an extrusion.

attributes.name: contourW
attributes.title: Contour Width
attributes.description: Defines the width of the contour on the shape.

attributes.name: extrusionH
attributes.title: Extrusion Height
attributes.description: Defines the height of the extrusion applied to the shape.

attributes.name: prstMaterial
attributes.title: Preset Material Type
attributes.description: Defines the preset material which is combined with the lighting properties to give the final look and feel of a shape.

attributes.name: z
attributes.title: Shape Depth
attributes.description: Defines the z coordinate for the 3D shape.

entries.name: up
entries.title: Up Vector
entries.description: This element defines a vector representing up. To be more precise, this attribute defines a vector representing up in relation to the face of the backdrop plane.

attributes.name: dx
attributes.title: Distance along X-axis in 3D
attributes.description: Distance along X-axis in 3D The possible values for this attribute are defined by the ST_Coordinate simple type (§20.1.10.16).

attributes.name: dy
attributes.title: Distance along Y-axis in 3D
attributes.description: Distance along Y-axis in 3D The possible values for this attribute are defined by the ST_Coordinate simple type (§20.1.10.16).

attributes.name: dz
attributes.title: Distance along Z-axis in 3D
attributes.description: Distance along Z-axis in 3D The possible values for this attribute are defined by the ST_Coordinate simple type (§20.1.10.16).

entries.name: clrMap
entries.title: Color Map
entries.description: This element specifics the color mapping layer which allows a user to define colors for background and text. This allows for swapping out of light/dark colors for backgrounds and the text on top of the background in order to maintain readability of the text On a deeper level, this specifies exactly which colors the first 12 values refer to in the color scheme.

attributes.name: accent1
attributes.title: Accent 1
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the accent 1 color.

attributes.name: accent2
attributes.title: Accent 2
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the accent 2 color.

attributes.name: accent3
attributes.title: Accent 3
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the accent 3 color.

attributes.name: accent4
attributes.title: Accent 4
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the accent 4 color.

attributes.name: accent5
attributes.title: Accent 5
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the accent 5 color.

attributes.name: accent6
attributes.title: Accent 6
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the accent 6 color.

attributes.name: bg1
attributes.title: Background 1
attributes.description: A color defined which is associated as the first background color.

attributes.name: bg2
attributes.title: Background 2
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the second background color.

attributes.name: folHlink
attributes.title: Followed Hyperlink
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the color for a followed hyperlink.

attributes.name: hlink
attributes.title: Hyperlink
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the color for a hyperlink.

attributes.name: tx1
attributes.title: Text 1
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the first text color.

attributes.name: tx2
attributes.title: Text 2
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the second text color.

entries.name: clrScheme
entries.title: Color Scheme
entries.description: This element defines a set of colors which are referred to as a color scheme. The color scheme is responsible for defining a list of twelve colors. The twelve colors consist of six accent colors, two dark colors, two light colors and a color for each of a hyperlink and followed hyperlink.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Name
attributes.description: The common name for this color scheme.

entries.name: custClrLst
entries.title: Custom Color List
entries.description: This element allows for a custom color palette to be created and which shows up alongside other color schemes. This can be very useful, for example, when someone would like to maintain a corporate color palette.

entries.name: extraClrScheme
entries.title: Extra Color Scheme
entries.description: This element defines an auxiliary color scheme, which includes both a color scheme and color mapping. This is mainly used for backward compatibility concerns and roundtrips information required by earlier versions.

entries.name: extraClrSchemeLst
entries.title: Extra Color Scheme List
entries.description: This element is a container for the list of extra color schemes present in a document.

entries.name: masterClrMapping
entries.title: Master Color Mapping
entries.description: This element is a part of a choice for which color mapping is used within the document. There is also defined an overrideClrMapping (§20.1.6.8) element which, when specified, the override is used rather than the color mapping defined in the master. If this element is specified, then we specifically use the color mapping defined in the master.

entries.name: objectDefaults
entries.title: Object Defaults
entries.description: This element allows for the definition of default shape, line, and textbox formatting properties. An application can use this information to format a shape (or text) initially on insertion into a document.

entries.name: overrideClrMapping
entries.title: Override Color Mapping
entries.description: This element provides an override for the color mapping in a document. When defined, this color mapping is used in place of the already defined color mapping, or master color mapping. This color mapping is defined in the same manner as the other mappings within this document.

attributes.name: accent1
attributes.title: Accent 1
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the accent 1 color.

attributes.name: accent2
attributes.title: Accent 2
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the accent 2 color.

attributes.name: accent3
attributes.title: Accent 3
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the accent 3 color.

attributes.name: accent4
attributes.title: Accent 4
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the accent 4 color.

attributes.name: accent5
attributes.title: Accent 5
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the accent 5 color.

attributes.name: accent6
attributes.title: Accent 6
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the accent 6 color.

attributes.name: bg1
attributes.title: Background 1
attributes.description: A color defined which is associated as the first background color.

attributes.name: bg2
attributes.title: Background 2
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the second background color.

attributes.name: folHlink
attributes.title: Followed Hyperlink
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the color for a followed hyperlink.

attributes.name: hlink
attributes.title: Hyperlink
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the color for a hyperlink.

attributes.name: tx1
attributes.title: Text 1
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the first text color.

attributes.name: tx2
attributes.title: Text 2
attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the second text color.

entries.name: theme
entries.title: Theme
entries.description: This element defines the root level complex type associated with a shared style sheet (or theme). This element holds all the different formatting options available to a document through a theme and defines the overall look and feel of the document when themed objects are used within the document.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Name
attributes.description: Specifies the name given to the theme.

entries.name: themeElements
entries.title: Theme Elements
entries.description: This element defines the theme formatting options for the theme and is the workhorse of the theme. This is where the bulk of the shared theme information is contained and used by a document. This element contains the color scheme, font scheme, and format scheme elements which define the different formatting aspects of what a theme defines.

entries.name: themeManager
entries.title: Theme Manager
entries.description: The starting part for a theme file.

entries.name: themeOverride
entries.title: Theme Override
entries.description: This element allows for an override which changes just the colors, fonts, or effects of a single object, like a table for example. Currently it is used only to control overrides on the non-top-level masters within a presentation.

entries.name: chExt
entries.title: Child Extents
entries.description: This element specifies the size dimensions of the child extents rectangle and is used for calculations of grouping, scaling, and rotation behavior of shapes placed within a group.

attributes.name: cx
attributes.title: Extent Length
attributes.description: Specifies the length of the extents rectangle in EMUs.

attributes.name: cy
attributes.title: Extent Width
attributes.description: Specifies the width of the extents rectangle in EMUs.

entries.name: chOff
entries.title: Child Offset
entries.description: This element specifies the location of the child extents rectangle and is used for calculations of grouping, scaling, and rotation behavior of shapes placed within a group.

attributes.name: y
attributes.title: Y-Axis Coordinate
attributes.description: Specifies a coordinate on the x-axis.

entries.name: ext
entries.title: Extents
entries.description: This element specifies the size of the bounding box enclosing the referenced object.

attributes.name: cx
attributes.title: Extent Length
attributes.description: Specifies the length of the extents rectangle in EMUs.

attributes.name: cy
attributes.title: Extent Width
attributes.description: Specifies the width of the extents rectangle in EMUs.

entries.name: off
entries.title: Offset
entries.description: This element specifies the location of the bounding box of an object. Effects on an object are not included in this bounding box.

attributes.name: x
attributes.title: X-Axis Coordinate
attributes.description: Specifies a coordinate on the x-axis.

attributes.name: y
attributes.title: Y-Axis Coordinate
attributes.description: Specifies a coordinate on the x-axis.

entries.name: xfrm
entries.title: 2D Transform for Grouped Objects
entries.description: This element is nearly identical to the representation of 2-D transforms for ordinary shapes (§20.1.7.6). The only addition is a member to represent the Child offset and the Child extents.

attributes.name: flipH
attributes.title: Horizontal Flip
attributes.description: Horizontal flip.

attributes.name: flipV
attributes.title: Vertical Flip
attributes.description: Vertical flip.

attributes.name: rot
attributes.title: Rotation
attributes.description: Rotation.

entries.name: xfrm
entries.title: 2D Transform for Individual Objects
entries.description: This element represents 2-D transforms for ordinary shapes.

attributes.name: flipH
attributes.title: Horizontal Flip
attributes.description: Specifies a horizontal flip.

attributes.name: flipV
attributes.title: Vertical Flip
attributes.description: Specifies a vertical flip.

attributes.name: rot
attributes.title: Rotation
attributes.description: Specifies the rotation of the Graphic Frame.

entries.name: alphaBiLevel
entries.title: Alpha Bi-Level Effect
entries.description: This element represents an Alpha Bi-Level Effect. Alpha (Opacity) values less than the threshold are changed to 0 (fully transparent) and alpha values greater than or equal to the threshold are changed to 100% (fully opaque).

attributes.name: thresh
attributes.title: Threshold
attributes.description: Specifies the threshold value for the alpha bi-level effect.

entries.name: alphaCeiling
entries.title: Alpha Ceiling Effect
entries.description: This element represents an alpha ceiling effect. Alpha (opacity) values greater than zero are changed to 100%. In other words, anything partially opaque becomes fully opaque.

entries.name: alphaFloor
entries.title: Alpha Floor Effect
entries.description: This element represents an alpha floor effect. Alpha (opacity) values less than 100% are changed to zero. In other words, anything partially transparent becomes fully transparent.

entries.name: alphaInv
entries.title: Alpha Inverse Effect
entries.description: This element represents an alpha inverse effect. Alpha (opacity) values are inverted by subtracting from 100%.

entries.name: alphaMod
entries.title: Alpha Modulate Effect
entries.description: This element represents an alpha modulate effect. Effect alpha (opacity) values are multiplied by a fixed percentage. The effect container specifies an effect containing alpha values to modulate.

entries.name: alphaModFix
entries.title: Alpha Modulate Fixed Effect
entries.description: This element represents an alpha modulate fixed effect. Effect alpha (opacity) values are multiplied by a fixed percentage.

attributes.name: amt
attributes.title: Amount
