attributes.description: Specifies the percentage amount to scale the alpha.

entries.name: alphaOutset
entries.title: Alpha Inset/Outset Effect
entries.description: This element specifies an alpha outset/inset effect. This is equivalent to an alpha ceiling, followed by alpha blur, followed by either an alpha ceiling (positive radius) or alpha floor (negative radius).

attributes.name: rad
attributes.title: Radius
attributes.description: Specifies the radius of outset/inset.

entries.name: alphaRepl
entries.title: Alpha Replace Effect
entries.description: This element specifies an alpha replace effect. Effect alpha (opacity) values are replaced by a fixed alpha.

attributes.name: a
attributes.title: Alpha
attributes.description: Specifies the new opacity value.

entries.name: bevel
entries.title: Line Join Bevel
entries.description: This element specifies a Bevel Line Join. A bevel joint specifies that an angle joint is used to connect lines.

entries.name: bgClr
entries.title: Background color
entries.description: This element specifies the background color of a Pattern fill.

entries.name: biLevel
entries.title: Bi-Level (Black/White) Effect
entries.description: This element specifies a bi-level (black/white) effect. Input colors whose luminance is less than the specified threshold value are changed to black. Input colors whose luminance are greater than or equal the specified value are set to white.

attributes.name: thresh
attributes.title: Threshold
attributes.description: Specifies the luminance threshold for the Bi-Level effect.

entries.name: blend
entries.title: Blend Effect
entries.description: This element specifies a blend of several effects. The container specifies the raw effects to blend while the blend mode specifies how the effects are to be blended.

attributes.name: blend
attributes.title: Blend Mode
attributes.description: Specifies how to blend the two effects.

entries.name: blip
entries.title: Blip
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of an image (binary large image or picture) and contains a reference to the image data.

attributes.name: cstate
attributes.title: Compression State
attributes.description: Specifies the compression state with which the picture is stored.

attributes.name: embed
attributes.title: Embedded Picture Reference
attributes.description: Specifies the identification information for an embedded picture.

entries.name: blipFill
entries.title: Picture Fill
entries.description: This element specifies the type of picture fill that the picture object has. Because a picture has a picture fill already by default, it is possible to have two fills specified for a picture object. An example of this is shown below.

attributes.name: dpi
attributes.title: DPI Setting
attributes.description: Specifies the DPI (dots per inch) used to calculate the size of the blip.

attributes.name: rotWithShape
attributes.title: Rotate With Shape
attributes.description: Specifies that the fill should rotate with the shape.

entries.name: blur
entries.title: Blur Effect
entries.description: This element specifies a blur effect that is applied to the entire shape, including its fill. All color channels, including alpha, are affected.

attributes.name: grow
attributes.title: Grow Bounds
attributes.description: Specifies whether the bounds of the object should be grown as a result of the blurring.

attributes.name: rad
attributes.title: Radius
attributes.description: Specifies the radius of blur.

entries.name: clrChange
entries.title: Color Change Effect
entries.description: This element specifies a Color Change Effect. Instances of clrFrom are replaced with instances of clrTo.

attributes.name: useA
attributes.title: Consider Alpha Values
attributes.description: Specifies whether alpha values are considered for the effect.

entries.name: clrFrom
entries.title: Change Color From
entries.description: This element specifies a color getting removed in a color change effect. It is the "from" or source input color.

entries.name: clrRepl
entries.title: Solid Color Replacement
entries.description: This element specifies a solid color replacement value. All effect colors are changed to a fixed color. Alpha values are unaffected.

entries.name: clrTo
entries.title: Change Color To
entries.description: This element specifies the color which replaces the clrFrom in a clrChange effect. This is the "target" or "to" color in the color change effect.

entries.name: cont
entries.title: Effect Container
entries.description: This element specifies an Effect Container. It is a list of effects.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Name
attributes.description: Specifies an optional name for this list of effects, so that it can be referred to later.

attributes.name: type
attributes.title: Effect Container Type
attributes.description: Specifies the kind of container, either sibling or tree.

entries.name: custDash
entries.title: Custom Dash
entries.description: This element specifies a custom dashing scheme. It is a list of dash stop elements which represent building block atoms upon which the custom dashing scheme is built.

entries.name: ds
entries.title: Dash Stop
entries.description: This element specifies a dash stop primitive. Dashing schemes are built by specifying an ordered list of dash stop primitive. A dash stop primitive consists of a dash and a space.

attributes.name: d
attributes.title: Dash Length
attributes.description: Specifies the length of the dash relative to the line width.

attributes.name: sp
attributes.title: Space Length
attributes.description: Specifies the length of the space relative to the line width.

entries.name: duotone
entries.title: Duotone Effect
entries.description: This element specifies a duotone effect. For each pixel, combines clr1 and clr2 through a linear interpolation to determine the new color for that pixel.

entries.name: effect
entries.title: Effect
entries.description: This element specifies a reference to an existing effect container.

attributes.name: ref
attributes.title: Reference
attributes.description: Specifies the reference.

entries.name: effectDag
entries.title: Effect Container
entries.description: This element specifies a list of effects. Effects are applied in the order specified by the container type (sibling or tree).

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Name
attributes.description: Specifies an optional name for this list of effects, so that it can be referred to later.

attributes.name: type
attributes.title: Effect Container Type
attributes.description: Specifies the kind of container, either sibling or tree.

entries.name: effectLst
entries.title: Effect Container
entries.description: This element specifies a list of effects. Effects in an effectLst are applied in the default order by the rendering engine. The following diagrams illustrate the order in which effects are applied, both for shapes and for group shapes.

entries.name: fgClr
entries.title: Foreground color
entries.description: This element specifies the foreground color of a pattern fill. Reflection Outer Shadow Glow Blur Soft Edges Group Shape Container Container effectLst Processing for Group Shapes Final Output

entries.name: fill
entries.title: Fill
entries.description: This element specifies a fill which is one of blipFill, gradFill, grpFill, noFill, pattFill or solidFill.

entries.name: fillOverlay
entries.title: Fill Overlay Effect
entries.description: This element specifies a fill overlay effect. A fill overlay can be used to specify an additional fill for an object and blend the two fills together.

attributes.name: blend
attributes.title: Blend
attributes.description: Specifies how to blend the fill with the base effect.

entries.name: fillRect
entries.title: Fill Rectangle
entries.description: This element specifies a fill rectangle. When stretching of an image is specified, a source rectangle, srcRect, is scaled to fit the specified fill rectangle. Each edge of the fill rectangle is defined by a percentage offset from the corresponding edge of the shape's bounding box.

attributes.name: b
attributes.title: Bottom Offset
attributes.description: Specifies the bottom edge of the rectangle.

attributes.name: l
attributes.title: Left Offset
attributes.description: Specifies the left edge of the rectangle.

attributes.name: r
attributes.title: Right Offset
attributes.description: Specifies the right edge of the rectangle.

attributes.name: t
attributes.title: Top Offset
attributes.description: Specifies the top edge of the rectangle.

entries.name: fillToRect
entries.title: Fill To Rectangle
entries.description: This element defines the "focus" rectangle for the center shade, specified relative to the fill tile rectangle. The center shade fills the entire tile except the margins specified by each attribute. Each edge of the center shade rectangle is defined by a percentage offset from the corresponding edge of the tile rectangle.

attributes.name: b
attributes.title: Bottom Offset
attributes.description: Specifies the bottom edge of the rectangle.

attributes.name: l
attributes.title: Left Offset
attributes.description: Specifies the left edge of the rectangle.

attributes.name: r
attributes.title: Right Offset
attributes.description: Specifies the right edge of the rectangle.

attributes.name: t
attributes.title: Top Offset
attributes.description: Specifies the top edge of the rectangle.

entries.name: glow
entries.title: Glow Effect
entries.description: This element specifies a glow effect, in which a color blurred outline is added outside the edges of the object.

attributes.name: rad
attributes.title: Radius
attributes.description: Specifies the radius of the glow.

entries.name: gradFill
entries.title: Gradient Fill
entries.description: This element defines a gradient fill. A gradient fill is a fill which is characterized by a smooth gradual transition from one color to the next. At its simplest, it is a fill which transitions between two colors; or more generally, it can be a transition of any number of colors.

attributes.name: flip
attributes.title: Tile Flip
attributes.description: Specifies the direction(s) in which to flip the gradient while tiling.

attributes.name: rotWithShape
attributes.title: Rotate With Shape
attributes.description: Specifies if a fill rotates along with a shape when the shape is rotated.

entries.name: grayscl
entries.title: Gray Scale Effect
entries.description: This element specifies a gray scale effect. Converts all effect color values to a shade of gray, corresponding to their luminance. Effect alpha (opacity) values are unaffected.

entries.name: grpFill
entries.title: Group Fill
entries.description: This element specifies a group fill. When specified, this setting indicates that the parent element is part of a group and should inherit the fill properties of the group.

entries.name: gs
entries.title: Gradient stops
entries.description: This element defines a gradient stop. A gradient stop consists of a position where the stop appears in the color band.

attributes.name: pos
attributes.title: Position
attributes.description: Specifies where this gradient stop should appear in the color band.

entries.name: gsLst
entries.title: Gradient Stop List
entries.description: The list of gradient stops that specifies the gradient colors and their relative positions in the color band.

entries.name: headEnd
entries.title: Line Head/End Style
entries.description: This element specifies decorations which can be added to the head of a line.

attributes.name: len
attributes.title: Length of Head/End
attributes.description: Specifies the line end length in relation to the line width.

attributes.name: type
attributes.title: Line Head/End Type
attributes.description: Specifies the line end decoration, such as a triangle or arrowhead.

attributes.name: w
attributes.title: Width of Head/End
attributes.description: Specifies the line end width in relation to the line width.

entries.name: hsl
entries.title: Hue Saturation Luminance Effect
entries.description: This element specifies a hue/saturation/luminance effect. The hue, saturation, and luminance can each be adjusted relative to its current value.

attributes.name: hue
attributes.title: Hue
attributes.description: Specifies the number of degrees by which the hue is adjusted.

attributes.name: lum
attributes.title: Luminance
attributes.description: Specifies the percentage by which the luminance is adjusted.

attributes.name: sat
attributes.title: Saturation
attributes.description: Specifies the percentage by which the saturation is adjusted.

entries.name: innerShdw
entries.title: Inner Shadow Effect
entries.description: This element specifies an inner shadow effect. A shadow is applied within the edges of the object according to the parameters given by the attributes.

attributes.name: blurRad
attributes.title: Blur Radius
attributes.description: Specifies the blur radius.

attributes.name: dir
attributes.title: Direction
attributes.description: Specifies the direction to offset the shadow.

attributes.name: dist
attributes.title: Distance
attributes.description: Specifies how far to offset the shadow.

entries.name: lin
entries.title: Linear Gradient Fill
entries.description: This element specifies a linear gradient.

attributes.name: ang
attributes.title: Angle
attributes.description: Specifies the direction of color change for the gradient.

attributes.name: scaled
attributes.title: Scaled
attributes.description: Whether the gradient angle scales with the fill region.

entries.name: lum
entries.title: Luminance Effect
entries.description: This element specifies a luminance effect. Brightness linearly shifts all colors closer to white or black. Contrast scales all colors to be either closer or further apart.

attributes.name: bright
attributes.title: Brightness
attributes.description: Specifies the percent to change the brightness.

attributes.name: contrast
attributes.title: Contrast
attributes.description: Specifies the percent to change the contrast.

entries.name: miter
entries.title: Miter Line Join
entries.description: This element specifies that a line join shall be mitered.

entries.name: noFill
entries.title: No Fill
entries.description: This element specifies that no fill is applied to the parent element.

entries.name: outerShdw
entries.title: Outer Shadow Effect
entries.description: This element specifies an Outer Shadow Effect.

attributes.name: algn
attributes.title: Shadow Alignment
attributes.description: Specifies shadow alignment; alignment happens first, effectively setting the origin for scale, skew, and offset.

attributes.name: blurRad
attributes.title: Blur Radius
attributes.description: Specifies the blur radius of the shadow.

attributes.name: dir
attributes.title: Shadow Direction
attributes.description: Specifies the direction to offset the shadow.

attributes.name: dist
attributes.title: Shadow Offset Distance
attributes.description: Specifies the how far to offset the shadow.

attributes.name: kx
attributes.title: Horizontal Skew
attributes.description: Specifies the horizontal skew angle.

attributes.name: ky
attributes.title: Vertical Skew
attributes.description: Specifies the vertical skew angle.

attributes.name: rotWithShape
attributes.title: Rotate With Shape
attributes.description: Specifies whether the shadow rotates with the shape if the shape is rotated.

attributes.name: sx
attributes.title: Horizontal Scaling Factor
attributes.description: Specifies the horizontal scaling factor; negative scaling causes a flip.

attributes.name: sy
attributes.title: Vertical Scaling Factor
attributes.description: Specifies the vertical scaling factor; negative scaling causes a flip.

entries.name: path
entries.title: Path Gradient
entries.description: This element defines that a gradient fill follows a path vs. a linear line.

attributes.name: path
attributes.title: Gradient Fill Path
attributes.description: Specifies the shape of the path to follow.

entries.name: pattFill
entries.title: Pattern Fill
entries.description: This element specifies a pattern fill. A repeated pattern is used to fill the object.

attributes.name: prst
attributes.title: Preset Pattern
attributes.description: Specifies one of a set of preset patterns to fill the object.

entries.name: prstDash
entries.title: Preset Dash
entries.description: This element specifies that a preset line dashing scheme should be used.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies which preset dashing scheme is to be used.

entries.name: prstShdw
entries.title: Preset Shadow
entries.description: This element specifies that a preset shadow is to be used. Each preset shadow is equivalent to a specific outer shadow effect. For each preset shadow, the color element, direction attribute, and distance attribute represent the color, direction, and distance parameters of the corresponding outer shadow.

attributes.name: dir
attributes.title: Direction
attributes.description: Specifies the direction to offset the shadow.

attributes.name: dist
attributes.title: Distance
attributes.description: Specifies how far to offset the shadow.

attributes.name: prst
attributes.title: Preset Shadow
attributes.description: Specifies which preset shadow to use.

entries.name: reflection
entries.title: Reflection Effect
entries.description: This element specifies a reflection effect.

attributes.name: algn
attributes.title: Shadow Alignment
attributes.description: Specifies shadow alignment.

attributes.name: blurRad
attributes.title: Blur Radius
attributes.description: Specifies the blur radius.

attributes.name: dir
attributes.title: Direction
attributes.description: Specifies the direction of the alpha gradient ramp relative to the shape itself.

attributes.name: dist
attributes.title: Distance
attributes.description: Specifies how far to distance the shadow.

attributes.name: endA
attributes.title: End Alpha
attributes.description: Specifies the ending reflection opacity.

attributes.name: endPos
attributes.title: End Position
attributes.description: Specifies the end position (along the alpha gradient ramp) of the end alpha value.

attributes.name: fadeDir
attributes.title: Fade Direction
attributes.description: Specifies the direction to offset the reflection.

attributes.name: kx
attributes.title: Horizontal Skew
attributes.description: Specifies the horizontal skew angle.

attributes.name: ky
attributes.title: Vertical Skew
attributes.description: Specifies the vertical skew angle.

attributes.name: rotWithShape
attributes.title: Rotate With Shape
attributes.description: Specifies if the reflection rotates with the shape.

attributes.name: stPos
attributes.title: Start Position
attributes.description: Specifies the start position (along the alpha gradient ramp) of the start alpha value.

attributes.name: sx
attributes.title: Horizontal Ratio
attributes.description: Specifies the horizontal scaling factor.

attributes.name: sy
attributes.title: Vertical Ratio
attributes.description: Specifies the vertical scaling factor.

entries.name: relOff
entries.title: Relative Offset Effect
entries.description: This element specifies a relative offset effect. Sets up a new origin by offsetting relative to the size of the previous effect.

attributes.name: tx
attributes.title: Offset X
attributes.description: Specifies the X offset.

attributes.name: ty
attributes.title: Offset Y
attributes.description: Specifies the Y offset.

entries.name: round
entries.title: Round Line Join
entries.description: This element specifies that lines joined together have a round join.

entries.name: softEdge
entries.title: Soft Edge Effect
entries.description: This element specifies a soft edge effect. The edges of the shape are blurred, while the fill is not affected.

attributes.name: rad
attributes.title: Radius
attributes.description: Specifies the radius of blur to apply to the edges.

entries.name: solidFill
entries.title: Solid Fill
entries.description: This element specifies a solid color fill. The shape is filled entirely with the specified color.

entries.name: srcRect
entries.title: Source Rectangle
entries.description: This element specifies the portion of the blip used for the fill. Each edge of the source rectangle is defined by a percentage offset from the corresponding edge of the bounding box. A positive percentage specifies an inset, while a negative percentage specifies an outset. [Note: For example, a left offset of 25% specifies that the left edge of the source rectangle is located to the right of the bounding box's left edge by an amount equal to 25% of the bounding box's width. end note]

attributes.name: b
attributes.title: Bottom Offset
attributes.description: Specifies the bottom edge of the rectangle.

attributes.name: l
attributes.title: Left Offset
attributes.description: Specifies the left edge of the rectangle.

attributes.name: r
attributes.title: Right Offset
attributes.description: Specifies the right edge of the rectangle.

attributes.name: t
attributes.title: Top Offset
attributes.description: Specifies the top edge of the rectangle.

entries.name: stretch
entries.title: Stretch
entries.description: This element specifies that a BLIP should be stretched to fill the target rectangle. The other option is a tile where a BLIP is tiled to fill the available area.

entries.name: tailEnd
entries.title: Tail line end style
entries.description: This element specifies decorations which can be added to the tail of a line.

attributes.name: len
attributes.title: Length of Head/End
attributes.description: Specifies the line end length in relation to the line width.

attributes.name: type
attributes.title: Line Head/End Type
attributes.description: Specifies the line end decoration, such as a triangle or arrowhead.

attributes.name: w
attributes.title: Width of Head/End
attributes.description: Specifies the line end width in relation to the line width.

entries.name: tile
entries.title: Tile
entries.description: This element specifies that a BLIP should be tiled to fill the available space. This element defines a "tile" rectangle within the bounding box. The image is encompassed within the tile rectangle, and the tile rectangle is tiled across the bounding box to fill the entire area.

attributes.name: algn
attributes.title: Alignment
attributes.description: Specifies where to align the first tile with respect to the shape.

attributes.name: flip
attributes.title: Tile Flipping
attributes.description: Specifies the direction(s) in which to flip the source image while tiling.

attributes.name: sx
attributes.title: Horizontal Ratio
attributes.description: Specifies the amount to horizontally scale the srcRect.

attributes.name: sy
attributes.title: Vertical Ratio
attributes.description: Specifies the amount to vertically scale the srcRect.

attributes.name: tx
attributes.title: Horizontal Offset
attributes.description: Specifies additional horizontal offset after alignment.

attributes.name: ty
attributes.title: Vertical Offset
attributes.description: Specifies additional vertical offset after alignment.

entries.name: tileRect
entries.title: Tile Rectangle
entries.description: This element specifies a rectangular region of the shape to which the gradient is applied. This region is then tiled across the remaining area of the shape to complete the fill. The tile rectangle is defined by percentage offsets from the sides of the shape's bounding box.

attributes.name: b
attributes.title: Bottom Offset
attributes.description: Specifies the bottom edge of the rectangle.

attributes.name: l
attributes.title: Left Offset
attributes.description: Specifies the left edge of the rectangle.

attributes.name: r
attributes.title: Right Offset
attributes.description: Specifies the right edge of the rectangle.

attributes.name: t
attributes.title: Top Offset
attributes.description: Specifies the top edge of the rectangle.

entries.name: tint
entries.title: Tint Effect
entries.description: This element specifies a tint effect. Shifts effect color values towards/away from hue by the specified amount.

attributes.name: amt
attributes.title: Amount
attributes.description: Specifies by how much the color value is shifted.

attributes.name: hue
attributes.title: Hue
attributes.description: Specifies the hue towards which to tint.

entries.name: xfrm
entries.title: Transform Effect
entries.description: This element specifies a transform effect. The transform is applied to each point in the shape's geometry using the following matrix: [ sx tan(kx) tx tan(ky) sy ty 0 0 1 ] ∙ [ x y ]

attributes.name: kx
attributes.title: Horizontal Skew
attributes.description: Specifies the horizontal skew angle, defined as the angle between the top-left corner and bottom-left corner of the object's original bounding box.

attributes.name: ky
attributes.title: Vertical Skew
attributes.description: Specifies the vertical skew angle, defined as the angle between the top-left corner and top-right corner of the object's original bounding box.

attributes.name: sx
attributes.title: Horizontal Ratio
attributes.description: Specifies a percentage by which to horizontally scale the object.

attributes.name: sy
attributes.title: Vertical Ratio
attributes.description: Specifies a percentage by which to vertically scale the object.

attributes.name: tx
attributes.title: Horizontal Shift
attributes.description: Specifies an amount by which to shift the object along the x-axis.

attributes.name: ty
attributes.title: Vertical Shift
attributes.description: Specifies an amount by which to shift the object along the y-axis.

entries.name: ahLst
entries.title: List of Shape Adjust Handles
entries.description: This element specifies the adjust handles that are applied to a custom geometry. These adjust handles specify points within the geometric shape that can be used to perform certain transform operations on the shape.

entries.name: ahPolar
entries.title: Polar Adjust Handle
entries.description: This element specifies a polar adjust handle for a custom shape. The position of this adjust handle is specified by the corresponding pos child element. The allowed adjustment of this adjust handle are specified via it's min and max attributes.

attributes.name: gdRefAng
attributes.title: Angle Adjustment Guide
attributes.description: Specifies the name of the guide that is updated with the adjustment angle from this adjust handle.

attributes.name: gdRefR
attributes.title: Radial Adjustment Guide
attributes.description: Specifies the name of the guide that is updated with the adjustment radius from this adjust handle.

attributes.name: maxAng
attributes.title: Maximum Angle Adjustment
attributes.description: Specifies the maximum angle position that is allowed for this adjustment handle.

attributes.name: maxR
attributes.title: Maximum Radial Adjustment
attributes.description: Specifies the maximum radial position that is allowed for this adjustment handle.

attributes.name: minAng
attributes.title: Minimum Angle Adjustment
attributes.description: Specifies the minimum angle position that is allowed for this adjustment handle.

attributes.name: minR
attributes.title: Minimum Radial Adjustment
attributes.description: Specifies the minimum radial position that is allowed for this adjustment handle.

entries.name: ahXY
entries.title: XY Adjust Handle
entries.description: This element specifies an XY-based adjust handle for a custom shape. The position of this adjust handle is specified by the corresponding pos child element. The allowed adjustment of this adjust handle are specified via it's min and max type attributes.

attributes.name: gdRefX
attributes.title: Horizontal Adjustment Guide
attributes.description: Specifies the name of the guide that is updated with the adjustment x position from this adjust handle.

attributes.name: gdRefY
attributes.title: Vertical Adjustment Guide
attributes.description: Specifies the name of the guide that is updated with the adjustment y position from this adjust handle.

attributes.name: maxX
attributes.title: Maximum Horizontal Adjustment
attributes.description: Specifies the maximum horizontal position that is allowed for this adjustment handle.

attributes.name: maxY
attributes.title: Maximum Vertical Adjustment
attributes.description: Specifies the maximum vertical position that is allowed for this adjustment handle.

attributes.name: minX
attributes.title: Minimum Horizontal Adjustment
attributes.description: Specifies the minimum horizontal position that is allowed for this adjustment handle.

attributes.name: minY
attributes.title: Minimum Vertical Adjustment
attributes.description: Specifies the minimum vertical position that is allowed for this adjustment handle.

entries.name: arcTo
entries.title: Draw Arc To
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of an arc within a shape path. It draws an arc with the specified parameters from the current pen position to the new point specified. An arc is a line that is bent based on the shape of a

attributes.name: hR
attributes.title: Shape Arc Height Radius
attributes.description: This attribute specifies the height radius of the supposed circle being used to draw the arc.

attributes.name: stAng
attributes.title: Shape Arc Start Angle
attributes.description: Specifies the start angle for an arc.

attributes.name: swAng
attributes.title: Shape Arc Swing Angle
attributes.description: Specifies the swing angle for an arc.

attributes.name: wR
attributes.title: Shape Arc Width Radius
attributes.description: This attribute specifies the width radius of the supposed circle being used to draw the arc.

entries.name: avLst
entries.title: List of Shape Adjust Values
entries.description: This element specifies the adjust values that are applied to the specified shape. An adjust value is simply a guide that has a value based formula specified. That is, no calculation takes place for an adjust value guide.

entries.name: close
entries.title: Close Shape Path
entries.description: This element specifies the ending of a series of lines and curves in the creation path of a custom geometric shape. When this element is encountered, the generating application should consider the corresponding path closed. That is, any further lines or curves that follow this element should be ignored.

entries.name: cubicBezTo
entries.title: Draw Cubic Bezier Curve To
entries.description: This element specifies to draw a cubic bezier curve along the specified points. To specify a cubic bezier curve there needs to be 3 points specified. The first two are control points used in the cubic bezier calculation and the last is the ending point for the curve.

entries.name: custGeom
entries.title: Custom Geometry
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of a custom geometric shape. This shape consists of a series of lines and curves described within a creation path. In addition to this there can also be adjust values, guides, adjust handles, connection sites and an inscribed rectangle specified for this custom geometric shape.

entries.name: cxn
entries.title: Shape Connection Site
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of a connection site on a custom shape. A connection site allows a cxnSp to be attached to this shape. This connection is maintained when the shape is repositioned within the document.

attributes.name: ang
attributes.title: Connection Site Angle
attributes.description: Specifies the incoming connector angle.

entries.name: cxnLst
entries.title: List of Shape Connection Sites
entries.description: This element specifies all the connection sites that are used for this shape. A connection site is specified by defining a point within the shape bounding box that can have a cxnSp element attached to it. These connection sites are specified using the shape coordinate system that is specified within the ext transform element.

entries.name: gd
entries.title: Shape Guide
entries.description: This element specifies the precense of a shape guide that is used to govern the geometry of the specified shape. A shape guide consists of a formula and a name that the result of the formula is assigned to. Recognized formulas are listed with the fmla attribute documentation for this element.

attributes.name: fmla
attributes.title: Shape Guide Formula
attributes.description: Specifies the formula that is used to calculate the value for a guide.

attributes.title: fmla="*/ x y z"
attributes.description: Usage: "*/ x y z" = ((x * y) / z) = value of this guide ('+-') - Add Subtract Formula Arguments:

attributes.title: fmla="+- x y z"
attributes.description: Usage: "+- x y z" = ((x + y) - z) = value of this guide Attributes Description ('+/') - Add Divide Formula Arguments:

attributes.title: fmla="+/ x y z"
attributes.description: Usage: "+/ x y z" = ((x + y) / z) = value of this guide ('?:') - If Else Formula Arguments:

attributes.title: fmla="?: x y z"
attributes.description: Usage: "?: x y z" = if (x > 0), then y = value of this guide, else z = value of this guide ('abs') - Absolute Value Formula Arguments:

attributes.title: fmla="abs x"
attributes.description: Usage: "abs x" = if (x < 0), then (-1) * x = value of this guide else x = value of this guide ('at2') - ArcTan Formula Arguments:

attributes.title: fmla="at2 x y"
attributes.description: Usage: "at2 x y" = arctan(y / x) = value of this guide ('cat2') - Cosine ArcTan Formula Arguments:

attributes.title: fmla="cat2 x y z"
attributes.description: Usage: "cat2 x y z" = (x*(cos(arctan(z / y))) = value of this guide ('cos') - Cosine Formula Arguments:

attributes.title: fmla="cos x y"
attributes.description: Usage: "cos x y" = (x * cos( y )) = value of this guide ('max') - Maximum Value Formula Arguments:

attributes.title: fmla="max x y"
attributes.description: Usage: "max x y" = if (x > y), then x = value of this guide else y = value of this guide ('min') - Minimum Value Formula Arguments:

attributes.title: fmla="min x y"
attributes.description: Usage: "min x y" = if (x < y), then x = value of this guide else y = value of this guide ('mod') - Modulo Formula Arguments:

attributes.title: fmla="mod x y z"
attributes.description: Usage: "mod x y z" = sqrt(x^2 + b^2 + c^2) = value of this guide ('pin') - Pin To Formula Arguments:

attributes.title: fmla="pin x y z"
attributes.description: Usage: "pin x y z" = if (y < x), then x = value of this guide else if (y > z), then z = value of this guide else y = value of this guide ('sat2') - Sine ArcTan Formula Arguments:

attributes.title: fmla="sat2 x y z"
attributes.description: Usage: "sat2 x y z" = (x*sin(arctan(z / y))) = value of this guide ('sin') - Sine Formula Attributes Description Arguments:

attributes.title: fmla="sin x y"
attributes.description: Usage: "sin x y" = (x * sin( y )) = value of this guide ('sqrt') - Square Root Formula Arguments:

attributes.title: fmla="sqrt x"
attributes.description: Usage: "sqrt x" = sqrt(x) = value of this guide ('tan') - Tangent Formula Arguments:

attributes.title: fmla="tan x y"
attributes.description: Usage: "tan x y" = (x * tan( y )) = value of this guide ('val') - Literal Value Formula Arguments:

attributes.title: fmla="val x"
attributes.description: Usage: "val x" = x = value of this guide [Note: Guides that have a literal value formula specified via fmla="val x" above should only be used within the avLst as an adjust value for the shape.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Shape Guide Name
attributes.description: Specifies the name that is used to reference to this guide.

entries.name: gdLst
entries.title: List of Shape Guides
entries.description: This element specifies all the guides that are used for this shape. A guide is specified by the gd element and defines a calculated value that can be used for the construction of the corresponding shape.

entries.name: lnTo
entries.title: Draw Line To
entries.description: This element specifies the drawing of a straight line from the current pen position to the new point specified. This line becomes part of the shape geometry, representing a side of the shape. The coordinate system used when specifying this line is the path coordinate system.

entries.name: moveTo
entries.title: Move Path To
entries.description: This element specifies a set of new coordinates to move the shape cursor to. This element is only used for drawing a custom geometry. When this element is utilized the pt element is used to specify a new set of shape coordinates that the shape cursor should be moved to.

entries.name: path
entries.title: Shape Path
entries.description: This element specifies a creation path consisting of a series of moves, lines and curves that when combined forms a geometric shape. This element is only utilized if a custom geometry is specified.

attributes.name: extrusionOk
attributes.title: 3D Extrusion Allowed
attributes.description: Specifies that the use of 3D extrusions are possible on this path.

attributes.name: fill
attributes.title: Path Fill
attributes.description: Specifies how the corresponding path should be filled.

attributes.name: h
attributes.title: Path Height
attributes.description: Specifies the height, or maximum y coordinate that should be used for within the path coordinate system.

attributes.name: stroke
attributes.title: Path Stroke
attributes.description: Specifies if the corresponding path should have a path stroke shown.

attributes.name: w
attributes.title: Path Width
attributes.description: Specifies the width, or maximum x coordinate that should be used for within the path coordinate system.

entries.name: pathLst
entries.title: List of Shape Paths
entries.description: This element specifies the entire path that is to make up a single geometric shape. The pathLst can consist of many individual paths within it.

entries.name: pos
entries.title: Shape Position Coordinate
entries.description: Specifies a position coordinate within the shape bounding box. It should be noted that this coordinate is placed within the shape bounding box using the transform coordinate system which is also called the shape coordinate system, as it encompasses the entire shape. The width and height for this coordinate system are specified within the ext transform element.

attributes.name: x
attributes.title: X-Coordinate
attributes.description: Specifies the x coordinate for this position coordinate.

attributes.name: y
attributes.title: Y-Coordinate
attributes.description: Specifies the y coordinate for this position coordinate.

entries.name: prstGeom
entries.title: Preset geometry
entries.description: This element specifies when a preset geometric shape should be used instead of a custom geometric shape. The generating application should be able to render all preset geometries enumerated in the ST_ShapeType list.

attributes.name: prst
attributes.title: Preset Shape
attributes.description: Specifies the preset geometry that is used for this shape.

entries.name: prstTxWarp
entries.title: Preset Text Warp
entries.description: This element specifies when a preset geometric shape should be used to transform a piece of text. This operation is known formally as a text warp. The generating application should be able to render all preset geometries enumerated in the ST_TextShapeType list.

attributes.name: prst
attributes.title: Preset Warp Shape
attributes.description: Specifies the preset geometry that is used for a shape warp on a piece of text.

entries.name: pt
entries.title: Shape Path Point
entries.description: This element specifies an x-y coordinate within the path coordinate space. This coordinate space is determined by the width and height attributes defined within the path element. A point is utilized by one of it's parent elements to specify the next point of interest in custom geometry shape.

attributes.name: x
attributes.title: X-Coordinate
attributes.description: Specifies the x coordinate for this position coordinate.

attributes.name: y
attributes.title: Y-Coordinate
attributes.description: Specifies the y coordinate for this position coordinate.

entries.name: quadBezTo
entries.title: Draw Quadratic Bezier Curve To
entries.description: This element specifies to draw a quadratic bezier curve along the specified points. To specify a quadratic bezier curve there needs to be 2 points specified. The first is a control point used in the quadratic bezier calculation and the last is the ending point for the curve.

entries.name: rect
entries.title: Shape Text Rectangle
entries.description: This element specifies the rectangular bounding box for text within a custGeom shape. The default for this rectangle is the bounding box for the shape. This can be modified using this elements four attributes to inset or extend the text bounding box.

attributes.name: b
attributes.title: Bottom Position
attributes.description: Specifies the y coordinate of the bottom edge for a shape text rectangle.

attributes.name: l
attributes.title: Left
attributes.description: Specifies the x coordinate of the left edge for a shape text rectangle.

attributes.name: r
attributes.title: Right
attributes.description: Specifies the x coordinate of the right edge for a shape text rectangle.

attributes.name: t
attributes.title: Top
attributes.description: Specifies the y coordinate of the top edge for a shape text rectangle.

entries.name: ST_AdjAngle
entries.title: Adjustable Angle Methods
entries.description: This simple type is an adjustable angle, either an absolute angle or a reference to a geometry guide. The units for an adjustable angle are 60,000ths of a degree. This simple type is a union of the following types:  The ST_Angle simple type (§20.1.10.3).  The ST_GeomGuideName simple type (§20.1.10.28).

entries.name: ST_AdjCoordinate
entries.title: Adjustable Coordinate Methods
entries.description: This simple type is an adjustable coordinate is either an absolute coordinate position or a reference to a geometry guide. This simple type is a union of the following types:  The ST_Coordinate simple type (§20.1.10.16).  The ST_GeomGuideName simple type (§20.1.10.28).

entries.name: ST_Angle
entries.title: Angle
entries.description: This simple type represents an angle in 60,000ths of a degree. Positive angles are clockwise (i.e., towards the positive y axis); negative angles are counter-clockwise (i.e., towards the negative y axis).

entries.name: ST_AnimationBuildType
entries.title: Animation Build Type
entries.description: This simple type specifies the ways that an animation can be built, or animated.

values.name: allAtOnce
values.title: Animate At Once
values.description: Animate all objects as one.

entries.name: ST_AnimationChartBuildType
entries.title: Chart Animation Build Type
entries.description: This simple type specifies the ways that a chart animation can be built. That is, it specifies the way in which the objects within the chart should be animated. This simple type is a union of the following types:  The ST_AnimationBuildType simple type (§20.1.10.4).  The ST_AnimationChartOnlyBuildType simple type (§20.1.10.6).

entries.name: ST_AnimationChartOnlyBuildType
entries.title: Chart only Animation Types
entries.description: This simple type specifies the build options available only for animating a chart. These options specify the manner in which the objects within the chart should be grouped and animated.

values.name: category
values.title: Catefory
values.description: Animate by each category

values.name: categoryEl
values.title: Category Element
values.description: Animate by each element within the category

values.name: series
values.title: Series
values.description: Animate by each series.

values.name: seriesEl
values.title: Series Element
values.description: Animate by each element within the series

entries.name: ST_AnimationDgmBuildType
entries.title: Diagram Animation Build Type
entries.description: This simple type specifies the ways that a diagram animation can be built. That is, it specifies the way in which the objects within the diagram graphical object should be animated. This simple type is a union of the following types:  The ST_AnimationBuildType simple type (§20.1.10.4).  The ST_AnimationDgmOnlyBuildType simple type (§20.1.10.8).

entries.name: ST_AnimationDgmOnlyBuildType
entries.title: Diagram only Animation Types
entries.description: This simple type specifies the build options available only for animating a diagram. These options specify the manner in which the objects within the chart should be grouped and animated.

values.name: lvlAtOnce
values.title: Each Level at Once
values.description: Animate the diagram one level at a time, animating the whole level as one object

values.name: lvlOne
values.title: Level One-by-One
values.description: Animate the diagram by the elements within a level, animating them one level element at a time.

values.name: one
values.title: Elements One-by-One
values.description: Animate the diagram by elements.

entries.name: ST_BevelPresetType
entries.title: Bevel Presets
entries.description: Represents a preset for a type of bevel which can be applied to a shape in 3D. The bevel properties are applied differently depending on the type of bevel defined for a shape.

entries.title: Black and White Mode
entries.description: This simple type specifies how an object should be rendered when specified to be in black and white mode.

entries.name: ST_BlendMode
entries.title: Blend Mode
entries.description: This simple type describes how to render effects one on top of another.

entries.name: ST_BlipCompression
entries.title: Blip Compression Type
entries.description: This type specifies the amount of compression that has been used for a particular binary large image or picture (blip).

values.name: email

values.name: hqprint

entries.name: ST_Coordinate
entries.title: Coordinate
entries.description: This simple type represents a one dimensional position or length as either:  EMUs.  A number followed immediately by a unit identifier. This simple type is a union of the following types:  The ST_CoordinateUnqualified simple type (§20.1.10.19).  The ST_UniversalMeasure simple type (§22.9.2.15).

entries.name: ST_Coordinate32
entries.title: Coordinate Point
entries.description: This simple type specifies a coordinate within the document. This can be used for measurements or spacing; its maximum size is 2147483647 EMUs. Its contents can contain either:  A whole number, whose contents consist of a measurement in EMUs (English Metric Units)  A number immediately followed by a unit identifier This simple type is a union of the following types:  The ST_Coordinate32Unqualified simple type (§20.1.10.18).  The ST_UniversalMeasure simple type (§22.9.2.15).

entries.name: ST_Coordinate32Unqualified
entries.title: Coordinate Point
entries.description: This simple type specifies a coordinate within the document. This can be used for measurements or spacing with the maximum size requirement being a 32 bit integer. The units of measurement used here are EMUs (English Metric Units).

entries.name: ST_CoordinateUnqualified
entries.title: Coordinate
entries.description: This simple type represents a one dimensional position or length in EMUs.

values.name: sp

entries.name: ST_DrawingElementId
entries.title: Drawing Element ID
entries.description: This simple type specifies a unique integer identifier for each drawing element.

entries.name: ST_EffectContainerType
entries.title: Effect Container Type
entries.description: This simple type determines the relationship between effects in a container, either sibling or tree.

values.name: sib
values.title: Sibling
values.description: Each effect is separately applied to the parent object.

values.name: tree
values.title: Tree
values.description: Each effect is applied to the result of the previous effect.

entries.name: ST_FixedAngle
entries.title: Fixed Angle
entries.description: This simple type represents a fixed range angle in 60000ths of a degree. Range from (-90, 90 degrees).

entries.name: ST_FixedPercentage
entries.title: Fixed Percentage
entries.description: This simple type represents a fixed percentage from negative one hundred to positive one hundred percent. See the union's member types for details. This simple type is a union of the following types:  The ST_FixedPercentage simple type (§22.9.2.3).

entries.name: ST_FontCollectionIndex
entries.title: Font Collection Index
entries.description: This simple type represents one of the fonts associated with the style.

values.name: major
values.title: Major Font
values.description: The major font of the style's font scheme.

values.name: minor
values.title: Minor Font
values.description: The minor font of the style's font scheme.

values.name: none
values.title: None
values.description: No font reference.

entries.name: ST_FOVAngle
entries.title: Field of View Angle
entries.description: Represents a positive angle in 60000ths of a degree. Range from [0, 180] degrees.

entries.name: ST_GeomGuideFormula
entries.title: Geometry Guide Formula Properties
entries.description: This simple type specifies a geometry guide formula.

entries.name: ST_GeomGuideName
entries.title: Geometry Guide Name Properties
entries.description: This simple type specifies a geometry guide name.

entries.name: ST_LightRigDirection
entries.title: Light Rig Direction
entries.description: Represents the direction from which the light rig is positioned relative to the scene. The light rig, itself, can be made up of multiple lights in any orientation around a given shape. This simple type defines the orientation of the light rig as a whole, and not the individual lights within the rig.

entries.name: ST_LightRigType
entries.title: Light Rig Type
entries.description: Represents a preset light right that can be applied to a shape. The light rig represents a group of lights oriented in a specific way relative to a 3D scene. The following properties were used to define the shape used in the image examples below:  Rounded rectangle shape  Circle bevel type  Warm Matte material type  Camera type defined by the perspectiveContrastingRightFacing preset  Bevel width and height each equal to 190500

entries.name: ST_LineCap
entries.title: End Line Cap
entries.description: This simple type specifies how to cap the ends of lines. This also affects the ends of line segments for dashed lines.

values.name: flat
values.title: Flat Line Cap
values.description: Line ends at end point.

values.name: rnd
values.title: Round Line Cap
values.description: Rounded ends.

values.name: sq
values.title: Square Line Cap
values.description: Square protrudes by half line width.

entries.title: Line Width
entries.description: This simple type specifies the width of a line in EMUs. 1 pt = 12700 EMUs.

entries.name: ST_OnOffStyleType
entries.title: On/Off Style Type
entries.description: This simple type represents whether a style property should be applied.

values.name: def
values.title: Default
values.description: Follow parent settings.

values.name: off
values.title: Off
values.description: Property is off.

values.name: on
values.title: On
values.description: Property is on.

entries.name: ST_PathFillMode
entries.title: Path Fill Mode
entries.description: This simple type specifies the manner in which a path should be filled. The lightening and darkening of a path allow for certain parts of the shape to be colored lighter of darker depending on user preference.

values.name: darken
values.title: Darken Path Fill
values.description: This specifies that the corresponding path should have a darker shaded color applied to it’s fill.

values.name: darkenLess
values.title: Darken Path Fill Less
values.description: This specifies that the corresponding path should have a slightly darker shaded color applied to it’s fill.

values.name: lighten
values.title: Lighten Path Fill
values.description: This specifies that the corresponding path should have a lightly shaded color applied to it’s fill.

values.name: lightenLess
values.title: Lighten Path Fill Less
values.description: This specifies that the corresponding path should have a slightly lighter shaded color applied to it’s fill.

values.name: none
values.title: No Path Fill
values.description: This specifies that the corresponding path should have no fill.

values.name: norm
values.title: Normal Path Fill
values.description: This specifies that the corresponding path should have a normally shaded color applied to it’s fill.

entries.name: ST_PathShadeType
entries.title: Path Shade Type
entries.description: This simple type describes the shape of path to follow for a path gradient shade.

values.name: circle
values.title: Circle
values.description: Gradient follows a circular path

values.name: rect
values.title: Rectangle
values.description: Gradient follows a rectangular path

values.name: shape
values.title: Shape
values.description: Gradient follows the shape

entries.name: ST_PenAlignment
entries.title: Alignment Type
entries.description: This simple type specifies the Pen Alignment type for use within a text body.

values.name: ctr
values.title: Center Alignment
values.description: Center pen (line drawn at center of path stroke).

values.name: in
values.title: Inset Alignment
values.description: Inset pen (the pen is aligned on the inside of the edge of the path).

entries.name: ST_Percentage
entries.title: Percentage
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents will contain a percentage value. See the union's member types for details. This simple type is a union of the following types:  The ST_Percentage simple type (§22.9.2.9).

entries.name: ST_PitchFamily
entries.title: Pitch Family
entries.description: This simple type specifies a font pitch.

entries.name: ST_PositiveCoordinate
entries.title: Positive Coordinate
entries.description: This simple type represents a positive position or length in EMUs.

entries.name: ST_PositiveCoordinate32
entries.title: Positive Coordinate Point
entries.description: This simple type specifies the a positive coordinate point that has a maximum size of 32 bits. The units of measurement used here are EMUs (English Metric Units).

entries.name: ST_PositiveFixedAngle
entries.title: Positive Fixed Angle
entries.description: This simple type represents a positive angle in 60000ths of a degree. Range from [0, 360 degrees).

entries.name: ST_PositiveFixedPercentage
entries.title: Positive Fixed Percentage
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents will contain a positive percentage value from zero through one hundred percent. See the union's member types for details. This simple type is a union of the following types:  The ST_PositiveFixedPercentage simple type (§22.9.2.10).

entries.name: ST_PositivePercentage
entries.title: Positive Percentage Value with Sign
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents will contain a positive percentage value. See the union's member types for details. This simple type is a union of the following types:  The ST_PositivePercentage simple type (§22.9.2.11).

entries.name: ST_PresetMaterialType
entries.title: Preset Material Type
entries.description: Describes surface appearance of a shape. The material type combines with lighting characteristics to create the final look and feel of a shape. The set of material properties which can be combined together to create the presets below consist of the following characteristics:

values.name: clear
values.title: Clear
values.description: The clear material type has the following characteristics:  Specular Color: light gray  Diffuse Color: shape fill color with 90% alpha  Ambient Color: shape fill color with 90% alpha  Emissive Color: black  Diffuse Fresnel value: -8  Alpha Fresnel value: 1 [Example: Consider the following example of the clear material type: Enumeration Value Description end example]

values.name: dkEdge
values.title: Dark Edge
values.description: The dkEdge material type has the following characteristics:  Specular Color: white  Specular Power value: 35  Ambient Color: shape fill color  Emissive Color: black  Diffuse Fresnel value: -2 [Example: Consider the following example of the dkEdge material type: end example]

values.name: flat
values.title: Flat
values.description: The flat material type has the following characteristics:  Specular Color: very light gray  Specular Power value: 50  Diffuse Color: black  Ambient Color: black  Emissive Color: shape fill color  Diffuse Fresnel value: -4 Enumeration Value Description [Example: Consider the following example of the flat material type: end example]

values.name: legacyMatte
values.title: Legacy Matte
values.description: The legacyMatte material type has the following characteristics:  Specular Color: black  Ambient Color: shape fill color  Emissive Color: black  Diffuse Fresnel value: -4 [Example: Consider the following example of the legacyMatte material type: end example]

values.name: legacyMetal
values.title: Legacy Metal
values.description: The legacyMetal material type has the following characteristics:  Specular Color: shape fill color  Specular Power value: 32  Diffuse Color: shape fill color darkened by adding black  Ambient Color: shape fill color darkened by Enumeration Value Description adding black  Emissive Color: black [Example: Consider the following example of the legacyMetal material type: end example]

values.name: legacyPlastic
values.title: Legacy Plastic
values.description: The legacyPlastic material type has the following characteristics:  Specular Color: white  Specular Power value: 32  Ambient Color: shape fill color  Emissive Color: black [Example: Consider the following example of the legacyPlastic material type: end example]

values.name: legacyWireframe
values.title: Legacy Wireframe
values.description: The legacyWireframe material type has none of the associated material properties and is based on a wireframe interpretation of the shape.

values.name: matte
values.title: Matte
values.description: The matte material type has the following characteristics:  Specular Color: black  Ambient Color: shape fill color  Emissive Color: black [Example: Consider the following example of the matte material type: end example]

values.name: metal
values.title: Metal
values.description: The metal material type has the following characteristics:  Specular Color: shape fill color plus white, which is brightened by 1.5 times the normal value  Specular Power value: 12  Ambient Color: shape fill color  Emissive Color: black  Diffuse Fresnel value: 4 Enumeration Value Description [Example: Consider the following example of the metal material type: end example]

values.name: plastic
values.title: Plastic
values.description: The plastic material type has the following characteristics:  Specular Color: light gray  Specular Power value: 12  Ambient Color: shape fill color  Emissive Color: black [Example: Consider the following example of the plastic material type: end example]

values.name: powder
values.title: Powder
values.description: The powder material type has the following characteristics:  Specular Color: dark gray  Specular Power value: 10  Diffuse Color: gray  Ambient Color: gray Enumeration Value Description  Emissive Color: black  Diffuse Fresnel value: 2 [Example: Consider the following example of the powder material type: end example]

values.name: softEdge
values.title: Soft Edge
values.description: The softEdge material type has the following characteristics:  Specular Color: white  Specular Power value: 35  Ambient Color: shape fill color  Emissive Color: black  Diffuse Fresnel value: 4  Alpha Fresnel value: -10 [Example: Consider the following example of the softEdge material type: end example]

values.name: softmetal

entries.title: System Color Value
entries.description: This simple type specifies a system color value. This color is based upon the value that this color currently has within the system on which the document is being viewed. entries.name: ST_TextBulletSizePercent
entries.title: Bullet Size Percentage
entries.description: This simple type specifies the range that the bullet percent can be. A bullet percent is the size of the bullet with respect to the text that should follow it. This simple type also specifies the following restrictions:  This simple type’s contents shall match the following regular expression pattern: 0*((2[5-9])|([3-9][0-9])|([1-3][0-9][0-9])|400)%.

entries.name: ST_TextBulletStartAtNum
entries.title: Start Bullet At Number
entries.description: This simple type specifies the range that the start at number for a bullet's auto-numbering sequence can begin at. When the numbering is alphabetical, then the numbers map to the appropriate letter. 1->a, 2->b, etc. If the numbers go above 26, then the numbers begin to double up.

entries.name: ST_TextFontSize
entries.title: Text Font Size
entries.description: This simple type specifies the size of any text in hundredths of a point. Shall be at least 1 point.

entries.name: ST_TextIndent
entries.title: Text Indentation
entries.description: This simple type specifies the text indentation amount to be used. The units of measurement used here are EMUs (English Metric Units).

entries.name: ST_TextIndentLevelType
entries.title: Text Indent Level Type
entries.description: This simple type specifies the indent level type. We support list level 0 to 8, and we use -1 and -2 for outline mode levels that should only exist in memory.

entries.name: ST_TextMargin
entries.title: Text Margin
entries.description: This simple type specifies the margin that is used and its corresponding size.

entries.name: ST_TextNonNegativePoint
entries.title: Text Non-Negative Point
entries.description: This simple type specifies a non-negative font size in hundredths of a point. This is restricted to the range [0, 400000].

entries.name: ST_TextPoint
entries.title: Text Point
entries.description: This simple type specifies a coordinate within the document. This can be used for measurements or spacing; its maximum size is +/- 4000 points. Its contents can contain either:  A whole number, whose contents consist of a measurement in hundredths of a point  A number immediately followed by a unit identifier This simple type is a union of the following types:  The ST_TextPointUnqualified simple type (§20.1.10.75).  The ST_UniversalMeasure simple type (§22.9.2.15).

entries.name: ST_TextPointUnqualified
entries.title: Text Point
entries.description: This simple type specifies a font size in hundredths of a point. This is restricted to the range [-400000, 400000], i.e from -4000 pt to 4000 pt.

entries.name: ST_TextShapeType
entries.title: Preset Text Shape Types
entries.description: This simple type specifies the preset text shape geometry that is to be used for a shape. An enumeration of this simple type is used so that a custom geometry does not have to be specified but instead can be constructed automatically by the generating application. For each enumeration listed there is also the corresponding DrawingML code that would be used to construct this shape were it a custom geometry.

entries.name: lockedCanvas
entries.title: Locked Canvas Container
entries.description: End of informative text. 20.3.2 Basics This section specifies a locked canvas within the basic DrawingML framework. 20.3.2.1 lockedCanvas (Locked Canvas Container) The locked canvas element acts as a container for more advanced drawing objects. The notion of a locked canvas comes from the fact that the generating application opening the file cannot create this object and can thus not perform edits either. Thus the drawing object is locked from all UI adjustments that would normally take place.

entries.name: align
entries.title: Relative Horizontal Alignment
entries.description: This element specifies how a DrawingML object shall be horizontally aligned relative to the horizontal alignment base defined by the parent element. Once an alignment base is defined, this element shall determine how the DrawingML object shall be aligned relative to that location.

entries.name: align
entries.title: Relative Vertical Alignment
entries.description: This element specifies how a DrawingML object shall be vertically aligned relative to the vertical alignment base defined by the parent element. Once an alignment base is defined, this element shall determine how the DrawingML object shall be aligned relative to that location.

entries.name: anchor
entries.title: Anchor for Floating DrawingML Object
entries.description: This element specifies that the DrawingML object located at this position in the document is a floating object. Within a WordprocessingML document, drawing objects can exist in two states:  Inline - The drawing object is in line with the text, and affects the line height and layout of its line (like a character glyph of similar size).  Floating - The drawing object is anchored within the text, but can be absolutely positioned in the document relative to the page. When this element encapsulates the DrawingML object's information, then all child elements shall dictate the positioning of this object as a floating object on the page.

attributes.name: allowOverlap
attributes.title: Allow Objects to Overlap
attributes.description: Specifies whether a DrawingML object which intersects another DrawingML object at display time is allowed to overlap the contents of the other DrawingML object.

attributes.name: behindDoc
attributes.title: Display Behind Document Text
attributes.description: Specifies whether this floating DrawingML object is displayed behind the text of the document when the document is displayed.

attributes.name: distB
attributes.title: Distance From Text on Bottom Edge
attributes.description: Specifies the minimum distance which shall be maintained between the bottom edge of this drawing object and any subsequent text within the document when this graphical object is displayed within the document's contents.

attributes.name: distL

attributes.name: distR

attributes.name: distT

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.title: Hidden

attributes.name: layoutInCell
attributes.title: Layout In Table Cell
attributes.description: Specifies how this DrawingML object behaves when its anchor is located in a table cell; and its specified position would cause it to intersect with a table cell displayed in the document.

attributes.name: locked
attributes.title: Lock Anchor
attributes.description: Specifies that the anchor location for this object shall not be modified at runtime when an application edits the contents of this document.

attributes.name: relativeHeight

attributes.description: Specifies the relative Z-ordering of all DrawingML objects in this document.

attributes.name: simplePos

attributes.description: Specifies that this object shall be positioned using the positioning information in the simplePos child element (§20.4.2.13).

entries.name: positionH
entries.title: Horizontal Positioning
entries.description: This element specifies the horizontal positioning of a floating DrawingML object within a WordprocessingML document. This positioning is specified in two parts:  Positioning Base - The relativeFrom attribute on this element specifies the part of the document from which the positioning shall be calculated.  Positioning - The child element of this element (align or posOffset) specifies how the object is positioned relative to that base.

attributes.name: relativeFrom
attributes.title: Horizontal Position Relative Base
attributes.description: Specifies the base to which the relative horizontal positioning of this object shall be calculated.

entries.name: positionV

This positioning is specified in two parts:  Positioning Base - The relativeFrom attribute on this element specifies the part of the document from which the positioning shall be calculated.  Positioning - The child element of this element (align or posOffset) specifies how the object is positioned relative to that base.

attributes.name: relativeFrom

entries.name: posOffset

entries.name: wrapNone

entries.name: wrapPolygon
entries.title: Wrapping Polygon
entries.description: This element specifies the wrapping polygon which shall be used to determine the extents to which text can wrap around the specified object in the document. This polygon shall be defined by the following:  The start element defines the coordinates of the origin of the wrap polygon  Two or more lineTo elements define the point of the wrap polygon If the set of child elements does not result in a closed polygon (the last lineTo element does not return to the position specified by the start element), then a single additional line shall be inferred as needed to close the wrapping polygon.

entries.name: wrapSquare
entries.title: Square Wrapping
entries.description: This element specifies that text shall wrap around a virtual rectangle bounding this object. The bounds of the wrapping rectangle shall be dictated by the extents including the addition of the effectExtent element as a child of this element (if present) or the effectExtent present on the parent element.

entries.name: wrapThrough

attributes.name: distL

attributes.name: distR

attributes.name: wrapText

attributes.name: horzOverflow

attributes.description: Determines whether the text can flow out of the bounding box horizontally.

attributes.name: lIns

attributes.name: numCol
attributes.title: Number of Columns
attributes.description: Specifies the number of columns of text in the bounding rectangle.

attributes.name: rIns
attributes.title: Right Inset
attributes.description: Specifies the right inset of the bounding rectangle.

attributes.name: rot
attributes.title: Rotation
attributes.description: Specifies the rotation that is being applied to the text within the bounding box.

attributes.name: rtlCol
attributes.title: Columns Right-To-Left
attributes.description: Specifies whether columns are used in a right-to-left or left-to-right order.

attributes.name: spcCol
attributes.title: Space Between Columns

attributes.name: spcFirstLastPara

attributes.name: tIns

attributes.name: wrap

If an application cannot process content of the content type specified by the targeted part, then it
