attributes.description: Specifies the rotation of the Graphic Frame.

entries.name: ST_AlignH
entries.title: Relative Horizontal Alignment Positions
entries.description: This simple type contains the possible settings specifying how a DrawingML object can be horizontally aligned relative to the horizontal alignment base defined by the parent element.

values.name: center
values.title: Center Alignment
values.description: Specifies that the object shall be centered with respect to the horizontal alignment base.

values.name: inside
values.title: Inside
values.description: Specifies that the object shall be inside of the horizontal alignment base.

values.name: left
values.title: Left Alignment
values.description: Specifies that the object shall be left aligned to the horizontal alignment base.

values.name: outside
values.title: Outside
values.description: Specifies that the object shall be outside of the horizontal alignment base.

values.name: right
values.title: Right Alignment
values.description: Specifies that the object shall be right aligned to the horizontal alignment base.

entries.name: ST_AlignV
entries.title: Vertical Alignment Definition
entries.description: This simple type contains the possible settings specifying how a DrawingML object can be vertically aligned relative to the vertical alignment base defined by the parent element.

values.name: bottom
values.title: Bottom
values.description: Specifies that the object shall be at the bottom of the vertical alignment base.

values.name: center
values.title: Center Alignment
values.description: Specifies that the object shall be centered with respect to the vertical alignment base.

values.name: inside
values.title: Inside
values.description: Specifies that the object shall be inside of the horizontal alignment base.

values.name: outside
values.title: Outside
values.description: Specifies that the object shall be outside of the vertical alignment base.

values.name: top
values.title: Top
values.description: Specifies that the object shall be at the top of the vertical alignment base.

entries.name: ST_PositionOffset
entries.title: Absolute Position Offset Value
entries.description: This simple type represents a one dimensional distance which shall be used to offset an objet from its base positioning location stored in EMUs.

entries.name: ST_RelFromH
entries.title: Horizontal Relative Positioning
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible values for the base from which the relative horizontal positioning of an object shall be calculated.

values.name: character
values.title: Character
values.description: Specifies that the horizontal positioning shall be relative to the position of the anchor within its run content.

values.name: column
values.title: Column
values.description: Specifies that the horizontal positioning shall be relative to the extents of the column which contains its anchor.

values.name: insideMargin
values.title: Inside Margin
values.description: Specifies that the horizontal positioning shall be Enumeration Value Description relative to the inside margin of the current page (the left margin on odd pages, right on even pages).

values.name: leftMargin
values.title: Left Margin
values.description: Specifies that the horizontal positioning shall be relative to the left margin of the page.

values.name: margin
values.title: Page Margin
values.description: Specifies that the horizontal positioning shall be relative to the page margins.

values.name: outsideMargin
values.title: Outside Margin
values.description: Specifies that the horizontal positioning shall be relative to the outside margin of the current page (the right margin on odd pages, left on even pages).

values.name: page
values.title: Page Edge
values.description: Specifies that the horizontal positioning shall be relative to the edge of the page.

values.name: rightMargin
values.title: Right Margin
values.description: Specifies that the horizontal positioning shall be relative to the right margin of the page.

entries.name: ST_RelFromV
entries.title: Vertical Relative Positioning
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible values for the base from which the relative vertical positioning of an object shall be calculated.

values.name: bottomMargin
values.title: Bottom Margin
values.description: Specifies that the vertical positioning shall be relative to the bottom margin of the current page.

values.name: insideMargin
values.title: Inside Margin
values.description: Specifies that the vertical positioning shall be relative Enumeration Value Description to the inside margin of the current page.

values.name: line
values.title: Line
values.description: Specifies that the vertical positioning shall be relative to the line containing the anchor character.

values.name: margin
values.title: Page Margin
values.description: Specifies that the vertical positioning shall be relative to the page margins.

values.name: outsideMargin
values.title: Outside Margin
values.description: Specifies that the vertical positioning shall be relative to the outside margin of the current page.

values.name: page
values.title: Page Edge
values.description: Specifies that the vertical positioning shall be relative to the edge of the page.

values.name: paragraph
values.title: Paragraph
values.description: Specifies that the vertical positioning shall be relative to the paragraph which contains the drawing anchor.

values.name: topMargin
values.title: Top Margin
values.description: Specifies that the vertical positioning shall be relative to the top margin of the current page.

entries.name: ST_WrapDistance
entries.title: Distance from Text
entries.description: This simple type represents a one dimensional distance which shall be used to offset an object from text, stored in EMUs.

entries.name: ST_WrapText
entries.title: Text Wrapping Location
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible settings for how text can wrap around the object's left and right sides.

values.name: bothSides
values.title: Both Sides
values.description: Specifies that text shall wrap around both sides of the object.

values.name: largest
values.title: Largest Side Only
values.description: Specifies that text shall only wrap around the largest side of the object.

values.name: left
values.title: Left Side Only
values.description: Specifies that text shall only wrap around the left side of the object.

values.name: right
values.title: Right Side Only
values.description: Specifies that text shall only wrap around the right side of the object.

entries.name: absoluteAnchor
entries.title: Absolute Anchor Shape Size
entries.description: This element is used as an anchor placeholder for a shape or group of shapes. It anchors the object in the same position relative to sheet position and its extents are in EMU units.

entries.name: blipFill
entries.title: Picture Fill
entries.description: This element specifies the type of picture fill that the picture object has. Because a picture has a picture fill already by default, it is possible to have two fills specified for a picture object. An example of this is shown below.

attributes.name: dpi
attributes.title: DPI Setting
attributes.description: Namespace: Specifies the DPI (dots per inch) used to calculate the size of the blip.

attributes.name: rotWithShape
attributes.title: Rotate With Shape
attributes.description: Specifies that the fill should rotate with the shape.

entries.name: clientData
entries.title: Client Data
entries.description: This element is used to set certain properties related to a drawing element on the client spreadsheet application.

attributes.name: fLocksWithSheet
attributes.title: Locks With Sheet Flag
attributes.description: This attribute indicates whether to disable selection on drawing elements when the sheet is protected.

attributes.name: fPrintsWithSheet
attributes.title: Prints With Sheet Flag
attributes.description: This attribute indicates whether to print drawing elements when printing the sheet.

entries.name: cNvCxnSpPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Connector Shape Drawing Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the non-visual properties for a connector shape. These are the set of properties on a shape which do not affect its display within a spreadsheet.

entries.name: cNvGraphicFramePr
entries.title: Non-Visual Graphic Frame Drawing Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the non-visual properties for a single graphical object frame within a spreadsheet. These are the set of properties of a frame which do not affect its display within a spreadsheet.

entries.name: cNvGrpSpPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Group Shape Drawing Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the non-visual properties of a hierarchical grouping of shapes, graphical object frames, and child groups. These are the set of properties of a group which do not affect its display within a spreadsheet.

entries.name: cNvPicPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Picture Drawing Properties
entries.description: This element describes the non-visual properties of a picture within a spreadsheet. These are the set of properties of a picture which do not affect its display within a spreadsheet.

attributes.name: ze
attributes.title: Relative Resize Preferred
attributes.description: Specifies if the user interface should show the resizing of the picture based on the picture's current size or its original size.

entries.name: cNvPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Drawing Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the set of non-visual properties for the parent element. These properties specify all the data about the parent which does not affect its display within the spreadsheet.

attributes.name: descr
attributes.title: Alternative Text for Object
attributes.description: Specifies alternative text for the current DrawingML object, for use by assistive technologies or applications which do not display the current object.

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.title: Hidden
attributes.description: Specifies whether this DrawingML object is displayed.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Unique Identifier
attributes.description: Specifies a unique identifier for the current DrawingML object within the current document.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Name
attributes.description: Specifies the name of the object.

attributes.name: title
attributes.title: Title
attributes.description: Specifies the title (caption) of the current DrawingML object.

entries.name: cNvSpPr
entries.title: Connection Non-Visual Shape Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the set of non-visual properties for a connection shape. These properties specify all data about the connection shape which do not affect its display within a spreadsheet.

attributes.name: txBox
attributes.title: Text Box
attributes.description: Specifies that the corresponding shape is a text box and thus should be treated as such by the generating application.

entries.name: col
entries.title: Column)
entries.description: This element specifies the column that is used within the from and to elements to specify anchoring information for a shape within a spreadsheet The possible values for this element are defined by the ST_ColID simple type (§20.5.3.1).

entries.name: colOff
entries.title: Column Offset
entries.description: This element is used to specify the column offset within a cell. The units for which this attribute is specified in reside within the simple type definition referenced below. The possible values for this element are defined by the ST_Coordinate simple type (§20.1.10.16).

entries.name: contentPart
entries.title: Content Part
entries.description: This element specifies a reference to XML content in a format not defined by ECMA-376. [Note: This part allows the native use of other commonly used interchange formats, such as:  MathML (http://www.w3.org/TR/MathML2/)  SMIL (http://www.w3.org/TR/REC-smil/)  SVG (http://www.w3.org/TR/SVG11/) end note] The relationship type of the explicit relationship specified by this element shall be http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/customXml and have a TargetMode attribute value of Internal. If an application cannot process content of the content type specified by the targeted part, then it

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Relationship to Part
attributes.description: Specifies the relationship ID to a content part.

entries.name: cxnSp
entries.title: Connection Shape
entries.description: This element specifies the properties for a connection shape drawing element. A connection shape is a line, etc. that connects two other shapes in this drawing.

attributes.name: fPublished
attributes.title: Publish to Server Flag
attributes.description: This attribute indicates whether the shape shall be published with the worksheet when sent to the server.

attributes.name: macro
attributes.title: Reference to Custom Function
attributes.description: This element specifies the custom function associated with the object.

entries.name: ext
entries.title: Shape Extent
entries.description: This element describes the length and width properties for how far a drawing element should extend for.

attributes.name: cx
attributes.title: Extent Length
attributes.description: Specifies the length of the extents rectangle in EMUs.

attributes.name: cy
attributes.title: Extent Width
attributes.description: Specifies the width of the extents rectangle in EMUs.

entries.name: from
entries.title: Starting Anchor Point
entries.description: This element specifies the first anchor point for the drawing element. This is used to anchor the top and left sides of the shape within the spreadsheet. That is when the cell that is specified in the from element is adjusted, the shape is also adjusted.

entries.name: graphicFrame
entries.title: Graphic Frame
entries.description: This element describes a single graphical object frame for a spreadsheet which contains a graphical object.

attributes.name: fPublished
attributes.title: Publish to Server Flag
attributes.description: This attribute indicates whether the shape shall be published with the worksheet when sent to the server.

entries.name: grpSp
entries.title: Group Shape
entries.description: This element specifies a group shape that represents many shapes grouped together. This shape is to be treated just as if it were a regular shape but instead of being described by a single geometry it is made up of all the shape geometries encompassed within it. Within a group shape each of the shapes that make up the group are specified just as they normally would.

entries.name: grpSpPr
entries.title: Group Shape Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the properties that are to be common across all of the shapes within the corresponding group. If there are any conflicting properties within the group shape properties and the individual shape properties then the individual shape properties should take precedence.

attributes.name: bwMode
attributes.title: Black and White Mode
attributes.description: Specifies that the group shape should be rendered using only black and white coloring.

entries.name: nvCxnSpPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Properties for a Connection Shape
entries.description: This element specifies all non-visual properties for a connection shape. This element is a container for the non- visual identification properties, shape properties and application properties that are to be associated with a connection shape. This allows for additional information that does not affect the appearance of the connection shape to be stored.

entries.name: nvGraphicFramePr
entries.title: Non-Visual Properties for a Graphic Frame
entries.description: This element specifies all non-visual properties for a graphic frame. This element is a container for the non-visual identification properties, shape properties and application properties that are to be associated with a graphic frame. This allows for additional information that does not affect the appearance of the graphic frame to be stored.

entries.name: nvGrpSpPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Properties for a Group Shape
entries.description: This element specifies all non-visual properties for a group shape. This element is a container for the non-visual identification properties, shape properties and application properties that are to be associated with a group shape. This allows for additional information that does not affect the appearance of the group shape to be stored.

entries.name: nvPicPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Properties for a Picture
entries.description: This element specifies all non-visual properties for a picture. This element is a container for the non-visual identification properties, shape properties and application properties that are to be associated with a picture. This allows for additional information that does not affect the appearance of the picture to be stored.

entries.name: nvSpPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Properties for a Shape
entries.description: This element specifies all non-visual properties for a shape. This element is a container for the non-visual identification properties, shape properties and application properties that are to be associated with a shape. This allows for additional information that does not affect the appearance of the shape to be stored.

entries.name: oneCellAnchor
entries.title: One Cell Anchor Shape Size
entries.description: This element specifies a one cell anchor placeholder for a group, a shape, or a drawing element. It moves with the cell and its extents is in EMU units.

entries.name: pic
entries.title: Picture
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of a picture object within the spreadsheet.

attributes.name: fPublished
attributes.title: Publish to Server Flag
attributes.description: This attribute indicates whether the shape shall be published with the worksheet when sent to the server.

attributes.name: macro
attributes.title: Reference To Custom Function
attributes.description: This element specifies the custom function associated with the object.

entries.name: pos
entries.title: Position
entries.description: This element describes the position of a drawing element within a spreadsheet.

attributes.name: x
attributes.title: X-Axis Coordinate
attributes.description: Specifies a coordinate on the x-axis.

attributes.name: y
attributes.title: Y-Axis Coordinate
attributes.description: Specifies a coordinate on the x-axis.

entries.name: row
entries.title: Row
entries.description: This element specifies the row that is used within the from and to elements to specify anchoring information for a shape within a spreadsheet. The possible values for this element are defined by the ST_RowID simple type (§20.5.3.3).

entries.name: rowOff
entries.title: Row Offset
entries.description: This element is used to specify the row offset within a cell. The units for which this attribute is specified in reside within the simple type definition referenced below. The possible values for this element are defined by the ST_Coordinate simple type (§20.1.10.16).

entries.name: sp
entries.title: Shape
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of a single shape. A shape can either be a preset or a custom geometry, defined using the SpreadsheetDrawingML framework. In addition to a geometry each shape can have both visual and non-visual properties attached.

attributes.name: fLocksText
attributes.title: Lock Text Flag
attributes.description: This attribute indicates whether to allow text editing within this drawing object when the parent worksheet is protected.

attributes.name: fPublished
attributes.title: Publish to Server Flag
attributes.description: This attribute indicates whether the shape shall be published with the worksheet when sent to the server.

attributes.name: macro
attributes.title: Reference to Custom Function
attributes.description: This element specifies the custom function associated with the object.

attributes.name: textlink
attributes.title: Text Link
attributes.description: This attribute specifies a formula linking to spreadsheet cell data.

entries.name: spPr
entries.title: Shape Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the visual shape properties that can be applied to a special shape such as a connector shape or picture. These are the same properties that are allowed to describe the visual properties of a shape but are used here to describe additional object-specific properties within a document. This allows for these shapes to have both the properties of a shape as well as specific properties that are unique to only them.

attributes.name: bwMode
attributes.title: Black and White Mode
attributes.description: Specifies that the picture should be rendered using only black and white coloring.

entries.name: style
entries.title: Shape Style
entries.description: The element specifies the style that is applied to a shape and the corresponding references for each of the style components such as lines and fills.

entries.name: to
entries.title: Ending Anchor Point
entries.description: This element specifies the second anchor point for the drawing element. This is used to anchor the bottom and right sides of the shape within the spreadsheet. That is when the cell that is specified in the to element is adjusted, the shape is also adjusted.

entries.name: twoCellAnchor
entries.title: Two Cell Anchor Shape Size
entries.description: This element specifies a two cell anchor placeholder for a group, a shape, or a drawing element. It moves with cells and its extents are in EMU units.

attributes.name: editAs
attributes.title: Positioning and Resizing Behaviors
attributes.description: Specifies how the DrawingML contents shall be moved and/or resized when the rows and columns between its start and ending anchor (the from and to child elements) are resized, or have additional rows/columns inserted within them, or additional row/columns are added before them.

entries.name: txBody
entries.title: Shape Text Body
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of text to be contained within the corresponding shape. All visible text and visible text related properties are contained within this element. There can be multiple paragraphs and within paragraphs multiple runs of text.

entries.name: wsDr
entries.title: Worksheet Drawing
entries.description: This element specifies all drawing objects within the worksheet. It acts much like the spTree element within the DrawingML framework. Allowing for the specification of all shapes for a given part of a document, in this case a single Worksheet.

entries.name: xfrm
entries.title: 2D Transform for Graphic Frames
entries.description: This element specifies a two dimensional transform for a Graphic Frame.

attributes.name: flipH
attributes.title: Horizontal Flip
attributes.description: Specifies a horizontal flip.

attributes.name: flipV
attributes.title: Vertical Flip
attributes.description: Specifies a vertical flip.

attributes.name: rot
attributes.title: Rotation
attributes.description: Specifies the rotation of the Graphic Frame.

entries.name: ST_ColID
entries.title: Column ID
entries.description: This simple type specifies a column identification. The numerical value used for the column id should be non- negative and never exceed the number of total columns within the spreadsheet document.

entries.name: ST_EditAs
entries.title: Resizing Behaviors
entries.description: This simple type specifies all possible settings for how DrawingML contents shall be resized when the rows and columns between its start and ending anchor (the from and to child elements) are resized, or have additional rows/columns inserted within them.

values.name: absolute
values.title: Do Not Move or Resize With Underlying Rows/Columns
values.description: Specifies that the current start and end positions shall be maintained with respect to the distances from the absolute start point of the worksheet.

values.name: oneCell
values.title: Move With Cells but Do Not Resize
values.description: Specifies that the current drawing shall move with its row and column (i.e. the object is anchored to the actual from row and column), but that the size shall remain absolute.

values.name: twoCell
values.title: Move and Resize With Anchor Cells
values.description: Specifies that the current drawing shall move and resize to maintain its row and column anchors (i.e. the object is anchored to the actual from and to row and Enumeration Value Description column).

entries.name: ST_RowID
entries.title: Row ID
entries.description: This simple type specifies a row identification. The numerical value used for the row id should be non-negative and never exceed the number of total rows within the spreadsheet document.

entries.name: bodyPr
entries.title: Body Properties
entries.description: This element defines the body properties for the text body within a shape.

attributes.name: anchor
attributes.title: Anchor
attributes.description: Specifies the anchoring position of the txBody within the shape.

attributes.name: anchorCtr
attributes.title: Anchor Center
attributes.description: Specifies the centering of the text box.

attributes.name: bIns
attributes.title: Bottom Inset
attributes.description: Specifies the bottom inset of the bounding rectangle.

attributes.name: compatLnSpc
attributes.title: Compatible Line Spacing
attributes.description: Specifies that the line spacing for this text body is decided in a simplistic manner using the font scene.

attributes.name: forceAA
attributes.title: Force Anti-Alias
attributes.description: Forces the text to be rendered anti-aliased regardless of the font size.

attributes.name: fromWordArt
attributes.title: From WordArt
attributes.description: Specifies that text within this textbox is converted text from a WordArt object.

attributes.name: horzOverflow
attributes.title: Text Horizontal Overflow
attributes.description: Determines whether the text can flow out of the bounding box horizontally.

attributes.name: lIns
attributes.title: Left Inset
attributes.description: Specifies the left inset of the bounding rectangle.

attributes.name: numCol
attributes.title: Number of Columns
attributes.description: Specifies the number of columns of text in the bounding rectangle.

attributes.name: rIns
attributes.title: Right Inset
attributes.description: Specifies the right inset of the bounding rectangle.

attributes.name: rot
attributes.title: Rotation
attributes.description: Specifies the rotation that is being applied to the text within the bounding box.

attributes.name: rtlCol
attributes.title: Columns Right-To-Left
attributes.description: Specifies whether columns are used in a right-to-left or left-to-right order.

attributes.name: spcCol
attributes.title: Space Between Columns
attributes.description: Specifies the space between text columns in the text area.

attributes.name: spcFirstLastPara
attributes.title: Paragraph Spacing
attributes.description: Specifies whether the before and after paragraph spacing defined by the user is to be respected.

attributes.name: tIns
attributes.title: Top Inset
attributes.description: Specifies the top inset of the bounding rectangle.

attributes.name: upright
attributes.title: Text Upright
attributes.description: Specifies whether text should remain upright, regardless of the transform applied to it and the accompanying shape transform.

attributes.name: vert
attributes.title: Vertical Text
attributes.description: Determines if the text within the given text body should be displayed vertically.

attributes.name: vertOverflow
attributes.title: Text Vertical Overflow
attributes.description: Determines whether the text can flow out of the bounding box vertically.

attributes.name: wrap
attributes.title: Text Wrapping Type
attributes.description: Specifies the wrapping options to be used for this text body.

entries.name: noAutofit
entries.title: No AutoFit
entries.description: This element specifies that text within the text body should not be auto-fit to the bounding box. Auto-fitting is when text within a text box is scaled in order to remain inside the text box. If this element is omitted, then noAutofit or auto-fit off is implied.

entries.name: normAutofit
entries.title: Normal AutoFit
entries.description: This element specifies that text within the text body should be normally auto-fit to the bounding box. Auto- fitting is when text within a text box is scaled in order to remain inside the text box. If this element is omitted, then noAutofit or auto-fit off is implied.

attributes.name: lnSpcReduction
attributes.title: Line Space Reduction
attributes.description: Specifies the percentage amount by which the line spacing of each paragraph in the text body is reduced.

entries.name: spAutoFit
entries.title: Shape AutoFit
entries.description: This element specifies that a shape should be auto-fit to fully contain the text described within it. Auto-fitting is when text within a shape is scaled in order to contain all the text inside. If this element is omitted, then noAutofit or auto-fit off is implied.

entries.name: br
entries.title: Text Line Break
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of a vertical line break between two runs of text within a paragraph. In addition to specifying a vertical space between two runs of text, this element can also have run properties specified via the rPr child element. This sets the formatting of text for the line break so that if text is later inserted there that a new run can be generated with the correct formatting.

entries.name: defPPr
entries.title: Default Paragraph Style
entries.description: This element specifies the paragraph properties that are to be applied when no other paragraph properties have been specified. If this attribute is omitted, then it is left to the application to decide the set of default paragraph properties that should be applied.

attributes.name: algn
attributes.title: Alignment
attributes.description: Specifies the alignment that is to be applied to the paragraph.

attributes.name: defTabSz
attributes.title: Default Tab Size
attributes.description: Specifies the default size for a tab character within this paragraph.

attributes.name: eaLnBrk
attributes.title: East Asian Line Break
attributes.description: Specifies whether an East Asian word can be broken in half and wrapped onto the next line without a hyphen being added.

attributes.name: fontAlgn
attributes.title: Font Alignment
attributes.description: Determines where vertically on a line of text the actual words are positioned.

attributes.name: hangingPunct
attributes.title: Hanging Punctuation
attributes.description: Specifies whether punctuation is to be forcefully laid out on a line of text or put on a different line of text.

attributes.name: indent
attributes.title: Indent
attributes.description: Specifies the indent size that is applied to the first line of text in the paragraph.

attributes.name: latinLnBrk
attributes.title: Latin Line Break
attributes.description: Specifies whether a Latin word can be broken in half and wrapped onto the next line without a hyphen being added.

attributes.name: lvl
attributes.title: Level
attributes.description: Specifies the particular level text properties that this paragraph follows.

attributes.name: marL
attributes.title: Left Margin
attributes.description: Specifies the left margin of the paragraph.

attributes.name: marR
attributes.title: Right Margin
attributes.description: Specifies the right margin of the paragraph.

attributes.name: rtl
attributes.title: Right To Left
attributes.description: Specifies whether the text is right-to-left or left-to-right in its flow direction.

entries.name: endParaRPr
entries.title: End Paragraph Run Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the text run properties that are to be used if another run is inserted after the last run specified. This effectively saves the run property state so that it can be applied when the user enters additional text. If this element is omitted, then the application can determine which default properties to apply.

attributes.name: altLang
attributes.title: Alternative Language
attributes.description: Specifies the alternate language to use when the generating application is displaying the user interface controls.

attributes.name: b
attributes.title: Bold
attributes.description: Specifies whether a run of text is formatted as bold text.

attributes.name: baseline
attributes.title: Baseline
attributes.description: Specifies the baseline for both the superscript and subscript fonts.

attributes.name: bmk
attributes.title: Bookmark Link Target
attributes.description: Specifies the link target name that is used to reference to the proper link properties in a custom XML part within the document.

attributes.name: cap
attributes.title: Capitalization
attributes.description: Specifies the capitalization that is to be applied to the text run.

attributes.name: dirty
attributes.title: Dirty
attributes.description: Specifies that the content of a text run has changed since the proofing tools have last been run.

attributes.name: err
attributes.title: Spelling Error
attributes.description: Specifies that when this run of text was checked for spelling, grammar, etc. that a mistake was indeed found.

attributes.name: i
attributes.title: Italics
attributes.description: Specifies whether a run of text is formatted as italic text.

attributes.name: kern
attributes.title: Kerning
attributes.description: Specifies the minimum font size at which character kerning occurs for this text run.

attributes.name: kumimoji
attributes.title: Kumimoji
attributes.description: Specifies whether the numbers contained within vertical text continue vertically with the text or whether they are to be displayed horizontally while the surrounding characters continue in a vertical fashion.

attributes.name: lang
attributes.title: Language ID
attributes.description: Specifies the language to be used when the generating application is displaying the user interface controls.

attributes.name: noProof
attributes.title: No Proofing
attributes.description: Specifies that a run of text has been selected by the user to not be checked for mistakes.

attributes.name: normalizeH
attributes.title: Normalize Heights
attributes.description: Specifies the normalization of height that is to be applied to the text run.

attributes.name: smtClean
attributes.title: SmartTag Clean
attributes.description: Specifies whether or not a text run has been checked for smart tags.

attributes.name: smtId
attributes.title: SmartTag ID
attributes.description: Specifies a smart tag identifier for a run of text.

attributes.name: spc
attributes.title: Spacing
attributes.description: Specifies the spacing between characters within a text run.

attributes.name: strike
attributes.title: Strikethrough

attributes.name: sz

attributes.name: u
attributes.title: Underline

entries.name: fld
entries.title: Text Field
entries.description: This element specifies a text field which contains generated text that the application should update periodically. Each piece of text when it is generated is given a unique identification number that is used to refer to a specific field. At the time of creation the text field indicates the kind of text that should be used to update this field.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Field ID
attributes.description: Specifies the unique to this document, host specified token that is used to identify the field.

attributes.name: type
attributes.title: Field Type
attributes.description: Specifies the type of text that should be used to update this text field.

entries.name: lnSpc
entries.title: Line Spacing
entries.description: This element specifies the vertical line spacing that is to be used within a paragraph. This can be specified in two different ways, percentage spacing and font point spacing. If this element is omitted then the spacing between two lines of text should be determined by the point size of the largest piece of text within a line.

entries.name: p
entries.title: Text Paragraphs
entries.description: This element specifies the presence of a paragraph of text within the containing text body. The paragraph is the highest level text separation mechanism within a text body. A paragraph can contain text paragraph properties associated with the paragraph.

entries.name: pPr
entries.title: Text Paragraph Properties
entries.description: This element contains all paragraph level text properties for the containing paragraph. These paragraph properties should override any and all conflicting properties that are associated with the paragraph in question.

attributes.name: algn
attributes.title: Alignment
attributes.description: Specifies the alignment that is to be applied to the paragraph.

attributes.name: defTabSz
attributes.title: Default Tab Size
attributes.description: Specifies the default size for a tab character within this paragraph.

attributes.name: eaLnBrk
attributes.title: East Asian Line Break
attributes.description: Specifies whether an East Asian word can be broken in half and wrapped onto the next line without a hyphen being added.

attributes.name: fontAlgn
attributes.title: Font Alignment
attributes.description: Determines where vertically on a line of text the actual words are positioned.

attributes.name: hangingPunct
attributes.title: Hanging Punctuation
attributes.description: Specifies whether punctuation is to be forcefully laid out on a line of text or put on a different line of text.

attributes.name: indent
attributes.title: Indent
attributes.description: Specifies the indent size that is applied to the first line of text in the paragraph.

attributes.name: latinLnBrk
attributes.title: Latin Line Break
attributes.description: Specifies whether a Latin word can be broken in half and wrapped onto the next line without a hyphen being added.

attributes.name: lvl
attributes.title: Level
attributes.description: Specifies the particular level text properties that this paragraph follows.

attributes.name: marL
attributes.title: Left Margin
attributes.description: Specifies the left margin of the paragraph.

attributes.name: marR
attributes.title: Right Margin
attributes.description: Specifies the right margin of the paragraph.

attributes.name: rtl
attributes.title: Right To Left
attributes.description: Specifies whether the text is right-to-left or left-to-right in its flow direction.

This means that the values of the cs element (§21.1.2.3.1) shall be used to determine the font face.  Character Directionality Override – When the contents of this run are displayed, this property acts as a right-to-left override for characters which are classified as follows (using the Unicode Character

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: On/Off Value
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value for the property defined by the parent XML element.

entries.name: spcAft
entries.title: Space After
entries.description: This element specifies the amount of vertical white space that is present after a paragraph. This space is specified in either percentage or points via the child elements spcPct and spcPts.

entries.name: spcBef
entries.title: Space Before
entries.description: This element specifies the amount of vertical white space that is present before a paragraph. This space is specified in either percentage or points via the child elements spcPct and spcPts.

entries.name: spcPct
entries.title: Spacing Percent
entries.description: This element specifies the amount of white space that is to be used between lines and paragraphs in the form of a percentage of the text size. The text size that is used to calculate the spacing here is the text for each run, with the largest text size having precedence. That is if there is a run of text with 10 point font and within the same paragraph on the same line there is a run of text with a 12 point font size then the 12 point should be used to calculate the spacing to be used.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the percentage of the size that the white space should be.

entries.name: spcPts
entries.title: Spacing Points
entries.description: This element specifies the amount of white space that is to be used between lines and paragraphs in the form of a text point size. The size is specified using points where 100 is equal to 1 point font and 1200 is equal to 12 point.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the size of the white space in point size.

entries.name: tab
entries.title: Tab Stop
entries.description: This element specifies a single tab stop to be used on a line of text when there are one or more tab characters present within the text. When there is more than one present than they should be utilized in increasing position order which is specified via the pos attribute.

attributes.name: algn
attributes.title: Tab Alignment
attributes.description: Specifies the alignment that is to be applied to text using this tab stop.

attributes.name: pos
attributes.title: Tab Position
attributes.description: Specifies the position of the tab stop relative to the left margin.

entries.name: tabLst
entries.title: Tab List
entries.description: This element specifies the list of all tab stops that are to be used within a paragraph. These tabs should be used when describing any custom tab stops within the document. If these are not specified then the default tab stops of the generating application should be used.

entries.name: cs

entries.description: This element specifies that a complex script font be used for a specific run of text. This font is specified with a typeface attribute much like the others but is specifically classified as a complex script font.

attributes.name: i

attributes.name: kumimoji

entries.name: uFillTx
entries.title: Underline Fill Properties Follow Text
entries.description: This element specifies that the fill color of an underline for a run of text should be of the same color as the text run within which it is contained.

entries.name: uLn
entries.title: Underline Stroke
entries.description: This element specifies the properties for the stroke of the underline that is present within a run of text.

entries.name: buAutoNum
entries.title: Auto-Numbered Bullet
entries.description: This element specifies that automatic numbered bullet points should be applied to a paragraph. These are not just numbers used as bullet points but instead automatically assigned numbers that are based on both buAutoNum attributes and paragraph level.

attributes.name: startAt
attributes.title: Start Numbering At
attributes.description: Specifies the number that starts a given sequence of automatically numbered bullets.

attributes.name: type
attributes.title: Bullet Autonumbering Type
attributes.description: Specifies the numbering scheme that is to be used.

entries.name: buBlip

attributes.name: char

entries.name: cell3D
entries.title: Cell 3-D
entries.description: This element specifies a set of properties which dictate the 3-D appearance of a given cell in a table. Collectively, these properties are referred to as a cell 3-D. The application of these properties occurs on a per- cell basis in the table.

attributes.name: prstMaterial
attributes.title: Preset Material
attributes.description: Specifies a material type which is used to define the material characteristics of the cell.

entries.name: gridCol
entries.title: Table Grid Column
entries.description: This element specifies the width of a given column within a table. For each column in a table, there is an associated table grid column defining the width of the column.

attributes.name: w
attributes.title: Width
attributes.description: The width of the column in EMUs.

entries.name: header
entries.title: Header Cell Reference
entries.description: This element specifies a reference, using a unique identifier, to a table header cell that is associated with the current table cell. The identifier representing the reference shall be stored on this element’s val attribute and is used to reference the unique identifier value of a table header cell. The contents of the table header cell designated by a specific unique identifier shall be used as the table header information associated with the table cell that references that specific unique identifier.

entries.name: headers
entries.title: Header Cells Associated With Table Cell
entries.description: This element specifies the list of header cells, as specified by children header elements, that provide header information associated with the current table cell. Each header cell shall specify a unique identifier, as specified

entries.name: lnB
entries.title: Bottom Border Line Properties
entries.description: This element defines the line properties associated with the bottom border of a given cell.

attributes.name: w

entries.description: This element defines the line properties associated with the diagonal line from the bottom left corner of the cell to the top right corner.

entries.name: tableStyle
entries.title: Table Style
entries.description: This element specifies a particular table style. Fourteen elements make up the styling information of a given table style. These fourteen elements work together to provide visual formatting options for on/off states of the following toggles:  First row on/off - Associated element: firstRow  Last row on/off - Associated element: lastRow  First column on/off - Associated element: firstCol  Last column on/off - Associated element: lastCol  Row banding on/off - Associated elements: band1H, band2H  Column banding on/off - Associated elements: band1V, band2V The formatting associated with the wholeTbl element defines the table formatting when all options are off.

attributes.name: styleId
attributes.title: Style ID
attributes.description: Specifies a GUID identifying the table style in a unique manner.

attributes.name: styleName
attributes.title: Name
attributes.description: Specifies the name of the table style which can show up in the user interface identifying the style to a user.

entries.name: tableStyleId
entries.title: Table Style ID
entries.description: This element defines the table style which is currently applied to the table by referencing the styleId attribute of the tableStyle element.

entries.name: tbl
entries.title: Table
entries.description: This element is the root element for a table. Within this element is contained everything that one would need to define a table within DrawingML.

entries.name: tblGrid
entries.title: Table Grid
entries.description: This element defines a list of table column (§21.1.3.2) elements. There should be a table column (§21.1.3.2) element for every column held within the table.

entries.name: tblPr
entries.title: Table Properties
entries.description: This element defines the properties of a table on the whole. Within this element are many visual modifications that can be applied to the table.

attributes.name: bandCol
attributes.title: Banded Columns
attributes.description: Enables or disables the banded column formatting for a table style.

attributes.name: bandRow
attributes.title: Banded Rows
attributes.description: Enables or disables the banded row formatting for a table style.

attributes.name: firstCol
attributes.title: First Column
attributes.description: Enables or disables the first column formatting for a table style.

attributes.name: firstRow
attributes.title: First Row
attributes.description: Enables or disables the first row formatting for a table style.

attributes.name: lastCol
attributes.title: Last Column
attributes.description: Enables or disables the last column formatting for a table style.

attributes.name: lastRow
attributes.title: Last Row
attributes.description: Enables or disables the last row formatting for a table style.

attributes.name: rtl
attributes.title: Right-to-Left
attributes.description: Defines enables the right-to-left settings of a table.

entries.name: tc
entries.title: Table Cell
entries.description: This element defines a cell within the table. The table cell holds a text body that actually contains the data held within the cell along with the properties of the table cell which hold formatting options associated with the cell.

attributes.name: gridSpan
attributes.title: Grid Span
attributes.description: Specifies the number of columns that a merged cell spans.

attributes.name: hMerge
attributes.title: Horizontal Merge
attributes.description: When this attribute is set to 1 or true , then this table cell is to be merged with the previous horizontal table cell when the table is created.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Table Cell Identifier
attributes.description: Specifies a unique identifier for the current table cell.

attributes.name: rowSpan
attributes.title: Row Span
attributes.description: Specifies the number of rows that a merged cell spans.

attributes.name: vMerge
attributes.title: Vertical Merge
attributes.description: When this attribute is set to 1 or true , then this table cell is to be merged with the previous vertical table cell when the table is created.

entries.name: tcPr
entries.title: Table Cell Properties
entries.description: This element defines the formatting properties associated with a cell. The formatting options which are available to be adjusted range from the line types used for the borders to the cell fill to the margins associated with the layout of the text in the cell.

attributes.name: anchor
attributes.title: Anchor
attributes.description: Defines the alignment of the text vertically within the cell.

attributes.name: anchorCtr
attributes.title: Anchor Center
attributes.description: When this attribute is 1 or true , it modifies the anchor attribute.

attributes.name: horzOverflow
attributes.title: Horizontal Overflow
attributes.description: Specifies the clipping behavior of the cell.

attributes.name: marB
attributes.title: Bottom Margin
attributes.description: Specifies the bottom margin of the cell.

attributes.name: marL
attributes.title: Left Margin
attributes.description: This attribute specifies the left margin of the cell.

attributes.name: marR
attributes.title: Right Margin
attributes.description: This attribute specifies the right margin of the cell.

attributes.name: marT
attributes.title: Top Margin
attributes.description: This attribute specifies the top margin of the cell.

attributes.name: vert
attributes.title: Text Direction
attributes.description: Defines the text direction within the cell.

entries.name: tr
entries.title: Table Row
entries.description: This element defines a row in a table. A row as defined in a table is simply a listing of table cells (§21.1.3.16). There is a table row element defined for every row in the table.

attributes.name: h
attributes.title: Height
attributes.description: Defines the height of the row in the table.

entries.name: applyToEnd
entries.title: Apply to End
entries.description: This element specifies the picture shall be applied to the end of the point or series.

entries.name: applyToFront
entries.title: Apply To Front
entries.description: This element specifies the picture shall be applied to the front of the point or series.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Boolean Value
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value for the property defined by the parent XML element.

entries.name: applyToSides
entries.title: Apply To Sides
entries.description: This element specifies the picture shall be applied to the sides of the point or series.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Boolean Value
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value for the property defined by the parent XML element.

entries.name: area3DChart
entries.title: 3D Area Charts
entries.description: This element specifies the 3-D area series on this chart.

entries.name: areaChart
entries.title: Area Charts
entries.description: This element specifies the 2-D area series on this chart.

entries.name: auto
entries.title: Automatic Category Axis
entries.description: This element specifies that this axis is a date or text axis based on the data that is used for the axis labels, not a specific choice.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Boolean Value
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value for the property defined by the parent XML element.

entries.name: autoTitleDeleted
entries.title: Auto Title Is Deleted
entries.description: This element specifies the title shall not be shown for this chart.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Boolean Value
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value for the property defined by the parent XML element.

entries.name: autoUpdate
entries.title: Update Automatically
entries.description: This element specifies the external data is updated automatically when the document containing the chart is opened.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Boolean Value
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value for the property defined by the parent XML element.

entries.name: axId
entries.title: Axis ID
entries.description: When specified as a child element of valAx, dateAx, catAx, or serAx, this element specifies the identifier for the axis. When specified as a child element of a chart, this element specifies the identifier of an axis that defines the coordinate space of the chart.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Integer Value
attributes.description: Specifies that the contents of this attribute contain an integer number.

entries.name: axPos
entries.title: Axis Position
entries.description: This element specifies the position of the axis on the chart.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Axis Position Value
attributes.description: Specifies the position of the axis on the chart.

entries.name: backWall
entries.title: Back Wall
entries.description: This element specifies the back wall of the chart.

entries.name: backward
entries.title: Backward
entries.description: This element specifies the number of categories (or units on a scatter chart) that the trend line extends before the data for the series that is being trended. On scatter and non-scatter charts, the value shall be any non- negative value.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Floating Point Value
attributes.description: Specifies that the contents of this attribute contain a floating point number.

entries.name: bandFmt
entries.title: Band Format
entries.description: This element specifies the formatting band of a surface chart.

entries.name: bandFmts
entries.title: Band Formats
entries.description: This element contains a collection of formatting bands for a surface chart indexed from low to high.

entries.name: bar3DChart
entries.title: 3D Bar Charts
entries.description: This element contains the 3-D bar or column series on this chart.

entries.name: barChart
entries.title: Bar Charts
entries.description: This element contains the 2-D bar or column series on this chart.

entries.name: barDir
entries.title: Bar Direction
entries.description: This element specifies whether the series form a bar (horizontal) chart or a column (vertical) chart

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Bar Direction Value
attributes.description: Specifies the direction of the series.

entries.name: baseTimeUnit
entries.title: Base Time Unit
entries.description: This element specifies the smallest time unit that is represented on the date axis.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Time Unit Value
attributes.description: Specifies the time unit for the tick marks.

entries.name: bubble3D
entries.title: 3D Bubble
entries.description: This element specifies that the bubbles have a 3-D effect applied to them.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Boolean Value
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value for the property defined by the parent XML element.

entries.name: bubbleChart
entries.title: Bubble Charts
entries.description: This element contains the bubble series on this chart.

entries.name: bubbleScale
entries.title: Bubble Scale
entries.description: This element specifies the scale factor for the bubble chart. This element can be a percentage value from 0 to 300, corresponding to a percentage of the default size.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Bubble Scale Value
attributes.description: Specifies how to scale bubbles on a bubble chart.

entries.name: bubbleSize
entries.title: Bubble Size
entries.description: This element specifies the data for the sizes of the bubbles on the bubble chart.

entries.name: builtInUnit
entries.title: Built in Display Unit Value
entries.description: This element specifies the display unit is one of the built in values.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Built In Unit Value
attributes.description: Specifies the display unit scaling applied to the axis.

entries.name: cat
entries.title: Category Axis Data
entries.description: This element specifies the data used for the category axis.

entries.name: catAx
entries.title: Category Axis Data
entries.description: This element specifies the category axis of the chart.

entries.name: chart
entries.title: Reference to Chart Part
entries.description: This element specifies the chart.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Relationship Reference
attributes.description: Specifies the relationship ID for the relationship for this Chart or Chart Drawing part.

entries.name: chart
entries.title: Chart
entries.description: This element specifies the chart.

entries.name: chartObject
entries.title: Chart Object
entries.description: This element specifies that the chart cannot be edited by the user

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Boolean Value
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value for the property defined by the parent XML element.

entries.name: chartSpace
entries.title: Chart Space
entries.description: This element specifies overall settings for a single chart, and is the root node for the chart part.

entries.name: clrMapOvr
entries.title: Color Map Override
entries.description: This element represents color mapping information. It is used to override the applications color mapping if the user has selected keep source formatting after a copy-paste.

attributes.name: accent1
attributes.title: Accent 1

attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the accent 5 color.

attributes.name: accent6

attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the accent 6 color.

attributes.name: bg1

attributes.name: bg2

attributes.name: folHlink

attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the color for a followed hyperlink.

attributes.name: tx1

attributes.name: tx2

attributes.description: Specifies a color defined which is associated as the second text color.

entries.name: crossAx
entries.title: Crossing Axis ID
entries.description: This element specifies the ID of axis that this axis crosses. For instance, a category axis might cross a value axis, and the category axis's crossAx would contain the ID of the value axis.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Integer Value
attributes.description: Specifies that the contents of this attribute contain an integer number.

entries.name: crossBetween
entries.title: Cross Between
entries.description: This element specifies whether the value axis crosses the category axis between categories. If not specified, then the application should choose an appropriate behavior.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Cross Between Value
attributes.description: Specifies whether the value axis crosses the category axis between categories or on categories.

entries.name: crosses
entries.title: Crosses
entries.description: This element specifies how this axis crosses the perpendicular axis.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Crosses Value
attributes.description: Specifies where the axis crosses its perpendicular axis.

entries.name: crossesAt
entries.title: Crossing Value
entries.description: This element specifies where on the axis the perpendicular axis crosses. The units are dependent on the type of axis. When specified as a child element of valAx, the value is a decimal number on the value axis.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Floating Point Value
attributes.description: Specifies that the contents of this attribute contain a floating point number.

entries.name: custSplit
entries.title: Custom Split
entries.description: This element contains the custom split information for a pie-of-pie or bar-of-pie chart with a custom split.

entries.name: custUnit
entries.title: Custom Display Unit
entries.description: This element specifies a custom value for the display unit.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Floating Point Value
attributes.description: Specifies that the contents of this attribute contain a floating point number.

entries.name: data
entries.title: Data Cannot Be Changed
entries.description: This element specifies that the user cannot change the choice of data used for the chart

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Boolean Value
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value for the property defined by the parent XML element.

entries.name: date1904
entries.title: 1904 Date System
entries.description: This element specifies that the chart uses the 1904 date system. If the 1904 date system is used, then all dates and times shall be specified as a decimal number of days since Dec. 31, 1903. If the 1904 date system is not used, then all dates and times shall be specified as a decimal number of days since Dec. 31, 1899.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Boolean Value
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value for the property defined by the parent XML element.

entries.name: dateAx
entries.title: Date Axis
entries.description: This element specifies a date axis for the chart.

entries.name: delete
entries.title: Delete
entries.description: This element specifies that the chart element specified by its containing element shall be deleted from the chart. This should be set to true if the application adds these elements by default even after the user has specified that they should be removed from the chart.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Boolean Value
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value for the property defined by the parent XML element.

entries.name: depthPercent
entries.title: Depth Percent
entries.description: This element specifies the depth of a 3-D chart as a percentage of the chart width (between 20 and 2000 percent).

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Depth Percent Value
attributes.description: Specifies a percentage value for the property defined by the parent XML element.

entries.name: dispBlanksAs
entries.title: Display Blanks As
entries.description: This element specifies how blank cells shall be plotted on a chart .

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Display Blanks As Value
attributes.description: Specifies how blank cells are plotted on the chart.

entries.name: dispEq
entries.title: Display Equation
entries.description: This element specifies that the equation for the trendline is displayed on the chart (in the same label as the R- squared value).

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Boolean Value
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value for the property defined by the parent XML element.

entries.name: dispRSqr
entries.title: Display R Squared Value
entries.description: This element specifies that the R-squared value of the trendline is displayed on the chart (in the same label as the equation).

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Boolean Value
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value for the property defined by the parent XML element.

entries.name: dispUnits
entries.title: Display Units
entries.description: This element specifies the scaling value of the display units for the value axis.

entries.name: dispUnitsLbl
entries.title: Display Units Label
entries.description: This element specifies the display unit label for the value axis in the specified chart.

entries.name: dLbl
entries.title: Data Label
entries.description: This element specifies a data label.

entries.name: dLblPos
entries.title: Data Label Position
entries.description: This element specifies the position of the data label.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Data Label Position Value
attributes.description: Specifies how the data label is positioned on the chart.

entries.name: dLbls
entries.title: Data Labels
entries.description: This element serves as a root element that specifies the settings for the data labels for an entire series or the entire chart. It contains child elements that specify the specific formatting and positioning settings.

entries.name: doughnutChart
entries.title: Doughnut Charts
entries.description: This element contains the doughnut chart series.

entries.name: downBars
entries.title: Down Bars
entries.description: This element specifies the down bars.

entries.name: dPt
entries.title: Data Point
entries.description: This element specifies a single data point.

entries.name: dropLines
entries.title: Drop Lines
entries.description: This element specifies drop lines.

entries.name: dTable
entries.title: Data Table
entries.description: This element specifies a data table.

entries.name: errBars
entries.title: Error Bars
entries.description: This element specifies error bars. The errValType element controls whether the minus, plus, or val elements are used.

entries.name: errBarType
entries.title: Error Bar Type
entries.description: This element specifies the style of the error bars - positive, negative, or both.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Error Bar Type Value
attributes.description: Specifies the style of error bars.

entries.name: errDir
entries.title: Error Bar Direction
entries.description: This element specifies the direction of the error bars.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Error Bar Direction Value
attributes.description: Specifies the direction of the error bars.

entries.name: errValType
entries.title: Error Bar Value Type
entries.description: This element specifies the type of values used to determine the length of the error bars.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Error Bar Type Value
attributes.description: Specifies the type of values of the error bars.

entries.name: evenFooter
entries.title: Even Footer
entries.description: This element specifies the footer to use on even numbered pages. (See §18.3.1.38 for more information.) The possible values for this element are defined by the ST_Xstring simple type (§22.9.2.19).

attributes.name: xml:space
attributes.title: Content Contains Significant Whitespace
attributes.description: Specifies how white space should be handled for the contents of this element using the W3C space preservation rules.

entries.name: evenHeader
entries.title: Even Header
entries.description: This element specifies the header to use on even numbered pages. (See §18.3.1.39 for more information.) The possible values for this element are defined by the ST_Xstring simple type (§22.9.2.19).

attributes.name: xml:space
attributes.title: Content Contains Significant Whitespace
attributes.description: Specifies how white space should be handled for the contents of this element using the W3C space preservation rules.

entries.name: explosion
entries.title: Explosion
entries.description: This element specifies the amount the data point shall be moved from the center of the pie.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Integer Value
attributes.description: Specifies that the contents of this attribute contain an integer number.

entries.name: ext
entries.title: Extension
entries.description: This element specifies an extension that is used for future extensions to the current version of DrawingML. This allows for the specifying of currently unknown elements in the future that are used for later versions of generating applications.

attributes.name: uri
attributes.title: Uniform Resource Identifier
attributes.description: Specifies the URI, or uniform resource identifier that represents the data stored under this tag.

entries.name: externalData
entries.title: External Data Relationship
entries.description: This element specifies the relationship to the data for this chart. The data can be linked, pointing to a spreadsheet in another file. Or, the data can be embedded, contained in a separate part within the same xml package containing the chart.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Relationship Reference
attributes.description: Specifies the relationship ID for the relationship for this chart.

entries.name: extLst
entries.title: Chart Extensibility
entries.description: This element contains tags used for future extensibility of the file format.

entries.name: f
entries.title: Formula
entries.description: This element specifies a reference to source of the data contained in this chart. This shall be used by the spreadsheet application only. A presentation, or word processing application should use the externalData element.

entries.name: firstFooter
entries.title: First Footer
entries.description: This element specifies the footer to use on the first page. (See §18.3.1.41 for more information.) The possible values for this element are defined by the ST_Xstring simple type (§22.9.2.19).

attributes.name: xml:space
attributes.title: Content Contains Significant Whitespace
attributes.description: Specifies how white space should be handled for the contents of this element using the W3C space preservation rules.

entries.name: firstHeader
entries.title: First Header
entries.description: This element specifies the header to use on the first page. (See §18.3.1.42 for more information.) The possible values for this element are defined by the ST_Xstring simple type (§22.9.2.19).

attributes.name: xml:space
attributes.title: Content Contains Significant Whitespace
attributes.description: Specifies how white space should be handled for the contents of this element using the W3C space preservation rules.

entries.name: firstSliceAng
entries.title: First Slice Angle
entries.description: This element specifies the angle of the first pie or doughnut chart slice, in degrees (clockwise from up).

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: First Slice Angle Value
attributes.description: Specifies the angle of the first slice.

entries.name: floor
entries.title: Floor
entries.description: This element specifies the floor of a 3D chart.

entries.name: fmtId
entries.title: Format ID
entries.description: This element represents a pivot format ID. It serves as a link back to the correct pivotTable which in turn specifies a link that then defines which set of chart format rules apply to this chart. This ID shall match the chartFormat element, chart attribute, described in §18.10.1.12 of the SpreadsheetML reference material.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Integer Value
attributes.description: Specifies that the contents of this attribute contain an integer number.

entries.name: formatCode
entries.title: Format Code
entries.description: This element specifies a string representing the format code to apply. For more information see the SpreadsheetML numFmt element's (§18.8.30) formatCode attribute. The possible values for this element are defined by the ST_Xstring simple type (§22.9.2.19).

entries.name: formatting
entries.title: Formatting
entries.description: This element specifies that a user cannot change formatting on chart elements.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Boolean Value
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value for the property defined by the parent XML element.

entries.name: forward
entries.title: Forward
entries.description: This element specifies the number of categories (or units on a scatter chart) that the trendline extends after the data for the series that is being trended. On scatter and non-scatter charts, the value shall be any non-negative value.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Floating Point Value
attributes.description: Specifies that the contents of this attribute contain a floating point number.

entries.name: gapDepth
entries.title: Gap Depth
entries.description: This element specifies the space between bar or column clusters, as a percentage of the bar or column width.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Gap Size Value
attributes.description: Specifies that the contents of this attribute contain a gap amount between 0% and 500%.

entries.name: gapWidth
entries.title: Gap Width
entries.description: This element specifies the space between bar or column clusters, as a percentage of the bar or column width.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Gap Size Value
attributes.description: Specifies that the contents of this attribute contain a gap amount between 0% and 500%.

entries.name: grouping
entries.title: Grouping
entries.description: This element specifies the kind of grouping for a column, line, or area chart.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Grouping Specifies the grouping value. Attributes Description Value
attributes.description: The possible values for this attribute are defined by the ST_Grouping simple type (§21.2.3.17).

entries.name: grouping
entries.title: Bar Grouping
entries.description: This element specifies the kind of grouping for a bar chart.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Bar Grouping Value
attributes.description: Specifies the bar grouping value.

entries.name: h
entries.title: Height
entries.description: This element specifies the height (if Height Mode is Factor) or bottom (if Height Mode is edge) of the chart element as a fraction of the height of the chart.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Floating Point Value
attributes.description: Specifies that the contents of this attribute contain a floating point number.

entries.name: headerFooter
entries.title: Header and Footer
entries.description: This element specifies the headers and footers that shall be used when the chart is printed. (See §18.3.1.46 for more information.)

attributes.name: alignWithMargins
attributes.title: Align With Margins
attributes.description: Specifies the header and footer should align with the left and right margins of the chart.

attributes.name: differentFirst
attributes.title: Different First
attributes.description: Specifies the header and footer are different for the first page.

attributes.name: differentOddEven
attributes.title: Different Odd Even
attributes.description: Specifies the header and footer are different on odd-numbered pages and even- numbered pages.

entries.name: hiLowLines
entries.title: High Low Lines
entries.description: This element specifies the high-low lines for the series.

entries.name: hMode
entries.title: Height Mode
entries.description: This element specifies how to interpret the Height element for this manual layout.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Layout Mode Value
attributes.description: Specifies the layout mode for the width.

entries.name: holeSize
entries.title: Hole Size
entries.description: This element specifies the size of the hole in a doughnut chart group.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Hole Size Value
attributes.description: Specifies that the contents of this attribute contain a hole size between 10% and 90% of the size of the plot area.

entries.name: hPercent
entries.title: Height Percent
entries.description: This element specifies the height of a 3-D chart as a percentage of the chart width.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Height Percent Value
attributes.description: Specifies that the contents of this attribute contain a height percent between 5% and 500%.

entries.name: idx
