entries.description: This element specifies the index of the containing element. This index shall determine which of the parent's children collection this element applies to.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Integer Value
attributes.description: Specifies that the contents of this attribute contain an integer number.

entries.name: intercept
entries.title: Intercept
entries.description: This element specifies the value where the trendline shall cross the y axis. This property shall be supported only when the trendline type is exp, linear, or poly.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Floating Point Value
attributes.description: Specifies that the contents of this attribute contain a floating point number.

entries.name: invertIfNegative
entries.title: Invert if Negative
entries.description: This element specifies the parent element shall invert its colors if the value is negative.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Boolean Value
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value for the property defined by the parent XML element.

entries.name: lang
entries.title: Editing Language
entries.description: This element specifies the primary editing language which was use when this chart was last modified.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Language Code
attributes.description: Specifies a language tag as defined by RFC 3066.

entries.name: layout
entries.title: Layout
entries.description: This element specifies how the chart element is placed on the chart.

entries.name: layoutTarget
entries.title: Layout Target
entries.description: This element specifies whether to layout the plot area by its inside (not including axis and axis labels) or outside (including axis and axis labels).

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Layout Target Value
attributes.description: Specifies the layout target value.

entries.name: lblAlgn
entries.title: Label Alignment
entries.description: This element specifies the text alignment for the tick labels on the axis.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Label Alignment Value
attributes.description: Specifies the label alignment.

entries.name: lblOffset
entries.title: Label Offset
entries.description: This element specifies the distance of labels from the axis.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Label Offset Value
attributes.description: Specifies the distance of labels from the axis.

entries.name: leaderLines
entries.title: Leader Lines
entries.description: This element specifies the leader lines for data labels.

entries.name: legend
entries.title: Legend
entries.description: This element specifies the legend.

entries.name: legendEntry
entries.title: Legend Entry
entries.description: This element specifies a legend entry.

entries.name: legendPos
entries.title: Legend Position
entries.description: This element specifies the position of the legend.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Legend Position Value
attributes.description: Specifies the position of the legend.

entries.name: line3DChart
entries.title: 3D Line Charts
entries.description: This element contains the 3-D line chart series.

entries.name: lineChart
entries.title: Line Charts
entries.description: This element contains the 2-D line chart series.

entries.name: logBase
entries.title: Logarithmic Base
entries.description: This element specifies the logarithmic base for a logarithmic axis.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Logarithmic Base Value
attributes.description: Specifies the logarithmic base for a logarithmic axis.

entries.name: lvl
entries.title: Level
entries.description: This element specifies data for a single level of labels for a category axis.

entries.name: majorGridlines
entries.title: Major Gridlines
entries.description: This element specifies major gridlines.

entries.name: majorTickMark
entries.title: Major Tick Mark
entries.description: This element specifies the major tick marks.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Tick Mark Value
attributes.description: Specifies the major tick mark position.

entries.name: majorTimeUnit
entries.title: Major Time Unit
entries.description: This element specifies the time unit for major tick marks.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Time Unit Value
attributes.description: Specifies the time unit for the tick marks.

entries.name: majorUnit
entries.title: Major Unit
entries.description: This element specifies the distance between major ticks.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Major Unit Value
attributes.description: Specifies the distance between major ticks.

entries.name: manualLayout
entries.title: Manual Layout

entries.name: marker
entries.title: Show Marker
entries.description: This element is a Boolean that, when true, specifies that the marker shall be shown.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Boolean Value
attributes.description: Specifies a boolean value for the property defined by the parent XML element.

entries.name: marker
entries.title: Marker
entries.description: This element specifies a data marker.

entries.name: max
entries.title: Maximum
entries.description: This element specifies the maximum value of the axis.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Floating Point Value
attributes.description: Specifies that the contents of this attribute contain a floating point number.

entries.name: min
entries.title: Minimum
entries.description: This element specifies the minimum value of the axis.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Floating Point Value
attributes.description: Specifies that the contents of this attribute contain a floating point number.

entries.name: minorGridlines
entries.title: Minor Gridlines
entries.description: This element specifies the minor gridlines.

entries.name: minorTickMark
entries.title: Minor Tick Mark
entries.description: This element specifies the minor tick marks for the axis.

attributes.name: val

attributes.description: Specifies the minor tick mark position.

entries.name: minorTimeUnit
entries.title: Minor Time Unit
entries.description: This element specifies the time unit for the minor tick marks.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Time Unit Value
attributes.description: Specifies the time unit for the tick marks.

entries.name: minorUnit
entries.title: Minor Unit
entries.description: This element specifies the distance between minor tick marks.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Minor Unit Value
attributes.description: Specifies the distance between minor tick marks.

entries.name: multiLvlStrCache

entries.name: multiLvlStrRef
entries.title: Multi Level String Reference
entries.description: This element specifies a reference to data for the category axis with a cache of the last values used.

entries.name: name
entries.title: Trendline Name
entries.description: This element specifies the name of the trendline. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema string datatype.

entries.name: name
entries.title: Pivot Name
entries.description: This element specifies the name of the pivot table to get the data for the chart from.

entries.name: noEndCap
entries.title: No End Cap
entries.description: This element specifies an end cap is not drawn on the error bars.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Boolean Value

attributes.name: xml:space
attributes.title: Content Contains Significant Whitespace
attributes.description: Specifies how white space should be handled for the contents of this element using the W3C space preservation rules.

entries.name: ofPieType
entries.title: Pie of Pie or Bar of Pie Type

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Pie of Pie or Bar of Pie Type Value
attributes.description: Specifies the type of pie of pie or bar of pie chart.

entries.name: order

entries.description: This element specifies that other chart elements shall be allowed to overlap this chart element.

attributes.name: val

entries.name: pageMargins

attributes.name: footer
attributes.title: Footer
attributes.description: Specifies the footer margin in inches.

attributes.name: header

attributes.description: Specifies the header margin in inches.

attributes.name: l

attributes.name: r

attributes.description: Specifies the right page margin in inches.

attributes.name: t

entries.name: pageSetup
entries.title: Page Setup

attributes.name: blackAndWhite

attributes.name: copies

attributes.name: draft

attributes.name: firstPageNumber

attributes.name: horizontalDpi

attributes.name: orientation

values.title: Percentage
values.description: Specifies that the length of the error bars shall be Error Bar Value percent of the data.

values.name: stdDev
values.title: Standard Deviation
values.description: Specifies that the length of the error bars shall be Error Bar Value standard deviations of the data.

values.name: stdErr
values.title: Standard Error
values.description: Specifies that the length of the error bars shall be Error Bar Value standard errors of the data.

entries.name: ST_FirstSliceAng
entries.title: First Slice Angle
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain an integer between 0 and 360.

entries.name: ST_GapAmount
entries.title: Gap Amount
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain a percentage between 0% and 500%. This simple type is a union of the following types:  ST_GapAmountPercent simple type (§21.2.3.53).

entries.name: ST_Grouping
entries.title: Grouping
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible groupings for a bar chart.

values.name: percentStacked
values.title: 100% Stacked
values.description: Specifies that the chart series are drawn next to each other along the value axis and scaled to total 100%.

values.name: stacked
values.title: Stacked
values.description: Specifies that the chart series are drawn next to each other on the value axis.

values.name: standard
values.title: Standard
values.description: Specifies that the chart series are drawn on the value axis.

entries.name: ST_HoleSize
entries.title: Hole Size
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain a percentage between 1% and 90%. This simple type is a union of the following types:  ST_HoleSizePercent simple type (§21.2.3.55).

entries.name: ST_HPercent
entries.title: Height Percent
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain a percentage between 5% and 500%. This simple type is a union of the following types:  ST_HPercentWithSymbol simple type (§21.2.3.52).

entries.name: ST_LayoutMode
entries.title: Layout Mode
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible ways to store a chart element's position.

values.name: edge
values.title: Edge
values.description: Specifies that the Width or Height shall be interpreted as the Right or Bottom of the chart element.

values.name: factor
values.title: Factor
values.description: Specifies that the Width or Height shall be interpreted as the Width or Height of the chart element.

entries.name: ST_LayoutTarget
entries.title: Layout Target
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible ways to layout the plot area.

values.name: inner
values.title: Inner
values.description: Specifies that the plot area size shall determine the size of the plot area, not including the tick marks and axis labels.

values.name: outer
values.title: Outer
values.description: Specifies that the plot area size shall determine the size of the plot area, the tick marks, and the axis labels.

entries.name: ST_LblAlgn
entries.title: Label Alignment
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible ways to align the tick labels.

values.name: ctr
values.title: Center
values.description: Specifies that the text shall be centered.

values.name: l
values.title: Left
values.description: Specifies that the text shall be left justified.

values.name: r
values.title: Right
values.description: Specifies that the text shall be right justified.

entries.name: ST_LblOffset
entries.title: Label Offset
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain a percentage of the default value, between 0% and 1000%. This simple type is a union of the following types:  ST_LblOffsetPercent simple type (§21.2.3.56).

entries.name: ST_LegendPos
entries.title: Legend Position
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible positions for a legend.

values.name: b
values.title: Bottom
values.description: Specifies that the legend shall be drawn at the bottom of the chart.

values.name: l
values.title: Left
values.description: Specifies that the legend shall be drawn at the left of the chart.

values.name: r
values.title: Right
values.description: Specifies that the legend shall be drawn at the right of the chart.

values.name: t
values.title: Top
values.description: Specifies that the legend shall be drawn at the top of the chart.

values.name: tr
values.title: Top Right
values.description: Specifies that the legend shall be drawn at the top right of the chart.

entries.name: ST_LogBase
entries.title: Logarithmic Base
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain a floating point number greater than or equal to two.

entries.name: ST_MarkerSize
entries.title: Marker Size
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain an integer between 2 and 72, whose contents are a size in points.

entries.name: ST_MarkerStyle
entries.title: Marker Style
entries.description: This picture shows each of the marker styles. Black is used as the line color, while red is used as the fill color. The height of the dash and the dot are 1/5th of the height of the marker.

values.name: circle
values.title: Circle
values.description: Specifies a circle shall be drawn at each data point.

values.name: dash
values.title: Dash
values.description: Specifies a dash shall be drawn at each data point.

values.name: diamond
values.title: Diamond
values.description: Specifies a diamond shall be drawn at each data point.

values.name: dot
values.title: Dot
values.description: Specifies a dot shall be drawn at each data point.

values.name: none
values.title: None
values.description: Specifies nothing shall be drawn at each data point.

values.name: picture
values.title: Picture
values.description: Specifies a picture shall be drawn at each data point.

values.name: plus
values.title: Plus
values.description: Specifies a plus shall be drawn at each data point.

values.name: square
values.title: Square
values.description: Specifies a square shall be drawn at each data point.

values.name: star
values.title: Star
values.description: Specifies a star shall be drawn at each data point.

values.name: triangle
values.title: Triangle
values.description: Specifies a triangle shall be drawn at each data point. x (X) Specifies an X shall be drawn at each data point.

entries.name: ST_OfPieType
entries.title: Pie of Pie or Bar of Pie Type
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible modes of Pie of Pie or Bar of Pie charts.

values.name: bar
values.title: Bar
values.description: Specifies that the chart is a bar of pie chart, not a pie of pie chart.

values.name: pie
values.title: Pie
values.description: Specifies that the chart is pie of pie chart, not a bar of pie chart.

entries.name: ST_Order
entries.title: Order
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain an integer between 2 and 6, whose contents are the order of the trendline polynomial.

entries.name: ST_Orientation
entries.title: Orientation
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible ways to place a picture on a data point, series, wall, or floor.

values.name: maxMin
values.title: Maximum to Minimum
values.description: Specifies that the values on the axis shall be reversed so they go from maximum to minimum.

values.name: minMax
values.title: Minimum to Maximum
values.description: Specifies that the axis values shall be in the usual order, minimum to maximum.

entries.name: ST_Overlap
entries.title: Overlap
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain a percentage between -100% and 100%. This simple type is a union of the following types:  ST_OverlapPercent simple type (§21.2.3.57).

entries.name: ST_PageSetupOrientation
entries.title: Printed Page Orientation
entries.description: This simple type specifies the page orientation of the printed page(s) on which this chart shall appear.

values.name: default
values.title: Default Page Orientation
values.description: Specifies that the page orientation shall be the default orientation of the system.

values.name: landscape
values.title: Landscape Page
values.description: Specifies that the printed page shall have landscape orientation.

values.name: portrait
values.title: Portrait Page
values.description: Specifies that the printed page shall have portrait orientation.

entries.name: ST_Period
entries.title: Period
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain an integer greater than or equal to 2.

values.name: auto
values.title: Auto
values.description: Specifies an application-specific marker shall be drawn at each data point.

entries.name: ST_Perspective
entries.title: Perspective
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain an integer between 0 and 100, whose contents are a percentage.

entries.name: ST_PictureFormat
entries.title: Picture Format
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible ways to place a picture on a data point, series, wall, or floor.

values.name: stack
values.title: Stack
values.description: Specifies that the picture shall be stacked.

values.name: stackScale
values.title: Stack and Scale
values.description: Specifies that the picture shall be stacked after being scaled so that it's height is one Picture Stack Unit.

values.name: stretch
values.title: Stretch
values.description: Specifies that the picture shall be anisotropic stretched to fill the data point, series, wall or floor.

entries.name: ST_PictureStackUnit
entries.title: Picture Stack Unit
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain a floating point number greater than zero.

entries.name: ST_RadarStyle
entries.title: Radar Style
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible styles of radar chart.

values.name: filled
values.title: Filled
values.description: Specifies that the radar chart shall be filled and have lines but no markers.

values.name: marker
values.title: Marker
values.description: Specifies that the radar chart shall have lines and markers but no fill.

values.name: standard
values.title: Standard
values.description: Specifies that the radar chart shall have lines but no markers and no fill.

entries.name: ST_RotX
entries.title: X Rotation
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain an integer between -90 and 90, whose contents are an angle in degrees.

entries.name: ST_RotY
entries.title: Y Rotation
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain an integer between 0 and 360, whose contents are an angle in degrees.

entries.name: ST_ScatterStyle
entries.title: Scatter Style
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible styles of scatter chart.

values.name: line
values.title: Line
values.description: Specifies the points on the scatter chart shall be connected with straight lines but markers shall not be drawn.

values.name: lineMarker
values.title: Line with Markers
values.description: Specifies the points on the scatter chart shall be connected with straight lines and markers shall be drawn.

values.name: marker
values.title: Marker
values.description: Specifies the points on the scatter chart shall not be connected with lines and markers shall be drawn.

values.name: none
values.title: None
values.description: Specifies the points on the scatter chart shall not be connected with straight lines and markers shall not be drawn.

values.name: smooth
values.title: Smooth
values.description: Specifies the the points on the scatter chart shall be connected with smoothed lines and markers shall not be drawn.

values.name: smoothMarker
values.title: Smooth with Markers
values.description: Specifies the the points on the scatter chart shall be connected with smoothed lines and markers shall be drawn.

entries.name: ST_SecondPieSize
entries.title: Second Pie Size
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain a percentage between 5% and 200%, whose contents consist of a percentage. This simple type is a union of the following types:  ST_SecondPieSizePercent simple type (§21.2.3.55).

entries.name: ST_Shape
entries.title: Shape
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible shapes for a 3-D data marker.

values.name: box
values.title: Box
values.description: Specifies the chart shall be drawn with a box shape.

values.name: cone
values.title: Cone
values.description: Specifies the chart shall be drawn as a cone, with the base of the cone on the floor and the point of the cone at the top of the data marker.

values.name: coneToMax
values.title: Cone to Max
values.description: Specifies the chart shall be drawn with truncated cones such that the point of the cone would be the maximum data value.

values.name: cylinder
values.title: Cylinder
values.description: Specifies the chart shall be drawn as a cylinder.

values.name: pyramid
values.title: Pyramid
values.description: Specifies the chart shall be drawn as a rectangular pyramid, with the base of the pyramid on the floor and the point of the pyramid at the top of the data marker.

values.name: pyramidToMax
values.title: Pyramid to Maximum
values.description: Specifies the chart shall be drawn with truncated cones such that the point of the cone would be the maximum data value.

entries.name: ST_SizeRepresents
entries.title: Size Represents
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible ways to represent data as bubble chart sizes.

values.name: area
values.title: Bubble Size Represents Area
values.description: Specifies the area of the bubbles shall be proportional to the bubble size value.

values.name: w
values.title: Bubble Size Represents Width
values.description: Specifies the radius of the bubbles shall be proportional to the bubble size value.

entries.name: ST_Skip
entries.title: Skip
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain an integer greater than or equal to one.

entries.name: ST_SplitType
entries.title: Split Type
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible ways to split a pie of pie or bar of pie chart.

values.name: auto
values.title: Default Split
values.description: Specifies the data points shall be split using the default mechanism for this chart type.

values.name: cust
values.title: Custom Split
values.description: Specifies the data points shall be split between the pie and the second chart according to the Custom Split values.

values.name: percent
values.title: Split by Percentage
values.description: Specifies the data points shall be split between the pie and the second chart by putting the points with percentage less than Split Position percent in the second chart.

values.name: pos
values.title: Split by Position
values.description: Specifies the data points shall be split between the pie and the second chart by putting the last Split Position of the data points in the second chart

values.name: val
values.title: Split by Value
values.description: Specifies the data points shall be split between the pie and the second chart by putting the data points with Enumeration Value Description value less than Split Position in the second chart

entries.name: ST_Style
entries.title: Style
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain an integer between 1 and 48. The value determines the default formatting for all chart elements through the tables described below. The default font is the minor font as defined by the document’s theme.

entries.name: ST_TickLblPos
entries.title: Tick Label Position
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible positions for tick labels.

values.name: high
values.title: High
values.description: Specifies the axis labels shall be at the high end of the perpendicular axis.

values.name: low
values.title: Low
values.description: Specifies the axis labels shall be at the low end of the perpendicular axis.

values.name: nextTo
values.title: Next To
values.description: Specifies the axis labels shall be next to the axis.

values.name: none
values.title: None
values.description: Specifies the axis labels are not drawn.

entries.name: ST_TickMark
entries.title: Tick Mark
entries.description: This simple type specifies the possible positions for tick marks.

values.name: cross
values.title: Cross
values.description: Specifies the tick marks shall cross the axis.

values.name: in
values.title: Inside
values.description: Specifies the tick marks shall be inside the plot area.

values.name: none
values.title: None
values.description: Specifies there shall be no tick marks.

values.name: out
values.title: Outside
values.description: Specifies the tick marks shall be outside the plot area.

entries.name: ST_TimeUnit
entries.title: Time Unit
entries.description: This simple type specifies a unit of time.

values.name: days
values.title: Days
values.description: Specifies the chart data shall be shown in days.

values.name: months
values.title: Months
values.description: Specifies the chart data shall be shown in months.

values.name: years
values.title: Years
values.description: Specifies the chart data shall be shown in years.

entries.name: ST_TrendlineType
entries.title: Trendline Type
entries.description: This simple type specifies all styles of trendline which are available for series in a chart.

values.name: exp
values.title: Exponential
values.description: Specifies the trendline shall be an exponential curve in the form y = abx.

values.name: linear
values.title: Linear
values.description: Specifies the trendline shall be a line in the form y = mx + b.

values.name: log
values.title: Logarithmic
values.description: Specifies the trendline shall be a logarithmic curve in the form y = a log x + b, where log is the natural logarithm.

values.name: movingAvg
values.title: Moving Average
values.description: Specifies the trendline shall be a moving average of period Period.

values.name: poly
values.title: Polynomial
values.description: Specifies the trendline shall be a polynomial curve of order Order in the form y = ax6 + bx5+cx4 + dx3 + ex2 + fx + g.

values.name: power
values.title: Power
values.description: Specifies the trendline shall be a power curve in the form y = axb.

entries.name: ST_DepthPercentWithSymbol
entries.title: Depth Percent with Symbol
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain a percentage between 20% and 2000%. The simple type’s contents shall match the following regular expression pattern: 0*(([2-9][0-9])|([1-9][0-9][0-9])|(1[0-9][0-9][0-9])|2000)%.

entries.name: ST_HPercentWithSymbol
entries.title: Height Percent with Symbol
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain a percentage between 5% and 500%. The simple type’s contents shall match the following regular expression pattern: 0*(([5-9])|([1-9][0-9])|([1-4][0-9][0-9])|500)%.

entries.name: ST_GapAmountPercent
entries.title: Gap Amount Percentage
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain a percentage between 0% and 500%. The simple type’s contents shall match the following regular expression pattern: 0*(([0-9])|([1-9][0-9])|([1-4][0-9][0-9])|500)%.

entries.name: ST_SecondPieSizePercent
entries.title: Second Pie Size Percentage
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain a percentage between 5% and 200%. The simple type’s contents shall match the following regular expression pattern: 0* (([5-9])|([1-9][0-9])|(1[0-9][0-9])|200)%.

entries.name: ST_HoleSizePercent
entries.title: Hole Size Percentage
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain a percentage between 1% and 90%. The simple type’s contents shall match the following regular expression pattern: 0*([1-9]|([1-8][0-9])|90)%.

entries.name: ST_LblOffsetPercent
entries.title: Label Offset Percentage
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain a percentage between 0% and 1000%. The simple type’s contents shall match the following regular expression pattern: 0*(([0-9])|([1-9][0-9])|([1-9][0-9][0-9])|1000)%.

entries.name: ST_OverlapPercent
entries.title: Overlap Percentage
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain a percentage between -100% and 100%. The simple type’s contents shall match the following regular expression pattern: (-?0*(([0-9])|([1-9][0-9])|100))%.

entries.name: ST_BubbleScalePercent
entries.title: Bubble Scale Percentage
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain a percentage between 0% and 300%. The simple type’s contents shall match the following regular expression pattern: 0*(([0-9])|([1-9][0-9])|([1-2][0-9][0-9])|300)%.

entries.name: ST_Thickness
entries.title: Thickness Percentage
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain a percentage. This simple type is a union of the following types:  ST_ThicknessPercent simple type (§21.2.3.60).

entries.name: ST_ThicknessPercent
entries.title: Thickness Percentage
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain a percentage. The simple type’s contents shall match the following regular expression pattern: ([0-9]+)%.

entries.name: absSizeAnchor
entries.title: Absolute Anchor Shape Size
entries.description: This element specifies that the shape described here to reside within a chart should be sized based on relative anchor points. This is achieved via two elements. The from element specifies the top left corner of the shape bounding box in a RTL(right-to-left) implementation.

entries.name: blipFill
entries.title: Picture Fill
entries.description: This element specifies the kind of picture fill that the picture object has. Because a picture has a picture fill already by default, it is possible to have two fills specified for a picture object. An example of this is shown below.

attributes.name: dpi
attributes.title: DPI Setting
attributes.description: Specifies the DPI (dots per inch) used to calculate the size of the blip.

attributes.name: rotWithShape
attributes.title: Rotate With Shape
attributes.description: Specifies that the fill should rotate with the shape.

entries.name: cNvCxnSpPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Connection Shape Drawing Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the non-visual drawing properties for a connector shape. These non-visual properties are properties that the generating application would utilize when rendering the parent chart.

entries.name: cNvGraphicFramePr
entries.title: Non-Visual Graphic Frame Drawing Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the non-visual drawing properties for a graphic frame. These non-visual properties are properties that the generating application would utilize when rendering the chart.

entries.name: cNvGrpSpPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Group Shape Drawing Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the non-visual drawing properties for a group shape. These non-visual properties are properties that the generating application would utilize when rendering the chart.

entries.name: cNvPicPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Picture Drawing Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the non-visual properties for the picture canvas. These properties are to be used by the generating application to determine how certain properties are to be changed for the picture object in question.

attributes.name: current
attributes.title: smaller
attributes.description: size. end example] The possible values for this attribute are defined by the W3C XML Schema boolean datatype.

entries.name: cNvPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Drawing Properties
entries.description: This element specifies non-visual canvas properties. This allows for additional information that does not affect the appearance of the picture to be stored.

attributes.name: descr
attributes.title: Alternative Text for Object
attributes.description: Specifies alternative text for the current DrawingML object, for use by assistive technologies or applications which do not display the current object.

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.title: Hidden
attributes.description: Specifies whether this DrawingML object is displayed.

attributes.name: id
attributes.title: Unique Identifier
attributes.description: Specifies a unique identifier for the current DrawingML object within the current document.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Name
attributes.description: Specifies the name of the object.

attributes.name: title
attributes.title: Title
attributes.description: Specifies the title (caption) of the current DrawingML object.

entries.name: cNvSpPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Shape Drawing Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the non-visual drawing properties for a shape. These properties are to be used by the generating application to determine how the shape should be dealt with.

attributes.name: txBox
attributes.title: Text Box
attributes.description: Namespace: Specifies that the corresponding shape is a text box and thus should be treated as such by the generating application.

entries.name: cxnSp
entries.title: Connection Shape
entries.description: This element specifies a connection shape that is used to connect two sp elements. Once a connection is specified using a cxnSp, it is left to the generating application to determine the exact path the connector takes. That is the connector routing algorithm is left up to the generating application as the desired path might be different depending on the specific needs of the application.

attributes.name: fPublished
attributes.title: Publish to Server
attributes.description: Specifies whether the shape shall be published with the worksheet when sent to the spreadsheet server.

attributes.name: macro
attributes.title: Reference to Custom Function
attributes.description: This element specifies the custom function associated with the chart.

entries.name: ext
entries.title: Shape Extent
entries.description: This element describes the length and width properties for how far a drawing element should extend for.

attributes.name: cx
attributes.title: Extent Length
attributes.description: Specifies the length of the extents rectangle in EMUs.

attributes.name: cy
attributes.title: Extent Width
attributes.description: Specifies the width of the extents rectangle in EMUs.

entries.name: from
entries.title: Starting Anchor Point
entries.description: This element specifies the first anchor point for the drawing element. This is used to anchor the top and left sides of the shape within the chart. That is when the corresponding chart is adjusted, the shape is also adjusted.

entries.name: graphicFrame
entries.title: Graphic Frame
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of a graphics frame. This frame contains a graphic that was generated by an external source and needs a container in which to be displayed on the slide surface.

attributes.name: fPublished
attributes.title: Publish To Server
attributes.description: Specifies whether the shape shall be published with the worksheet when sent to the spreadsheet server.

attributes.name: macro
attributes.title: Reference to Custom Function
attributes.description: This element specifies the custom function associated with the chart.

entries.name: grpSp
entries.title: Group Shape
entries.description: This element specifies a group shape that represents many shapes grouped together. This shape is to be treated just as if it were a regular shape but instead of being described by a single geometry it is made up of all the shape geometries encompassed within it. Within a group shape each of the shapes that make up the group are specified just as they normally would.

entries.name: grpSpPr
entries.title: Group Shape Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the properties that are to be common across all of the shapes within the corresponding group. If there are any conflicting properties within the group shape properties and the individual shape properties then the individual shape properties should take precedence.

attributes.name: bwMode
attributes.title: Black and White Mode
attributes.description: Specifies that the group shape should be rendered using only black and white coloring.

entries.name: nvCxnSpPr
entries.title: Connector Non Visual Properties
entries.description: This element specifies all non-visual properties for a connection shape. This element is a container for the non- visual identification properties, shape properties and application properties that are to be associated with a connection shape. This allows for additional information that does not affect the appearance of the connection shape to be stored.

entries.name: nvGraphicFramePr
entries.title: Non-Visual Graphic Frame Properties
entries.description: This element specifies all non-visual properties for a graphic frame. This element is a container for the non-visual identification properties, shape properties and application properties that are to be associated with a graphic frame. This allows for additional information that does not affect the appearance of the graphic frame to be stored.

entries.name: nvGrpSpPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Group Shape Properties
entries.description: This element specifies all non-visual properties for a group shape. This element is a container for the non-visual identification properties, shape properties and application properties that are to be associated with a group shape. This allows for additional information that does not affect the appearance of the group shape to be stored.

entries.name: nvPicPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Picture Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the non visual properties for a picture. This allows for additional information that does not affect the appearance of the picture to be stored.

entries.name: nvSpPr
entries.title: Non-Visual Shape Properties
entries.description: This element specifies all non-visual properties for a shape. This element is a container for the non-visual identification properties, shape properties and application properties that are to be associated with a shape. This allows for additional information that does not affect the appearance of the shape to be stored.

entries.name: pic
entries.title: Picture
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of a picture object within the document.

attributes.name: fPublished
attributes.title: Publish to Server
attributes.description: Specifies whether the shape shall be published with the worksheet when sent to the spreadsheet server.

attributes.name: macro
attributes.title: Reference to Custom Function
attributes.description: This element specifies the custom function associated with the chart.

entries.name: relSizeAnchor
entries.title: Relative Anchor Shape Size
entries.description: This element specifies that the shape described here to reside within a chart should be sized based on relative anchor points. This is achieved via two elements. The from element specifies the top left corner of the shape bounding box in a RTL(right-to-left) implementation.

entries.name: sp
entries.title: Shape
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of a single shape. A shape can either be a preset or a custom geometry, defined using the DrawingML framework. In addition to geometry, each shape can have both visual and non- visual properties attached.

attributes.name: fLocksText
attributes.title: Lock Text
attributes.description: Specifies whether to allow for the editing of text within this shape when the worksheet on which the shape resides has been protected as defined by SpreadsheetML.

attributes.name: fPublished
attributes.title: Publish to Server
attributes.description: Specifies whether the shape shall be published with the worksheet when sent to the spreadsheet server.

attributes.name: macro
attributes.title: Reference to Custom Function
attributes.description: This element specifies the custom function associated with the chart.

attributes.name: textlink
attributes.title: Text Link
attributes.description: Specifies whether the text contained within this shape is linked to a cell within the spreadsheet.

entries.name: spPr
entries.title: Shape Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the visual shape properties that can be applied to a special shape such as a connector shape or picture. These are the same properties that are allowed to describe the visual properties of a shape but are used here to describe additional object-specific properties within a document. This allows for these shapes to have both the properties of a shape as well as specific properties that are unique to only them.

attributes.name: bwMode
attributes.title: Black and White Mode
attributes.description: Specifies that the picture should be rendered using only black and white coloring.

entries.name: style
entries.title: Shape Style
entries.description: The element specifies the style that is applied to a shape and the corresponding references for each of the style components such as lines and fills.

entries.name: to
entries.title: Ending Anchor Point
entries.description: This element specifies the second anchor point for the drawing element. This is used to anchor the bottom and right sides of the shape within the spreadsheet. That is when the corresponding chart is adjusted, the shape is also adjusted.

entries.name: txBody
entries.title: Shape Text Body
entries.description: This element specifies the existence of text to be contained within the corresponding shape. All visible text and visible text related properties are contained within this element. There can be multiple paragraphs and within paragraphs multiple runs of text.

entries.name: x
entries.title: Relative X Coordinate
entries.description: This element specifies the relative x coordinate that is used to define the percentage-based horizontal position for a shape within a chart drawing object. The coordinate boundaries are specified within the corresponding simple type listed below. The possible values for this element are defined by the ST_MarkerCoordinate simple type (§21.3.3.1).

entries.name: xfrm
entries.title: Graphic Frame Transform
entries.description: This element specifies a 2-D transform to be applied to a Graphic Frame.

attributes.name: flipH
attributes.title: Horizontal Flip
attributes.description: Specifies a horizontal flip.

attributes.name: flipV
attributes.title: Vertical Flip
attributes.description: Specifies a vertical flip.

attributes.name: rot
attributes.title: Rotation
attributes.description: Specifies the rotation of the Graphic Frame.

entries.name: y
entries.title: Relative Y Coordinate
entries.description: This element specifies the relative y coordinate that is used to define the percentage-based vertical position for a shape within a chart drawing object. The coordinate boundaries are specified within the corresponding simple type listed below. The possible values for this element are defined by the ST_MarkerCoordinate simple type (§21.3.3.1).

entries.name: ST_MarkerCoordinate
entries.title: Chart Marker Coordinate Value
entries.description: This simple type specifies the chart marker coordinate value. It is to be represented as a fractional position between 0.0 and 1.0 of the chart width or height with 0.0 being the left or top edge.

entries.name: adj
entries.title: Shape Adjust
entries.description: Shape adjust value. These can be used to modify the adjust handles supported on various auto shapes. It is only possible to set the initial value, not to modify it using constraints and rules.

attributes.name: idx
attributes.title: Adjust Handle Index
attributes.description: Adjust value index.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: An absolute value.

entries.name: adjLst
entries.title: Shape Adjust List
entries.description: This element is simply a list of shape adjusts.

entries.name: alg
entries.title: Algorithm
entries.description: The algorithm used by the containing layout node. The algorithm defines the behavior of the layout node along with the behavior and layout of the nested layout nodes.

attributes.name: rev
attributes.title: Revision Number
attributes.description: The revision number of an algorithm.

attributes.name: type
attributes.title: Algorithm Type
attributes.description: Specifies the algorithm type.

entries.name: cat
entries.title: Category
entries.description: This element specifies a category in the user interface where this layout definition displays to the user.

attributes.name: pri
attributes.title: Priority
attributes.description: The priority within the category for this diagram determines the order in which it displays in the user interface.

attributes.name: type
attributes.title: Category Type
attributes.description: Specifies the category type associated with the element.

entries.name: catLst
entries.title: Category List
entries.description: This element is simply a list of cat elements.

entries.name: choose
entries.title: Choose Element
entries.description: The choose element wraps if/else blocks into a choose block.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Name
attributes.description: A unique name associated with the choose statement.

entries.name: clrData
entries.title: Color Transform Sample Data
entries.description: This element defines the sample data that is to be used in the user interface controls regarding displaying color transforms for a given diagram. This sample data predefines a data model to be combined with a layout definition in order to create a diagram which a color transform can be applied and displayed to the user as an example of the color transform.

attributes.name: useDef
attributes.title: Use Default
attributes.description: If the value of this attribute is true, the data model defined in the clrData element is ignored and a default data model is used instead.

entries.name: constr
entries.title: Constraint
entries.description: This element is used to specify size, position of nodes, text values, and layout dependencies between nodes in a layout definition.

attributes.name: fact
attributes.title: Factor
attributes.description: Factor used in a reference constraint or a rule in order to modify a referenced value by the factor defined.

attributes.name: for
attributes.title: For
attributes.description: Specifies the axis of layout nodes to apply a constraint or rule to.

attributes.name: forName
attributes.title: For Name
attributes.description: Specifies the name of the layout node to apply a constraint or rule to.

attributes.name: op
attributes.title: Operator
attributes.description: The operator constraint used to evaluate the condition.

attributes.name: ptType
attributes.title: Data Point Type
attributes.description: Specifies the type of data point to select.

attributes.name: refFor
attributes.title: Reference For
attributes.description: The for value of the referenced constraint.

attributes.name: refForName
attributes.title: Reference For Name
attributes.description: The name of the layout node referenced by a reference constraint.

attributes.name: refPtType
attributes.title: Reference Point Type
attributes.description: The point type used int he referenced constraint.

attributes.name: refType
attributes.title: Reference Type
attributes.description: Specifies the type of a reference constraint.

attributes.name: type
attributes.title: Constraint Type
attributes.description: Specifies the constraint to apply to this layout node.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies an absolute value instead of reference another constraint.

entries.name: constrLst
entries.title: Constraint List
entries.description: This element is simply a list of constraints.

entries.name: dataModel
entries.title: Data Model
entries.description: The data for this instance of the diagram. Either a sample data model, or the data the user has entered.

entries.name: desc
entries.title: Description
entries.description: This element holds a description for a layout definition. The description can be used to describe the qualities associated with a particular layout definition.

attributes.name: lang
attributes.title: Language
attributes.description: The natural language of the title or description of this layout definition.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: The string which is used as the description of the layout definition.

entries.name: else
entries.title: Else
entries.description: This element is similar to an else statement in a programming language in that it wraps elements which are to be used when the if conditionals are not true.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Name
attributes.description: A unique name associated with the choose statement.

entries.name: extLst
entries.title: Extension List
entries.description: This element specifies an extension list, within which all future extensions are defined within ext elements. The extension list along with corresponding future extensions is used to extend the storage capabilities of the DrawingML framework. This allows for various new types of data to be stored natively within the existing diagram syntax.

entries.name: forEach
entries.title: For Each
entries.description: A looping structure, similar to a for loop in a programming language, which defines what data model points use this layout node.

attributes.name: axis
attributes.title: Axis
attributes.description: Specifies the axis on which to select data from the data model.

attributes.name: cnt
attributes.title: Count
attributes.description: Specifies the count of items to use in a data set.

attributes.name: hideLastTrans
attributes.title: Hide Last Transition
attributes.description: In algorithms that support transitions, this attribute specifies that the last transition is not rendered.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Name
attributes.description: A unique identifier for the layout node.

attributes.name: ptType
attributes.title: Data Point Type
attributes.description: Specifies the type of data point to select.

attributes.name: ref
attributes.title: Reference
attributes.description: When used on a for-each element, causes the specified for-each element to be used instead.

attributes.name: st
attributes.title: Start
attributes.description: Specifies where to start in a data set.

attributes.name: step
attributes.title: Step
attributes.description: Specifies the step to use in a data set.

entries.name: if
entries.title: If
entries.description: Like an if statement in a programming language, wraps elements which are to be used under the conditions defined by its attributes.

attributes.name: arg
attributes.title: Argument
attributes.description: Specifies the variable to use as part of the test in an if element.

attributes.name: axis
attributes.title: Axis
attributes.description: Specifies the axis on which to select data from the data model.

attributes.name: cnt
attributes.title: Count
attributes.description: Specifies the count of items to use in a data set.

attributes.name: func
attributes.title: Function
attributes.description: The function used to evaluate the if condition.

attributes.name: hideLastTrans
attributes.title: Hide Last Transition
attributes.description: In algorithms that support transitions, this attribute specifies that the last transition is not rendered.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Name
attributes.description: A unique identifier for the layout node.

attributes.name: op
attributes.title: Operator
attributes.description: The operator used to evaluate the condition.

attributes.name: ptType
attributes.title: Data Point Type
attributes.description: Specifies the type of data point to select.

attributes.name: st
attributes.title: Start
attributes.description: Specifies where to start in a data set.

attributes.name: step
attributes.title: Step
attributes.description: Specifies the step to use in a data set.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: An absolute value.

entries.name: layoutDef
entries.title: Layout Definition
entries.description: This element is the root element for defining a layout definition. The layout definition is defined through a set of nested layout nodes. The layout definition is responsible for defining the look of a diagram.

attributes.name: defStyle
attributes.title: Default Style
attributes.description: This attribute defines a reference to a default style which is to be applied to the diagram.

attributes.name: minVer
attributes.title: Minimum Version
attributes.description: Minimum product version that can support this layout definition.

attributes.name: uniqueId
attributes.title: Unique Identifier
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this layout definition.

entries.name: layoutDefHdr
entries.title: Layout Definition Header
entries.description: This element is the header information representing the minimum knowledge needed by an application to preload information about a layout definition. This preloading allows for the actual load of the layout definition to occur at a later time which helps with any performance concerns an application might have.

attributes.name: defStyle
attributes.title: Default Style
attributes.description: This attribute defines a reference to a default style which is to be applied to the diagram.

attributes.name: minVer
attributes.title: Minimum Version
attributes.description: Minimum product version that can support this Diagram Layout.

attributes.name: resId
attributes.title: Resource Identifier
attributes.description: Resource ID used internally.

attributes.name: uniqueId
attributes.title: Unique Identifier
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this layout definition.

entries.name: layoutDefHdrLst
entries.title: Diagram Layout Header List
entries.description: This element is simply a list of layout definition headers. This list of headers is used internally as a way to group all of the layout definition headers together into a single structure.

entries.name: layoutNode
entries.title: Layout Node
entries.description: The layout node is the basic building block of diagrams. The layout node is responsible for defining how shapes are arranged in a diagram and how the data maps to a particular shape in a diagram.

attributes.name: chOrder
attributes.title: Child Order
attributes.description: Specifes the ordering of the child layout nodes for a given layout node.

attributes.name: moveWith
attributes.title: Move With
attributes.description: Reference to another layout node that this layout node moves with.

attributes.name: name
attributes.title: Name
attributes.description: A unique identifier for the layout node.

attributes.name: styleLbl
attributes.title: Style Label
attributes.description: Specify which formatting option from a style or color variation should be applied to this layout node.

entries.name: param
entries.title: Parameter
entries.description: The parameter element modifies the default behavior of an algorithm.

attributes.name: type
attributes.title: Parameter Type
attributes.description: Specifies the parameter which is being modified.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the actual value to be given to the parameter type defined by the type attribute.

entries.name: presOf
entries.title: Presentation Of
entries.description: This element specifies a particular data model point which is to be mapped to the containing layout node. This attribute is responsible for defining the mapping of data to the layout nodes in a diagram.

attributes.name: axis
attributes.title: Axis
attributes.description: Specifies the axis on which to select data from the data model.

attributes.name: cnt
attributes.title: Count
attributes.description: Specifies the count of items to use in a data set.

attributes.name: hideLastTrans
attributes.title: Hide Last Transition
attributes.description: In algorithms that support transitions, this attribute specifies that the last transition is not rendered.

attributes.name: ptType
attributes.title: Data Point Type
attributes.description: Specifies the type of data point to select.

attributes.name: st
attributes.title: Start
attributes.description: Specifies where to start in a data set.

attributes.name: step
attributes.title: Step
attributes.description: Specifies the step to use in a data set.

entries.name: relIds
entries.title: Explicit Relationships to Diagram Parts
entries.description: This element specifies the relationship IDs used to explicitly reference each of the four constituent parts of a DrawingML diagram:  Diagram Colors (cs attribute)  Diagram Data (dm attribute)  Diagram Layout Definition (lo attribute)  Diagram Style (qs attribute)

attributes.name: cs
attributes.title: Explicit Relationship to Diagram Colors Part
attributes.description: Specifies the relationship ID for the explicit relationship to the Diagram Colors part used by this diagram.

attributes.name: dm
attributes.title: Explicit Relationship to Diagram Data Part
attributes.description: Specifies the relationship ID for the explicit relationship to the Diagram Data part used by this diagram.

attributes.name: lo
attributes.title: Explicit Relationship to Diagram Layout Definition Part
attributes.description: Specifies the relationship ID for the explicit relationship to the Diagram Layout Definition part used by this diagram.

attributes.name: qs
attributes.title: Explicit Relationship to Style Definition Part
attributes.description: Specifies the relationship ID for the explicit relationship to the Diagram Style part used by this diagram.

entries.name: resizeHandles
entries.title: Shape Resize Style
entries.description: This element defines the behavior when resizing shapes within a diagram. Because the size of the shape plays a large role in the overall layout of other nodes within the diagram, there are two ways resize can occur on a node.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Shape Resize Style Type
attributes.description: Specifies the behavior for a shape when resizing shapes within a diagram.

entries.name: rule
entries.title: Rule
entries.description: This element allows for a rule to be specified which changes the value of an existing constraint.

attributes.name: fact
attributes.title: Factor
attributes.description: Factor used in a reference constraint or a rule in order to modify a referenced value by the factor defined.

attributes.name: for
attributes.title: For
attributes.description: Specifies the axis of layout nodes to apply a constraint or rule to.

attributes.name: forName
attributes.title: For Name
attributes.description: Specifies the name of the layout node to apply a constraint or rule to.

attributes.name: max
attributes.title: Max Value
attributes.description: Sets the maximum value for a constraint so rules can no longer increase the constraint beyond that value.

attributes.name: ptType
attributes.title: Data Point Type
attributes.description: Specifies the type of data point to select.

attributes.name: type
attributes.title: Constraint Type
attributes.description: Specifies the constraint to apply to this layout node.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies an absolute value instead of reference another constraint.

entries.name: ruleLst
entries.title: Rule List
entries.description: This element is simply a list of rules. This element allows for a rule to be specified which changes the value of an existing constraint.

entries.name: sampData
entries.title: Sample Data
entries.description: This element defines the sample data model which is used to pre-populate a diagram with placeholder data in order for the diagram to display itself in the user interface which shows all of the available diagrams to a user.

attributes.name: useDef
attributes.title: Use Default
attributes.description: If the value of this attribute is true, the data model defined in the clrData element is ignored and a default data model is used instead.

entries.name: shape
entries.title: Shape
entries.description: The shape displayed by the containing layout node. Not all layout nodes display shapes.

attributes.name: blip
attributes.title: Relationship to Image Part
attributes.description: Specifies the relationship ID of the explicit relationship to an image which shall be used as the image for the contents of this shape.

attributes.name: blipPhldr
attributes.title: Image Placeholder
attributes.description: Specifies whether to use an image placeholder or not.

attributes.name: hideGeom
attributes.title: Hide Geometry
attributes.description: When set to "true", hides the geometry of the shape.

attributes.name: lkTxEntry
attributes.title: Prevent Text Editing
attributes.description: Prevents text editing on this shape.

attributes.name: rot
attributes.title: Rotation
attributes.description: Rotates the shape by the specified number of degrees.

attributes.name: type
attributes.title: Shape Type
attributes.description: Specifies the type of shape.

attributes.name: zOrderOff
attributes.title: Z-Order Offset
attributes.description: Offsets the shape from its default z-order stacking, which is based on the order the layout nodes appear in the XML.

entries.name: style
entries.title: Shape Style
entries.description: This element specifies the style information for a shape, as defined by its DrawingML child elements.

entries.name: styleData
entries.title: Style Data
entries.description: This element defines the style data model which is used to pre-populate a diagram with placeholder data in order for the diagram to display itself in the user interface which shows a quick style applied to the diagram.

attributes.name: useDef
attributes.title: Use Default
attributes.description: If the value of this attribute is true, the data model defined in the clrData element is ignored and a default data model is used instead.

entries.name: title
entries.title: Title
entries.description: Title of the Diagram Layout.

attributes.name: lang
attributes.title: Language
attributes.description: Specifies the language of the title or description of this layout definition.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Value
attributes.description: Specifies the title or description of this layout definition.

entries.name: varLst
entries.title: Variable List
entries.description: This element consists of a list of variables which interact with user interface components.

entries.name: bg
entries.title: Background Formatting
entries.description: This element defines formatting that can be applied to the background shape of the entire diagram. The background shape can hold formatting options just as a normal shape can hold within DrawingML.

entries.name: cxn
entries.title: Connection
entries.description: This element defines a connection between two points. A connection defines a relationship between two points in a diagram.

attributes.name: destId
attributes.title: Destination Identifier
attributes.description: The model identifier of the destination point for a connection.

attributes.name: destOrd
attributes.title: Destination Position
attributes.description: The relative position of the destination point among it's siblings.

attributes.name: modelId
attributes.title: Model Identifier
attributes.description: The unique identifier associated with this cxn.

attributes.name: presId
attributes.title: Presentation Identifier
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the layout associated to the cxn (only the active presentation (layout) is saved so all the presId's in the file should be the same).

attributes.name: sibTransId
attributes.title: Sibling Transition Identifier
attributes.description: The model identifier of the point representing the sibling transition.

attributes.name: srcId
attributes.title: Source Identifier
attributes.description: The model identifier of the source point for a connection.

attributes.name: srcOrd
attributes.title: Source Position
attributes.description: The relative position of the source point among it's siblings.

attributes.name: type
attributes.title: Point Type
attributes.description: The type of point, which corresponds to a connection in this case.

entries.name: cxnLst
entries.title: Connection List
entries.description: This element defines a group of connections. There can be a connection list defined for any data model which holds all of the connections between points defined in the diagram.

entries.name: prSet
entries.title: Property Set
entries.description: This element holds properties and customizations which are used throughout certain elements in DiagramML. The properties can be grouped into the following general categories:  Presentation Properties - presLayoutVars, style, presAssocId, presName, presStyleLbl, presStyleIdx, presStyleCnt  Document Properties - loTypeId, loCatId, qsTypeId, qaCatId, csTypeId, coherent3DOff  Semantic Element Properties - phldrT, phldr  Customization Properties - custAng, custFlipVert, custFlipHor, custSzX, custSzY, custScaleX, custScaleY, custT, custLinFactX, custLinFactY, custLinFactNeighborX, custLinFactNeighborY, custRadScaleRad,

attributes.name: coherent3DOff
attributes.title: Coherent 3D Behavior
attributes.description: Enables or disables the Coherent 3D behavior for styles that specify this property.

attributes.name: csCatId
attributes.title: Color Transform Category
attributes.description: This attribute specifies the identifier of the current color transform category.

attributes.name: csTypeId
attributes.title: Color Transform Type Identifier
attributes.description: This attribute specifies the identifier of the currently applied color transform.

attributes.name: custAng
attributes.title: Custom Rotation
attributes.description: Specifies the amount that rotation is customized by.

attributes.name: custFlipHor
attributes.title: Custom Horizontal Flip
attributes.description: Specifies if there is a custom horizontal flip applied.

attributes.name: custFlipVert
attributes.title: Custom Vertical Flip
attributes.description: Specifies if there is a custom vertical flip applied.

attributes.name: orX
attributes.title: Neighbor Offset Width
attributes.description: Specifies the percentage of the neighbor's width used for offsetting shape.

attributes.name: orY
attributes.title: Neighbor Offset Height
attributes.description: Specifies the percentage of the neighbor's height used for offsetting shape.

attributes.name: custLinFactX
attributes.title: Custom Factor Width
attributes.description: Specifies the percentage of the current shape width used for offsetting the shape.

attributes.name: custLinFactY
attributes.title: Custom Factor Height
attributes.description: Specifies the percentage of the current shape height used for offsetting the shape.

attributes.name: custRadScaleInc
attributes.title: Include Angle Scale
attributes.description: Specifies the amount that the include angle has been scaled by.

attributes.name: custRadScaleRad
attributes.title: Radius Scale
attributes.description: Specifies how much the radius has been scaled.

attributes.name: custScaleX
attributes.title: Width Scale
attributes.description: Specifies the amount that the width has been scaled by.

attributes.name: custScaleY
attributes.title: Height Scale
attributes.description: Specifies the amount that the height has been scaled by.

attributes.name: custSzX
attributes.title: Fixed Width Override
attributes.description: Specifies a fixed width override for a shape.

attributes.name: custSzY
attributes.title: Fixed Height Override
attributes.description: Specifies a fixed height override for a shape.

attributes.name: custT
attributes.title: Text Changed
attributes.description: Specifies if the text has been customized which allows layout to ignore automatic formatting options available to the text.

attributes.name: loCatId
attributes.title: Current Diagram Category
attributes.description: Specifies the current identifier of the layout category applied to the diagram.

attributes.name: loTypeId
attributes.title: Current Diagram Type
attributes.description: Specifies the identifier for the layout currently applied to the diagram.

attributes.name: phldr
attributes.title: Placeholder
attributes.description: Indicates that the point is a placeholder or sample item.

attributes.name: phldrT
attributes.title: Placeholder Text
attributes.description: The text used for display in the element if the placeholder flag is set to true.

attributes.name: presAssocID
attributes.title: Presentation Element Identifier
attributes.description: The point associated with this presentation element.

attributes.name: presName
attributes.title: Presentation Name
attributes.description: The layout node name of this presentation element.

attributes.name: presStyleCnt
attributes.title: Presentation Style Count
attributes.description: Specifies the layout node style count of this presentation element.

attributes.name: presStyleIdx
attributes.title: Presentation Style Index
attributes.description: Specifies the layout node style index of this presentation element.

attributes.name: presStyleLbl
attributes.title: Presentation Style Label
attributes.description: Specifies the layout node style label of this presentation element.

attributes.name: qsCatId
attributes.title: Current Style Category
attributes.description: Specifies the identifier of the category of the currently applied quick style.

attributes.name: qsTypeId
attributes.title: Current Style Type
attributes.description: Specifies the identifier of the currently applied quick style.

entries.name: pt
entries.title: Point
entries.description: This element defines a point in DiagramML. A point in DiagramML is defined to hold data associated with a particular point or node in a diagram. Transitions between nodes in a diagram along with the nodes themselves are defined as different types of points.

attributes.name: cxnId
attributes.title: Connection Identifier
attributes.description: The model identifier of the connection that represents the transition node.

attributes.name: modelId
attributes.title: Model Identifier
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the element within the data model.

attributes.name: type
attributes.title: Point Type
attributes.description: The type of point.

entries.name: ptLst
entries.title: Point List
entries.description: This element simply holds a list of points within the data model.

entries.name: spPr
entries.title: Shape Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the properties for a single shape in a diagram's data, as defined using DrawingML child elements.

attributes.name: bwMode
attributes.title: Black and White Mode
attributes.description: Specifies that the picture should be rendered using only black and white coloring.

entries.name: t
entries.title: Text Body
entries.description: Text body containing the default body, paragraph and character properties. There should be a signle paragraph and no text runs. Any runs in the first paragraph and paragraphs in addition to the first are ignored.

entries.name: whole
entries.title: Whole E2O Formatting
entries.description: Formatting that applies to the entire diagram object, and not just the background, includes line and effect properties.

entries.name: cat
entries.title: Color Transform Category
entries.description: This element specifies the category in the user interface that a color transform is to be displayed within.

attributes.name: pri
attributes.title: Priority
attributes.description: The priority within the category for this color variation determines the order in which it displays in the user interface.

attributes.name: type
attributes.title: Category Type
attributes.description: The category type used to organize the color transforms in the user interface.

entries.name: catLst
entries.title: Color Transform Category List
entries.description: This element defines a list of color transform categories. This list can be used to populate user interface components which could separate color transforms into categories.

entries.name: colorsDef
entries.title: Color Transform Definitions
entries.description: This element is the root element for color transforms. Held within this element are all of the available color transforms themselves along with other elements and attributes associated with defining the general color transform properties and attributes.

attributes.name: minVer
attributes.title: Minimum The minimum product version that can support this color transform. Attributes Description Version

attributes.name: uniqueId
attributes.title: Unique ID
attributes.description: A unique id associated with the color transform definition.

entries.name: colorsDefHdr
entries.title: Color Transform Definition Header
entries.description: This element specifies header information associated with a color transform definition. The header information is used by an application to preprocess required data in order to help with possible performance concerns associated with an initial full load of a color transform definition.

attributes.name: minVer
attributes.title: Minimum Version
attributes.description: The minimum product version that can support the associated color transform definition.

attributes.name: resId
attributes.title: Resource ID
attributes.description: This attribute is the id which associates this header to the actual color transform definition.

attributes.name: uniqueId
attributes.title: Unique ID
attributes.description: This attribute defines a unique identifier for the associated color transform definition.

entries.name: colorsDefHdrLst
entries.title: Color Transform Header List
entries.description: This element is simply a list of color transform definition headers and is used to consolidate multiple headers in a group.

entries.name: desc
entries.title: Description
entries.description: This element holds a description for a color definition. The description can be used to describe the qualities associated with a particular color transform definition.

attributes.name: lang
attributes.title: Language
attributes.description: The natural language of the color transform definition.

attributes.name: val
attributes.title: Description Value
attributes.description: The string which is used as the description of the color transform definition.

entries.name: effectClrLst
entries.title: Effect Color List
entries.description: This element defines a list of colors applied to effects within a color transform.

attributes.name: hueDir
attributes.title: Hue Direction
attributes.description: The direction around the color wheel the hue shift (if defined) occurs.

attributes.name: meth
attributes.title: Color Application Method Type
attributes.description: The method used to apply the color transform.

entries.name: fillClrLst
entries.title: Fill Color List
entries.description: This element defines a list of colors which are used as fill colors in the color transform. The fill colors define the color of the nodes in a diagram.

attributes.name: hueDir
attributes.title: Hue Direction
