entries.name: Application
entries.title: Application Name
entries.description: This element specifies the name of the application that created this document. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema string datatype.

entries.name: AppVersion
entries.title: Application Version
entries.description: This element specifies the version of the application which produced this document. The content of this element shall be of the form XX.YYYY where X and Y represent numerical values, or the document shall be considered non-conformant.

entries.name: Characters
entries.title: Total Number of Characters
entries.description: This element specifies the total number of characters in a document. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema int datatype.

entries.name: CharactersWithSpaces
entries.title: Number of Characters (With Spaces)
entries.description: This element specifies the last count of the number of characters (including spaces) in this document. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema int datatype.

entries.name: Company
entries.title: Name of Company
entries.description: This element specifies the name of a company associated with the document. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema string datatype.

entries.name: DigSig
entries.title: Digital Signature
entries.description: This element contains the signature of a digitally signed document.

entries.name: DocSecurity
entries.title: Document Security
entries.description: This metadata element specifies the security level of a document as a numeric value. Document security is defined as: DocSecurity Security Level 1 Document is password protected. 2 Document is recommended to be opened as read-only. 4 Document is enforced to be opened as read-only. 8 Document is locked for annotation.

entries.name: HeadingPairs
entries.title: Heading Pairs
entries.description: Heading pairs indicates the grouping of document parts and the number of parts in each group. These parts are not document parts but conceptual representations of document sections.

entries.name: HiddenSlides
entries.title: Number of Hidden Slides
entries.description: This element specifies the number of hidden slides in a presentation document. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema int datatype.

entries.name: HLinks
entries.title: Hyperlink List
entries.description: This element specifies the set of hyperlinks that were in this document when last saved.

entries.name: HyperlinkBase
entries.title: Relative Hyperlink Base
entries.description: This element specifies the base string used for evaluating relative hyperlinks in this document. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema string datatype.

entries.name: HyperlinksChanged
entries.title: Hyperlinks Changed
entries.description: This element specifies that one or more hyperlinks in this part were updated exclusively in this part by a producer. The next producer to open this document shall update the hyperlink relationships with the new hyperlinks specified in this part. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema boolean datatype.

entries.name: Lines
entries.title: Number of Lines
entries.description: This element specifies the total number of lines in a document when last saved by a conforming producer if applicable. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema int datatype.

entries.name: LinksUpToDate
entries.title: Links Up-to-Date
entries.description: This element indicates whether hyperlinks in a document are up-to-date. Set this element to TRUE to indicate that hyperlinks are updated. Set this element to FALSE to indicate that hyperlinks are outdated.

entries.name: Manager
entries.title: Name of Manager
entries.description: This element specifies the name of a supervisor associated with the document. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema string datatype.

entries.name: MMClips
entries.title: Total Number of Multimedia Clips
entries.description: This element specifies the total number of sound or video clips that are present in the document. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema int datatype.

entries.name: Notes
entries.title: Number of Slides Containing Notes
entries.description: This element specifies the number of slides in a presentation containing notes. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema int datatype.

entries.name: Pages
entries.title: Total Number of Pages
entries.description: This element specifies the total number of pages of a document if applicable. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema int datatype.

entries.name: Paragraphs
entries.title: Total Number of Paragraphs
entries.description: This element specifies the total number of paragraphs found in a document if applicable. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema int datatype.

entries.name: PresentationFormat
entries.title: Intended Format of Presentation
entries.description: This element specifies the intended format for a presentation document. For example, a presentation intended to be shown on video has PresentationFormat "Video". The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema string datatype.

entries.name: Properties
entries.title: Application Specific File Properties
entries.description: This element specifies the application properties of a document. For properties of type string, NCR escape format (_xHHHH_) is used for any invalid XML characters.

entries.name: ScaleCrop
entries.title: Thumbnail Display Mode
entries.description: This element indicates the display mode of the document thumbnail. Set this element to TRUE to enable scaling of the document thumbnail to the display. Set this element to FALSE to enable cropping of the document thumbnail to show only sections that fits the display.

entries.name: SharedDoc
entries.title: Shared Document
entries.description: This element indicates if this document is currently shared between multiple producers. If this element is set to TRUE, producers should take care when updating the document. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema boolean datatype.

entries.name: Slides
entries.title: Slides Metadata Element
entries.description: This element specifies the total number of slides in a presentation document. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema int datatype.

entries.name: Template
entries.title: Name of Document Template
entries.description: This element specifies the name of an external document template containing format and style information used to create the current document. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema string datatype.

entries.name: TitlesOfParts
entries.title: Part Titles
entries.description: This element specifies the title of each document. These parts are not document parts but conceptual representations of document sections.

entries.name: TotalTime
entries.title: Total Edit Time Metadata Element
entries.description: Total time that a document has been edited. The default time unit is minutes. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema int datatype.

entries.name: Words
entries.title: Word Count
entries.description: This element specifies the total number of words contained in a document when last saved. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema int datatype. 22.3 Custom Properties Custom properties enable users to define custom metadata properties through a set of well-defined data types. Custom properties are represented by property elements (§22.3.2.2) stored in the Custom File Properties part with:  Source Relationship: http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/customProperties  Content Type: application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.custom-properties+xml

entries.name: property
entries.title: Custom File Property
entries.description: End of informative text. 22.3.2 Elements This subclause specifies the set of elements that define this namespace:

entries.name: array
entries.title: Array
entries.description: The array element defines the array variant type. Array contents shall be of uniform type as specified by the baseType attribute. The contents of an array are defined using repeated child elements of the appropriate variant type.

attributes.name: baseType
attributes.title: Array Base Type
attributes.description: The baseType attribute specifies the base variant type of an array.

attributes.name: lBounds
attributes.title: Array Lower Bounds Attribute
attributes.description: The lBounds attribute specifies the lower bound of an array in the format: #, #, # … # where each # represents an integer.

attributes.name: uBounds
attributes.title: Array Upper Bounds Attribute
attributes.description: The uBounds attribute specifies the upper bound of an array in the format: #, #, # … # where each # represents an integer.

entries.name: blob
entries.title: Binary Blob
entries.description: This element specifies a base64 binary blob variant type. This type is defined as follows: a DWORD count of bytes, followed by that many bytes of data. The byte count does not include the four bytes for the length of the count itself; an empty blob member would have a count of zero, followed by zero bytes.

entries.name: bool
entries.title: Boolean
entries.description: This element specifies a Boolean variant type. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema boolean datatype.

entries.name: bstr
entries.title: Basic String
entries.description: This element defines a binary basic string variant type, which can store any valid Unicode character. Unicode characters that cannot be directly represented in XML as defined by the XML 1.0 specification, shall be escaped using the Unicode numerical character representation escape character format _xHHHH_, where H represents a hexadecimal character in the character's value. [Example: The Unicode character 8 is not permitted in an XML 1.0 document, so it shall be escaped as _x0008_. end example] To store the literal form of an escape sequence, the initial underscore shall itself be escaped (i.e. stored as _x005F_). [Example: The string literal _x0008_ would

entries.name: clsid
entries.title: Class ID
entries.description: This element specifies a class ID variant type. The value shall be a Globally Unique Identifier with format: {HHHHHHHH-HHHH-HHHH-HHHH-HHHHHHHH}. The possible values for this element are defined by the ST_Guid simple type (§22.9.2.4).

entries.name: cy
entries.title: Currency
entries.description: This element specifies a currency variant type with exactly four digits after the decimal point. The possible values for this element are defined by the ST_Cy simple type (§22.4.3.2).

entries.name: date
entries.title: Date and Time
entries.description: This element specifies a date variant type of type date-time as defined in RFC 3339. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema dateTime datatype.

entries.name: decimal
entries.title: Decimal
entries.description: This element specifies a decimal variant type. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema decimal datatype.

entries.name: empty
entries.title: Empty
entries.description: This element specifies an empty variant type. No values or child elements are allowed.

entries.name: error
entries.title: Error Status Code
entries.description: The error element specifies a 32-bit error status code variant type of the form 0xHHHHHHHH. Each H represents a hexadecimal digit. The possible values for this element are defined by the ST_Error simple type (§22.4.3.3).

entries.name: filetime
entries.title: File Time
entries.description: This element specifies a file-time variant type of type date-time as defined in RFC 3339. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema dateTime datatype.

entries.name: i1
entries.title: 1-Byte Signed Integer
entries.description: This element specifies a 1-byte signed integer variant type. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema byte datatype.

entries.name: i2
entries.title: 2-Byte Signed Integer
entries.description: This element specifies a 2-byte signed integer variant type. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema short datatype.

entries.name: i4
entries.title: 4-Byte Signed Integer
entries.description: This element specifies a 4-byte signed integer variant type. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema int datatype.

entries.name: i8
entries.title: 8-Byte Signed Integer
entries.description: This element specifies a 8-byte signed integer variant type. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema long datatype.

entries.name: int
entries.title: Integer
entries.description: This element specifies an integer variant type. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema int datatype.

entries.name: lpstr
entries.title: LPSTR
entries.description: This element specifies a string variant type. For all characters that cannot be represented in XML as defined by the XML 1.0 specification, the characters are escaped using the Unicode numerical character representation escape character format _xHHHH_, where H represents a hexadecimal character in the character's value.

entries.name: lpwstr
entries.title: LPWSTR
entries.description: This element specifies a string variant type. For all characters that cannot be represented in XML as defined by the XML 1.0 specification, the characters are escaped using the Unicode numerical character representation escape character format _xHHHH_, where H represents a hexadecimal character in the character's value.

entries.name: null
entries.title: Null
entries.description: This element specifies a null variant type.

entries.name: oblob
entries.title: Binary Blob Object
entries.description: This element specifies a base64 binary blob object variant type. This type is defined as follows: A blob member that contains a serialized object in the same representation that would appear in the ostream element. That is, a DWORD byte count (where the byte count does not include the size of itself) which is in the format of a class identifier followed by initialization data for that class.

entries.name: ostorage
entries.title: Binary Storage Object
entries.description: This element specifies a base64 binary storage object variant type. This type is defined as follows: Identical to the storage element, but indicates that the designated storage shall contain a loadable object. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema base64Binary datatype.

entries.name: ostream
entries.title: Binary Stream Object
entries.description: This element specifies a binary stream object variant type. This type is defined as follows: Identical to the definition of the stream element, but indicates that the stream contains a serialized object, which is a CLSID – see the ST_Guid simple type (§22.9.2.4) – followed by initialization data for the specified class. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema base64Binary datatype.

entries.name: r4
entries.title: 4-Byte Real Number
entries.description: This element specifies a 4-byte real number variant type. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema float datatype.

entries.name: r8
entries.title: 8-Byte Real Number
entries.description: This element specifies a 8-byte real number variant type. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema double datatype.

entries.name: storage
entries.title: Binary Storage
entries.description: This element specifies a binary storage variant type. This type is defined as follows: Contains the base64-encoded data for a structured storage. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema base64Binary datatype.

entries.name: stream
entries.title: Binary Stream
entries.description: This element specifies a binary stream variant type. This type is defined as follows: Contains the base64-encoded data for a structured storage stream. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema base64Binary datatype.

entries.name: ui1
entries.title: 1-Byte Unsigned Integer
entries.description: This element specifies a 1-byte unsigned integer variant type. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema unsignedByte datatype.

entries.name: ui2
entries.title: 2-Byte Unsigned Integer
entries.description: This element specifies a 2-byte unsigned integer variant type. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema unsignedShort datatype.

entries.name: ui4
entries.title: 4-Byte Unsigned Integer
entries.description: This element specifies a 4-byte unsigned integer variant type. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema unsignedInt datatype.

entries.name: ui8
entries.title: 8-Byte Unsigned Integer
entries.description: This element specifies a 8-byte unsigned integer variant type. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema unsignedLong datatype.

entries.name: uint
entries.title: Unsigned Integer
entries.description: This element specifies an unsigned integer variant type. The possible values for this element are defined by the W3C XML Schema unsignedInt datatype.

entries.name: variant
entries.title: Variant
entries.description: This element can contain exactly 1 child element of any variant type. This element is only valid as a child element of a vector or array variant type.

entries.name: vector
entries.title: Vector
entries.description: This element defines the vector variant type. Vector contents shall be of uniform type as specified by the baseType attribute. The contents of a vector are defined using repeated child elements of the appropriate variant type.

attributes.name: baseType

attributes.description: The baseType attribute specifies the base variant type of a vector.

attributes.name: size

attributes.description: Specifies the number of elements in the vector.

entries.name: vstream
entries.title: Binary Versioned Stream
entries.description: This element specifies a binary versioned stream variant type. This type is defined as follows: A stream element's content with a GUID version (the version attribute).

entries.name: ST_ArrayBaseType

attributes.name: itemID
attributes.title: Custom XML Data ID
attributes.description: Specifies a globally unique identifier (GUID) that uniquely identifies a single custom XML part within an Office Open XML document.

entries.name: schemaRef
entries.title: Associated XML Schema
entries.description: This element specifies a single XML schema that is associated with the custom XML data part. This XML schema is identified using its target namespace, and can be located via any means available to an application processing the contents of this file. If the custom XML part cannot be validated using the specified XML schema when it is opened, then this reference can be omitted when the file is subsequently saved.

attributes.name: uri
attributes.title: Target Namespace of Associated XML Schema
attributes.description: Specifies the target namespace for the XML Schema associated with this schema reference.

entries.name: schemaRefs
entries.title: Set of Associated XML Schemas
entries.description: This element specifies the set of XML schemas that are associated with the parent custom XML part. Any number of XML schemas can be referenced, and this collection of schemas shall then be used to validate the contents of the corresponding custom XML part. If this element is present, then the set of XML schemas provided within should be used to validate the contents of the corresponding custom XML part (including the explicit presence of no child elements to specify that no custom XML schemas should be used even if one is present).

entries.name: AbbreviatedCaseNumber
entries.title: Abbreviated Case Number
entries.description: This element describes the abbreviated form of a case number. Typically, this field is used in the Case source type.

entries.name: AlbumTitle
entries.title: Album Title
entries.description: This element specifies the title of an album. Typically, this field is used in the Sound recording source type.

entries.name: Artist
entries.title: Artist
entries.description: This element specifies the artist of the source. Typically, this field is used in the Art and Sound Recording source types. [Example:

entries.name: Author
entries.title: Contributors List
entries.description: This element specifies the contributors to the source. [Example: <b:Author> <b:Author> <b:NameList> <b:Person> <b:Last>Rothschiller</b:Last> <b:First>Chad</b:First> </b:Person> </b:NameList> </b:Author> <b:Editor> <b:NameList> <b:Person> <b:Last>Jaeschke</b:Last> <b:First>Rex</b:First> </b:Person> </b:NameList> </b:Editor>

entries.name: Author
entries.title: Author
entries.description: This element specifies the author of the source. [Example: <b:Author> <b:Author> <b:NameList> <b:Person> <b:Last>Jones</b:Last> <b:First>Brian</b:First> </b:Person> </b:NameList> </b:Author> </b:Author> end example]

attributes.name: xml:space
attributes.title: Content Contains Significant Whitespace
attributes.description: Specifies how white space should be handled for the contents of this element using the W3C space preservation rules.

entries.name: BookAuthor
entries.title: Book Author
entries.description: This element specifies the author of a book, when the primary author has authored the book section. For example, if person X writes a chapter in a book by person Y, person X is the Author and person Y is the BookAuthor. [Example: <b:Author> <b:BookAuthor> <b:NameList> <b:Person> <b:Last>Rothschiller</b:Last> <b:First>Chad</b:First> </b:Person> </b:NameList> </b:BookAuthor> </b:Author> end example]

entries.name: BookTitle
entries.title: Book Title
entries.description: This element specifies the title of a book, when the source is a book section. In this case, the title of the book section is the primary title. For example, if X is the title of a chapter in a book entitled , X is the Title and Y is the BookTitle. [Example: <b:Source> … <b:Year>1992</b:Year> <b:City>Paris</b:City> <b:Publisher>Publisher</b:Publisher> <b:Pages>51-84</b:Pages> <b:Comments>Comments</b:Comments> <b:BookTitle>Book Title</b:BookTitle> </b:Source> end example] The possible values for this element are defined by the ST_String simple type (§22.9.2.13).

entries.name: Broadcaster
entries.title: Broadcaster
entries.description: This element specifies the broadcaster of a source. Typically, this field is used in the Interview source type.

entries.name: BroadcastTitle
entries.title: Broadcast Title
entries.description: This element specifies the broadcast title of a source. Typically, this field is used in the Interview source type.

entries.name: CaseNumber
entries.title: Case Number
entries.description: This element specifies the case number of a source. Typically, this field is used in the Case source type.

entries.name: ChapterNumber
entries.title: Chapter Number
entries.description: This element specifies the number or index of the chapter being referenced. [Example: … <b:BookTitle>Title</b:BookTitle> <b:Pages>23-65</b:Pages> <b:Comments>Comments</b:Comments> <b:ChapterNumber>6</b:ChapterNumber> <b:RefOrder>1</b:RefOrder> … end example] The possible values for this element are defined by the ST_String simple type (§22.9.2.13).

entries.name: City
entries.title: City
entries.description: This element specifies the city in which the source was published, printed, or manufactured. [Example:

entries.name: Comments
entries.title: Comments
entries.description: This element specifies any additional comments about the source. The documentation style determines whether the comments appear in the bibliography. [Example: … <b:ShortTitle>Short Title</b:ShortTitle> <b:Comments>Comments</b:Comments> <b:RefOrder>2</b:RefOrder> … end example] The possible values for this element are defined by the ST_String simple type (§22.9.2.13).

entries.name: Compiler
entries.title: Compiler
entries.description: This element specifies the person who compiled the information in a source. [Example: <b:Author> <b:Compiler> <b:NameList> <b:Person> <b:Last>Jones</b:Last> <b:First>Brian</b:First> </b:Person> </b:NameList> </b:Compiler> </b:Author> end example]

entries.name: ST_Guid
entries.title: 128-Bit GUID
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its values shall be a 128-bit globally unique identifier (GUID) value.

entries.name: ST_HexColorRGB
entries.title: Hexadecimal Color Value
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents shall contain a color value in RRGGBB hexadecimal format, specified using six hexadecimal digits. Each of the red, green, and blue color values, from 0-255, is encoded as two hexadecimal digits.

entries.name: ST_Lang
entries.title: Language Reference
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contains a language identifier as defined by RFC 4646/BCP 47. The contents of this language are interpreted based on the context of the parent XML element.

entries.name: ST_OnOff
entries.title: On/Off Value
entries.description: This simple type specifies a set of values for any binary (true or false) property defined in a WordprocessingML document. A value of 1 or true specifies that the property shall be turned on. This is the default value for this attribute, and is implied when the parent element is present, but this attribute is omitted.

entries.name: ST_Panose
entries.title: Panose-1 Number
entries.description: This simple type specifies a Panose-1 font classification. This value is used as one piece of information to guide selection of a similar alternate font if the desired font is unavailable. [Guidance: ISO/IEC 14496-22 refers to the Panose specification dated 1997, but some implementations of ECMA-376 may follow an older precursor version of the Panose specification. Some values between the two versions are incompatible and the handling of these differences is implementation-defined.

entries.name: ST_Percentage
entries.title: Percentage Value with Sign
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents will contain a percentage measurement, with a trailing percent sign (U+0025).

entries.name: ST_PositiveFixedPercentage
entries.title: Positive Fixed Percentage Value with Sign
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents will contain a positive percentage measurement from 0% to 100% inclusive, including a trailing percent sign (U+0025).

entries.name: ST_PositivePercentage
entries.title: Positive Percentage Value with Sign
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents will contain a positive percentage measurement, including a trailing percent sign (U+0025).

entries.name: ST_PositiveUniversalMeasure
entries.title: Positive Universal Measurement
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents will contain a measurement expressed using one of common measure units. The content of this type is a positive decimal number immediately followed by a unit identifier. Unit identifiers are case sensitive and shall be in lowercase.

entries.name: ST_String
entries.title: String
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contains a string.

entries.name: ST_TwipsMeasure
entries.title: Measurement in Twentieths of a Point
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain wither:  A positive whole number, whose contents consist of a measurement in twentieths of a point (equivalent to 1/1440th of an inch), or  A positive decimal number immediately following by a unit identifier. The contents of this measurement are interpreted based on the context of the parent XML element.

entries.name: ST_UniversalMeasure
entries.title: Universal Measurement
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents will contain measurement expressed using one of common measure units. The content of this type is a decimal number immediately followed by a unit identifier. Unit identifiers are case sensitive and shall be in lowercase.

entries.name: ST_UnsignedDecimalNumber
entries.title: Unsigned Decimal Number Value
entries.description: This simple type specifies that its contents contain a positive whole decimal number, whose contents are interpreted based on the context of the parent XML element.

entries.name: ST_VerticalAlignRun
entries.title: Vertical Positioning Location
entries.description: This simple type specifies possible values for the alignment of the contents of this run in relation to the default appearance of the run's text. This allows the text to be repositioned as subscript or superscript without altering the font size of the run properties.

values.name: baseline
values.title: Regular Vertical Positioning
values.description: Specifies that the text in the parent run shall be located at the baseline and presented in the same size as surrounding text.

values.name: subscript
values.title: Subscript
values.description: Specifies that this text should be subscript.

values.name: superscript
values.title: Superscript
values.description: Specifies that this text should be superscript.

entries.name: ST_XAlign
entries.title: Horizontal Alignment Location
entries.description: This simple type specifies the set of possible relative horizontal positions for the parent floating object. This relative position is specified relative to the horizontal anchor specified by the parent object.

values.name: center
values.title: Centered Horizontally
values.description: Specifies that the parent object shall be centered with respect to the anchor settings.

values.name: inside
values.title: Inside
values.description: Specifies that the parent object shall be inside of the anchor object.

values.name: left
values.title: Left Aligned Horizontally
values.description: Specifies that the parent object shall be left aligned with respect to the anchor settings.

values.name: outside
values.title: Outside
values.description: Specifies that the parent object shall be outside of the anchor object.

values.name: right
values.title: Right Aligned Horizontally
values.description: Specifies that the parent object shall be right aligned with respect to the anchor settings.

entries.name: ST_Xstring
entries.title: Escaped String
entries.description: String of characters with support for escaped invalid-XML characters. For all characters which cannot be represented in XML as defined by the XML 1.0 specification, the characters are escaped using the Unicode numerical character representation escape character format _xHHHH_, where H represents a hexadecimal character in the character's value. [Example: The Unicode character 8 is not permitted in an XML 1.0 document, so it must be escaped as _x0008_. end example]

entries.name: ST_YAlign
entries.title: Vertical Alignment Location
entries.description: This simple type specifies the set of possible relative vertical positions for the parent floating object. This relative position is specified relative to the vertical anchor specified by the parent object.

values.name: bottom
values.title: Bottom
values.description: Specifies that the parent object shall be vertically aligned to the bottom edge of the anchor object.

values.name: center
values.title: Centered Vertically
values.description: Specifies that the parent object shall be vertically centered with respect to the anchor object.

values.name: inline
values.title: In line With Text
values.description: Specifies that the parent object shall be vertically aligned in line with the surrounding text (i.e. shall not allow any text wrapping around it when positioned in the document.

values.name: inside
values.title: Inside Anchor Extents
values.description: Specifies that the parent object shall be vertically aligned to the edge of the anchor object, and positioned inside that object.

values.name: outside
values.title: Outside Anchor Extents
values.description: Specifies that the parent object shall be vertically aligned to the edge of the anchor object, and positioned outside that object.

values.name: top
values.title: Top
values.description: Specifies that the parent object shall be vertically aligned to the top edge of the anchor object .

entries.name: ST_XmlName
entries.title: XML Name
entries.description: This simple type shall contain an XML non-colonized name (NCName).

entries.name: schema
entries.title: Custom XML Schema Reference
entries.description: 23.2.2 schemaLibrary (Embedded Custom XML Schema Supplementary Data) ........................................ 3806

attributes.name: manifestLocation
attributes.title: Supplementary XML File Location
attributes.description: Specifies the location of a supplementary XML file that can be downloaded and parsed when this document is loaded in order to provide additional application-defined capabilities.

attributes.name: schemaLanguage
attributes.title: Schema Language
attributes.description: Specifies the media type or the root namespace of the schema language.

attributes.name: schemaLocation
attributes.title: Custom XML Schema Location
attributes.description: Specifies the location of the XML schema file which should be downloaded and parsed when this document is loaded.

attributes.name: uri
attributes.title: Custom XML Schema Namespace
attributes.description: Specifies the target namespace for the XML Schema associated with this schema reference.

entries.name: schemaLibrary
entries.title: Embedded Custom XML Schema Supplementary Data
entries.description: This element specifies the set of XML namespaces which have been associated with the contents of the custom XML markup within the current Office Open XML document. Each unique namespace which is referenced within the document can be referenced within this element by a single schema element, regardless of the number of constituent XML schemas which comprise that namespace. 23. Custom XML Schema References
